text_en: Adam , Seth, Enos,
text_la: Adam, Seth, Enos,
text_pt: Adão, Sete, Enos,
text_el: Αδαμ Σηθ Ενως

text_en: Cainan, Malaleel, Jared,
text_la: Cainan, Malaleel, Jared,
text_pt: Cainã, Maalaleel, Jerede,
text_el: Καιναν Μαλελεηλ Ιαρεδ

text_en: Henoc, Mathusale , Lamech,
text_la: Henoch, Mathusale, Lamech,
text_pt: Enoque, Matusalém, Lameque,
text_el: Ενωχ Μαθουσαλα Λαμεχ

text_en: Noe , Sem , Cham , and Japheth.
text_la: Noë, Sem, Cham, et Japtheth.
text_pt: Noé, Sem, Cão e Jafé.
text_el: Νωε υἱοὶ Νωε Σημ Χαμ Ιαφεθ

text_en: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog , and Madai , and Javan , Thubal, Mosoch, Thiras.
text_la: Filii Japheth : Gomer, et Magog, et Madai, et Javan, Thubal, Mosoch, Thiras.
text_pt: Os filhos de Jafé foram: Gomer, Magogue, Madai, Javã, Tubal, Meseque e Tiras.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ιαφεθ Γαμερ Μαγωγ Μαδαι Ιωυαν Ελισα Θοβελ Μοσοχ καὶ Θιρας

text_en: And the sons of Gomer: Ascenez, and Riphath, and Thogorma.
text_la: Porro filii Gomer : Ascenez, et Riphath, et Thogorma.
text_pt: E os filhos de Gomer: Asquenaz, Rifate, Togarma.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Γαμερ Ασχαναζ καὶ Ριφαθ καὶ Θοργαμα

text_en: And the sons of Javan : Elisa and Tharsis, Cethim and Dodanim .
text_la: Filii autem Javan : Elisa et Tharsis, Cethim et Dodanim.
text_pt: E os filhos de Javã: Elisá, Társis, Quitim e Dodanim.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιωυαν Ελισα καὶ Θαρσις Κίτιοι καὶ Ῥόδιοι

text_en: The sons of Cham : Chus , and Mesrai , and Phut, and Chanaan .
text_la: Filii Cham : Chus, et Mesraim, et Phut, et Chanaan.
text_pt: Os filhos de Cão: Cuxe, Mizraim, Pute e Canaã.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Χαμ Χους καὶ Μεστραιμ Φουδ καὶ Χανααν

text_en: And the sons of Chus : Saba, and Hevila, Sabatha, and Regma, and Sabathaca. And the sons of Regma: Saba , and Dadan.
text_la: Filii autem Chus : Saba, et Hevila, Sabatha, et Regma, et Sabathacha. Porro filii Regma : Saba, et Dadan.
text_pt: E os filhos de Cuxe eram: Sebá, Havilá, Sabtá, Raamá e Sabtecá; os filhos de Raamá: Sebá e Dedã.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Χους Σαβα καὶ Ευιλατ καὶ Σαβαθα καὶ Ρεγμα καὶ Σεβεκαθα καὶ υἱοὶ Ρεγμα Σαβα καὶ Ουδαδαν

text_en: Now Chus begot Nemrod : he began to be mighty upon earth.
text_la: Chus autem genuit Nemrod : iste cœpit esse potens in terra.
text_pt: E Cuxe gerou a Ninrode, que começou a ser poderoso na terra.
text_el: καὶ Χους ἐγέννησεν τὸν Νεβρωδ οὗτος ἤρξατο τοῦ εἶναι γίγας κυνηγὸς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: But Mesraim begot Ludim, and Anamim, and Laabim, and Nephtuim,
text_la: Mesraim vero genuit Ludim, et Anamim, et Laabim, et Nephtuim,
text_pt: E Mizraim gerou a Ludim e a Anamim e a Leabim e a Naftuim,

text_en: Phetrusim also, and Casluim: from whom came the Philistines , and Caphtorim.
text_la: Phetrusim quoque, et Casluim : de quibus egressi sunt Philisthiim, et Caphtorim.
text_pt: E a Patrusim e a Casluim (dos quais procedem os filisteus) e a Caftorim.

text_en: And Chanaan begot Sidon his firstborn , and the Hethite ,
text_la: Chanaan vero genuit Sidonem primogenitum suum, Hethæum quoque,
text_pt: E Canaã gerou a Sidom seu primogênito, e a Hete,

text_en: and the Jebusite, and the Amorrhite , and the Gergesite,
text_la: et Jebusæum, et Amorrhæum, et Gergesæum,
text_pt: E aos jebuseus e aos amorreus e aos girgaseus,

text_en: and the Hevite, and the Aracite, and the Sinite,
text_la: Hevæumque et Aracæum, et Sinæum.
text_pt: E aos heveus e aos arqueus e aos sineus,

text_en: and the Aradian, and the Samarite, and the Hamathite .
text_la: Aradium quoque, et Samaræum, et Hamathæum.
text_pt: E aos arvadeus e aos zemareus e aos hamateus.

text_en: The sons of Sem : Elam and Asur , and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Hus, and Hul, and Gether, and Mosoch.
text_la: Filii Sem : Ælam, et Assur, et Arphaxad, et Lud, et Aram, et Hus, et Hul, et Gether, et Mosoch.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Sem: Elão, Assur, Arfaxade, Lude, Arã, Uz, Hul, Geter e Meseque.
text_el: υἱοὶ Σημ Αιλαμ καὶ Ασσουρ καὶ Αρφαξαδ

text_en: And Arphaxad begot Sale, and Sale begot Heber.
text_la: Arphaxad autem genuit Sale, qui et ipse genuit Heber.
text_pt: E Arfaxade gerou a Selá e Selá gerou a Éber.

text_en: And to Heber were born two sons, the name of the one was Phaleg, because in his days the earth was divided; and the name of his brother was Jectan.
text_la: Porro Heber nati sunt duo filii : nomen uni Phaleg, quia in diebus ejus divisa est terra; et nomen fratris ejus Jectan.
text_pt: E a Éber nasceram dois filhos: o nome de um foi Pelegue, porquanto nos seus dias se repartiu a terra, e o nome de seu irmão era Joctã.

text_en: And Jectan begot Elmodad, and Saleph, and Asarmoth, and Jare,
text_la: Jectan autem genuit Elmodad, et Saleph, et Asarmoth, et Jare,
text_pt: E Joctã gerou a Almodá, a Selefe, a Hazarmavé, e a Jerá,

text_en: and Adoram, and Usal, and Decla,
text_la: Adoram quoque, et Huzal, et Decla,
text_pt: E a Hadorão, a Usal, e a Dicla,

text_en: and Hebal, and Abimael, and Saba ,
text_la: Hebal etiam, et Abimaël, et Saba, necnon
text_pt: E a Obal, a Abimael, a Sebá,

text_en: and Ophir , and Hevila, and Jobab. All these are the sons of Jectan.
text_la: et Ophir, et Hevila, et Jobab : omnes isti filii Jectan.
text_pt: E a Ofir, a Havilá, e a Jobabe: todos estes foram filhos de Joctã.

text_en: Sem , Arphaxad, Sale,
text_la: Sem, Arphaxad, Sale,
text_pt: Sem, Arfaxade, Selá,
text_el: Σαλα

text_en: Heber, Phaleg, Ragau,
text_la: Heber, Phaleg, Ragau,
text_pt: Éber, Pelegue, Reú,
text_el: Εβερ Φαλεκ Ραγαυ

text_en: Serug, Nachor, Thare,
text_la: Serug, Nachor, Thare,
text_pt: Serugue, Naor, Terá,
text_el: Σερουχ Ναχωρ Θαρα

text_en: Abram , this is Abraham .
text_la: Abram : iste est Abraham.
text_pt: Abrão, que é Abraão.
text_el: Αβρααμ

text_en: And the sons of Abraham , Isaac and Ismahel .
text_la: Filii autem Abraham, Isaac et Ismahel.
text_pt: Os filhos de Abraão foram: Isaque e Ismael.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Αβρααμ Ισαακ καὶ Ισμαηλ

text_en: And these are the generations of them. The firstborn of Ismahel , Nabajoth, then Cedar , and Adbeel, and Mabsam,
text_la: Et hæ generationes eorum. Primogenitus Ismahelis, Nabaioth, et Cedar, et Adbeel, et Mabsam,
text_pt: Estas são as suas gerações: o primogênito de Ismael foi Nebaiote, e, depois, Quedar, Adbeel, Mibsão,
text_el: αὗται δὲ αἱ γενέσεις πρωτοτόκου Ισμαηλ Ναβαιωθ καὶ Κηδαρ Ναβδεηλ Μαβσαν

text_en: and Masma, and Duma, Massa, Hadad, and Thema,
text_la: et Masma, et Duma, Massa, Hadad, et Thema,
text_pt: Misma, Dumá, Massá, Hadade, Tema,
text_el: Μασμα Ιδουμα Μασση Χοδδαδ Θαιμαν

text_en: Jetur, Naphis, Cedma: these are the sons of Ismahel .
text_la: Jetur, Naphis, Cedma : hi sunt filii Ismahelis.
text_pt: Jetur, Nafis e Quedemá; estes foram os filhos de Ismael.
text_el: Ιεττουρ Ναφες καὶ Κεδμα οὗτοί εἰσιν υἱοὶ Ισμαηλ

text_en: And the sons of Cetura, Abraham's concubine , whom she bore: Zamran, Jecsan, Madan, Madian , Jesboc, and Sue. And the sons of Jecsan, Saba , and Dadan. And the sons of Dadan: Assurim, and Latussim, and Laomin.
text_la: Filii autem Ceturæ concubinæ Abraham, quos genuit : Zamran, Jecsan, Madan, Madian, Jesboc, et Sue. Porro filii Jecsan : Saba, et Dadan. Filii autem Dadan : Assurim, et Latussim, et Laomim.
text_pt: Quanto aos filhos de Quetura, concubina de Abraão, esta deu à luz a Zinrã, a Jocsã, a Medã, a Midiã, a Jisbaque e a Suá; e os filhos de Jocsã foram Seba e Dedã.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Χεττουρας παλλακῆς Αβρααμ καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Ζεμβραν Ιεξαν Μαδαν Μαδιαμ Σοβακ Σωε καὶ υἱοὶ Ιεξαν Σαβα καὶ Δαιδαν

text_en: And the sons of Madian : Epha, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaa. All these are the sons of Cetura.
text_la: Filii autem Madian : Epha, et Epher, et Henoch, et Abida, et Eldaa : omnes hi filii Ceturæ.
text_pt: E os filhos de Midiã: Efá, Efer, Enoque, Abida e Elda; todos estes foram filhos de Quetura.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Μαδιαμ Γαιφα καὶ Οφερ καὶ Ενωχ καὶ Αβιδα καὶ Ελδαα πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Χεττουρας

text_en: And Abraham begot Isaac : and his sons were Esau and Israel .
text_la: Genuit autem Abraham Isaac : cujus fuerunt filii Esau, et Israël.
text_pt: Abraão, pois, gerou a Isaque; e foram os filhos de Isaque: Esaú e Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐγέννησεν Αβρααμ τὸν Ισαακ καὶ υἱοὶ Ισαακ Ησαυ καὶ Ιακωβ

text_en: The sons of Esau : Eliphaz, Rahuel, Jehus, Ihelom, and Core.
text_la: Filii Esau : Eliphaz, Rahuel, Jehus, Ihelom, et Core.
text_pt: Os filhos de Esaú: Elifaz, Reuel, Jeús, Jalão e Coré.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ησαυ Ελιφας καὶ Ραγουηλ καὶ Ιεουλ καὶ Ιεγλομ καὶ Κορε

text_en: The sons of Eliphaz: Theman, Omar, Sephi, Gathan, Cenez, and by Thamna, Amalec.
text_la: Filii Eliphaz : Theman, Omar, Sephi, Gathan, Cenez, Thamna, Amalec.
text_pt: Os filhos de Elifaz: Temã, Omar, Zefi, Gaetã, Quenaz, Timna e Amaleque.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ελιφας Θαιμαν καὶ Ωμαρ Σωφαρ καὶ Γοωθαμ καὶ Κενεζ καὶ τῆς Θαμνα Αμαληκ

text_en: The sons of Rahuel: Nahath, Zara, Samma, Meza.
text_la: Filii Rahuel : Nahath, Zara, Samma, Meza.
text_pt: Os filhos de Reuel: Naate, Zerá, Samá e Mizá.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ραγουηλ Ναχεθ Ζαρε Σομε καὶ Μοζε

text_en: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Sobal, Sebeon, Ana, Dison, Eser, Disan.
text_la: Filii Seir : Lotan, Sobal, Sebeon, Ana, Dison, Eser, Disan.
text_pt: E os filhos de Seir: Lotã, Sobal, Zibeão, Aná, Disom, Eser e Disã.
text_el: υἱοὶ Σηιρ Λωταν Σωβαλ Σεβεγων Ανα Δησων Ωσαρ Δαισων

text_en: The sons of Lotan: Hori, Homam. And the sister of Lotan was Thamna.
text_la: Filii Lotan : Hori, Homam. Soror autem Lotan fuit Thamna.
text_pt: E os filhos de Lotã: Hori e Homã; e a irmã de Lotã foi Timna.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Λωταν Χορρι καὶ Αιμαν καὶ Αιλαθ καὶ Ναμνα

text_en: The sons of Sobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Sephi, and Onam. The sons of Sebeon: Aia, and Ana. The son of Ana: Dison.
text_la: Filii Sobal : Alian, et Manahath, et Ebal, Sephi et Onam. Filii Sebeon : Aja et Ana. Filii Ana : Dison.
text_pt: Os filhos de Sobal eram Alvã, Manaate, Ebal, Sefi e Onã; e os filhos de Zibeão eram Aiá e Aná.
text_el: υἱοὶ Σωβαλ Γωλαμ Μαναχαθ Γαιβηλ Σωβ καὶ Ωναμ υἱοὶ δὲ Σεβεγων Αια καὶ Ανα

text_en: The sons of Dison: Hamram, and Eseban, and Jethran, and Charan.
text_la: Filii Dison : Hamram, et Heseban, et Jethran, et Charan.
text_pt: O filho de Aná foi Disom; e os filhos de Disom foram Hanrão, Esbã, Itrã e Querã.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ανα Δαισων υἱοὶ δὲ Δησων Εμερων καὶ Εσεβαν καὶ Ιεθραν καὶ Χαρραν

text_en: The sons of Eser: Balaan, and Zavan, and Jacan. The sons of Disan: Hus and Aran.
text_la: Filii Eser : Balaan, et Zavan, et Jacan. Filii Disan : Hus et Aran.
text_pt: Os filhos de Eser eram: Bilã, Zaavã e Jaacã; os filhos de Disã eram: Uz e Arã.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ωσαρ Βαλααν καὶ Ζουκαν καὶ Ιωκαν υἱοὶ Δαισων Ως καὶ Αρραν

text_en: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom , before there was a king over the children of Israel : Bale the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Denaba.
text_la: Isti sunt reges qui imperaverunt in terra Edom, antequam esset rex super filios Israël. Bale filius Beor : et nomen civitatis ejus, Denaba.
text_pt: E estes são os reis que reinaram na terra de Edom, antes que reinasse rei sobre os filhos de Israel: Bela, filho de Beor, e era o nome da sua cidade Dinabá.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν Βαλακ υἱὸς Βεωρ καὶ ὄνομα τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ Δενναβα

text_en: And Bale died, and Jobab the son of Zare of Bosra, reigned in his stead.
text_la: Mortuus est autem Bale, et regnavit pro eo Jobab filius Zare de Bosra.
text_pt: E morreu Bela, e reinou em seu lugar Jobabe, filho de Zerá, de Bozra.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Βαλακ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Ιωβαβ υἱὸς Ζαρα ἐκ Βοσορρας

text_en: And when Jobab also was dead, Husam of the land of the Themanites reigned in his stead.
text_la: Cumque et Jobab fuisset mortuus, regnavit pro eo Husam de terra Themanorum.
text_pt: E morreu Jobabe, e reinou em seu lugar Husão, da terra dos temanitas.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ιωβαβ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Ασομ ἐκ τῆς γῆς Θαιμανων

text_en: And Husam also died, and Adad the son of Badad reigned in his stead, and he defeated the Madianites in the land of Moab : the name of his city was Avith.
text_la: Obiit quoque et Husam, et regnavit pro eo Adad filius Badad, qui percussit Madian in terra Moab : et nomen civitatis ejus Avith.
text_pt: E morreu Husão, e reinou em seu lugar Hadade, filho de Bedade; este feriu os midianitas no campo de Moabe; e era o nome da sua cidade Avite.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ασομ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Αδαδ υἱὸς Βαραδ ὁ πατάξας Μαδιαμ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ Μωαβ καὶ ὄνομα τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ Γεθθαιμ

text_en: And when Adad also was dead, Semla of Masreca reigned in his stead.
text_la: Cumque et Adad fuisset mortuus, regnavit pro eo Semla de Masreca.
text_pt: E morreu Hadade, e reinou em seu lugar Samlá, de Masreca.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Αδαδ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Σαμαα ἐκ Μασεκκας

text_en: Semla also died, and Saul of Rohoboth, which is near the river, reigned in his stead.
text_la: Sed et Semla mortuus est, et regnavit pro eo Saul de Rohoboth, quæ juxta amnem sita est.
text_pt: E morreu Samlá, e reinou em seu lugar Saul, de Reobote, junto ao rio.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Σαμαα καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Σαουλ ἐκ Ροωβωθ τῆς παρὰ ποταμόν

text_en: And when Saul was dead, Balanan the son of Achobor reigned in his stead.
text_la: Mortuo quoque Saul, regnavit pro eo Balanan filius Achobor.
text_pt: E morreu Saul, e reinou em seu lugar Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Σαουλ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Βαλαεννων υἱὸς Αχοβωρ

text_en: He also died, and Adad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Phau, and his wife was called Meetabel the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezaab.
text_la: Sed et hic mortuus est, et regnavit pro eo Adad : cujus urbis nomen fuit Phau, et appellata est uxor ejus Meetabel filia Matred filiæ Mezaab.
text_pt: E, morrendo Baal-Hanã, Hadade reinou em seu lugar; e era o nome da sua cidade Paí; e o nome de sua mulher era Meetabel, filha de Matrede, filha de Me-Zaabe.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Βαλαεννων υἱὸς Αχοβωρ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Αδαδ υἱὸς Βαραδ καὶ ὄνομα τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ Φογωρ

text_en: And after the death of Adad, there began to be dukes in Edom instead of kings: duke Thamna, duke Alva, duke Jetheth,
text_la: Adad autem mortuo, duces pro regibus in Edom esse cœperunt : dux Thamna, dux Alva, dux Jetheth,
text_pt: E, morrendo Hadade, foram príncipes em Edom o príncipe Timna, o príncipe Alva, o príncipe Jetete,
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Αδαδ καὶ ἦσαν ἡγεμόνες Εδωμ ἡγεμὼν Θαμανα ἡγεμὼν Γωλα ἡγεμὼν Ιεθετ

text_en: duke Oolibama, duke Ela, duke Phinon,
text_la: dux Oolibama, dux Ela, dux Phinon,
text_pt: O príncipe Oolibama, o príncipe Elá, o príncipe Pinom,
text_el: ἡγεμὼν Ελιβαμας ἡγεμὼν Ηλας ἡγεμὼν Φινων

text_en: duke Cenez, duke Theman, duke Mabsar,
text_la: dux Cenez, dux Theman, dux Mabsar,
text_pt: O príncipe Quenaz, o príncipe Temã, o príncipe Mibzar,
text_el: ἡγεμὼν Κενεζ ἡγεμὼν Θαιμαν ἡγεμὼν Μαβσαρ

text_en: duke Magdiel, duke Hiram. These are the dukes of Edom .
text_la: dux Magdiel, dux Hiram : hi duces Edom.
text_pt: O príncipe Magdiel, o príncipe Irã, estes foram os príncipes de Edom.
text_el: ἡγεμὼν Μεγεδιηλ ἡγεμὼν Ηραμ οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες Εδωμ

text_en: And these are the sons of Israel : Ruben , Simeon , Levi , Juda , Issachar , and Zabulon ,
text_la: Filii autem Israël : Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Juda, Issachar, et Zabulon,
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Israel: Rúben, Simeão, Levi, Judá, Issacar e Zebulom;
text_el: ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ Ρουβην Συμεων Λευι Ιουδα Ισσαχαρ Ζαβουλων

text_en: Dan , Joseph , Benjamin , Nephtali , Gad , and Aser .
text_la: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Nephthali, Gad, et Aser.
text_pt: Dã, José e Benjamim, Naftali, Gade e Aser.
text_el: Δαν Ιωσηφ Βενιαμιν Νεφθαλι Γαδ Ασηρ

text_en: The sons of Juda : Her, Onan and Sela. These three were born to him of the Chanaanitess the daughter of Sue. And Her the firstborn of Juda , was wicked in the sight of the Lord , and he slew him.
text_la: Filii Juda : Her, Onan, et Sela : hi tres nati sunt ei de filia Sue Chananitide. Fuit autem Her primogenitus Juda malus coram Domino, et occidit eum.
text_pt: Os filhos de Judá foram Er, e Onã, e Selá, estes três lhe nasceram da filha de Suá, a cananéia; e Er, o primogênito de Judá, foi mau aos olhos do Senhor, pelo que o matou.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ιουδα Ηρ Αυναν Σηλων τρεῖς ἐγεννήθησαν αὐτῷ ἐκ τῆς θυγατρὸς Σαυας τῆς Χαναανίτιδος καὶ ἦν Ηρ ὁ πρωτότοκος Ιουδα πονηρὸς ἐναντίον κυρίου καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτόν

text_en: And Thamar his daughter in law bore him Phares and Zara. So all the sons of Juda were five.
text_la: Thamar autem nurus ejus peperit ei Phares et Zara : omnes ergo filii Juda, quinque.
text_pt: Porém Tamar, sua nora, lhe deu à luz Perez e Zerá; todos os filhos de Judá foram cinco.
text_el: καὶ Θαμαρ ἡ νύμφη αὐτοῦ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Φαρες καὶ τὸν Ζαρα πάντες υἱοὶ Ιουδα πέντε

text_en: And the sons of Phares, were Hesron and Hamul.
text_la: Filii autem Phares : Hesron et Hamul.
text_pt: Os filhos de Perez foram Hezrom e Hamul.
text_el: υἱοὶ Φαρες Αρσων καὶ Ιεμουηλ

text_en: And the sons also of Zare: Zamri, and Ethan, and Eman, and Chalchal, and Dara, five in all.
text_la: Filii quoque Zaræ : Zamri, et Ethan, et Eman, Chalchal quoque, et Dara, simul quinque.
text_pt: E os filhos de Zerá: Zinri, e Etã, e Hemã, e Calcol, e Dara: cinco ao todo.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ζαρα Ζαμβρι καὶ Αιθαν καὶ Αιμαν καὶ Χαλχαλ καὶ Δαρα πάντες πέντε

text_en: And the sons of Charmi: Achar, who troubled Israel , and sinned by the theft of the anathema .
text_la: Filii Charmi : Achar, qui turbavit Israël, et peccavit in furto anathematis.
text_pt: E os filhos de Carmi foram Acar, o perturbador de Israel, que pecou no anátema.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Χαρμι Αχαρ ὁ ἐμποδοστάτης Ισραηλ ὃς ἠθέτησεν εἰς τὸ ἀνάθεμα

text_en: The sons of Ethan: Azarias,
text_la: Filii Ethan : Azarias.
text_pt: E o filho de Etã foi Azarias.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Αιθαν Αζαρια

text_en: and the sons of Hesron that were born to him: Jerameel, and Ram, and Calubi .
text_la: Filii autem Hesron qui nati sunt ei : Jerameel, et Ram, et Calubi.
text_pt: E os filhos de Hezrom, que lhe nasceram, foram Jerameel, e Rão, e Quelubai.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Εσερων οἳ ἐτέχθησαν αὐτῷ ὁ Ιραμεηλ καὶ ὁ Ραμ καὶ ὁ Χαλεβ καὶ Αραμ

text_en: And Ram begot Aminadab, and Aminadab begot Nahasson, prince of the children of Juda .
text_la: Porro Ram genuit Aminadab. Aminadab autem genuit Nahasson, principem filiorum Juda.
text_pt: E Rão gerou a Aminadabe, e Aminadabe gerou a Naassom, príncipe dos filhos de Judá.
text_el: καὶ Αραμ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αμιναδαβ καὶ Αμιναδαβ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ναασσων ἄρχοντα τοῦ οἴκου Ιουδα

text_en: And Nahasson begot Salma, the father of Booz.
text_la: Nahasson quoque genuit Salma, de quo ortus est Booz.
text_pt: E Naassom gerou a Salma, e Salma gerou a Boaz.
text_el: καὶ Ναασσων ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλμων καὶ Σαλμων ἐγέννησεν τὸν Βοος

text_en: And Booz begot Obed, and Obed begot Isai.
text_la: Booz vero genuit Obed, qui et ipse genuit Isai.
text_pt: E Boaz gerou a Obede, e Obede gerou a Jessé.
text_el: καὶ Βοος ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ωβηδ καὶ Ωβηδ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιεσσαι

text_en: And Isai begot Eliab his firstborn , the second Abinadab, the third Simmaa,
text_la: Isai autem genuit primogenitum Eliab, secundum Abinadab, tertium Simmaa,
text_pt: E Jessé gerou a Eliabe, seu primogênito, e Abinadabe, o segundo, e Siméia, o terceiro.
text_el: καὶ Ιεσσαι ἐγέννησεν τὸν πρωτότοκον αὐτοῦ Ελιαβ Αμιναδαβ ὁ δεύτερος Σαμαα ὁ τρίτος

text_en: the fourth, Nathanael, the fifth Raddai,
text_la: quartum Nathanaël, quintum Raddai,
text_pt: Natanael, o quarto, Radai, o quinto.
text_el: Ναθαναηλ ὁ τέταρτος Ραδδαι ὁ πέμπτος

text_en: the sixth Asom, the seventh David .
text_la: sextum Asom, septimum David.
text_pt: Ozém, o sexto, Davi, o sétimo.
text_el: Ασομ ὁ ἕκτος Δαυιδ ὁ ἕβδομος

text_en: And their sisters were Sarvia, and Abigail. The sons of Sarvia: Abisai , Joab, and Asael, three.
text_la: Quorum sorores fuerunt Sarvia et Abigail. Filii Sarviæ : Abisai, Joab, et Asaël, tres.
text_pt: E foram suas irmãs Zeruia e Abigail; e foram os filhos de Zeruia: Abisai e Joabe, e Asael, três.
text_el: καὶ ἀδελφὴ αὐτῶν Σαρουια καὶ Αβιγαια καὶ υἱοὶ Σαρουια Αβεσσα καὶ Ιωαβ καὶ Ασαηλ τρεῖς

text_en: And Abigail bore Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ismahelite .
text_la: Abigail autem genuit Amasa, cujus pater fuit Jether Ismahelites.
text_pt: E Abigail deu à luz a Amasa; e o pai de Amasa foi Jeter, o ismaelita.
text_el: καὶ Αβιγαια ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αμεσσα καὶ πατὴρ Αμεσσα Ιοθορ ὁ Ισμαηλίτης

text_en: And Caleb the son of Hesron took a wife named Azuba, of whom he had Jerioth: and her sons were Jaser, and Sobab, and Ardon.
text_la: Caleb vero filius Hesron accepit uxorem nomine Azuba, de qua genuit Jerioth : fueruntque filii ejus Jaser, et Sobab, et Ardon.
text_pt: E Calebe, filho de Hezrom, gerou filhos de Azuba, sua mulher, e de Jeriote; e os filhos desta foram estes: Jeser, Sobabe, e Ardom.
text_el: καὶ Χαλεβ υἱὸς Εσερων ἐγέννησεν τὴν Γαζουβα γυναῖκα καὶ τὴν Ιεριωθ καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ αὐτῆς Ιωασαρ καὶ Σωβαβ καὶ Ορνα

text_en: And when Azuba was dead, Caleb took to wife Ephrata: who bore him Hur.
text_la: Cumque mortua fuisset Azuba, accepit uxorem Caleb Ephratha, quæ peperit ei Hur.
text_pt: E morreu Azuba; e Calebe tomou para si a Efrate, da qual lhe nasceu Hur.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Γαζουβα καὶ ἔλαβεν ἑαυτῷ Χαλεβ τὴν Εφραθ καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Ωρ

text_en: And Hur begot Uri: and Uri begot Bezeleel.
text_la: Porro Hur genuit Uri, et Uri genuit Bezeleel.
text_pt: E Hur gerou a Uri, e Uri gerou a Bezaleel.
text_el: καὶ Ωρ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ουρι καὶ Ουρι ἐγέννησεν τὸν Βεσελεηλ

text_en: And afterwards Hesron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Galaad, and took her to wife when he was threescore years old: and she bore him Segub.
text_la: Post hæc ingressus est Hesron ad filiam Machir patris Galaad, et accepit eam cum esset annorum sexaginta : quæ peperit ei Segub.
text_pt: Então Hezrom coabitou com a filha de Maquir, pai de Gileade, e, sendo ele de sessenta anos, a tomou; e ela deu à luz a Segube.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα εἰσῆλθεν Εσερων πρὸς τὴν θυγατέρα Μαχιρ πατρὸς Γαλααδ καὶ οὗτος ἔλαβεν αὐτήν καὶ αὐτὸς ἑξήκοντα ἦν ἐτῶν καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Σεγουβ

text_en: And Segub begot Jair, and he had three and twenty cities in the land of Galaad.
text_la: Sed et Segub genuit Jair, et possedit viginti tres civitates in terra Galaad.
text_pt: E Segube gerou a Jair; e este tinha vinte e três cidades na terra de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ Σεγουβ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιαϊρ καὶ ἦσαν αὐτῷ εἴκοσι τρεῖς πόλεις ἐν τῇ Γαλααδ

text_en: And he took Gessur, and Aram the towns of Jair, and Canath, and the villages thereof, threescore cities. All these, the sons of Machir father of Galaad.
text_la: Cepitque Gessur et Aram oppida Jair, et Canath, et viculos ejus sexaginta civitatum : omnes isti filii Machir patris Galaad.
text_pt: E Gesur e Arã tomaram deles as aldeias de Jair, e Quenate, e seus lugares, sessenta cidades; todos estes foram filhos de Maquir, pai de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Γεδσουρ καὶ Αραμ τὰς κώμας Ιαϊρ ἐξ αὐτῶν τὴν Καναθ καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς ἑξήκοντα πόλεις πᾶσαι αὗται υἱῶν Μαχιρ πατρὸς Γαλααδ

text_en: And when Hesron was dead, Caleb went in to Ephrata . Hesron also had to wife Abia who bore him Ashur the father of Thecua.
text_la: Cum autem mortuus esset Hesron, ingressus est Caleb ad Ephratha. Habuit quoque Hesron uxorem Abia, quæ peperit ei Assur patrem Thecuæ.
text_pt: E, depois da morte de Hezrom, em Calebe de Efrata, Abia, mulher de Hezrom, deu à luz a Asur, pai de Tecoa.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν Εσερων ἦλθεν Χαλεβ εἰς Εφραθα καὶ ἡ γυνὴ Εσερων Αβια καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Ασχωδ πατέρα Θεκωε

text_en: And the sons of Jerameel the firstborn of Hesron, were Ram his firstborn , and Buna, and Aram, and Asom, and Achia.
text_la: Nati sunt autem filii Jerameel primogeniti Hesron, Ram primogenitus ejus, et Buna, et Aram, et Asom, et Achia.
text_pt: E os filhos de Jerameel, primogênito de Hezrom, foram Rão, o primogênito, Buna, Orem, Ozém e Aías.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ Ιερεμεηλ πρωτοτόκου Εσερων ὁ πρωτότοκος Ραμ καὶ Βαανα καὶ Αραν καὶ Ασομ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Jerameel married another wife, named Atara, who was the mother of Onam.
text_la: Duxit quoque uxorem alteram Jerameel, nomine Atara, quæ fuit mater Onam.
text_pt: Teve também Jerameel ainda outra mulher cujo nome era Atara; esta foi a mãe de Onã.
text_el: καὶ ἦν γυνὴ ἑτέρα τῷ Ιερεμεηλ καὶ ὄνομα αὐτῇ Αταρα αὕτη ἐστὶν μήτηρ Οζομ

text_en: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerameel, were Moos, Jamin, and Achar.
text_la: Sed et filii Ram primogeniti Jerameel fuerunt Moos, Jamin, et Achar.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Rão, primogênito de Jerameel: Maaz, Jamim, e Equer.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ Ραμ πρωτοτόκου Ιερεμεηλ Μαας καὶ Ιαμιν καὶ Ακορ

text_en: And Onam had sons Semei, and Jada. And the sons of Semei: Nadab, and Abisur.
text_la: Onam autem habuit filios Semei et Jada. Filii autem Semei : Nadab et Abisur.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Onã: Samai e Jada; e os filhos de Samai: Nadabe e Abisur.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ Οζομ Σαμαι καὶ Ιαδαε καὶ υἱοὶ Σαμαι Ναδαβ καὶ Αβισουρ

text_en: And the name of Abisur's wife was Abihail, who bore him Ahobban, and Molid.
text_la: Nomen vero uxoris Abisur, Abihail, quæ peperit ei Ahobban et Molid.
text_pt: E o nome da mulher de Abisur era Abiail, que lhe deu a Abã e a Molide.
text_el: καὶ ὄνομα τῆς γυναικὸς Αβισουρ Αβιχαιλ καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Αχαβαρ καὶ τὸν Μωλιδ

text_en: And the sons of Nadab were Saled and Apphaim. And Saled died without children.
text_la: Filii autem Nadab fuerunt Saled et Apphaim. Mortuus est autem Saled absque liberis.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Nadabe, Selede e Apaim; e Selede morreu sem filhos.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ναδαβ Σαλαδ καὶ Αφφαιμ καὶ ἀπέθανεν Σαλαδ οὐκ ἔχων τέκνα

text_en: But the son of Apphaim was Jesi: and Jesi begot Sesan. And Sesan begot Oholai.
text_la: Filius vero Apphaim, Jesi : qui Jesi genuit Sesan. Porro Sesan genuit Oholai.
text_pt: E o filho de Apaim foi Isi; e o filho de Isi, Sesã. E o filho de Sesã, Alai.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Αφφαιμ Ισεμιηλ καὶ υἱοὶ Ισεμιηλ Σωσαν καὶ υἱοὶ Σωσαν Αχλαι

text_en: And the sons of Jada the brother of Semei: Jether and Jonathan . And Jether also died without children.
text_la: Filii autem Jada fratris Semei : Jether, et Jonathan. Sed et Jether mortuus est absque liberis.
text_pt: E os filhos de Jada, irmão de Samai, foram Jeter e Jônatas; e Jeter morreu sem filhos.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιαδαε Αχισαμαι Ιεθερ Ιωναθαν καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ιεθερ οὐκ ἔχων τέκνα

text_en: But Jonathan begot Phaleth, and Ziza. These were the sons of Jerameel.
text_la: Porro Jonathan genuit Phaleth, et Ziza. Isti fuerunt filii Jerameel.
text_pt: E os filhos de Jônatas foram: Pelete e Zaza; estes foram os filhos de Jerameel.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιωναθαν Φαλεθ καὶ Οζαζα οὗτοι ἦσαν υἱοὶ Ιερεμεηλ

text_en: And Sesan had no sons, but daughters and a servant an Egyptian , named Jeraa.
text_la: Sesan autem non habuit filios, sed filias : et servum ægyptium nomine Jeraa.
text_pt: E Sesã não teve filhos, mas filhas; e tinha Sesã um servo egípcio, cujo nome era Jará.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἦσαν τῷ Σωσαν υἱοί ἀλλ' ἢ θυγατέρες καὶ τῷ Σωσαν παῖς Αἰγύπτιος καὶ ὄνομα αὐτῷ Ιωχηλ

text_en: And he gave him his daughter to wife: and she bore him Ethei.
text_la: Deditque ei filiam suam uxorem : quæ peperit ei Ethei.
text_pt: Deu, pois, Sesã sua filha por mulher a Jará, seu servo; e lhe deu à luz a Atai.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν Σωσαν τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ τῷ Ιωχηλ παιδὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς γυναῖκα καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Εθθι

text_en: And Ethei begot Nathan , and Nathan begot Zabad.
text_la: Ethei autem genuit Nathan, et Nathan genuit Zabad.
text_pt: E Atai gerou a Natã, e Natã gerou a Zabade.
text_el: καὶ Εθθι ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ναθαν καὶ Ναθαν ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ζαβεδ

text_en: And Zabad begot Ophlal, and Ophlal begot Obed.
text_la: Zabad quoque genuit Ophlal, et Ophlal genuit Obed.
text_pt: E Zabade gerou a Eflal, e Eflal gerou a Obede.
text_el: καὶ Ζαβεδ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αφαληλ καὶ Αφαληλ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ωβηδ

text_en: Obed begot Jehu , Jehu begot Azarias.
text_la: Obed genuit Jehu, Jehu genuit Azariam,
text_pt: E Obede gerou a Jeú, e Jeú gerou a Azarias.
text_el: καὶ Ωβηδ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιηου καὶ Ιηου ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αζαριαν

text_en: Azarias begot Helles, and Helles begot Elasa.
text_la: Azarias genuit Helles, et Helles genuit Elasa.
text_pt: E Azarias gerou a Helez, e Helez gerou a Eleasá.
text_el: καὶ Αζαριας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Χελλης καὶ Χελλης ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ελεασα

text_en: Elasa begot Sisamoi, Sisamoi begot Sellum,
text_la: Elasa genuit Sisamoi, Sisamoi genuit Sellum,
text_pt: E Eleasá gerou a Sismai, e Sismai gerou a Salum.
text_el: καὶ Ελεασα ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σοσομαι καὶ Σοσομαι ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλουμ

text_en: Sellum begot Icamia, and Icamia begot Elisama.
text_la: Sellum genuit Icamiam, Icamia autem genuit Elisama.
text_pt: E Salum gerou a Jecamias, e Jecamias gerou a Elisama.
text_el: καὶ Σαλουμ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιεχεμιαν καὶ Ιεχεμιας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ελισαμα

text_en: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerameel were Mesa his firstborn , who was the father of Siph: and the sons of Maresa father of Hebron .
text_la: Filii autem Caleb fratris Jerameel : Mesa primogenitus ejus; ipse est pater Ziph : et filii Maresa patris Hebron.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Calebe, irmão de Jerameel, Messa, seu primogênito (este foi o pai de Zife), e os filhos de Maressa, pai de Hebrom.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Χαλεβ ἀδελφοῦ Ιερεμεηλ Μαρισα ὁ πρωτότοκος αὐτοῦ οὗτος πατὴρ Ζιφ καὶ υἱοὶ Μαρισα πατρὸς Χεβρων

text_en: And the sons of Hebron , Core, and Thaphua, and Recem, and Samma.
text_la: Porro filii Hebron, Core, et Taphua, et Recem, et Samma.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Hebrom: Coré, Tápua, Requém e Sema.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Χεβρων Κορε καὶ Θαπους καὶ Ρεκομ καὶ Σεμαα

text_en: And Samma begot Raham, the father of Jercaam, and Recem begot Sammai.
text_la: Samma autem genuit Raham, patrem Jercaam, et Recem genuit Sammai.
text_pt: E Sema gerou a Raão, pai de Jorqueão; e Requém gerou a Samai.
text_el: καὶ Σεμαα ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ραεμ πατέρα Ιερκααν καὶ Ιερκααν ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαμαι

text_en: The son of Sammai, Maon: and Maon the father of Bethsur.
text_la: Filius Sammai, Maon : et Maon pater Bethsur.
text_pt: E foi o filho de Samai, Maom; e Maom foi pai de Bete-Zur.
text_el: καὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Μαων καὶ Μαων πατὴρ Βαιθσουρ

text_en: And Epha the concubine of Caleb bore Haran, and Mosa, and Gezez. And Haran begot Gezez.
text_la: Epha autem concubina Caleb peperit Haran, et Mosa, et Gezez. Porro Haran genuit Gezez.
text_pt: E Efá, a concubina de Calebe, deu à luz a Harã, a Mosa, e a Gazez; e Harã gerou a Gazez.
text_el: καὶ Γαιφα ἡ παλλακὴ Χαλεβ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αρραν καὶ τὸν Μωσα καὶ τὸν Γεζουε καὶ Αρραν ἐγέννησεν τὸν Γεζουε

text_en: And the sons of Jahaddai, Rogom, and Joathan, and Gesan, and Phalet, and Epha, and Saaph.
text_la: Filii autem Jahaddai, Regom, et Joathan, et Gesan, et Phalet, et Epha, et Saaph.
text_pt: E foram filhos de Jadai: Regém, Jotão, Gesã, Pelete, Efá e Saafe.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιαδαι Ραγεμ καὶ Ιωαθαμ καὶ Γηρσωμ καὶ Φαλετ καὶ Γαιφα καὶ Σαγαφ

text_en: And Maacha the concubine of Caleb bore Saber, and Tharana.
text_la: Concubina Caleb Maacha, peperit Saber, et Tharana.
text_pt: De Maaca, concubina, Calebe gerou a Seber e a Tiraná.
text_el: καὶ ἡ παλλακὴ Χαλεβ Μωχα ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαβερ καὶ τὸν Θαρχνα

text_en: And Saaph the father of Madmena begot Sue the father of Machbena, and the father of Gabaa. And the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.
text_la: Genuit autem Saaph pater Madmena Sue, patrem Machbena et patrem Gabaa. Filia vero Caleb fuit Achsa.
text_pt: E a mulher de Saafe, pai de Madmana, deu à luz a Seva, pai de Macbena e pai de Gibeá; e foi a filha de Calebe, Acsa.
text_el: καὶ ἐγέννησεν Σαγαφ πατέρα Μαρμηνα καὶ τὸν Σαου πατέρα Μαχαβηνα καὶ πατέρα Γαιβαα καὶ θυγάτηρ Χαλεβ Ασχα

text_en: These were the sons of Caleb , the son of Hur the firstborn of Ephrata, Sobal the father of Cariathiarim.
text_la: Hi erant filii Caleb, filii Hur primogeniti Ephratha, Sobal pater Cariathiarim.
text_pt: Estes foram os filhos de Calebe, filho de Hur, o primogênito de Efrata: Sobal, pai de Quiriate-Jearim,
text_el: οὗτοι ἦσαν υἱοὶ Χαλεβ υἱοὶ Ωρ πρωτοτόκου Εφραθα Σωβαλ πατὴρ Καριαθιαριμ

text_en: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hariph the father of Bethgader.
text_la: Salma pater Bethlehem, Hariph pater Bethgader.
text_pt: E Salma, pai dos belemitas, Harefe, pai de Bete-Gader.
text_el: Σαλωμων πατὴρ Βαιθλαεμ Αριμ πατὴρ Βαιθγεδωρ

text_en: And Sobal the father of Cariathiarim had sons: he that saw half of the places of rest.
text_la: Fuerunt autem filii Sobal patris Cariathiarim, qui videbat dimidium requietionum.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Sobal, pai de Quiriate-Jearim: Haroé e metade dos menuítas.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ τῷ Σωβαλ πατρὶ Καριαθιαριμ Αραα Εσι Αμμανιθ

text_en: And of the kindred of Cariathiarim, the Jethrites, and Aphuthites, and Semathites, and Maserites. Of them came the Saraites, and Esthaolites.
text_la: Et de cognatione Cariathiarim, Jethrei, et Aphuthei, et Semathei, et Maserei. Ex his egressi sunt Saraitæ, et Esthaolitæ.
text_pt: E as famílias de Quiriate-Jearim foram os jitreus, e os puteus, e os sumateus, e os misraeus; destes saíram os zorateus, e os estaoleus.
text_el: Εμοσφεως πόλις Ιαϊρ Αιθαλιμ καὶ Μιφιθιμ καὶ Ησαμαθιμ καὶ Ημασαραϊμ ἐκ τούτων ἐξήλθοσαν οἱ Σαραθαῖοι καὶ οἱ Εσθαωλαῖοι

text_en: The sons of Salma, Bethlehem, and Netophathi, the crowns of the house of Joab, and half of the place of rest of Sarai.
text_la: Filii Salma, Bethlehem, et Netophathi, coronæ domus Joab, et dimidium requietionis Sarai:
text_pt: Os filhos de Salma foram Belém e os netofatitas, Atarote, Bete-Joabe, e metade dos manaatitas, e os zoritas.
text_el: υἱοὶ Σαλωμων Βαιθλαεμ Νετωφαθι Αταρωθ οἴκου Ιωαβ καὶ ἥμισυ τῆς Μαναθι Ησαρεϊ

text_en: And the families of the scribes that dwell in Jabes, singing and making melody, and abiding in tents. These are the Cinites , who came of Calor (Chamath) father of the house of Rechab .
text_la: cognationes quoque scribarum habitantium in Jabes, canentes atque resonantes, et in tabernaculis commorantes. Hi sunt Cinæi, qui venerunt de Calore patris domus Rechab.
text_pt: E as famílias dos escribas que habitavam em Jabez foram os tiratitas, os simeatitas e os sucatitas; estes são os queneus, que vieram de Hamate, pai da casa de Recabe.
text_el: πατριαὶ γραμματέων κατοικοῦντες Ιαβες Θαργαθιιμ Σαμαθιιμ Σωκαθιιμ οὗτοι οἱ Κιναῖοι οἱ ἐλθόντες ἐκ Μεσημα πατρὸς οἴκου Ρηχαβ

text_en: Now these were the sons of David that were born to him in Hebron : the firstborn Amnon of Achinoam the Jezrahelitess, the second Daniel of Abigail the Carmelitess.
text_la: David vero hos habuit filios, qui ei nati sunt in Hebron : primogenitum Amnon ex Achinoam Jezrahelitide, secundum Daniel de Abigail Carmelitide,
text_pt: E estes foram os filhos de Davi, que lhe nasceram em Hebrom: o primogênito, Amnom, de Ainoã, a jizreelita; o segundo Daniel, de Abigail, a carmelita;
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι ἦσαν υἱοὶ Δαυιδ οἱ τεχθέντες αὐτῷ ἐν Χεβρων ὁ πρωτότοκος Αμνων τῇ Αχινααμ τῇ Ιεζραηλίτιδι ὁ δεύτερος Δανιηλ τῇ Αβιγαια τῇ Καρμηλίᾳ

text_en: The third Absalom the son of Maacha the daughter of Tolmai king of Gessur, the fourth Adonias the son of Aggith ,
text_la: tertium Absalom filium Maacha filiæ Tholmai regis Gessur, quartum Adoniam filium Aggith,
text_pt: O terceiro, Absalão, filho de Maaca, filha de Talmai, rei de Gesur; o quarto, Adonias, filho de Hagite;
text_el: ὁ τρίτος Αβεσσαλωμ υἱὸς Μωχα θυγατρὸς Θολμαι βασιλέως Γεδσουρ ὁ τέταρτος Αδωνια υἱὸς Αγγιθ

text_en: the fifth Saphatias of Abital, the sixth Jethrahem of Egla his wife.
text_la: quintum Saphathiam ex Abital, sextum Jethraham de Egla uxore sua.
text_pt: O quinto, Sefatias, de Abital; o sexto, Itreão, de Eglá, sua mulher.
text_el: ὁ πέμπτος Σαφατια τῆς Αβιταλ ὁ ἕκτος Ιεθρααμ τῇ Αγλα γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: So six sons were born to him in Hebron , where he reigned seven years and six months. And in Jerusalem he reigned three and thirty years.
text_la: Sex ergo nati sunt ei in Hebron, ubi regnavit septem annis et sex mensibus. Triginta autem et tribus annis regnavit in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Seis filhos lhe nasceram em Hebrom, porque ali reinou sete anos e seis meses; e trinta e três anos reinou em Jerusalém.
text_el: ἓξ ἐγεννήθησαν αὐτῷ ἐν Χεβρων καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἐκεῖ ἑπτὰ ἔτη καὶ ἑξάμηνον καὶ τριάκοντα καὶ τρία ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And these sons were born to him in Jerusalem : Simmaa, and Sobab, and Nathan , and Solomon , four of Bethsabee the daughter of Ammiel.
text_la: Porro in Jerusalem nati sunt ei filii, Simmaa, et Sobab, et Nathan, et Salomon, quatuor de Bethsabee filia Ammiel:
text_pt: E estes lhe nasceram em Jerusalém: Siméia, e Sobabe, e Natã, e Salomão; estes quatro lhe nasceram de Bate-Sua, filha de Amiel.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι ἐτέχθησαν αὐτῷ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ Σαμαα Σωβαβ Ναθαν καὶ Σαλωμων τέσσαρες τῇ Βηρσαβεε θυγατρὶ Αμιηλ

text_en: Jebaar also and Elisama,
text_la: Jebaar quoque et Elisama,
text_pt: Nasceram-lhe mais Ibar, Elisama, Elifelete,
text_el: καὶ Ιβααρ καὶ Ελισαμα καὶ Ελιφαλετ

text_en: and Eliphaleth, and Noge, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
text_la: et Eliphaleth, et Noge, et Nepheg, et Japhia,
text_pt: Nogá, Nefegue, Jafia,
text_el: καὶ Ναγε καὶ Ναφαγ καὶ Ιανουε

text_en: and Elisama, and Eliada, and Elipheleth, nine:
text_la: necnon Elisama, et Eliada, et Elipheleth, novem:
text_pt: Elisama, Eliada, e Elifelete, nove.
text_el: καὶ Ελισαμα καὶ Ελιαδα καὶ Ελιφαλετ ἐννέα

text_en: All these the sons of David , beside the sons of the concubines : and they had a sister Thamar.
text_la: omnes hi, filii David absque filiis concubinarum : habueruntque sororem Thamar.
text_pt: Todos estes foram filhos de Davi, afora os filhos das concubinas e Tamar, irmã deles.
text_el: πάντες υἱοὶ Δαυιδ πλὴν τῶν υἱῶν τῶν παλλακῶν καὶ Θημαρ ἀδελφὴ αὐτῶν

text_en: And Solomon's son was Roboam: whose son Abia begot Asa. And his son was Josaphat,
text_la: Filius autem Salomonis, Roboam : cujus Abia filius genuit Asa. De hoc quoque natus est Josaphat,
text_pt: E o filho de Salomão foi Roboão; de quem foi filho Abias; de quem foi filho Asa; de quem foi filho Jeosafá;
text_el: υἱοὶ Σαλωμων Ροβοαμ Αβια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ασα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ιωσαφατ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: the father of Joram: and Joram begot Ochozias, of whom was born Joas:
text_la: pater Joram : qui Joram genuit Ochoziam, ex quo ortus est Joas:
text_pt: De quem foi filho Jorão; de quem foi filho Acazias; de quem foi filho Joás;
text_el: Ιωραμ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Οχοζια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ιωας υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And his son Amasias begot Azarias. And Joathan the son of Azarias
text_la: et hujus Amasias filius genuit Azariam. Porro Azariæ filius Joatham
text_pt: De quem foi filho Amazias; de quem foi filho Jotão;
text_el: Αμασιας υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Αζαρια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ιωαθαν υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: begot Achaz , the father of Ezechias , of whom was born Manasses .
text_la: procreavit Achaz patrem Ezechiæ, de quo natus est Manasses.
text_pt: De quem foi filho Acaz; de quem foi filho Ezequias; de quem foi filho Manassés;
text_el: Αχαζ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Εζεκιας υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Μανασσης υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Manasses begot Amon the father of Josias .
text_la: Sed et Manasses genuit Amon patrem Josiæ.
text_pt: De quem foi filho Amom; de quem foi filho Josias.
text_el: Αμων υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ιωσια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the sons of Josias were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Joakim, the third Sedecias, the fourth Sellum.
text_la: Filii autem Josiæ fuerunt : primogenitus Johanan, secundus Joakim, tertius Sedecias, quartus Sellum.
text_pt: E os filhos de Josias foram: o primogênito, Joanã: o segundo, Jeoiaquim; o terceiro, Zedequias; o quarto, Salum.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιωσια πρωτότοκος Ιωαναν ὁ δεύτερος Ιωακιμ ὁ τρίτος Σεδεκια ὁ τέταρτος Σαλουμ

text_en: Of Joakim was born Jechonias, and Sedecias.
text_la: De Joakim natus est Jechonias, et Sedecias.
text_pt: E os filhos de Jeoiaquim: Jeconias, seu filho, e Zedequias, seu filho.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιωακιμ Ιεχονιας υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Σεδεκιας υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The sons of Jechonias were Asir, Salathiel,
text_la: Filii Jechoniæ fuerunt : Asir, Salathiel,
text_pt: E os filhos de Jeconias: Assir, e seu filho Sealtiel.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιεχονια-ασιρ Σαλαθιηλ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Melchiram, Phadaia, Senneser and Jecemia, Sama, and Nadabia.
text_la: Melchiram, Phadaia, Senneser, et Jecemia, Sama, et Nadabia.
text_pt: Os filhos deste foram: Malquirão, Pedaías, Senazar, Jecamias, Hosama, e Nedabias.
text_el: Μελχιραμ καὶ Φαδαιας καὶ Σανεσαρ καὶ Ιεκεμια καὶ Ωσαμω καὶ Δενεθι

text_en: Of Phadaia were born Zorobabel and Semei. Zorobabel begot Mosollam, Hananias, and Salomith their sister:
text_la: De Phadaia orti sunt Zorobabel et Semei. Zorobabel genuit Mosollam, Hananiam, et Salomith sororem eorum:
text_pt: E os filhos de Pedaías: Zorobabel e Simei; e os filhos de Zorobabel: Mesulão, Hananias, e Selomite, sua irmã,
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Σαλαθιηλ Ζοροβαβελ καὶ Σεμεϊ καὶ υἱοὶ Ζοροβαβελ Μοσολλαμος καὶ Ανανια καὶ Σαλωμιθ ἀδελφὴ αὐτῶν

text_en: Hasaba also, and Ohol, and Barachias, and Hasadias, Josabhesed, five.
text_la: Hasaban quoque, et Ohol, et Barachian, et Hasadian, Josabhesed, quinque.
text_pt: E Hasubá, Oel, Berequias, Hasadias, Jusabe-Hesede, cinco.
text_el: καὶ Ασουβε καὶ Οολ καὶ Βαραχια καὶ Ασαδια καὶ Ασοβαεσδ πέντε

text_en: And the son of Hananias was Phaltias the father of Jeseias, whose son was Raphaia. And his son was Arnan, of whom was born Obdia, whose son was Sechenias.
text_la: Filius autem Hananiæ, Phaltias pater Jeseiæ, cujus filius Raphaia : hujus quoque filius, Arnan, de quo natus est Obdia, cujus filius fuit Sechenias.
text_pt: E os filhos de Hananias: Pelatias e Jesaías; os filhos de Refaías, os filhos de Arnã, os filhos de Obadias, e os filhos de Secanias.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ανανια Φαλλετια καὶ Ισαια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ραφαια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ορνα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Αβδια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Σεχενια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The son of Sechenias was Semeia, whose sons were Hattus, and Jegaal, and Baria, and Naaria, and Saphat, six in number.
text_la: Filius Secheniæ, Semeia : cujus filii Hattus, et Jegaal, et Baria, et Naaria, et Saphat, sex numero.
text_pt: E o filho de Secanias foi Semaías; e os filhos de Semaías: Hatus, e Igeal, e Bariá, e Nearias, e Safate, seis.
text_el: καὶ υἱὸς Σεχενια Σαμαια καὶ υἱοὶ Σαμαια Χαττους καὶ Ιωηλ καὶ Μαρι καὶ Νωαδια καὶ Σαφαθ ἕξ

text_en: The sons of Naaria, Elioenai, and Ezechias , and Ezricam, three.
text_la: Filius Naariæ, Elioënai, et Ezechias, et Ezricam, tres.
text_pt: E os filhos de Nearias: Elioenai, e Ezequias, e Azricão, três.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Νωαδια Ελιθεναν καὶ Εζεκια καὶ Εζρικαμ τρεῖς

text_en: The sons of Elioenai, Oduia, and Eliasub, and Pheleia, and Accub, and Johanan, and Dalaia, and Anani, seven.
text_la: Filii Elioënai, Oduia, et Eliasub, et Pheleia, et Accub, et Johanan, et Dalaia, et Anani, septem.
text_pt: E os filhos de Elioenai; Hodavias, Eliasibe, Pelaías, Acube, Joanã, Delaías, e Anani, sete.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ελιθεναν Οδουια καὶ Ελιασιβ καὶ Φαλαια καὶ Ακουν καὶ Ιωαναν καὶ Δαλαια καὶ Ανανι ἑπτά

text_en: The sons of Juda : Phares, Hesron, and Charmi and Hur, and Sobal.
text_la: Filii Juda : Phares, Hesron, et Charmi, et Hur, et Sobal.
text_pt: Os filhos de Judá foram: Perez, Hezrom, Carmi, Hur, e Sobal.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιουδα Φαρες Αρσων καὶ Χαρμι καὶ Ωρ Σουβαλ

text_en: And Raia the son of Sobal begot Jahath, of whom were born Ahumai, and Laad. These are the families of Sarathi.
text_la: Raia vero filius Sobal genuit Jahath, de quo nati sunt Ahumai, et Laad : hæ cognationes Sarathi.
text_pt: E Reaías, filho de Sobal gerou a Jaate, e Jaate gerou a Aumai e a Laade; estas são as famílias dos zoratitas.
text_el: καὶ Ραια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ Σουβαλ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιεθ καὶ Ιεθ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αχιμι καὶ τὸν Λααδ αὗται αἱ γενέσεις τοῦ Σαραθι

text_en: And this is the posterity of Etam: Jezrahel, and Jesema, And Jedebos: and the name of their sister was Asalelphuni.
text_la: Ista quoque stirps Etam : Jezrahel, et Jesema, et Jedebos. Nomen quoque sororis eorum, Asalelphuni.
text_pt: E estes foram os filhos do pai de Etã: Jizreel, Isma e Idbas; e era o nome de sua irmã Hazelelponi.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Αιταμ Ιεζραηλ καὶ Ραγμα καὶ Ιαβας καὶ ὄνομα ἀδελφῆς αὐτῶν Εσηλεββων

text_en: And Phanuel the father of Gedor, and Ezar the father of Hosa, these are the sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephratha the father of Bethlehem.
text_la: Phanuel autem pater Gedor, et Ezer pater Hosa : isti sunt filii Hur primogeniti Ephratha patris Bethlehem.
text_pt: E mais Penuel, pai de Gedor, e Ezer, pai de Husá; estes foram os filhos de Hur, o primogênito de Efrata, pai de Belém.
text_el: καὶ Φανουηλ πατὴρ Γεδωρ καὶ Αζηρ πατὴρ Ωσαν οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ωρ τοῦ πρωτοτόκου Εφραθα πατρὸς Βαιθλαεμ

text_en: And Assur the father of Thecua had two wives, Halaa and Naara:
text_la: Assur vero patri Thecuæ erant duæ uxores, Halaa et Naara.
text_pt: E tinha Asur, pai de Tecoa, duas mulheres: Helá e Naará.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Σαουρ πατρὶ Θεκωε ἦσαν δύο γυναῖκες Αωδα καὶ Θοαδα

text_en: And Naara bore him Ozam, and Hepher, and Themani, and Ahasthari: these are the sons of Naara.
text_la: Peperit autem ei Naara, Oozam, et Hepher, et Themani, et Ahasthari : isti sunt filii Naara.
text_pt: E Naará deu à luz a Auzão, e a Hefer, e a Temeni, e a Haastari; estes foram os filhos de Naará.
text_el: καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ Αωδα τὸν Ωχαζαμ καὶ τὸν Ηφαδ καὶ τὸν Θαιμαν καὶ τὸν Ασθηραν πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Αωδας

text_en: And the sons of Halaa, Sereth, Isaar, and Ethnan.
text_la: Porro filii Halaa, Sereth, Isaar et Ethnan.
text_pt: E os filhos de Helá: Zerete, Izar e Etnã.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Θοαδα Σαρεθ καὶ Σααρ καὶ Εθναν

text_en: And Cos begot Anob, and Soboba, and the kindred of Aharehel the son of Arum.
text_la: Cos autem genuit Anob, et Soboba, et cognationem Aharehel filii Arum.
text_pt: E Coz gerou a Anube e a Zobeba e as famílias de Aarel, filho de Harum.
text_el: καὶ Κως ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ενωβ καὶ τὸν Σαβηβα καὶ γεννήσεις ἀδελφοῦ Ρηχαβ υἱοῦ Ιαριμ

text_en: And Jabes was more honourable than any of his brethren, and his mother called his name Jabes, saying: Because I bore him with sorrow.
text_la: Fuit autem Jabes inclytus præ fratribus suis, et mater ejus vocavit nomen illius Jabes, dicens : Quia peperi eum in dolore.
text_pt: E foi Jabez mais ilustre do que seus irmãos; e sua mãe deu-lhe o nome de Jabez, dizendo: Porquanto com dores o dei à luz.
text_el: καὶ ἦν Ιγαβης ἔνδοξος ὑπὲρ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ιγαβης λέγουσα ἔτεκον ὡς γαβης

text_en: And Jabes called upon the God of Israel , saying: If blessing you will bless me, and will enlarge my borders, and your hand be with me, and you save me from being oppressed by evil . And God granted him the things he prayed for.
text_la: Invocavit vero Jabes Deum Israël, dicens : Si benedicens benedixeris mihi, et dilataveris terminos meos, et fuerit manus tua mecum, et feceris me a malitia non opprimi. Et præstitit Deus quæ precatus est.
text_pt: Porque Jabez invocou o Deus de Israel, dizendo: Se me abençoares muitíssimo, e meus termos ampliares, e a tua mão for comigo, e fizeres que do mal não seja afligido! E Deus lhe concedeu o que lhe tinha pedido.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεκαλέσατο Ιγαβης τὸν θεὸν Ισραηλ λέγων ἐὰν εὐλογῶν εὐλογήσῃς με καὶ πληθύνῃς τὰ ὅριά μου καὶ ᾖ ἡ χείρ σου μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ποιήσεις γνῶσιν τοῦ μὴ ταπεινῶσαί με καὶ ἐπήγαγεν ὁ θεὸς πάντα ὅσα ᾐτήσατο

text_en: And Caleb the brother of Sua begot Mahir, who was the father of Esthon.
text_la: Caleb autem frater Sua genuit Mahir, qui fuit pater Esthon.
text_pt: E Quelube, irmão de Suá, gerou a Meir; este é o pai de Estom.
text_el: καὶ Χαλεβ πατὴρ Ασχα ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μαχιρ οὗτος πατὴρ Ασσαθων

text_en: And Esthon begot Bethrapha, and Phesse, and Tehinna father of the city of Naas: these are the men of Recha.
text_la: Porro Esthon genuit Bethrapha, et Phesse, et Tehinna patrem urbis Naas : hi sunt viri Recha.
text_pt: E Estom gerou a Bete-Rafa, a Pasea, e a Teina, pai de Ir-Naás; estes foram os homens de Reca.
text_el: καὶ Ασσαθων ἐγέννησεν τὸν Βαθρεφαν καὶ τὸν Φεσσηε καὶ τὸν Θανα πατέρα πόλεως Ναας ἀδελφοῦ Εσελων τοῦ Κενεζι οὗτοι ἄνδρες Ρηφα

text_en: And the sons of Cenez were Othoniel, and Saraia. And the sons of Othoniel, Hathath, and Maonathi.
text_la: Filii autem Cenez, Othoniel, et Saraia. Porro filii Othoniel, Hathath, et Maonathi.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Quenaz: Otniel e Seraías; o filho de Otniel: Hatate.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Κενεζ Γοθονιηλ καὶ Σαραια καὶ υἱοὶ Γοθονιηλ Αθαθ

text_en: Maonathi begot Ophra, and Saraia begot Joab the father of the Valley of artificers: for artificers were there.
text_la: Maonathi genuit Ophra, Saraia autem genuit Joab patrem Vallis artificum : ibi quippe artifices erant.
text_pt: E Meonotai gerou a Ofra, e Seraías gerou a Joabe, pai dos do vale dos artífices; porque os dali eram artífices.
text_el: καὶ Μαναθι ἐγέννησεν τὸν Γοφερα καὶ Σαραια ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιωαβ πατέρα Αγεαδδαϊρ ὅτι τέκτονες ἦσαν

text_en: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephone , were Hir, and Ela, and Naham. And the sons of Ela: Cenez.
text_la: Filii vero Caleb filii Jephone, Hir, et Ela, et Naham. Filii quoque Ela : Cenez.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Calebe, filho de Jefoné: Iru, Elá e Naã; e o filho de Elá: Quenaz.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Χαλεβ υἱοῦ Ιεφοννη Ηρα Αλα καὶ Νοομ καὶ υἱοὶ Αλα Κενεζ

text_en: The sons also of Jaleleel: Ziph, and Zipha, Thiria and Asrael.
text_la: Filii quoque Jaleleel : Ziph, et Zipha, Thiria, et Asraël.
text_pt: E os filhos de Jealelel: Zife, Zifa, Tiria e Asareel.
text_el: καὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Γεσεηλ Αμηαχι καὶ Ζαφα καὶ Ζαιρα καὶ Εσεραηλ

text_en: And the sons of Esra, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon, and he begot Mariam, and Sammai, and Jesba the father of Esthamo.
text_la: Et filii Ezra, Jether, et Mered, et Epher, et Jalon, genuitque Mariam, et Sammai, et Jesba patrem Esthamo.
text_pt: E os filhos de Ezra: Jeter, Merede, Efer, e Jalom; e teve mais a Miriã, e Samai, e Isbá, pai de Estemoa.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Εσρι Ιεθερ Μωραδ καὶ Αφερ καὶ Ιαλων καὶ ἐγέννησεν Ιεθερ τὸν Μαρων καὶ τὸν Σεμαι καὶ τὸν Μαρεθ πατέρα Εσθεμων

text_en: And his wife Judaia, bore Jared the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Icuthiel the father of Zanoe. And these are the sons of Bethia the daughter of Pharao , whom Mered took to wife .
text_la: Uxor quoque ejus Judaia, peperit Jared patrem Gedor, et Heber patrem Socho, et Icuthiel patrem Zanoë : hi autem filii Bethiæ filiæ Pharaonis, quam accepit Mered.
text_pt: E sua mulher, Judia, deu à luz a Jerede, pai de Gedor, e a Héber, pai de Socó, e a Jecutiel, pai de Zanoa; e estes foram os filhos de Bitia, filha de Faraó, que Merede tomou.
text_el: καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ αὕτη Αδια ἔτεκεν τὸν Ιαρεδ πατέρα Γεδωρ καὶ τὸν Αβερ πατέρα Σωχων καὶ τὸν Ιεκθιηλ πατέρα Ζανω καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Γελια θυγατρὸς Φαραω ἣν ἔλαβεν Μωρηδ

text_en: And the sons of his wife Odaia the sister of Naham the father of Celia, Garmi, and Esthamo, who was of Machathi.
text_la: Et filii uxoris Odaiæ sororis Naham patris Ceila, Garmi, et Esthamo, qui fuit de Machathi.
text_pt: E foram os filhos da mulher de Hodias, irmã de Naã: Abiqueila, o garmita, Estemoa, o maacatita.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ γυναικὸς τῆς Ιδουιας ἀδελφῆς Ναχεμ καὶ Δαλια πατὴρ Κεϊλα καὶ Σεμειων πατὴρ Ιωμαν καὶ υἱοὶ Ναημ πατρὸς Κεϊλα Αγαρμι καὶ Εσθεμωη Μαχαθι

text_en: The sons also of Simon, Amnon, and Rinna the son of Hanan, and Thilon. And the sons of Jesi Zoheth, and Benzoheth.
text_la: Filii quoque Simon, Amnon, et Rinna filius Hanan, et Thilon. Et filii Jesi, Zoheth, et Benzoheth.
text_pt: E os filhos de Simeão: Amom, Rina, Bene-Hanã, e Tilom; e os filhos de Isi: Zoete e Bene-Zoete.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Σεμιων Αμνων καὶ Ρανα υἱὸς Αναν καὶ Θιλων καὶ υἱοὶ Ισεϊ Ζωαθ καὶ υἱοὶ Ζωαθ

text_en: The sons of Sela the son of Juda : Her the father of Lecha, and Laada the father of Maresa, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen in the House of oath .
text_la: Filii Sela, filii Juda : Her pater Lecha, et Laada pater Maresa, et cognationes domus operantium byssum in domo juramenti.
text_pt: Os filhos de Selá, filho de Judá: Er, pai de Leca, e Lada, pai de Maressa, e as famílias da casa dos que fabricavam linho fino, em casa de Asbéia.
text_el: υἱοὶ Σηλωμ υἱοῦ Ιουδα Ηρ πατὴρ Ληχα καὶ Λααδα πατὴρ Μαρησα καὶ γενέσεις οἰκιῶν εφραθ αβακ τῷ οἴκῳ Εσοβα

text_en: And he that made the sun to stand, and the men of Lying, and Secure, and Burning, who were princes in Moab , and who returned into Lahem. Now these are things of old.
text_la: Et qui stare fecit solem, virique Mendacii, et Securus, et Incendens, qui principes fuerunt in Moab, et qui reversi sunt in Lahem : hæc autem verba vetera.
text_pt: Como também Joquim, e os homens de Cozeba, e Joás, e Sarafe (que dominaram sobre os moabitas), e Jasubi-Leém; porém estas coisas já são antigas.
text_el: καὶ Ιωακιμ καὶ ἄνδρες Χωζηβα καὶ Ιωας καὶ Σαραφ οἳ κατῴκησαν ἐν Μωαβ καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν αὐτοὺς αβεδηριν αθουκιιν

text_en: These are the potters, and they dwelt in Plantations, and Hedges, with the king for his works, and they abode there.
text_la: Hi sunt figuli habitantes in plantationibus et in sepibus, apud regem in operibus ejus : commoratique sunt ibi.
text_pt: Estes foram oleiros, e habitavam nas hortas e nos cerrados; estes ficaram ali com o rei na sua obra.
text_el: οὗτοι κεραμεῖς οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐν Ναταϊμ καὶ Γαδηρα μετὰ τοῦ βασιλέως ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ ἐνίσχυσαν καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐκεῖ

text_en: The sons of Simeon : Namuel and Jamin, Jarib, Zara, Saul:
text_la: Filii Simeon : Namuel et Jamin, Jarib, Zara, Saul.
text_pt: Os filhos de Simeão foram Nemuel, Jamim, Jaribe, Zerá, e Saul,
text_el: υἱοὶ Συμεων Ναμουηλ καὶ Ιαμιν Ιαριβ Ζαρε Σαουλ

text_en: Sellum his son, Mapsam his son, Masma his son.
text_la: Sellum filius ejus, Mapsam filius ejus, Masma filius ejus.
text_pt: Cujo filho foi Salum, de quem foi filho Mibsão, de quem foi filho Misma.
text_el: Σαλεμ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Μαβασαμ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Μασμα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The sons of Masma: Hamuel his son, Zachur his son, Semei his son.
text_la: Filii Masma : Hamuel filius ejus, Zachur filius ejus, Semei filius ejus.
text_pt: E os filhos de Misma foram: Hamuel, de quem foi filho Zacur, de quem foi filho Simei.
text_el: Αμουηλ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Σαβουδ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ζακχουρ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Σεμεϊ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The sons of Semei were sixteen, and six daughters: but his brethren had not many sons, and the whole kindred could not reach to the sum of the children of Juda .
text_la: Filii Semei sedecim, et filiæ sex : fratres autem ejus non habuerunt filios multos, et universa cognatio non potuit adæquare summam filiorum Juda.
text_pt: E Simei teve dezesseis filhos, e seis filhas, porém seus irmãos não tiveram muitos filhos; e toda a sua família não se multiplicou tanto como as dos filhos de Judá.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Σεμεϊ υἱοὶ ἑκκαίδεκα καὶ θυγατέρες τρεῖς καὶ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτῶν οὐκ ἦσαν υἱοὶ πολλοί καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ πατριαὶ αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐπλεόνασαν ὡς υἱοὶ Ιουδα

text_en: And they dwelt in Bersabee , and Molada, and Hasarsuhal,
text_la: Habitaverunt autem in Bersabee, et Molada, et Hasarsuhal,
text_pt: E habitaram em Berseba, e em Moladá, e em Hazar-Sual,
text_el: καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐν Βηρσαβεε καὶ Σαμα καὶ Μωλαδα καὶ Εσηρσουαλ

text_en: and in Bala, and in Asom, and in Tholad,
text_la: et in Bala, et in Asom, et in Tholad,
text_pt: E em Bila, e em Ezém, e em Tolade,
text_el: καὶ ἐν Βαλαα καὶ Βοασομ καὶ Θουλαδ

text_en: and in Bathuel, and in Horma, and in Siceleg,
text_la: et in Bathuel, et in Horma, et in Siceleg,
text_pt: E em Betuel, e em Hormá, e em Ziclague,
text_el: καὶ Βαθουηλ καὶ Ερμα καὶ Σεκλαγ

text_en: and in Bethmarchaboth, and in Hasarsusim, and in Bethberai, and in Saarim. These were their cities unto the reign of David .
text_la: et in Bethmarchaboth, et in Hasarsusim, et in Bethberai, et in Saarim : hæ civitates eorum usque ad regem David.
text_pt: E em Bete-Marcabote, e em Hazar-Susim, e em Bete-Biri, e em Saaraim; estas foram as suas cidades, até que Davi reinou.
text_el: καὶ Βαιθμαρχαβωθ καὶ ἥμισυ Σωσιμ καὶ οἶκον Βαρουμσεωριμ αὗται πόλεις αὐτῶν ἕως βασιλέως Δαυιδ

text_en: Their towns also were Etam, and Aen, Remmon, and Thochen, and Asan, five cities.
text_la: Villæ quoque eorum : Etam, et Aën, Remmon, et Thochen, et Asan, civitates quinque.
text_pt: E foram as suas aldeias: Etã, Aim, Rimom, Toquém, e Asã, cinco cidades,
text_el: καὶ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν Αιταμ καὶ Ηνρεμμων καὶ Θοκκαν καὶ Αισαν πόλεις πέντε

text_en: And all their villages round about these cities as far as Baal . This was their habitation, and the distribution of their dwellings.
text_la: Et universi viculi eorum per circuitum civitatum istarum usque ad Baal : hæc est habitatio eorum, et sedium distributio.
text_pt: E todas as suas aldeias, que estavam em redor destas cidades, até Baal. Estas foram as suas habitações e suas genealogias.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν κύκλῳ τῶν πόλεων τούτων ἕως Βααλ αὕτη ἡ κατάσχεσις αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ καταλοχισμὸς αὐτῶν

text_en: And Mosabab and Jemlech, and Josaphat, the son of Amasias,
text_la: Mosobab quoque et Jemlech, et Josa filius Amasiæ,
text_pt: Porém Mesobabe, e Janleque e Josa, filho de Amazias,
text_el: καὶ Μοσωβαβ καὶ Ιεμολοχ καὶ Ιωσια υἱὸς Αμασια

text_en: and Joel, and Jehu the son of Josabia the son of Saraia, the son of Asiel,
text_la: et Joël, et Jehu filius Josabiæ filii Saraiæ filii Asiel,
text_pt: E Joel, e Jeú, filho de Josibias, filho de Seraías, filho de Asiel,
text_el: καὶ Ιωηλ καὶ οὗτος υἱὸς Ισαβια υἱὸς Σαραια υἱὸς Ασιηλ

text_en: and Elioenai, and Jacoba, and Isuhaia, and Asaia, and Adiel, and Ismiel, and Banaia,
text_la: et Elioënai, et Jacoba, et Isuhaia, et Asaia, et Adiel, et Ismiel, et Banaia,
text_pt: E Elioenai e Jaacobá, Jesoaías, Asaías, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaias,
text_el: καὶ Ελιωηναι καὶ Ιακαβα καὶ Ιασουια καὶ Ασαια καὶ Εδιηλ καὶ Ισμαηλ καὶ Βαναια

text_en: Ziza also the son of Sephei the son of Allon the son of Idaia the son of Semri the son of Samaia.
text_la: Ziza quoque filius Sephei filii Allon filii Idaia filii Semri filii Samaia.
text_pt: E Ziza, filho de Sifi, filho de Alom, filho de Jedaías, filho de Sinri, filho de Semaías;
text_el: καὶ Ζουζα υἱὸς Σεφεϊ υἱοῦ Αλλων υἱοῦ Ιεδια υἱοῦ Σαμαρι υἱοῦ Σαμαιου

text_en: These were named princes in their kindreds, and in the houses of their families were multiplied exceedingly.
text_la: Isti sunt nominati principes in cognationibus suis, et in domo affinitatum suarum multiplicati sunt vehementer.
text_pt: Estes, registrados por seus nomes, foram príncipes nas suas famílias; e as famílias de seus pais se multiplicaram abundantemente.
text_el: οὗτοι οἱ διελθόντες ἐν ὀνόμασιν ἀρχόντων ἐν ταῖς γενέσεσιν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν οἴκοις πατριῶν αὐτῶν ἐπληθύνθησαν εἰς πλῆθος

text_en: And they went forth to enter into Gador as far as to the east side of the valley, to seek pastures for their flocks.
text_la: Et profecti sunt ut ingrederentur in Gador usque ad orientem vallis, et ut quærerent pascua gregibus suis.
text_pt: E chegaram até à entrada de Gedor, ao oriente do vale, a buscar pasto para os seus rebanhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν Γεραρα ἕως τῶν ἀνατολῶν τῆς Γαι τοῦ ζητῆσαι νομὰς τοῖς κτήνεσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And they found fat pastures, and very good , and a country spacious, and quiet, and fruitful, in which some of the race of Cham had dwelt before.
text_la: Inveneruntque pascuas uberes, et valde bonas, et terram latissimam et quietam et fertilem, in qua ante habitaverant de stirpe Cham.
text_pt: E acharam pasto fértil e terra espaçosa, e quieta, e descansada; porque os de Cão haviam habitado ali antes.
text_el: καὶ εὗρον νομὰς πίονας καὶ ἀγαθάς καὶ ἡ γῆ πλατεῖα ἐναντίον αὐτῶν καὶ εἰρήνη καὶ ἡσυχία ὅτι ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Χαμ τῶν κατοικούντων ἐκεῖ ἔμπροσθεν

text_en: And these whose names are written above, came in the days of Ezechias king of Juda : and they beat down their tents, and slew the inhabitants that were found there, and utterly destroyed them unto this day: and they dwelt in their place, because they found there fat pastures.
text_la: Hi ergo venerunt, quos supra descripsimus nominatim, in diebus Ezechiæ regis Juda : et percusserunt tabernacula eorum, et habitatores qui inventi fuerant ibi, et deleverunt eos usque in præsentem diem : habitaveruntque pro eis, quoniam uberrimas pascuas ibidem repererunt.
text_pt: Estes, pois, que estão descritos por seus nomes, vieram nos dias de Ezequias, rei de Judá, e derrubaram as tendas e habitações dos que se acharam ali, e as destruíram totalmente até o dia de hoje, e habitaram em seu lugar; porque ali havia pasto para os seus rebanhos.
text_el: καὶ ἤλθοσαν οὗτοι οἱ γεγραμμένοι ἐπ' ὀνόματος ἐν ἡμέραις Εζεκιου βασιλέως Ιουδα καὶ ἐπάταξαν τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς Μιναίους οὓς εὕροσαν ἐκεῖ καὶ ἀνεθεμάτισαν αὐτοὺς ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης καὶ ᾤκησαν ἀντ' αὐτῶν ὅτι νομαὶ τοῖς κτήνεσιν αὐτῶν ἐκεῖ

text_en: Some also of the children of Simeon , five hundred men , went into mount Seir, having for their captains Phaltias and Naaria and Raphaia and Oziel the sons of Jesi:
text_la: De filiis quoque Simeon abierunt in montem Seir viri quingenti, habentes principes Phalthiam et Naariam et Raphaiam et Oziel filios Jesi:
text_pt: Também deles, dos filhos de Simeão, quinhentos homens foram às montanhas de Seir; levaram por cabeças a Pelatias, e a Nearias, e a Refaías, e a Uziel, filhos de Isi.
text_el: καὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Συμεων ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς ὄρος Σηιρ ἄνδρες πεντακόσιοι καὶ Φαλεττια καὶ Νωαδια καὶ Ραφαια καὶ Οζιηλ υἱοὶ Ιεσι ἄρχοντες αὐτῶν

text_en: And they slew the remnant of the Amalecites , who had been able to escape, and they dwelt there in their stead unto this day.
text_la: et percusserunt reliquias, quæ evadere potuerant, Amalecitarum, et habitaverunt ibi pro eis usque ad diem hanc.
text_pt: E feriram o restante dos que escaparam dos amalequitas, e habitaram ali até o dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξαν τοὺς καταλοίπους τοὺς καταλειφθέντας τοῦ Αμαληκ καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐκεῖ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: Now the sons of Ruben the firstborn of Israel , (for he was his firstborn : but forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his first birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel , and he was not accounted for the firstborn .
text_la: Filii quoque Ruben primogeniti Israël. (Ipse quippe fuit primogenitus ejus : sed cum violasset thorum patris sui, data sunt primogenita ejus filiis Joseph filii Israël, et non est ille reputatus in primogenitum.
text_pt: Quanto aos filhos de Rúben, o primogênito de Israel (pois ele era o primogênito; mas porque profanara a cama de seu pai, deu-se a sua primogenitura aos filhos de José, filho de Israel; de modo que não foi contado, na genealogia da primogenitura,
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ρουβην πρωτοτόκου Ισραηλ ὅτι οὗτος ὁ πρωτότοκος καὶ ἐν τῷ ἀναβῆναι ἐπὶ τὴν κοίτην τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἔδωκεν εὐλογίαν αὐτοῦ τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ Ιωσηφ υἱῷ Ισραηλ καὶ οὐκ ἐγενεαλογήθη εἰς πρωτοτόκια

text_en: But of the race of Juda , who was the strongest among his brethren, came the princes: but the first birthright was accounted to Joseph .)
text_la: Porro Judas, qui erat fortissimus inter fratres suos, de stirpe ejus principes germinati sunt : primogenita autem reputata sunt Joseph.)
text_pt: Porque Judá foi poderoso entre seus irmãos, e dele veio o soberano; porém a primogenitura foi de José).
text_el: ὅτι Ιουδας δυνατὸς ἰσχύι καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς ἡγούμενον ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ εὐλογία τοῦ Ιωσηφ

text_en: The sons then of Ruben the firstborn of Israel were Enoch, and Phallu, Esron, and Charmi.
text_la: Filii ergo Ruben primogeniti Israël : Enoch, et Phallu, Esron, et Carmi.
text_pt: Foram, pois, os filhos de Rúben, o primogênito de Israel: Enoque, Palu, Hezrom, e Carmi.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ρουβην πρωτοτόκου Ισραηλ Ενωχ καὶ Φαλλους Αρσων καὶ Χαρμι

text_en: The sons of Joel: Samaia his son, Gog his son, Semei his son,
text_la: Filii Joël : Samia filius ejus, Gog filius ejus, Semei filius ejus,
text_pt: Os filhos de Joel: Semaías, seu filho; Gogue, seu filho; Simei, seu filho;
text_el: υἱοὶ Ιωηλ Σεμεϊ καὶ Βαναια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ υἱοὶ Γουγ υἱοῦ Σεμεϊ

text_en: Micha his son, Reia his son, Baal his son,
text_la: Micha filius ejus, Reia filius ejus, Baal filius ejus,
text_pt: Mica, seu filho; Reaías, seu filho; Baal, seu filho;
text_el: υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Μιχα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ρηχα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Βααλ

text_en: Beera his son, whom Thelgathphalnasar king of the Assyrians carried away captive, and he was prince in the tribe of Ruben .
text_la: Beera filius ejus, quem captivum duxit Thelgathphalnasar rex Assyriorum, et fuit princeps in tribu Ruben.
text_pt: Beera, seu filho, o qual Tiglate-Pilneser, rei da Assíria, levou preso; este foi príncipe dos rubenitas.
text_el: υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Βεηρα ὃν μετῴκισεν Θαγλαθφαλνασαρ βασιλεὺς Ασσουρ οὗτος ἄρχων τῶν Ρουβην

text_en: And his brethren, and all his kindred, when they were numbered by their families , had for princes Jehiel, and Zacharias.
text_la: Fratres autem ejus, et universa cognatio ejus, quando numerabantur per familias suas, habuerunt principes Jehiel, et Zachariam.
text_pt: Quanto a seus irmãos pelas suas famílias, quando foram postos nas genealogias, segundo as suas descendências, tiveram por chefes Jeiel e Zacarias,
text_el: καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ τῇ πατριᾷ αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς καταλοχισμοῖς αὐτῶν κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν ὁ ἄρχων Ιωηλ καὶ Ζαχαρια

text_en: And Bala the son of Azaz, the son of Samma, the son of Joel, dwelt in Aroer as far as Nebo , and Beelmeon.
text_la: Porro Bala filius Azaz filii Samma filii Joël, ipse habitavit in Aroër usque ad Nebo, et Beelmeon.
text_pt: E Bela, filho de Azaz, filho de Sema, filho de Joel, que habitou em Aroer, até Nebo e Baal-Meom,
text_el: καὶ Βαλεκ υἱὸς Οζουζ υἱὸς Σαμα υἱὸς Ιωηλ οὗτος κατῴκησεν ἐν Αροηρ καὶ ἐπὶ Ναβαυ καὶ Βεελμαων

text_en: And eastward he had his habitation as far as the entrance of the desert , and the river Euphrates. For they possessed a great number of cattle in the land of Galaad.
text_la: Contra orientalem quoque plagam habitavit usque ad introitum eremi, et flumen Euphraten. Multum quippe jumentorum numerum possidebant in terra Galaad.
text_pt: Também habitou do lado do oriente, até à entrada do deserto, desde o rio Eufrates; porque seu gado se tinha multiplicado na terra de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ πρὸς ἀνατολὰς κατῴκησεν ἕως ἐρχομένων τῆς ἐρήμου ἀπὸ τοῦ ποταμοῦ Εὐφράτου ὅτι κτήνη αὐτῶν πολλὰ ἐν γῇ Γαλααδ

text_en: And in the days of Saul they fought against the Agarites, and slew them, and dwelt in their tents in their stead, in all the country, that looks to the east of Galaad.
text_la: In diebus autem Saul præliati sunt contra Agareos, et interfecerunt illos, habitaveruntque pro eis in tabernaculis eorum, in omni plaga quæ respicit ad orientem Galaad.
text_pt: E nos dias de Saul fizeram guerra aos hagarenos, que caíram pela sua mão; e eles habitaram nas suas tendas defronte de todo o lado oriental de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις Σαουλ ἐποίησαν πόλεμον πρὸς τοὺς παροίκους καὶ ἔπεσον ἐν χερσὶν αὐτῶν κατοικοῦντες ἐν σκηναῖς ἕως πάντες κατ' ἀνατολὰς τῆς Γαλααδ

text_en: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them in the land of Basan, as far as Selcha:
text_la: Filii vero Gad e regione eorum habitaverunt in terra Basan usque Selcha:
text_pt: E os filhos de Gade habitaram defronte deles, na terra de Basã, até Salcá.
text_el: υἱοὶ Γαδ κατέναντι αὐτῶν κατῴκησαν ἐν τῇ Βασαν ἕως Σελχα

text_en: Johel the chief, and Saphan the second: and Janai, and Saphat in Basan.
text_la: Joël in capite, et Saphan secundus : Janai autem et Saphat in Basan.
text_pt: Joel foi chefe, e Safã o segundo; também Janai e Safate estavam em Basã.
text_el: Ιωηλ ὁ πρωτότοκος καὶ Σαφαμ ὁ δεύτερος καὶ Ιανι ὁ γραμματεὺς ἐν Βασαν

text_en: And their brethren according to the houses of their kindreds, were Michael and Mosollam, and Sebe, and Jorai, and Jacan, and Zie, and Heber, seven.
text_la: Fratres vero eorum secundum domos cognationum suarum, Michaël, et Mosollam, et Sebe, et Jorai, et Jachan, et Zie, et Heber, septem.
text_pt: E seus irmãos, segundo as suas casas paternas, foram: Micael, Mesulão, Seba, Jorai, Jacã, Zia, e Éber, sete.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν Μιχαηλ Μοσολλαμ καὶ Σεβεε καὶ Ιωρεε καὶ Ιαχαν καὶ Ζουε καὶ Ωβηδ ἑπτά

text_en: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jara, the son of Galaad, the son of Michael, the son of Jesisi, the son of Jeddo, the son of Buz.
text_la: Hi filii Abihail, filii Huri, filii Jara, filii Galaad, filii Michaël, filii Jesesi, filii Jeddo, filii Buz.
text_pt: Estes foram os filhos de Abiail filho de Huri, filho de Jaroa, filho de Gileade, filho de Micael, filho de Jesisai, filho de Jado, filho de Buz;
text_el: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Αβιχαιλ υἱοῦ Ουρι υἱοῦ Ιδαι υἱοῦ Γαλααδ υἱοῦ Μιχαηλ υἱοῦ Ισαι υἱοῦ Ιουρι υἱοῦ Ζαβουχαμ

text_en: And their brethren the sons of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house in their families ,
text_la: Fratres quoque, filii Abdiel filii Guni, princeps domus in familiis suis.
text_pt: Aí, filho de Abdiel, filho de Guni, foi chefe da casa de seus pais.
text_el: υἱοῦ Αβδιηλ υἱοῦ Γουνι ἄρχων οἴκου πατριῶν

text_en: and they dwelt in Galaad, and in Basan and in the towns thereof, and in all the suburbs of Saron, unto the borders.
text_la: Et habitaverunt in Galaad, et in Basan, et in viculis ejus, et in cunctis suburbanis Saron, usque ad terminos.
text_pt: E habitaram em Gileade, em Basã e nos lugares da sua jurisdição; como também em todos os arrabaldes de Sarom, até aos seus termos.
text_el: κατῴκουν ἐν Γαλααδ ἐν Βασαν καὶ ἐν ταῖς κώμαις αὐτῶν καὶ πάντα τὰ περίχωρα Σαρων ἕως ἐξόδου

text_en: All these were numbered in the days of Joathan king of Juda , and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel .
text_la: Omnes hi numerati sunt in diebus Joathan regis Juda, et in diebus Jeroboam regis Israël.
text_pt: Todos estes foram registrados, segundo as suas genealogias, nos dias de Jotão, rei de Judá, e nos dias de Jeroboão, rei de Israel.
text_el: πάντων ὁ καταλοχισμὸς ἐν ἡμέραις Ιωαθαμ βασιλέως Ιουδα καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις Ιεροβοαμ βασιλέως Ισραηλ

text_en: The Sons of Ruben , and of Gad , and of the half tribe of Manasses , fighting men , bearing shields, and swords, and bending the bow, and trained up to battles, four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore that went out to war .
text_la: Filii Ruben, et Gad, et dimidiæ tribus Manasse, viri bellatores, scuta portantes et gladios, et tendentes arcum, eruditique ad prælia, quadraginta quatuor millia et septingenti sexaginta, procedentes ad pugnam.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Rúben, e dos gaditas, e da meia tribo de Manassés, homens muito valentes, que traziam escudo e espada, e entesavam o arco, e eram destros na guerra; houve quarenta e quatro mil e setecentos e sessenta, que saíam à peleja.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ρουβην καὶ Γαδ καὶ ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασση ἐξ υἱῶν δυνάμεως ἄνδρες αἴροντες ἀσπίδας καὶ μάχαιραν καὶ τείνοντες τόξον καὶ δεδιδαγμένοι πόλεμον τεσσαράκοντα καὶ τέσσαρες χιλιάδες καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι καὶ ἑξήκοντα ἐκπορευόμενοι εἰς παράταξιν

text_en: They fought against the Agarites: but the Itureans, and Naphis, and Nodab,
text_la: Dimicaverunt contra Agareos : Ituræi vero, et Naphis, et Nodab
text_pt: E fizeram guerra aos hagarenos, como a Jetur, e a Nafis e a Nodabe.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίουν πόλεμον μετὰ τῶν Αγαρηνῶν καὶ Ιτουραίων καὶ Ναφισαίων καὶ Ναδαβαίων

text_en: gave them help. and the Agarites were delivered into their hands, and all that were with them, because they called upon God in the battle: and he heard them, because they had put their faith in him.
text_la: præbuerunt eis auxilium. Traditique sunt in manus eorum Agarei, et universi qui fuerant cum eis, quia Deum invocaverunt cum præliarentur : et exaudivit eos, eo quod credidissent in eum.
text_pt: E foram ajudados contra eles, e os hagarenos e todos quantos estavam com eles foram entregues em sua mão; porque, na peleja, clamaram a Deus que lhes deu ouvidos, porquanto confiaram nele.
text_el: καὶ κατίσχυσαν ἐπ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἐδόθησαν εἰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν οἱ Αγαραῖοι καὶ πάντα τὰ σκηνώματα αὐτῶν ὅτι πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ἐβόησαν ἐν τῷ πολέμῳ καὶ ἐπήκουσεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἤλπισαν ἐπ' αὐτόν

text_en: And they took all that they possessed, of camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men a hundred thousand souls .
text_la: Ceperuntque omnia quæ possederant, camelorum quinquaginta millia, et ovium ducenta quinquaginta millia, et asinos duo millia, et animas hominum centum millia.
text_pt: E levaram preso o seu gado; seus camelos, cinqüenta mil, e duzentas e cinqüenta mil ovelhas, e dois mil jumentos, e cem mil homens.
text_el: καὶ ᾐχμαλώτευσαν τὴν ἀποσκευὴν αὐτῶν καμήλους πεντακισχιλίας καὶ προβάτων διακοσίας πεντήκοντα χιλιάδας ὄνους δισχιλίους καὶ ψυχὰς ἀνδρῶν ἑκατὸν χιλιάδας

text_en: And many fell down slain: for it was the battle of the Lord . And they dwelt in their stead till the captivity.
text_la: Vulnerati autem multi corruerunt : fuit enim bellum Domini. Habitaveruntque pro eis usque ad transmigrationem.
text_pt: Porque muitos caíram feridos, porque de Deus era a peleja; e habitaram em seu lugar, até ao cativeiro.
text_el: ὅτι τραυματίαι πολλοὶ ἔπεσον ὅτι παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ὁ πόλεμος καὶ κατῴκησαν ἀντ' αὐτῶν ἕως τῆς μετοικεσίας

text_en: And the children of the half tribe of Manasses possessed the land, from the borders of Basan unto Baal, Hermon, and Sanir, and mount Hermon , for their number was great.
text_la: Filii quoque dimidiæ tribus Manasse possederunt terram a finibus Basan usque Baal, Hermon, et Sanir, et montem Hermon : ingens quippe numerus erat.
text_pt: E os filhos da meia tribo de Manassés habitaram naquela terra; multiplicaram-se desde Basã até Baal-Hermom, e Senir, e o monte de Hermom.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἡμίσεις φυλῆς Μανασση κατῴκησαν ἐν τῇ γῇ ἀπὸ Βασαν ἕως Βααλερμων καὶ Σανιρ καὶ ὄρος Αερμων καὶ ἐν τῷ Λιβάνῳ αὐτοὶ ἐπλεονάσθησαν

text_en: And these were the heads of the house of their kindred, Epher, and Jesi, and Eliel, and Esriel, and Jeremia , and Odoia, and Jediel, most valiant and powerful men , and famous chiefs in their families .
text_la: Et hi fuerunt principes domus cognationis eorum : Epher, et Jesi, et Eliel, et Ezriel, et Jeremia, et Odoia, et Jediel, viri fortissimi et potentes, et nominati duces in familiis suis.
text_pt: E estes foram cabeças de suas casas paternas, a saber: Hefer, Isi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremias, Hodavias, e Jadiel, homens valentes, homens de nome, e chefes das casas de seus pais.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι ἀρχηγοὶ οἴκου πατριῶν αὐτῶν Οφερ καὶ Ισεϊ καὶ Ελιηλ καὶ Εσδριηλ καὶ Ιερμια καὶ Ωδουια καὶ Ιεδιηλ ἄνδρες ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει ἄνδρες ὀνομαστοί ἄρχοντες τῶν οἴκων πατριῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: But they forsook the God of their fathers, and went astray after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
text_la: Reliquerunt autem Deum patrum suorum, et fornicati sunt post deos populorum terræ, quos abstulit Deus coram eis.
text_pt: Porém transgrediram contra o Deus de seus pais; e se prostituíram, seguindo os deuses dos povos da terra, os quais Deus destruíra de diante deles.
text_el: καὶ ἠθέτησαν ἐν θεῷ πατέρων αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπόρνευσαν ὀπίσω θεῶν λαῶν τῆς γῆς οὓς ἐξῆρεν ὁ θεὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν

text_en: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Phul king of the Assyrians . and the spirit of Thelgathphalnasar king of Assur : and he carried away Ruben , and Gad , and the half tribe of Manasses , and brought them to Lahela, and to Habor , and to Ara, and to the river of Gozan, unto this day.
text_la: Et suscitavit Deus Israël spiritum Phul regis Assyriorum, et spiritum Thelgathphalnasar regis Assur : et transtulit Ruben, et Gad, et dimidiam tribum Manasse, et adduxit eos in Lahela, et in Habor, et Ara, et fluvium Gozan, usque ad diem hanc.
text_pt: Por isso o Deus de Israel suscitou o espírito de Pul, rei da Assíria, e o espírito de Tiglate-Pilneser, rei da Assíria, que os levaram presos, a saber: os rubenitas e gaditas, e a meia tribo de Manassés; e os trouxeram a Hala, e a Habor, e a Hara, e ao rio de Gozã, até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἐπήγειρεν ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ τὸ πνεῦμα Φαλωχ βασιλέως Ασσουρ καὶ τὸ πνεῦμα Θαγλαθφαλνασαρ βασιλέως Ασσουρ καὶ μετῴκισεν τὸν Ρουβην καὶ τὸν Γαδδι καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασση καὶ ἤγαγεν αὐτοὺς εἰς Χαλαχ καὶ Χαβωρ καὶ ἐπὶ ποταμὸν Γωζαν ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: The sons of Levi were Gerson, Caath, and Merari.
text_la: Filii Levi : Gerson, Caath, et Merari.
text_pt: Os filhos de Levi foram: Gérson, Coate e Merari,
text_el: υἱοὶ Λευι Γεδσων Κααθ καὶ Μεραρι

text_en: The Sons of Caath: Amram, Isaar, Hebron , and Oziel.
text_la: Filii Caath : Amram, Isaar, Hebron, et Oziel.
text_pt: E os filhos de Coate: Anrão, e Izar, e Hebrom, e Uziel.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Κααθ Αμβραμ καὶ Ισσααρ Χεβρων καὶ Οζιηλ

text_en: The children of Amram: Aaron , Moses , and Mary. The Sons of Aaron : Nadab and Abiu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
text_la: Filii Amram : Aaron, Moyses, et Maria. Filii Aaron : Nadab et Abiu, Eleazar, et Ithamar.
text_pt: E os filhos de Anrão: Arão, Moisés, e Miriã; e os filhos de Arão: Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar, e Itamar.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Αμβραμ Ααρων καὶ Μωυσῆς καὶ Μαριαμ καὶ υἱοὶ Ααρων Ναδαβ καὶ Αβιουδ Ελεαζαρ καὶ Ιθαμαρ

text_en: Eleazar begot Phinees, and Phinees begot Abisue,
text_la: Eleazar genuit Phinees, et Phinees genuit Abisue.
text_pt: E Eleazar gerou a Finéias, e Finéias gerou a Abisua,
text_el: Ελεαζαρ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Φινεες Φινεες ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αβισου

text_en: and Abisue begot Bocci, and Bocci begot Ozi.
text_la: Abisue vero genuit Bocci, et Bocci genuit Ozi.
text_pt: E Abisua gerou a Buqui, e Buqui gerou a Uzi,
text_el: Αβισου ἐγέννησεν τὸν Βωκαι Βωκαι ἐγέννησεν τὸν Οζι

text_en: Ozi begot Zaraias, and Zaraias begot Maraioth.
text_la: Ozi genuit Zaraiam, et Zaraias genuit Meraioth.
text_pt: E Uzi gerou a Zeraías, e Zeraías gerou a Meraiote.
text_el: Οζι ἐγέννησε τὸν Ζαραια Ζαραια ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μαριηλ

text_en: And Maraioth begot Amarias, and Amarias begot Achitob.
text_la: Porro Meraioth genuit Amariam, et Amarias genuit Achitob.
text_pt: E Meraiote gerou a Amarias, e Amarias gerou a Aitube.
text_el: καὶ Μαριηλ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αμαρια καὶ Αμαρια ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αχιτωβ

text_en: Achitob begot Sadoc, and Sadoc begot Achimaas .
text_la: Achitob genuit Sadoc, et Sadoc genuit Achimaas,
text_pt: E Aitube gerou a Zadoque, e Zadoque gerou a Aimaás,
text_el: καὶ Αχιτωβ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαδωκ καὶ Σαδωκ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αχιμαας

text_en: Achimaas begot Azarias, Azarias begot Johanan,
text_la: Achimaas genuit Azariam, Azarias genuit Johanan,
text_pt: E Aimaás gerou a Azarias, e Azarias gerou a Joanã,
text_el: καὶ Αχιμαας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αζαρια καὶ Αζαριας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιωαναν

text_en: Johanan begot Azarias. This is he that executed the priestly office in the house which Solomon built in Jerusalem .
text_la: Johanan genuit Azariam : ipse est qui sacerdotio functus est in domo quam ædificavit Salomon in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E Joanã gerou a Azarias; e este é o que exerceu o sacerdócio na casa que Salomão tinha edificado em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ Ιωανας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αζαριαν οὗτος ἱεράτευσεν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ ᾧ ᾠκοδόμησεν Σαλωμων ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And Azarias begot Amarias, and Amarias begot Achitob.
text_la: Genuit autem Azarias Amariam, et Amarias genuit Achitob,
text_pt: E Azarias gerou a Amarias, e Amarias gerou a Aitube,
text_el: καὶ ἐγέννησεν Αζαρια τὸν Αμαρια καὶ Αμαρια ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αχιτωβ

text_en: And Achitob begot Sadoc, and Sadoc begot Sellum,
text_la: Achitob genuit Sadoc, et Sadoc genuit Sellum,
text_pt: E Aitube gerou a Zadoque, e Zadoque gerou a Salum,
text_el: καὶ Αχιτωβ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαδωκ καὶ Σαδωκ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλωμ

text_en: Sellum begot Helcias, and Helcias begot Azarias,
text_la: Sellum genuit Helciam, et Helcias genuit Azariam,
text_pt: E Salum gerou a Hilquias, e Hilquias gerou a Azarias,
text_el: καὶ Σαλωμ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Χελκιαν καὶ Χελκιας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αζαρια

text_en: Azarias begot Saraias, and Saraias begot Josedec.
text_la: Azarias genuit Saraiam, et Saraias genuit Josedec.
text_pt: E Azarias gerou a Seraías, e Seraías gerou a Jeozadaque,
