text_el: καὶ Αζαριας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαραια καὶ Σαραιας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιωσαδακ

text_en: Now Josedec went out, when the Lord carried away Juda , and Jerusalem , by the hands of Nabuchodonosor .
text_la: Porro Josedec egressus est, quando transtulit Dominus Judam et Jerusalem per manus Nabuchodonosor.
text_pt: E Jeozadaque foi levado cativo quando o Senhor levou presos a Judá e a Jerusalém pela mão de Nabucodonosor.
text_el: καὶ Ιωσαδακ ἐπορεύθη ἐν τῇ μετοικίᾳ μετὰ Ιουδα καὶ Ιερουσαλημ ἐν χειρὶ Ναβουχοδονοσορ

text_en: So the sons of Levi were Gerson, Caath, and Merari.
text_la: Filii ergo Levi : Gersom, Caath, et Merari.
text_pt: Os filhos de Levi foram, pois, Gérson, Coate, e Merari.
text_el: υἱοὶ Λευι Γεδσων Κααθ καὶ Μεραρι

text_en: And these are the names of the sons of Gerson: Lobni and Semei.
text_la: Et hæc nomina filiorum Gersom : Lobni, et Semei.
text_pt: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Gérson: Libni e Simei.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Γεδσων Λοβενι καὶ Σεμεϊ

text_en: The sons of Caath: Amram, and Isaar, and Hebron , and Oziel.
text_la: Filii Caath : Amram, et Isaar, et Hebron, et Oziel.
text_pt: E os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom, e Uziel.
text_el: υἱοὶ Κααθ Αμβραμ καὶ Ισσααρ Χεβρων καὶ Οζιηλ

text_en: The sons of Merari: Moholi and Musi. And these are the kindreds of Levi according to their families .
text_la: Filii Merari : Moholi et Musi. Hæ autem cognationes Levi secundum familias eorum.
text_pt: Os filhos de Merari: Mali e Musi; estas são as famílias dos levitas, segundo seus pais.
text_el: υἱοὶ Μεραρι Μοολι καὶ Ομουσι καὶ αὗται αἱ πατριαὶ τοῦ Λευι κατὰ πατριὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: Of Gerson: Lobni his son, Jahath his son, Zamma his son,
text_la: Gersom : Lobni filius ejus, Jahath filius ejus, Zamma filius ejus,
text_pt: De Gérson: Libni, seu filho; Jaate, seu filho; Zima, seu filho;
text_el: τῷ Γεδσων τῷ Λοβενι υἱῷ αὐτοῦ Ιεεθ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ζεμμα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Joah his son, Addo his son, Zara his son, Jethrai his son.
text_la: Joah filius ejus, Addo filius ejus, Zara filius ejus, Jethrai filius ejus.
text_pt: Joá, seu filho; Ido, seu filho; Zerá, seu filho; Jeatarai, seu filho.
text_el: Ιωαχ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Αδδι υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ζαρα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ιεθρι υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The sons of Caath, Aminadab his son, Core his son, Asir his son,
text_la: Filii Caath : Aminadab filius ejus, Core filius ejus, Asir filius ejus,
text_pt: Os filhos de Coate foram: Aminadabe, seu filho; Coré, seu filho; Assir, seu filho;
text_el: υἱοὶ Κααθ Αμιναδαβ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Κορε υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ασιρ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Elcana his son, Abiasaph his son, Asir his son,
text_la: Elcana filius ejus, Abiasaph filius ejus, Asir filius ejus,
text_pt: Elcana, seu filho; Ebiasafe, seu filho; Assir, seu filho;
text_el: Ελκανα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ Αβιασαφ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ασιρ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Thahath his son, Uriel his son, Ozias his son, Saul his son.
text_la: Thahath filius ejus, Uriel filius ejus, Ozias filius ejus, Saul filius ejus.
text_pt: Taate, seu filho; Uriel, seu filho; Uzias, seu filho; e Saul, seu filho.
text_el: Θααθ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ουριηλ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Οζια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Σαουλ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The sons of Elcana: Amasai, and Achimoth.
text_la: Filii Elcana, Amasai et Achimoth
text_pt: E os filhos de Elcana: Amasai e Aimote.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ελκανα Αμασι καὶ Αχιμωθ

text_en: And Elcana. The sons of Elcana: Sophai his son, Nahath his son,
text_la: et Elcana. Filii Elcana : Sophai filius ejus, Nahath filius ejus,
text_pt: Quanto a Elcana: os filhos de Elcana foram Zofai, seu filho; e seu filho Naate.
text_el: Ελκανα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Σουφι υἱὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ Νααθ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elcana his son.
text_la: Eliab filius ejus, Jeroham filius ejus, Elcana filius ejus.
text_pt: Seu filho Eliabe, seu filho Jeroão, seu filho Elcana.
text_el: Ελιαβ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ιδαερ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ελκανα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn Vasseni, and Abia.
text_la: Filii Samuel : primogenitus Vasseni, et Abia.
text_pt: E os filhos de Samuel: Joel, seu primogênito, e o segundo Abias.
text_el: υἱοὶ Σαμουηλ ὁ πρωτότοκος Σανι καὶ Αβια

text_en: And the sons of Merari, Moholi: Lobni his son, Semei his son, Oza his son,
text_la: Filii autem Merari, Moholi : Lobni filius ejus, Semei filius ejus, Oza filius ejus,
text_pt: Os filhos de Merari: Mali, seu filho Libni, seu filho Simei, seu filho Uzá.
text_el: υἱοὶ Μεραρι Μοολι Λοβενι υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Σεμεϊ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Οζα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Sammaa his son, Haggia his son, Asaia his son.
text_la: Sammaa filius ejus, Haggia filius ejus, Asaia filius ejus.
text_pt: Seu filho Siméia, seu filho Hagias, seu filho Asaías.
text_el: Σομεα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Αγγια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ασαια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: These are they, whom David set over the singing men of the house of the Lord , after that the ark was placed.
text_la: Isti sunt quos constituit David super cantores domus Domini, ex quo collocata est arca:
text_pt: Estes são, pois, os que Davi constituiu para o ofício do canto na casa do Senhor, depois que a arca teve repouso.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οὓς κατέστησεν Δαυιδ ἐπὶ χεῖρας ᾀδόντων ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου ἐν τῇ καταπαύσει τῆς κιβωτοῦ

text_en: And they ministered before the tabernacle of the testimony , with singing, until Solomon built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem , and they stood according to their order in the ministry.
text_la: et ministrabant coram tabernaculo testimonii, canentes donec ædificaret Salomon domum Domini in Jerusalem : stabant autem juxta ordinem suum in ministerio.
text_pt: E ministravam diante do tabernáculo da tenda da congregação com cantares, até que Salomão edificou a casa do Senhor em Jerusalém; e estiveram, segundo o seu costume, no seu ministério.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν λειτουργοῦντες ἐναντίον τῆς σκηνῆς οἴκου μαρτυρίου ἐν ὀργάνοις ἕως οὗ ᾠκοδόμησεν Σαλωμων τὸν οἶκον κυρίου ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἔστησαν κατὰ τὴν κρίσιν αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὰς λειτουργίας αὐτῶν

text_en: And these are they that stood with their sons, of the sons of Caath, Hemam a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Sammuel,
text_la: Hi vero sunt qui assistebant cum filiis suis, de filiis Caath, Hemam cantor filius Johel, filii Samuel,
text_pt: Estes são, pois, os que ali estavam com seus filhos: dos filhos dos coatitas, Hemã, o cantor, filho de Joel, filho de Samuel,
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἑστηκότες καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν τοῦ Κααθ Αιμαν ὁ ψαλτῳδὸς υἱὸς Ιωηλ υἱοῦ Σαμουηλ

text_en: the son of Elcana, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Thohu,
text_la: filii Elcana, filii Jeroham, filii Eliel, filii Thohu,
text_pt: Filho de Elcana, filho de Jeroão, filho de Eliel, filho de Toá,
text_el: υἱοῦ Ελκανα υἱοῦ Ηδαδ υἱοῦ Ελιηλ υἱοῦ Θιε

text_en: the son of Suph, the son of Elcana, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
text_la: filii Suph, filii Elcana, filii Mahath, filii Amasai,
text_pt: Filho de Zufe, filho de Elcana, filho de Maate, filho de Amasai,
text_el: υἱοῦ Σουφ υἱοῦ Ελκανα υἱοῦ Μεθ υἱοῦ Αμασιου

text_en: the son of Elcana, the son of Johel, the son of Azarias, the son of Sophonias,
text_la: filii Elcana, filii Johel, filii Azariæ, filii Sophoniæ,
text_pt: Filho de Elcana, filho de Joel, filho de Azarias, filho de Sofonias.
text_el: υἱοῦ Ελκανα υἱοῦ Ιωηλ υἱοῦ Αζαρια υἱοῦ Σαφανια

text_en: the son of Thahath, the son of Asir, the son of Abiasaph, the son of Core ,
text_la: filii Thahath, filii Asir, filii Abiasaph, filii Core,
text_pt: Filho de Taate, filho de Assir, filho de Ebiasafe, filho de Coré,
text_el: υἱοῦ Θααθ υἱοῦ Ασιρ υἱοῦ Αβιασαφ υἱοῦ Κορε

text_en: the son of Isaar, the son of Caath, the son of Levi , the son of Israel .
text_la: filii Isaar, filii Caath, filii Levi, filii Israël.
text_pt: Filho de Isar, filho de Coate, filho de Levi, filho de Israel.
text_el: υἱοῦ Ισσααρ υἱοῦ Κααθ υἱοῦ Λευι υἱοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, Asaph the son of Barachias, the son of Samaa.
text_la: Et frater ejus Asaph, qui stabat a dextris ejus, Asaph filius Barachiæ, filii Samaa,
text_pt: E seu irmão Asafe estava à sua direita; e era Asafe filho de Berequias, filho de Siméia,
text_el: καὶ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ Ασαφ ὁ ἑστηκὼς ἐν δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ Ασαφ υἱὸς Βαραχια υἱοῦ Σαμαα

text_en: The son of Michael, the son of Basaia, the, son of Melchia.
text_la: filii Michaël, filii Basaiæ, filii Melchiæ,
text_pt: Filho de Micael, filho de Baaséias, filho de Malquias,
text_el: υἱοῦ Μιχαηλ υἱοῦ Μαασια υἱοῦ Μελχια

text_en: The son of Athanai, the son of Zara, the son of Adaia.
text_la: filii Athanai, filii Zara, filii Adaia,
text_pt: Filho de Etni, filho de Zerá, filho de Adaías,
text_el: υἱοῦ Αθανι υἱοῦ Ζαραι υἱοῦ Αδια

text_en: The son of Ethan, the son of Zamma, the son of Semei.
text_la: filii Ethan, filii Zamma, filii Semei,
text_pt: Filho de Etã, filho de Zima, filho de Simei,
text_el: υἱοῦ Αιθαν υἱοῦ Ζαμμα υἱοῦ Σεμεϊ

text_en: The son of Jeth, the son of Gerson, the son of Levi .
text_la: filii Jeth, filii Gersom, filii Levi.
text_pt: Filho de Jaate, filho de Gérson, filho de Levi.
text_el: υἱοῦ Ηχα υἱοῦ Γεδσων υἱοῦ Λευι

text_en: And the sons of Merari their brethren, on the left hand, Ethan the son of Cusi, the son of Abdi, the son of Meloch,
text_la: Filii autem Merari fratres eorum, ad sinistram, Ethan filius Cusi, filii Abdi, filii Maloch,
text_pt: E seus irmãos, os filhos de Merari, estavam à esquerda; a saber: Etã, filho de Quisi, filho de Abdi, filho de Maluque,
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Μεραρι ἀδελφοῦ αὐτῶν ἐξ ἀριστερῶν Αιθαν υἱὸς Κισαι υἱοῦ Αβδι υἱοῦ Μαλωχ

text_en: the son of Hasabia, the son of Amasai, the son of Helcias,
text_la: filii Hasabiæ, filii Amasiæ, filii Helciæ,
text_pt: Filho de Hasabias, filho de Amazias, filho de Hilquias,
text_el: υἱοῦ Ασεβι υἱοῦ Αμεσσια υἱοῦ Χελκιου

text_en: the son of Amasai, the son of Boni, the son of Somer,
text_la: filii Amasai, filii Boni, filii Somer,
text_pt: Filho de Anzi, filho de Bani, filho de Semer,
text_el: υἱοῦ Αμασαι υἱοῦ Βανι υἱοῦ Σεμμηρ

text_en: the son of Moholi, the son of Musi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi .
text_la: filii Moholi, filii Musi, filii Merari, filii Levi.
text_pt: Filho de Mali, filho de Musi, filho de Merari, filho de Levi.
text_el: υἱοῦ Μοολι υἱοῦ Μουσι υἱοῦ Μεραρι υἱοῦ Λευι

text_en: Their brethren also the Levites , who were appointed for all the ministry of the tabernacle of the house of the Lord .
text_la: Fratres quoque eorum Levitæ, qui ordinati sunt in cunctum ministerium tabernaculi domus Domini.
text_pt: E seus irmãos, os levitas, foram postos para todo o ministério do tabernáculo da casa de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν οἱ Λευῖται δεδομένοι εἰς πᾶσαν ἐργασίαν λειτουργίας σκηνῆς οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: But Aaron and his sons offered burnt offerings upon the altar of holocausts , and upon the altar of incense , for every work of the holy of holies: and to pray for Israel according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
text_la: Aaron vero et filii ejus adolebant incensum super altare holocausti, et super altare thymiamatis, in omne opus Sancti sanctorum : et ut precarentur pro Israël juxta omnia quæ præceperat Moyses servus Dei.
text_pt: E Arão e seus filhos ofereceram sobre o altar do holocausto e sobre o altar do incenso, por todo o serviço do lugar santíssimo, e para fazer expiação por Israel, conforme tudo quanto Moisés, servo de Deus, tinha ordenado.
text_el: καὶ Ααρων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ θυμιῶντες ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τῶν ὁλοκαυτωμάτων καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τῶν θυμιαμάτων εἰς πᾶσαν ἐργασίαν ἅγια τῶν ἁγίων καὶ ἐξιλάσκεσθαι περὶ Ισραηλ κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῆς παῖς τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And these are the sons of Aaron : Eleazar his son, Phinees his son, Abisue his son,
text_la: Hi sunt autem filii Aaron : Eleazar filius ejus, Phinees filius ejus, Abisue filius ejus,
text_pt: E estes foram os filhos de Arão: seu filho Eleazar, seu filho Finéias, seu filho Abisua.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ααρων Ελεαζαρ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Φινεες υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Αβισου υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Bocci his son, Ozi his son, Zarahia his son,
text_la: Bocci filius ejus, Ozi filius ejus, Zarahia filius ejus,
text_pt: Seu filho Buqui, seu filho Uzi, seu filho Seraías,
text_el: Βωκαι υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Οζι υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ζαραια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Meraioth his son, Amarias his son, Achitob his son,
text_la: Meraioth filius ejus, Amarias filius ejus, Achitob filius ejus,
text_pt: Seu filho Meraiote, seu filho Amarias, seu filho Aitube,
text_el: Μαριηλ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Αμαρια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Αχιτωβ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Sadoc his son, Achimaas his son.
text_la: Sadoc filius ejus, Achimaas filius ejus.
text_pt: Seu filho Zadoque, seu filho Aimaás.
text_el: Σαδωκ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Αχιμαας υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And these are their dwelling places by the towns and confines, to wit, of the sons of Aaron , of the families of the Caathites: for they fell to them by lot.
text_la: Et hæc habitacula eorum per vicos atque confinia, filiorum scilicet Aaron, juxta cognationes Caathitarum : ipsis enim sorte contigerant.
text_pt: E estas foram as suas habitações, segundo os seus acampamentos, nos seus termos, a saber: dos filhos de Arão, da família dos coatitas, porque a eles caiu a sorte.
text_el: καὶ αὗται αἱ κατοικίαι αὐτῶν ἐν ταῖς κώμαις αὐτῶν ἐν τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῶν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ααρων τῇ πατριᾷ τοῦ Κααθι ὅτι αὐτοῖς ἐγένετο ὁ κλῆρος

text_en: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Juda , and the suburbs thereof round about:
text_la: Dederunt igitur eis Hebron in terra Juda, et suburbana ejus per circuitum:
text_pt: Deram-lhes, pois, a Hebrom, na terra de Judá, e os arrabaldes que a rodeiam.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτοῖς τὴν Χεβρων ἐν γῇ Ιουδα καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς κύκλῳ αὐτῆς

text_en: But the fields of the city, and the villages to Caleb son of Jephone .
text_la: agros autem civitatis, et villas, Caleb filio Jephone.
text_pt: Porém o território da cidade e as suas aldeias deram a Calebe, filho de Jefoné.
text_el: καὶ τὰ πεδία τῆς πόλεως καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς ἔδωκαν τῷ Χαλεβ υἱῷ Ιεφοννη

text_en: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities for refuge Hebron , and Lobna, and the suburbs thereof,
text_la: Porro filiis Aaron dederunt civitates ad confugiendum Hebron, et Lobna, et suburbana ejus,
text_pt: E aos filhos de Arão deram as cidades de refúgio: Hebrom e Libna e os seus arrabaldes, e Jatir e Estemoa e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ααρων ἔδωκαν τὰς πόλεις τῶν φυγαδευτηρίων τὴν Χεβρων καὶ τὴν Λοβνα καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Σελνα καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Εσθαμω καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: and Jether and Esthemo, with their suburbs, and Helon, and Dabir with their suburbs:
text_la: Jether quoque, et Esthemo cum suburbanis suis, sed et Helon, et Dabir cum suburbanis suis,
text_pt: E Hilém, e os seus arrabaldes, Debir e os seus arrabaldes,
text_el: καὶ τὴν Ιεθθαρ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Δαβιρ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: Asan also, and Bethsames, with their suburbs.
text_la: Asan quoque, et Bethsemes, et suburbana earum.
text_pt: E Asã e os seus arrabaldes, e Bete-Semes e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Ασαν καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Ατταν καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Βασαμυς καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin : Gabee and its suburbs, Almath with its suburbs, Anathoth also with its suburbs: all their cities throughout their families were thirteen.
text_la: De tribu autem Benjamin, Gabee et suburbana ejus, et Almath cum suburbanis suis, Anathoth quoque cum suburbanis suis : omnes civitates, tredecim, per cognationes suas.
text_pt: E da tribo de Benjamim, Geba e os seus arrabaldes, Alemete e os seus arrabaldes, e Anatote e os seus arrabaldes; todas as suas cidades, pelas suas famílias, foram treze.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ φυλῆς Βενιαμιν τὴν Γαβεε καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Γαλεμεθ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Αγχωχ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις αὐτῶν τρισκαίδεκα πόλεις κατὰ πατριὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: And to the sons of Caath that remained of their kindred they gave out of the half tribe of Manasses ten cities in possession.
text_la: Filiis autem Caath residuis de cognatione sua dederunt ex dimidia tribu Manasse in possessionem urbes decem.
text_pt: Mas os filhos de Coate, que restaram da sua família, tiveram, por sorte, dez cidades da meia tribo de Manassés.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Κααθ τοῖς καταλοίποις ἐκ τῶν πατριῶν ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς ἐκ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασση κλήρῳ πόλεις δέκα

text_en: And to the sons of Gerson by their families out of the tribe of Issachar , and out of the tribe of Aser , and out of the tribe of Nephtali , and out of the tribe Manasses in Basan, thirteen cities.
text_la: Porro filiis Gersom per cognationes suas de tribu Issachar, et de tribu Aser, et de tribu Nephthali, et de tribu Manasse in Basan, urbes tredecim.
text_pt: E os filhos de Gérson, segundo as suas famílias, tiveram treze cidades da tribo de Issacar, e da tribo de Aser, e da tribo de Naftali e da tribo de Manassés, em Basã.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Γεδσων κατὰ πατριὰς αὐτῶν ἐκ φυλῆς Ισσαχαρ ἐκ φυλῆς Ασηρ ἐκ φυλῆς Νεφθαλι ἐκ φυλῆς Μανασση ἐν τῇ Βασαν πόλεις τρισκαίδεκα

text_en: And to the sons of Merari by their families out of the tribe of Ruben , and out of the tribe of Gad , and out of the tribe of Zabulon , they gave by lot twelve cities.
text_la: Filiis autem Merari per cognationes suas de tribu Ruben, et de tribu Gad, et de tribu Zabulon, dederunt sorte civitates duodecim.
text_pt: Os filhos de Merari, segundo as suas famílias, tiveram, por sorte, doze cidades da tribo de Rúben, e da tribo de Gade, e da tribo de Zebulom.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Μεραρι κατὰ πατριὰς αὐτῶν ἐκ φυλῆς Ρουβην ἐκ φυλῆς Γαδ ἐκ φυλῆς Ζαβουλων κλήρῳ πόλεις δέκα δύο

text_en: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities, and their suburbs.
text_la: Dederunt quoque filii Israël Levitis civitates, et suburbana earum:
text_pt: Assim os filhos de Israel deram aos levitas estas cidades e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τοῖς Λευίταις τὰς πόλεις καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῶν

text_en: And they gave them by lot, out of the tribe of the sons of Juda , and out of the tribe of the sons of Simeon , and out of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin , these cities which they called by their names .
text_la: dederuntque per sortem, ex tribu filiorum Juda, et ex tribu filiorum Simeon, et ex tribu filiorum Benjamin urbes has, quas vocaverunt nominibus suis,
text_pt: E deram-lhes por sorte estas cidades, da tribo dos filhos de Judá, da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, e da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, às quais deram os seus nomes.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν ἐν κλήρῳ ἐκ φυλῆς υἱῶν Ιουδα καὶ ἐκ φυλῆς υἱῶν Συμεων τὰς πόλεις ταύτας ἃς ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὰς ἐπ' ὀνόματος

text_en: And to them that were of the kindred of the sons of Caath, and the cities in their borders were of the tribe of Ephraim.
text_la: et his, qui erant de cognatione filiorum Caath, fueruntque civitates in terminis eorum de tribu Ephraim.
text_pt: E quanto ao mais das famílias dos filhos de Coate, se lhes deram, da tribo de Efraim as cidades dos seus termos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν πατριῶν υἱῶν Κααθ καὶ ἐγένοντο πόλεις τῶν ὁρίων αὐτῶν ἐκ φυλῆς Εφραιμ

text_en: And they gave the cities of refuge Sichem with its suburbs in mount Ephraim, and Gazer with its suburbs,
text_la: Dederunt ergo eis urbes ad confugiendum, Sichem cum suburbanis suis in monte Ephraim, et Gazer cum suburbanis suis,
text_pt: Porque lhes deram as cidades de refúgio, Siquém e os seus arrabaldes, nas montanhas de Efraim, como também Gezer e os seus arrabaldes,
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτῷ τὰς πόλεις τῶν φυγαδευτηρίων τὴν Συχεμ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς ἐν ὄρει Εφραιμ καὶ τὴν Γαζερ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: Jecmaan also with its suburbs, and Beth-horon in like manner,
text_la: Jecmaam quoque cum suburbanis suis, et Bethoron similiter,
text_pt: E Jocmeão e os seus arrabaldes, Bete-Horom e os seus arrabaldes,
text_el: καὶ τὴν Ιεκμααμ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Βαιθωρων καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: Helon also with its suburbs, and Gethremmon in like manner,
text_la: necnon et Helon cum suburbanis suis, et Gethremmon in eumdem modum.
text_pt: E Aijalom e os seus arrabaldes, Gate-Rimom e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Εγλαμ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Γεθρεμμων καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: and out of the half tribe of Manasses , Aner and its suburbs, Baalam and its suburbs, to wit, to them that were left of the family of the sons of Caath.
text_la: Porro ex dimidia tribu Manasse, Aner et suburbana ejus, Balaam et suburbana ejus : his videlicet, qui de cognatione filiorum Caath reliqui erant.
text_pt: E da meia tribo de Manassés, Aner e os seus arrabaldes, e Bileã e os seus arrabaldes; estas cidades tiveram os que ficaram da família dos filhos de Coate.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασση τὴν Αναρ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Ιεβλααμ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς κατὰ πατριὰν τοῖς υἱοῖς Κααθ τοῖς καταλοίποις

text_en: And to the sons of Gersom, out the kindred of the half tribe of Manasses , Gaulon, in Basan, and its suburbs, and Astharoth with its suburbs.
text_la: Filiis autem Gersom de cognatione dimidiæ tribus Manasse, Gaulon in Basan, et suburbana ejus, et Astaroth cum suburbanis suis.
text_pt: Os filhos de Gérson tiveram, da família da meia tribo de Manassés, Golã, em Basã, e os seus arrabaldes, e Astarote e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Γεδσων ἀπὸ πατριῶν ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασση τὴν Γωλαν ἐκ τῆς Βασαν καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Ασηρωθ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: Out of the tribe of Issachar , Cedes and its suburbs, and Dabereth with its suburbs;
text_la: De tribu Issachar, Cedes et suburbanis suis, et Dabereth cum suburbanis suis,
text_pt: E da tribo de Issacar, Quedes e os seus arrabaldes, e Daberate e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ φυλῆς Ισσαχαρ τὴν Κεδες καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Δεβερι καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: Ramoth also and its suburbs, and Anem with its suburbs.
text_la: Ramoth quoque et suburbana ejus, et Anem cum suburbanis suis.
text_pt: E Ramote e os seus arrabaldes, e Aném e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Δαβωρ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Αναμ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: And out of the tribe of Aser : Masal with its suburbs, and Abdon in like manner;
text_la: De tribu vero Aser : Masal cum suburbanis suis, et Abdon similiter,
text_pt: E da tribo de Aser, Masal e os seus arrabaldes, e Abdom e os seus arrabaldes,
text_el: καὶ ἐκ φυλῆς Ασηρ τὴν Μασαλ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Αβαραν καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: Hucac also and its suburbs, and Rohol with its suburbs.
text_la: Hucac quoque et suburbana ejus, et Rohob cum suburbanis suis.
text_pt: E Hucoque e os seus arrabaldes, e Reobe e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Ικακ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Ροωβ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: And out of the tribe of Nephtali , Cedes in Galilee and its suburbs, Hamon with its suburbs, and Cariathaim, and its suburbs.
text_la: Porro de tribu Nephthali, Cedes in Galilæa et suburbana ejus, Hamon cum suburbanis suis, et Cariathaim et suburbana ejus.
text_pt: E da tribo de Naftali, Quedes, em Galiléia, e os seus arrabaldes, Hamom e os seus arrabaldes e Quiriataim e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ φυλῆς Νεφθαλι τὴν Κεδες ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Χαμωθ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Καριαθαιμ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: And to the sons of Merari that remained: out of the tribe of Zabulon , Remmono and its suburbs, and Thabor with its suburbs.
text_la: Filiis autem Merari residuis : de tribu Zabulon, Remmono et suburbana ejus, et Thabor cum suburbanis sus:
text_pt: Os que ficaram dos filhos de Merari tiveram, da tribo de Zebulom, a Rimom e os seus arrabaldes, a Tabor e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: τοῖς υἱοῖς Μεραρι τοῖς καταλοίποις ἐκ φυλῆς Ζαβουλων τὴν Ρεμμων καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Θαχχια καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: Beyond the Jordan also over against Jericho , on the east side of the Jordan and out of the tribe of Ruben , Bosor in the wilderness with its suburbs, and Jassa with its suburbs;
text_la: trans Jordanem quoque ex adverso Jericho contra orientem Jordanis, de tribu Ruben, Bosor in solitudine cum suburbanis suis, et Jassa cum suburbanis suis,
text_pt: E dalém do Jordão, na altura de Jericó, ao oriente do Jordão, da tribo de Rúben, a Bezer, no deserto, e os seus arrabaldes, e a Jaza e os seus arrabaldes,
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τοῦ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου Ιεριχω κατὰ δυσμὰς τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐκ φυλῆς Ρουβην τὴν Βοσορ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Ιασα καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: Cademoth also and its suburbs, and Mephaath with its suburbs;
text_la: Cademoth quoque et suburbana ejus, et Mephaat cum suburbanis suis.
text_pt: E a Quedemote e os seus arrabaldes, e a Mefaate e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Καδημωθ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Μωφααθ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: moreover also out of the tribe of Gad , Ramoth in Galaad and its suburbs, and Manaim with its suburbs;
text_la: Necnon et de tribu Gad, Ramoth in Galaad et suburbana ejus, et Manaim cum suburbanis suis,
text_pt: E da tribo de Gade, a Ramote, em Gileade, e os seus arrabaldes, e Maanaim e os seus arrabaldes,
text_el: καὶ ἐκ φυλῆς Γαδ τὴν Ραμωθ Γαλααδ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Μααναιμ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: Hesebon also with its suburbs, and Jazer with its suburbs.
text_la: sed et Hesebon cum suburbanis suis, et Jezer cum suburbanis suis.
text_pt: E a Hesbom e os seus arrabaldes, e a Jazer e os seus arrabaldes.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Εσεβων καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Ιαζηρ καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς

text_en: Now the sons of Issachar were Thola, and Phua, Jasub and Simeron, four.
text_la: Porro filii Issachar : Thola, et Phua, Jasub, et Simeron, quatuor.
text_pt: E quanto aos filhos de Issacar, foram: Tola, Pua, Jasube e Sinrom, quatro.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισσαχαρ Θωλα καὶ Φουα καὶ Ιασουβ καὶ Σεμερων τέσσαρες

text_en: The sons of Thola: Ozi and Raphaia, and Jeriel, and Jemai, and Jebsem, and Samuel, chiefs of the houses of their kindreds. Of the posterity of Thola were numbered in the days of David , two and twenty thousand six hundred most valiant men .
text_la: Filii Thola : Ozi, et Raphaia, et Jeriel, et Jemai, et Jebsem, et Samuel, principes per domos cognationum suarum. De stirpe Thola viri fortissimi numerati sunt in diebus David, viginti duo millia sexcenti.
text_pt: E os filhos de Tola foram: Uzi, Refaías, Jeriel, Jamai, Ibsão e Semuel, chefes das casas de seus pais, descendentes de Tola, homens valentes nas suas gerações; o seu número, nos dias de Davi, foi de vinte e dois mil e seiscentos.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Θωλα Οζι καὶ Ραφαια καὶ Ιεριηλ καὶ Ιεμου καὶ Ιεβασαμ καὶ Σαμουηλ ἄρχοντες οἴκων πατριῶν αὐτῶν τῷ Θωλα ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν ἐν ἡμέραις Δαυιδ εἴκοσι καὶ δύο χιλιάδες καὶ ἑξακόσιοι

text_en: The sons of Ozi: Izrahia, of whom were born Michael, and Obadia, and Joel, and Jesia, five all great men .
text_la: Filii Ozi : Izrahia, de quo nati sunt Michaël, et Obadia, et Joël, et Jesia, quinque omnes principes.
text_pt: E o filho de Uzi: Izraías; e os filhos de Izraías foram: Mical, Obadias, Joel e Issias; todos estes cinco chefes.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Οζι Ιεζρια καὶ υἱοὶ Ιεζρια Μιχαηλ καὶ Οβδια καὶ Ιωηλ καὶ Ιεσια πέντε ἄρχοντες πάντες

text_en: And there were with them by their families and peoples, six and thirty thousand most valiant men ready for war : for they had many wives and children.
text_la: Cumque eis per familias et populos suos, accincti ad prælium, viri fortissimi, triginta sex millia : multas enim habuerunt uxores, et filios.
text_pt: E houve com eles nas suas gerações, segundo as suas casas paternas, em tropas de guerra, trinta e seis mil; porque tiveram muitas mulheres e filhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπ' αὐτῶν κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατρικοὺς αὐτῶν ἰσχυροὶ παρατάξασθαι εἰς πόλεμον τριάκοντα καὶ ἓξ χιλιάδες ὅτι ἐπλήθυναν γυναῖκας καὶ υἱούς

text_en: Their brethren also throughout all the house of Issachar , were numbered fourscore and seven thousand most valiant men for war .
text_la: Fratres quoque eorum per omnem cognationem Issachar robustissimi ad pugnandum, octoginta septem millia numerati sunt.
text_pt: E seus irmãos, em todas as famílias de Issacar, homens valentes, foram oitenta e sete mil, todos contados pelas suas genealogias.
text_el: καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν εἰς πάσας πατριὰς Ισσαχαρ ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει ὀγδοήκοντα καὶ ἑπτὰ χιλιάδες ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν τῶν πάντων

text_en: The sons of Benjamin were Bela, and Bechor, and Jadihel, three.
text_la: Filii Benjamin : Bela, et Bechor, et Jadihel, tres.
text_pt: Os filhos de Benjamim foram: Belá, e Bequer, e Jediael, três.
text_el: βενιαμιν Βαλε καὶ Βαχιρ καὶ Ιαδιηλ τρεῖς

text_en: The sons of Bela: Esbon, and Ozi, and Ozial, and Jerimoth and Urai, five chiefs of their families , and most valiant warriors, and their number was twenty-two thousand and thirty-four.
text_la: Filii Bela : Esbon, et Ozi, et Oziel, et Jerimoth, et Urai, quinque principes familiarum, et ad pugnandum robustissimi : numerus autem eorum, viginti duo millia et triginta quatuor.
text_pt: E os filhos de Belá: Esbom, e Uzi, e Uziel, e Jerimote, e Iri, cinco chefes da casa dos pais, homens valentes que foram contados pelas suas genealogias, vinte e dois mil e trinta e quatro.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Βαλε Ασεβων καὶ Οζι καὶ Οζιηλ καὶ Ιεριμωθ καὶ Ουρι πέντε ἄρχοντες οἴκων πατρικῶν ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν εἴκοσι καὶ δύο χιλιάδες καὶ τριάκοντα τέσσαρες

text_en: And the sons of Bechor were Zamira, and Joas, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Amai, and Jerimoth, and Abia, and Anathoth , and Almath: all these were the sons of Bechor.
text_la: Porro filii Bechor : Zamira, et Joas, et Eliezer, et Elioënai, et Amri, et Jerimoth, et Abia, et Anathoth, et Almath : omnes hi filii Bechor.
text_pt: E os filhos de Bequer: Zemira, Joás, Eliezer, Elioenai, Onri, Jerimote, Abias, Anatote, e Alemete; todos estes foram filhos de Bequer.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Βαχιρ Ζαμαριας καὶ Ιωας καὶ Ελιεζερ καὶ Ελιθεναν καὶ Αμαρια καὶ Ιεριμωθ καὶ Αβιου καὶ Αναθωθ καὶ Γεμεεθ πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Βαχιρ

text_en: And they were numbered by the families , heads of their kindreds, most valiant men for war , twenty thousand and two hundred.
text_la: Numerati sunt autem per familias suas principes cognationum suarum ad bella fortissimi, viginti millia et ducenti.
text_pt: E foram contados pelas suas genealogias, segundo as suas gerações, e chefes das casas de seus pais, homens valentes, vinte mil e duzentos.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν ἄρχοντες οἴκων πατριῶν αὐτῶν ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει εἴκοσι χιλιάδες καὶ διακόσιοι

text_en: And the son of Jadihel: Balan. And the sons of Balan: Jehus and Benjamin, and Aod, and Chanana, and Zethan and Tharsis, and Ahisahar.
text_la: Porro filii Jadihel : Balan. Filii autem Balan : Jehus, et Benjamin, et Aod, et Chanana, et Zethan, et Tharsis, et Ahisahar:
text_pt: E foi o filho de Jediael, Bilã; e os filhos de Bilã foram Jeús, Benjamim, Eúde, Quenaaná, Zetã, Társis e Aisaar.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιαδιηλ Βαλααν καὶ υἱοὶ Βαλααν Ιαους καὶ Βενιαμιν καὶ Αωθ καὶ Χανανα καὶ Ζαιθαν καὶ Ραμεσσαι καὶ Αχισααρ

text_en: All these were sons of Jadihel, heads of their kindreds, most valiant men , seventeen thousand and two hundred fifty to go out to war .
text_la: omnes hi filii Jadihel, principes cognationum suarum viri fortissimi, decem et septem millia et ducenti ad prælium procedentes.
text_pt: Todos estes filhos de Jediael foram chefes das famílias dos pais, homens valentes, dezessete mil e duzentos, que saíam no exército à peleja.
text_el: πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ιαδιηλ ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει ἑπτακαίδεκα χιλιάδες καὶ διακόσιοι ἐκπορευόμενοι δυνάμει τοῦ πολεμεῖν

text_en: Sepham also and Hapham the sons of Hir: and Hasim the sons of Aher.
text_la: Sepham quoque et Hapham filii Hir : et Hasim filii Aher.
text_pt: E Supim, e Hupim, filhos de Ir, e Husim, dos filhos de Aer.
text_el: καὶ Σαπφιν καὶ Απφιν καὶ υἱοὶ Ραωμ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Αερ

text_en: And the sons of Nephtali were Jasiel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Sellum, sons of Bala.
text_la: Filii autem Nephthali : Jaziel, et Guni, et Jeser, et Sellum, filii Bala.
text_pt: Os filhos de Naftali: Jaziel, e Guni, e Jezer, e Salum, filhos de Bila.
text_el: υἱοὶ Νεφθαλι Ιασιηλ καὶ Γωνι καὶ Ισσιηρ καὶ Σαλωμ υἱοὶ Βαλαα

text_en: And the son of Manasses , Ezriel: and his concubine the Syrian bore Machir the father of Galaad.
text_la: Porro filius Manasse, Esriel : concubinaque ejus Syra peperit Machir patrem Galaad.
text_pt: Os filhos de Manassés: Asriel, que a mulher de Gileade concebeu (porém a sua concubina, a síria, concebeu a Maquir, pai de Gileade;
text_el: υἱοὶ Μανασση Ασεριηλ ὃν ἔτεκεν ἡ παλλακὴ αὐτοῦ ἡ Σύρα ἔτεκεν τὸν Μαχιρ πατέρα Γαλααδ

text_en: And Machir took wives for his sons Happhim, and Saphan: and he had a sister named Maacha: the name of the second was Salphaad, and Salphaad had daughters.
text_la: Machir autem accepit uxores filiis suis Happhim, et Saphan : et habuit sororem nomine Maacha : nomen autem secundi, Salphaad, natæque sunt Salphaad filiæ.
text_pt: E Maquir tomou a irmã de Hupim e Supim por mulher, e era o seu nome Maaca), e foi o nome do segundo Zelofeade; e Zelofeade teve filhas.
text_el: καὶ Μαχιρ ἔλαβεν γυναῖκα τῷ Αμφιν καὶ Μαμφιν καὶ ὄνομα ἀδελφῆς αὐτοῦ Μοωχα καὶ ὄνομα τῷ δευτέρῳ Σαλπααδ καὶ ἐγεννήθησαν τῷ Σαλπααδ θυγατέρες

text_en: And Maacha the wife of Machir bore a son, and she called his name Phares: and the name of his brother was Sares: and his sons were Ulam and Recen.
text_la: Et peperit Maacha uxor Machir filium, vocavitque nomen ejus Phares : porro nomen fratris ejus, Sares : et filii ejus, Ulam, et Recen.
text_pt: E Maaca, mulher de Maquir, deu à luz um filho, e chamou-o Perez; e o nome de seu irmão foi Seres; e foram seus filhos Ulão e Raquém.
text_el: καὶ ἔτεκεν Μοωχα γυνὴ Μαχιρ υἱὸν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Φαρες καὶ ὄνομα ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ Σορος υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ουλαμ

text_en: And the son of Ulam, Baden. These are the sons of Galaad, the son of Machir, the son of Manasses .
text_la: Filius autem Ulam, Badan : hi sunt filii Galaad, filii Machir, filii Manasse.
text_pt: E o filho de Ulão, Bedã; estes foram os filhos de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ουλαμ Βαδαν οὗτοι υἱοὶ Γαλααδ υἱοῦ Μαχιρ υἱοῦ Μανασση

text_en: And his sister named Queen bore Goodlyman, and Abiezer, and Mohola.
text_la: Soror autem ejus Regina peperit Virum decorum, et Abiezer, et Mohola.
text_pt: E quanto à sua irmã Hamolequete, teve a Is-Hode, a Abiezer, e a Maalá.
text_el: καὶ ἀδελφὴ αὐτοῦ ἡ Μαλεχεθ ἔτεκεν τὸν Ισαδεκ καὶ τὸν Αβιεζερ καὶ τὸν Μαελα

text_en: And the sons of Semida were Ahiu, and Sechem, and Leci and Aniam.
text_la: Erant autem filii Semida, Ahin, et Sechem, et Leci, et Aniam.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Semida: Aiã, Siquém, Liqui, e Anião.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ Σεμιρα Ιααιμ καὶ Συχεμ καὶ Λακεϊ καὶ Ανιαμ

text_en: And the sons of Ephraim were Suthala, Bared his son, Thahath his son, Elada his son, Thahath his son, and his son Zabad,
text_la: Filii autem Ephraim : Suthala, Bared filius ejus, Thahath filius ejus, Elada filius ejus, Thahath filius ejus, hujus filius Zabad,
text_pt: E os filhos de Efraim: Sutela, e seu filho Berede, e seu filho Taate, e seu filho Elada e seu filho Taate.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Εφραιμ Σωθαλα καὶ Βαραδ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ Θααθ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ελεαδα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Νομεε υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: and his son Suthala, and his son Ezer, and Elad: and the men of Geth born in the land slew them, because they came down to invade their possessions.
text_la: et hujus filius Suthula, et hujus filius Ezer et Elad : occiderunt autem eos viri Geth indigenæ, quia descenderant ut invaderent possessiones eorum.
text_pt: E seu filho Zabade, e seu filho Sutela, e Ezer, e Elade; e os homens de Gate, naturais da terra, os mataram, porque desceram para tomar os seus gados.
text_el: Ζαβεδ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Σωθελε υἱὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ Εζερ καὶ Ελεαδ καὶ ἀπέκτειναν αὐτοὺς ἄνδρες Γεθ οἱ τεχθέντες ἐν τῇ γῇ ὅτι κατέβησαν λαβεῖν τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν

text_en: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
text_la: Luxit igitur Ephraim pater eorum multis diebus, et venerunt fratres ejus ut consolarentur eum.
text_pt: Por isso Efraim, seu pai, por muitos dias os chorou; e vieram seus irmãos para o consolar.
text_el: καὶ ἐπένθησεν Εφραιμ πατὴρ αὐτῶν ἡμέρας πολλάς καὶ ἦλθον ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ τοῦ παρακαλέσαι αὐτόν

text_en: And he went in to his wife: and she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Beria, because he was born when it went evil with his house:
text_la: Ingressusque est ad uxorem suam : quæ concepit, et peperit filium, et vocavit nomen ejus Beria, eo quod in malis domus ejus ortus esset:
text_pt: Depois coabitou com sua mulher, e ela concebeu, e teve um filho; e chamou-o Berias; porque ia mal na sua casa.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔλαβεν ἐν γαστρὶ καὶ ἔτεκεν υἱόν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Βαραγα ὅτι ἐν κακοῖς ἐγένετο ἐν οἴκῳ μου

text_en: And his daughter was Sara, who built Bethoron, the nether and the upper, and Ozensara.
text_la: filia autem ejus fuit Sara, quæ ædificavit Bethoron inferiorem et superiorem, et Ozensara.
text_pt: E sua filha foi Seerá, que edificou a Bete-Horom, a baixa e a alta, como também a Uzém-Seerá.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἐκείνοις τοῖς καταλοίποις καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν Βαιθωρων τὴν κάτω καὶ τὴν ἄνω καὶ υἱοὶ Οζαν Σεηρα

text_en: And Rapha was his son, and Reseph, and Thale, of whom was born Thaan,
text_la: Porro filius ejus Rapha, et Reseph, et Thale, de quo natus est Thaan,
text_pt: E foi seu filho Refa, e Resefe, de quem foi filho Tela, de quem foi filho Taã,
text_el: καὶ Ραφη υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ Ρασεφ καὶ Θαλε υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ Θαεν υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: who begot Laadan: and his son was Ammiud, who begot Elisama,
text_la: qui genuit Laadan : hujus quoque filius Ammiud, qui genuit Elisama,
text_pt: De quem foi filho Ladã, de quem foi filho Amiúde, de quem foi filho Elisama,
text_el: τῷ Λααδαν υἱῷ αὐτοῦ Αμιουδ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ελισαμα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: of whom was born Nun, who had Joshua for his son.
text_la: de quo ortus est Nun, qui habuit filium Josue.
text_pt: De quem foi filho Num, de quem foi filho Josué.
text_el: Νουμ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ιησουε υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And their possessions and habitations were Bethel with her daughters, and eastward Noran, and westward Gazer and her daughters, Sichem also with her daughters, as far as Asa with her daughters.
text_la: Possessio autem eorum et habitatio, Bethel cum filiabus suis, et contra orientem Noran, ad occidentalem plagam Gazer et filiæ ejus, Sichem quoque cum filiabus suis, usque ad Aza cum filiabus ejus.
text_pt: E foi a sua possessão e habitação Betel e os lugares da sua jurisdição; e ao oriente Naarã, e ao ocidente Gezer e os lugares da sua jurisdição, e Siquém e os lugares da sua jurisdição, até Gaza e os lugares da sua jurisdição;
text_el: καὶ κατάσχεσις αὐτῶν καὶ κατοικία αὐτῶν Βαιθηλ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς κατ' ἀνατολὰς Νααραν πρὸς δυσμαῖς Γαζερ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς καὶ Συχεμ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς ἕως Γαιαν καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς

text_en: And by the borders of the sons of Manasses Bethsan and her daughters, Thanach and her daughters, Mageddo and her daughters: Dor and her daughters: in these dwelt the children of Joseph , the son of Israel .
text_la: Juxta filios quoque Manasse, Bethsan et filias ejus, Thanach et filias ejus, Mageddo et filias ejus, Dor et filias ejus : in his habitaverunt filii Joseph, filii Israël.
text_pt: E do lado dos filhos de Manassés, Bete-Seã e os lugares da sua jurisdição, Taanaque e os lugares da sua jurisdição, Megido e os lugares da sua jurisdição, Dor e os lugares da sua jurisdição; nestas habitaram os filhos de José, filho de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἕως ὁρίων υἱῶν Μανασση Βαιθσααν καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς Θααναχ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς καὶ Βαλαδ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς Μαγεδδω καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς Δωρ καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς ἐν ταύταις κατῴκησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ιωσηφ υἱοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: The children of Aser were Jemna, and Jesua, and Jessui, and Baria, and Sara their sister.
text_la: Filii Aser : Jemna, et Jesua, et Jessui, et Baria, et Sara soror eorum.
text_pt: Os filhos de Aser foram: Imná, Isvá, Isvi, Berias, e Sera, irmã deles.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ασηρ Ιεμνα καὶ Ισουα καὶ Ισουι καὶ Βεριγα καὶ Σορε ἀδελφὴ αὐτῶν

text_en: And the sons of Baria: Haber, and Melchiel: he is the father of Barsaith.
text_la: Filii autem Baria : Heber, et Melchiel : ipse est pater Barsaith.
text_pt: E os filhos de Berias: Héber e Malquiel; este foi o pai de Birzavite.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Βεριγα Χαβερ καὶ Μελχιηλ οὗτος πατὴρ Βερζαιθ

text_en: And Heber begot Jephlat, and Somer, and Hotham, and Suaa their sister.
text_la: Heber autem genuit Jephlat, et Somer, et Hotham, et Suaa sororem eorum.
text_pt: E Héber gerou a Jaflete, e a Somer, e a Hotão, e a Suá, irmã deles.
text_el: καὶ Χαβερ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιαφαλητ καὶ τὸν Σαμηρ καὶ τὸν Χωθαμ καὶ τὴν Σωλα ἀδελφὴν αὐτῶν

text_en: The sons of Jephlat: Phosech, and Chamaal, and Asoth: these are the sons of Jephlat.
text_la: Filii Jephlat : Phosech, et Chamaal, et Asoth : hi filii Jephlat.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Jaflete: Pasaque, e Bimal e Asvate; estes foram os filhos de Jaflete.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιαφαλητ Φεσηχι Βαμαηλ καὶ Ασιθ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ιαφαλητ

text_en: And the sons of Somer: Ahi, and Roaga and Haba, and Aram.
text_la: Porro filii Somer : Ahi, et Roaga, et Haba, et Aram.
text_pt: E os filhos de Semer: Ai, Roga, Jeubá, e Arã.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Σεμμηρ Αχιουραογα καὶ Οβα καὶ Αραμ

text_en: And the sons of Helem his brother: Supha, and Jemna, and Selles, and Amal.
text_la: Filii autem Helem fratris ejus : Supha, et Jemna, et Selles, et Amal.
text_pt: E os filhos de seu irmão Helém: Zofa, e Imna, e Seles, e Amal.
text_el: καὶ Βανηελαμ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ Σωφα καὶ Ιμανα καὶ Σελλης καὶ Αμαλ

text_en: The sons of Supha: Sue, Hernapher, and Sual, and Beri, and Jamra.
text_la: Filii Supha : Sue, Harnapher, et Sual, et Beri, et Jamra,
text_pt: Os filhos de Zofa: Suá, e Harnefer, e Sual, e Beri, e Inra,
text_el: υἱοὶ Σωφα Χουχι Αρναφαρ καὶ Σουαλ καὶ Βαρι καὶ Ιμαρη

text_en: Bosor and Hod, and Samma, and Salusa, and Jethran, and Bera.
text_la: Bosor, et Hod, et Samma, et Salusa, et Jethran, et Bera.
text_pt: Bezer, Hode, Samá, Silsa, Itrã, e Beera.
text_el: Σοβαλ καὶ Ωδ καὶ Σεμμα καὶ Σαλισα καὶ Ιεθραν καὶ Βεηρα

text_en: The sons of Jether: Jephone, and Phaspha, and Ara.
text_la: Filii Jether : Jephone, et Phaspha, et Ara.
text_pt: E os filhos de Jeter: Jefoné, Pispa e Ara.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιεθερ Ιφινα καὶ Φασφα καὶ Αρα

text_en: And the sons of Olla: Aree, and Haniel, and Resia.
text_la: Filii autem Olla : Aree, et Haniel, et Resia.
text_pt: E os filhos de Ula: Ará e Haniel e Rizia.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ωλα Ορεχ Ανιηλ καὶ Ρασια

text_en: All these were sons of Aser , heads of their families , choice and most valiant captains of captains : and the number of them that were of the age that was fit for war , was six and twenty thousand.
text_la: Omnes hi filii Aser, principes cognationum, electi atque fortissimi duces ducum : numerus autem eorum ætatis quæ apta esset ad bellum, viginti sex millia.
text_pt: Todos estes foram filhos de Aser, chefes das casas paternas, homens escolhidos e valentes, chefes dos príncipes, e contados nas suas genealogias, no exército para a guerra; foi seu número de vinte e seis mil homens.
text_el: πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ασηρ πάντες ἄρχοντες πατριῶν ἐκλεκτοὶ ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει ἄρχοντες ἡγούμενοι ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν εἰς παράταξιν τοῦ πολεμεῖν ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν ἄνδρες εἴκοσι ἓξ χιλιάδες

text_en: Now Benjamin begot Bale his firstborn , Asbel the second, Ahara the third,
text_la: Benjamin autem genuit Bale primogenitum suum, Asbel secundum, Ahara tertium,
text_pt: E Benjamim gerou a Belá, seu primogênito, a Asbel o segundo, e a Aará o terceiro,
text_el: καὶ Βενιαμιν ἐγέννησεν τὸν Βαλε πρωτότοκον αὐτοῦ καὶ Ασβηλ τὸν δεύτερον Ααρα τὸν τρίτον

text_en: Nohaa the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
text_la: Nohaa quartum, et Rapha quintum.
text_pt: A Noá o quarto, e a Rafa o quinto.
text_el: Νωα τὸν τέταρτον καὶ Ραφη τὸν πέμπτον

text_en: And the sons of Bale were Addar, and Gera, and Abiud,
text_la: Fueruntque filii Bale : Addar, et Gera, et Abiud,
text_pt: E Belá teve estes filhos: Adar, Gera, Abiúde,
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ τῷ Βαλε Αδερ καὶ Γηρα καὶ Αβιουδ

text_en: and Abisue, and Naaman, and Ahoe,
text_la: Abisue quoque et Naaman, et Ahoë,
text_pt: Abisua, Naamã, Aoá,
text_el: καὶ Αβισουε καὶ Νοομα καὶ Αχια

text_en: and Gera, and Sephuphan, and Huram.
text_la: sed et Gera, et Sephuphan, et Huram.
text_pt: Gera, Sefufá e Hurão.
text_el: καὶ Γηρα καὶ Σωφαρφακ καὶ Ωιμ

text_en: These are the sons of Abed, heads of families that dwelt in Gabaa, who were removed into Manahath.
text_la: Hi sunt filii Ahod, principes cognationum habitantium in Gabaa, qui translati sunt in Manahath.
text_pt: E estes foram os filhos de Eúde; que foram chefes dos pais dos moradores de Geba, e os levaram cativos a Manaate;
text_el: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Αωδ οὗτοί εἰσιν ἄρχοντες πατριῶν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Γαβεε καὶ μετῴκισαν αὐτοὺς εἰς Μαναχαθι

text_en: And Naaman, and Achia, and Gera he removed them, and begot Oza, and Ahiud.
text_la: Naaman autem, et Achia, et Gera, ipse transtulit eos, et genuit Osa, et Ahiud.
text_pt: E Naamã, e Aías e Gera; este os transportou, e gerou a Uzá e a Aiúde.
text_el: καὶ Νοομα καὶ Αχια καὶ Γηρα οὗτος ιγλααμ καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ναανα καὶ τὸν Αχιχωδ

text_en: And Saharim begot in the land of Moab , after he sent away Husim and Bara his wives.
text_la: Porro Saharaim genuit in regione Moab, postquam dimisit Husim et Bara uxores suas.
text_pt: E Saaraim (depois de os enviar), na terra de Moabe, gerou filhos de Husim e Baara, suas mulheres.
text_el: καὶ Σααρημ ἐγέννησεν ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ Μωαβ μετὰ τὸ ἀποστεῖλαι αὐτὸν Ωσιμ καὶ τὴν Βααδα γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he begot of Hodes his wife Jobab, and Sebia, and Mosa, and Molchom,
text_la: Genuit autem de Hodes uxore sua Jobab, et Sebia, et Mosa, et Molchom,
text_pt: E de Hodes, sua mulher, gerou a Jobabe, a Zíbia, a Mesa, a Malcã,
text_el: καὶ ἐγέννησεν ἐκ τῆς Αδα γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ τὸν Ιωβαβ καὶ τὸν Σεβια καὶ τὸν Μισα καὶ τὸν Μελχαμ

text_en: and Jehus and Sechia, and Marma. These were his sons heads of their families .
text_la: Jehus quoque, et Sechia, et Marma : hi sunt filii ejus principes in familiis suis.
text_pt: A Jeuz, a Saquias e a Mirma; estes foram seus filhos, chefes dos pais.
text_el: καὶ τὸν Ιαως καὶ τὸν Σαβια καὶ τὸν Μαρμα οὗτοι ἄρχοντες πατριῶν

text_en: And Mehusim begot Abitob, and Elphaal.
text_la: Mehusim vero genuit Abitob et Elphaal.
text_pt: E de Husim gerou a Abitube e a Elpaal.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τῆς Ωσιμ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αβιτωβ καὶ τὸν Αλφααλ

text_en: And the sons of Elphaal were Heber, and Misaam, and Samad: who built Ono, and Lod, and its daughters.
text_la: Porro filii Elphaal : Heber, et Misaam, et Samad : hic ædificavit Ono, et Lod, et filias ejus.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Elpaal: Éber, Misã e Semede; este edificou a Ono e a Lode e os lugares da sua jurisdição.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Αλφααλ Ωβηδ Μεσσααμ Σεμμηρ οὗτος ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν Ωνω καὶ τὴν Λοδ καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς

text_en: And Baria, and Sama were heads of their kindreds that dwelt in Aialon: these drove away the inhabitants of Geth.
text_la: Baria autem et Sama principes cognationum habitantium in Ajalon: hi fugaverunt habitatores Geth.
text_pt: E Berias e Sema foram cabeças dos pais dos moradores de Aijalom; estes afugentaram os moradores de Gate.
text_el: καὶ Βεριγα καὶ Σαμα οὗτοι ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν Αιλαμ καὶ οὗτοι ἐξεδίωξαν τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Γεθ

text_en: And Ahio, and Sesac, and Jerimoth,
text_la: Et Ahio, et Sesac, et Jerimoth,
text_pt: E Aiô, Sasaque, Jerimote,
text_el: καὶ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ Σωσηκ καὶ Ιαριμωθ

text_en: and Zabadia, and Arod, and Heder,
text_la: et Zabadia, et Arod, et Heder,
text_pt: Zebadias, Arade, Eder,
text_el: καὶ Ζαβαδια καὶ Ωρηρ καὶ Ωδηδ

text_en: and Michael, and Jespha, and Joha, the sons of Baria.
text_la: Michaël quoque, et Jespha, et Joha filii Baria.
text_pt: Micael, Ispa e Joa foram filhos de Berias.
text_el: καὶ Μιχαηλ καὶ Ιεσφα καὶ Ιωχα υἱοὶ Βαριγα

text_en: And Zabadia, and Mosollam, Hezeci, and Heber,
text_la: Et Zabadia, et Mosollam, et Hezeci, et Heber,
text_pt: Zebadias, Mesulão, Hizque, Héber,
text_el: καὶ Ζαβαδια καὶ Μοσολλαμ καὶ Αζακι καὶ Αβαρ

text_en: and Jesamari, and Jezlia, and Jobab, sons of Elphaal,
text_la: et Jesamari, et Jezlia, et Jobab filii Elphaal,
text_pt: Ismerai, Izlias e Jobabe, filhos de Elpaal.
text_el: καὶ Ισαμαρι καὶ Ιεζλια καὶ Ιωβαβ υἱοὶ Ελφααλ

text_en: and Jacim, and Zechri, and Zabdi,
text_la: et Jacim, et Zechri, et Zabdi,
text_pt: Jaquim, Zicri, Zabdi,
text_el: καὶ Ιακιμ καὶ Ζεχρι καὶ Ζαβδι

text_en: and Elioenai, and Selethai, and Elial,
text_la: et Elioënai, et Selethai, et Eliel,
text_pt: Elienai, Ziletai, Eliel,
text_el: καὶ Ελιωηναι καὶ Σαλθι καὶ Ελιηλι

text_en: and Adaia, and Baraia, and Samareth, the sons of Semei.
text_la: et Adaia, et Baraia, et Samarath, filii Semei.
text_pt: Adaías, Beraías e Sinrate, filhos de Simei.
text_el: καὶ Αδαια καὶ Βαραια καὶ Σαμαραθ υἱοὶ Σαμαϊ

text_en: And Jespham, and Heber, and Eliel,
text_la: Et Jespham, et Heber, et Eliel,
text_pt: E Ispã, Éber, Eliel,
text_el: καὶ Ισφαν καὶ Ωβηδ καὶ Ελεηλ

text_en: and Abdon, and Zechri, and Hanan,
text_la: et Abdon, et Zechri, et Hanan,
text_pt: Abdom, Zicri, Hanã,
text_el: καὶ Αβαδων καὶ Ζεχρι καὶ Αναν

text_en: and Hanania, and Elam, and Anathothia .
text_la: et Hanania, et Ælam, et Anathothia,
text_pt: Hananias, Elão, Antotias,
text_el: καὶ Ανανια καὶ Αμβρι καὶ Αιλαμ καὶ Αναθωθια

text_en: And Jephdaia, and Phanuel the sons of Sesac.
text_la: et Jephdaia, et Phanuel, filii Sesac.
text_pt: E Ifdéias, e Penuel, filhos de Sasaque;
text_el: καὶ Αθιν καὶ Ιεφερια καὶ Φελιηλ υἱοὶ Σωσηκ

text_en: And Samsari, and Sohoria and Otholia,
text_la: Et Samsari, et Sohoria, et Otholia,
text_pt: E Sanserai, e Searias, e Atalias,
text_el: καὶ Σαμσαρια καὶ Σααρια καὶ Ογοθολια

text_en: and Jersia, and Elia, and Zechri, the sons of Jeroham.
text_la: et Jersia, et Elia, et Zechri, filii Jeroham.
text_pt: E Jaaresias, e Elias e Zicri, filhos de Jeroão.
text_el: καὶ Ιαρασια καὶ Ηλια καὶ Ζεχρι υἱοὶ Ιρααμ

text_en: These were the chief fathers, and heads of their families who dwelt in Jerusalem .
text_la: Hi patriarchæ, et cognationum principes, qui habitaverunt in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Estes foram cabeças dos pais, segundo as suas gerações, chefes, e habitaram em Jerusalém.
text_el: οὗτοι ἄρχοντες πατριῶν κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν ἄρχοντες οὗτοι κατῴκησαν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And at Gabaon dwelt Abigabaon, and the name of his wife was Maacha:
text_la: In Gabaon autem habitaverunt Abigabaon, et nomen uxoris ejus Maacha:
text_pt: E em Gibeão habitou o pai de Gibeão; e era o nome de sua mulher Maaca;
text_el: καὶ ἐν Γαβαων κατῴκησεν πατὴρ Γαβαων καὶ ὄνομα γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ Μααχα

text_en: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Sur, and Cis, and Baal , and Nadab,
text_la: filiusque ejus primogenitus Abdon, et Sur, et Cis, et Baal, et Nadab,
text_pt: E seu filho primogênito, Abdom; depois Zur, e Quis, Baal, e Nadabe,
text_el: καὶ υἱὸς αὐτῆς ὁ πρωτότοκος Αβαδων καὶ Σουρ καὶ Κις καὶ Βααλ καὶ Νηρ καὶ Ναδαβ

text_en: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher, and Macelloth:
text_la: Gedor quoque, et Ahio, et Zacher, et Macelloth:
text_pt: E Gedor, Aiô, e Zequer,
text_el: καὶ Γεδουρ καὶ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ Ζαχουρ καὶ Μακαλωθ

text_en: And Macelloth begot Samaa: and they dwelt over against their brethren in Jerusalem with their brethren.
text_la: et Macelloth genuit Samaa : habitaveruntque ex adverso fratrum suorum in Jerusalem cum fratribus suis.
text_pt: E Miclote gerou a Siméia; e também estes, defronte de seus irmãos, habitaram em Jerusalém com eles.
text_el: καὶ Μακαλωθ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σεμαα καὶ γὰρ οὗτοι κατέναντι τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν κατῴκησαν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And Ner begot Cis and Cis begot Saul . And Saul begot Jonathan and Melchisua, and Abinadab, and Esbaal.
text_la: Ner autem genuit Cis, et Cis genuit Saul. Porro Saul genuit Jonathan, et Melchisua, et Abinadab, et Esbaal.
text_pt: E Ner gerou a Quis, e Quis gerou a Saul; e Saul gerou a Jônatas, a Malquisua, a Abinadabe, e a Esbaal.
text_el: καὶ Νηρ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Κις καὶ Κις ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαουλ καὶ Σαουλ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιωναθαν καὶ τὸν Μελχισουε καὶ τὸν Αμιναδαβ καὶ τὸν Ασαβαλ

text_en: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begot Micha.
text_la: Filius autem Jonathan, Meribbaal : et Meribbaal genuit Micha.
text_pt: E o filho de Jônatas foi Meribe-Baal; e Meribe-Baal gerou a Mica.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιωναθαν Μεριβααλ καὶ Μεριβααλ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μιχια

text_en: And the sons of Micha were Phithon, and Melech, and Tharaa, and Ahaz.
text_la: Filii Micha, Phithon, et Melech, et Tharaa, et Ahaz.
text_pt: E os filhos de Mica foram: Pitom, Meleque, Tareá, e Acaz.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Μιχια Φιθων καὶ Μελχηλ καὶ Θερεε καὶ Αχαζ

text_en: And Ahaz begot Joada: and Joada begot Alamath, and Azmoth, and Zamri: and Zamri begot Mosa,
text_la: Et Ahaz genuit Joada, et Joada genuit Alamath, et Azmoth, et Zamri : porro Zamri genuit Mosa,
text_pt: E Acaz gerou a Jeoada; e Jeoada gerou a Alemete, e a Azmavete, e a Zinri; e Zinri gerou a Moza,
text_el: καὶ Αχαζ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιωιαδα καὶ Ιωιαδα ἐγέννησεν τὸν Γαλεμαθ καὶ τὸν Ασμωθ καὶ τὸν Ζαμβρι καὶ Ζαμβρι ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μαισα

text_en: and Mosa begot Banaa, whose son was Rapha, of whom was born Elasa, who begot Asel.
text_la: et Mosa genuit Banaa, cujus filius fuit Rapha, de quo ortus est Elasa, qui genuit Asel.
text_pt: E Moza gerou a Bineá, cujo filho foi Rafa, de quem foi filho Eleasá, cujo filho foi Azel.
text_el: καὶ Μαισα ἐγέννησεν τὸν Βαανα Ραφαια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ελασα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Εσηλ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Asel had six sons whose names were Ezricam, Bochru, Ismahel, Saris, Obdia, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Asel.
text_la: Porro Asel sex filii fuerunt his nominibus : Ezricam, Bocru, Ismahel, Saria, Obdia, et Hanan : omnes hi filii Asel.
text_pt: E teve Azel seis filhos, e estes foram os seus nomes: Azricão, Bocru, Ismael, Searias, Obadias, e Hanã; todos estes foram filhos de Azel.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Εσηλ ἓξ υἱοί καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν Εζρικαμ πρωτότοκος αὐτοῦ καὶ Ισμαηλ καὶ Σαραια καὶ Αβδια καὶ Αναν πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Εσηλ

text_en: And the sons of Esec, his brother, were Ulam the firstborn , and Jehus the second, and Eliphalet the third.
text_la: Filii autem Esec fratris ejus, Ulam primogenitus, et Jehus secundus, et Eliphalet tertius.
text_pt: E os filhos de Ezeque, seu irmão: Ulão, seu primogênito, Jeús o segundo e Elifelete o terceiro.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ασηλ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ Αιλαμ πρωτότοκος αὐτοῦ καὶ Ιαις ὁ δεύτερος Ελιφαλετ ὁ τρίτος

text_en: And the sons of Ulam were most valiant men , and archers of great strength: and they had many sons and grandsons, even to a hundred and fifty. All these were children of Benjamin .
text_la: Fueruntque filii Ulam viri robustissimi, et magno robore tendentes arcum : et multos habentes filios ac nepotes, usque ad centum quinquaginta. Omnes hi filii Benjamin.
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Ulão homens heróis, valentes, e flecheiros destros; e tiveram muitos filhos, e filhos de filhos, cento e cinqüenta; todos estes foram dos filhos de Benjamim.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ Αιλαμ ἰσχυροὶ ἄνδρες δυνάμει τείνοντες τόξον καὶ πληθύνοντες υἱοὺς καὶ υἱοὺς τῶν υἱῶν ἑκατὸν πεντήκοντα πάντες οὗτοι ἐξ υἱῶν Βενιαμιν

text_en: And all Israel was numbered: and the sum of them was written in the book of the kings of Israel , and Juda : and they were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
text_la: Universus ergo Israël dinumeratus est, et summa eorum scripta est in libro regum Israël et Juda : translatique sunt in Babylonem propter delictum suum.
text_pt: E todo o Israel foi contado por genealogias, que estão escritas no livro dos reis de Israel; e os de Judá foram transportados a Babilônia, por causa da sua transgressão.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ ὁ συλλοχισμὸς αὐτῶν καὶ οὗτοι καταγεγραμμένοι ἐν βιβλίῳ τῶν βασιλέων Ισραηλ καὶ Ιουδα μετὰ τῶν ἀποικισθέντων εἰς Βαβυλῶνα ἐν ταῖς ἀνομίαις αὐτῶν

text_en: Now the first that dwelt in their possessions, and in their cities, were the Israelites , and the priests , and the Levites , and the Nathineans .
text_la: Qui autem habitaverunt primi in possessionibus et in urbibus suis : Israël, et sacerdotes, et Levitæ, et Nathinæi.
text_pt: E os primeiros habitantes, que moravam na sua possessão e nas suas cidades, foram os israelitas, os sacerdotes, os levitas, e os netineus.
text_el: καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες πρότερον ἐν ταῖς κατασχέσεσιν αὐτῶν ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν Ισραηλ οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ Λευῖται καὶ οἱ δεδομένοι

text_en: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Juda , and of the children of Benjamin , and of the children of Ephraim, and of Manasses .
text_la: Commorati sunt in Jerusalem de filiis Juda, et de filiis Benjamin, de filiis quoque Ephraim, et Manasse.
text_pt: Porém alguns dos filhos de Judá, e dos filhos de Benjamim, e dos filhos de Efraim e Manassés, habitaram em Jerusalém:
text_el: καὶ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ κατῴκησαν ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ιουδα καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Βενιαμιν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Εφραιμ καὶ Μανασση

text_en: Othei the son of Ammiud, the son of Amri, the son of Omrai, the son of Bonni of the sons of Phares the son of Juda .
text_la: Othei filius Ammiud, filii Amri, filii Omrai, filii Bonni, de filiis Phares filii Juda.
text_pt: Utai, filho de Amiúde, filho de Onri, filho de Inri, filho de Bani, dos filhos de Perez, filho de Judá;
text_el: Γωθι υἱὸς Αμμιουδ υἱοῦ Αμρι υἱοῦ υἱῶν Φαρες υἱοῦ Ιουδα

text_en: And of Siloni: Asaia the firstborn , and his sons.
text_la: Et de Siloni : Asaia primogenitus, et filii ejus.
text_pt: E dos silonitas: Asaías o primogênito, e seus filhos;
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τῶν Σηλωνι Ασαια πρωτότοκος αὐτοῦ καὶ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And of the sons of Zara: Jehuel and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
text_la: De filiis autem Zara, Jehuel, et fratres eorum, sexcenti nonaginta.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Zerá: Jeuel, e seus irmãos, seiscentos e noventa;
text_el: ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ζαρα Ιιηλ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν ἑξακόσιοι καὶ ἐνενήκοντα

text_en: And of the sons of Benjamin : Salo the son of Mosollam, the son of Oduia, the son of Asana:
text_la: Porro de filiis Benjamin : Salo filius Mosollam, filii Oduia, filii Asana,
text_pt: E dos filhos de Benjamim: Salu, filho de Mesulão, filho de Hodavias, filho de Hassenua,
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Βενιαμιν Σαλω υἱὸς Μοσολλαμ υἱοῦ Ωδουια υἱοῦ Σαναα

text_en: And Jobania the son of Jeroham: and Ela the son of Ozi, the son of Mochori and Mosallam the son of Saphatias, the son of Rahuel, the son of Jebania:
text_la: et Jobania filius Jeroham, et Ela filius Ozi, filii Mochori, et Mosollam filius Saphatiæ, filii Rahuel, filii Jebaniæ,
text_pt: E Ibnéias, filho de Jeroão, e Elá, filho de Uzi, filho de Micri, e Mesulão, filho de Sefatias, filho de Reuel, filho de Ibnijas;
text_el: καὶ Ιβαναα υἱὸς Ιρααμ καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Οζι υἱοῦ Μαχιρ καὶ Μασσαλημ υἱὸς Σαφατια υἱοῦ Ραγουηλ υἱοῦ Βαναια

text_en: And their brethren by their families , nine hundred and fifty-six. All these were heads of their families , by the houses of their fathers.
text_la: et fratres eorum per familias suas, nongenti quinquaginta sex. Omnes hi principes cognationum per domos patrum suorum.
text_pt: E seus irmãos, segundo as suas gerações, novecentos e cinqüenta e seis; todos estes homens foram chefes dos pais nas casas de seus pais.
text_el: καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν ἐννακόσιοι πεντήκοντα ἕξ πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες ἄρχοντες πατριῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And of the priests : Jedaia, Joiarib, and Jachin:
text_la: De sacerdotibus autem : Jedaia, Jojarib, et Jachin:
text_pt: E dos sacerdotes: Jedaías, e Jeoiaribe, e Jaquim,
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἱερέων Ιωδαε καὶ Ιωαριμ καὶ Ιαχιν

text_en: And Azarias the son of Helcias, the son of Mosollam, the son of Sadoc, the son of Maraioth, the son of Achitob, high priest of the house of God .
text_la: Azarias quoque filius Helciæ, filii Mosollam, filii Sadoc, filii Maraioth, filii Achitob, pontifex domus Dei.
text_pt: E Azarias, filho de Hilquias, filho de Mesulão, filho de Zadoque, filho de Meraiote, filho de Aitube, maioral da casa de Deus;
text_el: καὶ Αζαρια υἱὸς Χελκια υἱοῦ Μοσολλαμ υἱοῦ Σαδωκ υἱοῦ Μαραιωθ υἱοῦ Αχιτωβ ἡγούμενος οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And Adaias the son of Jeroham, the son of Phassur, the son of Melchias, and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jezra, the son of Mosollam, the son of Mosollamith, the son of Emmer.
text_la: Porro Adaias filius Jeroham, filii Phassur, filii Melchiæ, et Maasai filius Adiel filii Jezra, filii Mosollam, filii Mosollamith, filii Emmer.
text_pt: Adaías, filho de Jeroão, filho de Pasur, filho de Malquias, e Masai, filho de Adiel, filho de Jazera, filho de Mesulão, filho de Mesilemite, filho de Imer;
text_el: καὶ Αδαια υἱὸς Ιρααμ υἱοῦ Πασχωρ υἱοῦ Μαλχια καὶ Μαασαια υἱὸς Αδιηλ υἱοῦ Ιεδιου υἱοῦ Μοσολλαμ υἱοῦ Μασελμωθ υἱοῦ Εμμηρ

text_en: And their brethren heads in their families a thousand seven hundred and threescore, very strong and able men for the work of the ministry in the house of God .
text_la: Fratres quoque eorum principes per familias suas, mille septingenti sexaginta, fortissimi robore ad faciendum opus ministerii in domo Dei.
text_pt: Como também seus irmãos, cabeças nas casas de seus pais, mil, setecentos e sessenta, homens valentes para a obra do ministério da casa de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν ἄρχοντες οἴκων πατριῶν χίλιοι ἑπτακόσιοι ἑξήκοντα ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει εἰς ἐργασίαν λειτουργίας οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And of the Levites : Semeia the son of Hassub the son of Ezricam, the son of Hasebia of the sons of Merari.
text_la: De Levitis autem : Semeia filius Hassub filii Ezricam, filii Hasebia de filiis Merari.
text_pt: E dos levitas: Semaías, filho de Hassube, filho de Azricão, filho de Hasabias, dos filhos de Merari;
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τῶν Λευιτῶν Σαμαια υἱὸς Ασωβ υἱοῦ Εσρικαμ υἱοῦ Ασαβια ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Μεραρι

text_en: And Bacbacar the carpenter, and Galal, and Mathania the son of Micha, the son of Zechri the son of Asaph:
text_la: Bacbacar quoque carpentarius, et Galal, et Mathania filius Micha, filii Zechri, filii Asaph:
text_pt: E Baquebacar, Heres e Galal; e Matanias, filho de Mica, filho de Zicri, filho de Asafe;
text_el: καὶ Βακβακαρ καὶ Αρης καὶ Γαλαλ καὶ Μανθανιας υἱὸς Μιχα υἱοῦ Ζεχρι υἱοῦ Ασαφ

text_en: And Obdia the son of Semeia, the son of Galal, the son of Idithum: and Barachia the son of Asa, the son of Elcana, who dwelt in the suburbs of Netophati.
text_la: et Obdia filius Semeiæ, filii Galal, filii Idithun : et Barachia filius Asa, filii Elcana, qui habitavit in atriis Netophati.
text_pt: E Obadias, filho de Semaías, filho de Galal, filho de Jedutum; e Berequias, filho de Asa, filho de Elcana, morador das aldeias dos netofatitas.
text_el: καὶ Αβδια υἱὸς Σαμια υἱοῦ Γαλαλ υἱοῦ Ιδιθων καὶ Βαραχια υἱὸς Οσσα υἱοῦ Ηλκανα ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν ταῖς κώμαις Νετωφατι

text_en: And the porters were Sellum, and Accub, and Telmon, and Ahiman: and their brother Sellum was the prince,
text_la: Janitores autem : Sellum, et Accub, et Telmon, et Ahimam : et frater eorum Sellum princeps,
text_pt: E foram porteiros: Salum, Acube, Talmom, Aimã, e seus irmãos, cujo chefe era Salum.
text_el: οἱ πυλωροί Σαλωμ καὶ Ακουβ καὶ Ταλμαν καὶ Αιμαν καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν Σαλωμ ὁ ἄρχων

text_en: until that time, in the king's gate eastward, the sons of Levi waited by their turns.
text_la: usque ad illud tempus, in porta regis ad orientem, observabant per vices suas de filiis Levi.
text_pt: E até aquele tempo estavam de guarda à porta do rei, do lado do oriente; estes foram os porteiros dos arraiais dos filhos de Levi.
text_el: καὶ ἕως ταύτης ἐν τῇ πύλῃ τοῦ βασιλέως κατ' ἀνατολάς αὗται αἱ πύλαι τῶν παρεμβολῶν υἱῶν Λευι

text_en: But Sellum the son of Core, the son of Abiasaph, the son of Core , with his brethren and his father's house, the Corites were over the works of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle : and their families in turns were keepers of the entrance of the camp of the Lord .
text_la: Sellum vero filius Core filii Abiasaph, filii Core, cum fratribus suis, et domo patris sui, hi sunt Coritæ super opera ministerii, custodes vestibulorum tabernaculi : et familiæ eorum per vices castrorum Domini custodientes introitum.
text_pt: E Salum, filho de Coré, filho de Ebiasafe, filho de Corá, e seus irmãos da casa de seu pai, os coraítas, tinham cargo da obra do ministério, e eram guardas das portas do tabernáculo, como seus pais foram responsáveis pelo arraial do Senhor, e guardas da entrada.
text_el: καὶ Σαλωμ υἱὸς Κωρη υἱοῦ Αβιασαφ υἱοῦ Κορε καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς οἶκον πατρὸς αὐτοῦ οἱ Κορῖται ἐπὶ τῶν ἔργων τῆς λειτουργίας φυλάσσοντες τὰς φυλακὰς τῆς σκηνῆς καὶ πατέρες αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τῆς παρεμβολῆς κυρίου φυλάσσοντες τὴν εἴσοδον

text_en: And Phinees the son of Eleazar , was their prince before the Lord ,
text_la: Phinees autem filius Eleazari erat dux eorum coram Domino.
text_pt: Finéias, filho de Eleazar, antes era líder entre eles; e o Senhor era com ele.
text_el: καὶ Φινεες υἱὸς Ελεαζαρ ἡγούμενος ἦν ἐπ' αὐτῶν ἔμπροσθεν καὶ οὗτοι μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: and Zacharias the son of Mosollamia, was porter of the gate of the tabernacle of the testimony :
text_la: Porro Zacharias filius Mosollamia, janitor portæ tabernaculi testimonii.
text_pt: E Zacarias, filho de Meselemias, porteiro da entrada da tenda da congregação.
text_el: Ζαχαριας υἱὸς Μασαλαμι πυλωρὸς τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου

text_en: All these that were chosen to be porters at the gates, were two hundred and twelve: they were registered in their proper towns: whom David and Samuel the seer appointed in their trust.
text_la: Omnes hi electi in ostiarios per portas, ducenti duodecim : et descripti in villis propriis, quos constituerunt David, et Samuel videns, in fide sua,
text_pt: Todos estes, escolhidos para serem guardas das portas, foram duzentos e doze; e foram estes, segundo as suas aldeias, postos em suas genealogias; e Davi e Samuel, o vidente, os constituíram nos seus respectivos cargos.
text_el: πάντες οἱ ἐκλεκτοὶ ταῖς πύλαις ἐν ταῖς πύλαις διακόσιοι καὶ δέκα δύο οὗτοι ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς αὐτῶν ὁ καταλοχισμὸς αὐτῶν τούτους ἔστησεν Δαυιδ καὶ Σαμουηλ ὁ βλέπων τῇ πίστει αὐτῶν

text_en: As well them as their sons, to keep the gates of the house of the Lord , and the tabernacle by their turns.
text_la: tam ipsos quam filios eorum, in ostiis domus Domini et in tabernaculo vicibus suis.
text_pt: Estavam, pois, eles, e seus filhos, às portas da casa do Senhor, na casa da tenda, junto aos guardas,
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τῶν πυλῶν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου ἐν οἴκῳ τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ φυλάσσειν

text_en: In four quarters were the porters: that is to say, toward the east, and west, and north, and south.
text_la: Per quatuor ventos erant ostiarii : id est, ad orientem, et ad occidentem, et ad aquilonem, et ad austrum.
text_pt: Os porteiros estavam aos quatro lados; ao oriente, ao ocidente, ao norte, e ao sul.
text_el: κατὰ τοὺς τέσσαρας ἀνέμους ἦσαν αἱ πύλαι κατ' ἀνατολάς θάλασσαν βορρᾶν νότον

text_en: And their brethren dwelt in village , and came upon their sabbath days from time to time.
text_la: Fratres autem eorum in viculis morabantur, et veniebant in sabbatis suis de tempore usque ad tempus.
text_pt: E seus irmãos, que estavam nas suas aldeias, deviam, de tempo em tempo, vir por sete dias para servirem com eles.
text_el: καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς αὐτῶν τοῦ εἰσπορεύεσθαι κατὰ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας ἀπὸ καιροῦ εἰς καιρὸν μετὰ τούτων

text_en: To these four Levites were committed the whole number of the porters, and they were over the chambers, and treasures, of the house of the Lord .
text_la: His quatuor Levitis creditus erat omnis numerus janitorum, et erant super exedras et thesauros domus Domini.
text_pt: Porque havia naquele ofício quatro porteiros principais que eram levitas, e tinham o encargo das câmaras e dos tesouros da casa de Deus.
text_el: ὅτι ἐν πίστει εἰσὶν τέσσαρες δυνατοὶ τῶν πυλῶν οἱ Λευῖται ἦσαν ἐπὶ τῶν παστοφορίων καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν θησαυρῶν οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And they abode in their watches round about the temple of the Lord : that when it was time, they might open the gates in the morning.
text_la: Per gyrum quoque templi Domini morabantur in custodiis suis : ut cum tempus fuisset, ipsi mane aperirent fores.
text_pt: E de noite ficavam em redor da casa de Deus, cuja guarda lhes tinha sido confiada, e tinham o encargo de abri-la cada manhã.
text_el: καὶ περικύκλῳ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ παρεμβαλοῦσιν ὅτι ἐπ' αὐτοὺς φυλακή καὶ οὗτοι ἐπὶ τῶν κλειδῶν τὸ πρωὶ πρωὶ ἀνοίγειν τὰς θύρας τοῦ ἱεροῦ

text_en: And some of their stock had the charge of the vessels for the ministry: for the vessels were both brought in and carried out by number.
text_la: De horum genere erant et super vasa ministerii : ad numerum enim et inferebantur vasa, et efferebantur.
text_pt: E alguns deles estavam encarregados dos utensílios do ministério, porque por conta os traziam e por conta os tiravam.
text_el: καὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὰ σκεύη τῆς λειτουργίας ὅτι ἐν ἀριθμῷ εἰσοίσουσιν αὐτὰ καὶ ἐν ἀριθμῷ ἐξοίσουσιν αὐτά

text_en: Some of them also had the instruments of the sanctuary committed unto them, and the charge of the fine flour, and wine, and oil, and frankincense, and spices.
text_la: De ipsis et qui credita habebant utensilia sanctuarii, præerant similæ, et vino, et oleo, et thuri, et aromatibus.
text_pt: Porque deles havia alguns que tinham o encargo dos objetos e de todos os utensílios do santuário; como também da flor de farinha, do vinho, do azeite, do incenso, e das especiarias.
text_el: καὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν καθεσταμένοι ἐπὶ τὰ σκεύη καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τὰ ἅγια καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς σεμιδάλεως τοῦ οἴνου τοῦ ἐλαίου τοῦ λιβανωτοῦ καὶ τῶν ἀρωμάτων

text_en: And the sons of the priests made the ointments of the spices.
text_la: Filii autem sacerdotum unguenta ex aromatibus conficiebant.
text_pt: E alguns dos filhos dos sacerdotes eram os obreiros da confecção das especiarias.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν τῶν ἱερέων ἦσαν μυρεψοὶ τοῦ μύρου καὶ εἰς τὰ ἀρώματα

text_en: And Mathathias a Levite , the firstborn of Sellum the Corite, was overseer of such things as were fried the frying pan.
text_la: Et Mathathias Levites primogenitus Sellum Coritæ, præfectus erat eorum quæ in sartagine frigebantur.
text_pt: E Matitias, dentre os levitas, o primogênito de Salum, o coraíta, tinha o encargo da obra que se fazia em sertãs.
text_el: καὶ Ματταθιας ἐκ τῶν Λευιτῶν οὗτος ὁ πρωτότοκος τῷ Σαλωμ τῷ Κορίτῃ ἐν τῇ πίστει ἐπὶ τὰ ἔργα τῆς θυσίας τοῦ τηγάνου τοῦ μεγάλου ἱερέως

text_en: And some of the sons of Caath their brethren, were over the loaves of proposition , to prepare always new for every sabbath .
text_la: Porro de filiis Caath fratribus eorum, super panes erant propositionis, ut semper novos per singula sabbata præpararent.
text_pt: E alguns dos seus irmãos, dos filhos dos coatitas, tinham o encargo de preparar os pães da proposição para todos os sábados.
text_el: καὶ Βαναιας ὁ Κααθίτης ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τῶν ἄρτων τῆς προθέσεως τοῦ ἑτοιμάσαι σάββατον κατὰ σάββατον

text_en: These are the chief of the singing men of the families of the Levites , who dwelt in the chambers, by the temple , that they might serve continually day and night in their ministry.
text_la: Hi sunt principes cantorum per familias Levitarum, qui in exedris morabantur, ut die ac nocte jugiter suo ministerio deservirent.
text_pt: Destes foram também os cantores, chefes dos pais entre os levitas, habitando nas câmaras, isentos de serviços; porque de dia e de noite estava a seu cargo ocuparem-se naquela obra.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι ψαλτῳδοὶ ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν τῶν Λευιτῶν διατεταγμέναι ἐφημερίαι ὅτι ἡμέρα καὶ νὺξ ἐπ' αὐτοῖς ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις

text_en: The heads of the Levites , princes in their families , abode in Jerusalem .
text_la: Capita Levitarum, per familias suas principes, manserunt in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Estes foram cabeças dos pais entre os levitas, chefes em suas gerações; estes habitaram em Jerusalém.
text_el: οὗτοι ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν τῶν Λευιτῶν κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν ἄρχοντες οὗτοι κατῴκησαν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And in Gabaon dwelt Jehiel the father of Gabaon, and the name of his wife was Maacha:
text_la: In Gabaon autem commorati sunt pater Gabaon Jehiel, et nomen uxoris ejus Maacha.
text_pt: Porém em Gibeão habitaram Jeiel, pai de Gibeão (e era o nome de sua mulher Maaca).
text_el: καὶ ἐν Γαβαων κατῴκησεν πατὴρ Γαβαων Ιιηλ καὶ ὄνομα γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ Μοωχα

text_en: His firstborn son Abdon, and Sur, and Cis, and Baal , and Ner, and Nadab,
text_la: Filius primogenitus ejus Abdon, et Sur, et Cis, et Baal, et Ner, et Nadab,
text_pt: E seu filho primogênito Abdom; depois Zur, Quis, Baal, Ner e Nadabe,
text_el: καὶ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ὁ πρωτότοκος Αβαδων καὶ Σιρ καὶ Κις καὶ Βααλ καὶ Νηρ καὶ Ναδαβ

text_en: Gedor also, and Ahio, and Zacharias, and Macelloth.
text_la: Gedor quoque, et Ahio, et Zacharias, et Macelloth.
text_pt: E Gedor, Aiô, Zacarias e Miclote.
text_el: καὶ Γεδουρ καὶ ἀδελφὸς καὶ Ζαχαρια καὶ Μακελλωθ

text_en: And Macelloth begot Samaan: these dwelt over against their brethren in Jerusalem , with their brethren.
text_la: Porro Macelloth genuit Samaan: isti habitaverunt e regione fratrum suorum in Jerusalem cum fratribus suis.
text_pt: Miclote gerou a Simeão; e também estes habitaram em Jerusalém, defronte de seus irmãos, com eles.
text_el: καὶ Μακελλωθ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαμαα καὶ οὗτοι ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν κατῴκησαν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: Now Ner begot Cis: and Cis begot Saul : and Saul begot Jonathan and Melchisua, and Abinadab, and Esbaal.
text_la: Ner autem genuit Cis, et Cis genuit Saul, et Saul genuit Jonathan, et Melchisua, et Abinadab, et Esbaal.
text_pt: E Ner gerou a Quis; e Quis gerou a Saul, Saul gerou a Jônatas, a Malquisua, a Abinadabe e a Esbaal.
text_el: καὶ Νηρ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Κις καὶ Κις ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαουλ καὶ Σαουλ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιωναθαν καὶ τὸν Μελχισουε καὶ τὸν Αμιναδαβ καὶ τὸν Ισβααλ

text_en: And the son of Jonathan , was Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begot Micha.
text_la: Filius autem Jonathan, Meribbaal : et Meribbaal genuit Micha.
text_pt: E o filho de Jônatas foi Meribe-Baal, e Meribe-Baal gerou a Mica.
text_el: καὶ υἱὸς Ιωναθαν Μαριβααλ καὶ Μαριβααλ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μιχα

text_en: And the sons of Micha, were Phithon, and Melech, and Tharaa, and Ahaz.
text_la: Porro filii Micha, Phithon, et Melech, et Tharaa, et Ahaz.
text_pt: E os filhos de Mica foram: Pitom, Meleque e Taréia.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Μιχα Φαιθων καὶ Μαλαχ καὶ Θαραχ

text_en: And Ahaz begot Jara, and Jara begot Alamath, and Azmoth, and Zamri. And Zamri begot Mosa.
text_la: Ahaz autem genuit Jara, et Jara genuit Alamath, et Azmoth, et Zamri. Zamri autem genuit Mosa.
text_pt: E Acaz gerou a Jaerá, e Jaerá gerou a Alemete, a Azmavete e a Zinri; e Zinri gerou a Moza.
text_el: καὶ Αχαζ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιαδα καὶ Ιαδα ἐγέννησεν τὸν Γαλεμεθ καὶ τὸν Γαζμωθ καὶ τὸν Ζαμβρι καὶ Ζαμβρι ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μασα

text_en: And Mosa begot Banaa: whose son Raphaia begot Elasa: of whom was born Asel.
text_la: Mosa vero genuit Banaa, cujus filius Raphaia, genuit Elasa, de quo ortus est Asel.
text_pt: E Moza gerou a Bineá, cujo filho foi Refaías, de quem foi filho Eleasá, cujo filho foi Azel.
text_el: καὶ Μασα ἐγέννησεν τὸν Βαανα Ραφαια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ελεασα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Εσηλ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Asel had six sons whose names are, Ezricam Bochru, Ismahel, Saria, Obdia, Hanan: these are the sons of Asel.
text_la: Porro Asel sex filios habuit, his nominibus : Ezricam, Bocru, Ismahel, Saria, Obdia, Hanan : hi sunt filii Asel.
text_pt: E teve Azel seis filhos, e estes foram os seus nomes: Azricão, Bocru, Ismael, Searias, Obadias e Hanã; estes foram os filhos de Azel.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Εσηλ ἓξ υἱοί καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν Εσδρικαμ πρωτότοκος αὐτοῦ Ισμαηλ καὶ Σαρια καὶ Αβδια καὶ Αναν οὗτοι υἱοὶ Εσηλ

text_en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel , and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down wounded in mount Gelboe.
text_la: Philisthiim autem pugnabant contra Israël, fugeruntque viri Israël Palæsthinos, et ceciderunt vulnerati in monte Gelboë.
text_pt: E os filisteus pelejaram com Israel; e os homens de Israel fugiram de diante dos filisteus, e caíram mortos nas montanhas de Gilboa.
text_el: καὶ ἀλλόφυλοι ἐπολέμησαν πρὸς Ισραηλ καὶ ἔφυγον ἀπὸ προσώπου ἀλλοφύλων καὶ ἔπεσον τραυματίαι ἐν ὄρει Γελβουε

text_en: And the Philistines drew near pursuing after Saul , and his sons, and they killed Jonathan , and Abinadab, and Melchisua the sons of Saul .
text_la: Cumque appropinquassent Philisthæi, persequentes Saul et filios ejus, percusserunt Jonathan, et Abinadab, et Melchisua filios Saul.
text_pt: E os filisteus perseguiram a Saul e aos seus filhos e mataram a Jônatas, a Abinadabe e a Malquisua, filhos de Saul.
text_el: καὶ κατεδίωξαν ἀλλόφυλοι ὀπίσω Σαουλ καὶ ὀπίσω υἱῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπάταξαν ἀλλόφυλοι τὸν Ιωναθαν καὶ τὸν Αμιναδαβ καὶ τὸν Μελχισουε υἱοὺς Σαουλ

text_en: And the battle grew hard against Saul and the archers reached him, and wounded him with arrows.
text_la: Et aggravatum est prælium contra Saul, inveneruntque eum sagittarii, et vulneraverunt jaculis.
text_pt: E a peleja se agravou contra Saul, e os flecheiros o alcançaram; e temeu muito aos flecheiros.
text_el: καὶ ἐβαρύνθη ὁ πόλεμος ἐπὶ Σαουλ καὶ εὗρον αὐτὸν οἱ τοξόται ἐν τοῖς τόξοις καὶ πόνοις καὶ ἐπόνεσεν ἀπὸ τῶν τόξων

text_en: And Saul said to his armourbearer: Draw your sword, and kill me: lest these uncircumcised come, and mock me. But his armourbearer would not, for he was struck with fear: so Saul took his sword, and fell upon it.
text_la: Et dixit Saul ad armigerum suum : Evagina gladium tuum, et interfice me, ne forte veniant incircumcisi isti, et illudant mihi. Noluit autem armiger ejus hoc facere, timore perterritus : arripuit ergo Saul ensem, et irruit in eum.
text_pt: Então disse Saul ao seu escudeiro: Arranca a tua espada, e atravessa-me com ela; para que porventura não venham estes incircuncisos e escarneçam de mim. Porém o seu escudeiro não quis, porque temia muito; então tomou Saul a espada, e se lançou sobre ela.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Σαουλ τῷ αἴροντι τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ σπάσαι τὴν ῥομφαίαν σου καὶ ἐκκέντησόν με ἐν αὐτῇ μὴ ἔλθωσιν οἱ ἀπερίτμητοι οὗτοι καὶ ἐμπαίξωσίν μοι καὶ οὐκ ἐβούλετο ὁ αἴρων τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐφοβεῖτο σφόδρα καὶ ἔλαβεν Σαουλ τὴν ῥομφαίαν καὶ ἐπέπεσεν ἐπ' αὐτήν

text_en: And when his armourbearer saw it, to wit, that Saul was dead, he also fell upon his sword and died.
text_la: Quod cum vidisset armiger ejus, videlicet mortuum esse Saul, irruit etiam ipse in gladium suum, et mortuus est.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, o seu escudeiro que Saul estava morto, também ele se lançou sobre a espada e morreu.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ὁ αἴρων τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἀπέθανεν Σαουλ καὶ ἔπεσεν καί γε αὐτὸς ἐπὶ τὴν ῥομφαίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house fell together.
text_la: Interiit ergo Saul : et tres filii ejus, et omnis domus illius pariter concidit.
text_pt: Assim morreram Saul e seus três filhos; e toda a sua casa morreu juntamente.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Σαουλ καὶ τρεῖς υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ πᾶς ὁ οἶκος αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And when the men of Israel , that dwelt in the plains, saw this, they fled: and Saul and his sons being dead, they forsook their cities, and were scattered up and down: and the Philistines came, and dwelt in them.
text_la: Quod cum vidissent viri Israël qui habitabant in campestribus, fugerunt : et Saul ac filiis ejus mortuis, dereliquerunt urbes suas, et huc illucque dispersi sunt : veneruntque Philisthiim, et habitaverunt in eis.
text_pt: E, vendo todos os homens de Israel, que estavam no vale, que haviam fugido, e que Saul e seus filhos eram mortos, deixaram as suas cidades, e fugiram; então vieram os filisteus, e habitaram nelas.
