text_el: καὶ εἶδεν πᾶς ἀνὴρ Ισραηλ ὁ ἐν τῷ αὐλῶνι ὅτι ἔφυγεν Ισραηλ καὶ ὅτι ἀπέθανεν Σαουλ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ κατέλιπον τὰς πόλεις αὐτῶν καὶ ἔφυγον καὶ ἦλθον ἀλλόφυλοι καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐν αὐταῖς

text_en: And the next day the Philistines taking away the spoils of them that were slain, found Saul and his sons lying on mount Gelboe.
text_la: Die igitur altero detrahentes Philisthiim spolia cæsorum, invenerunt Saul et filios ejus jacentes in monte Gelboë.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, no dia seguinte, vindo os filisteus a despojar os mortos, acharam a Saul e a seus filhos estirados nas montanhas de Gilboa.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τῇ ἐχομένῃ καὶ ἦλθον ἀλλόφυλοι τοῦ σκυλεύειν τοὺς τραυματίας καὶ εὗρον τὸν Σαουλ καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ πεπτωκότας ἐν τῷ ὄρει Γελβουε

text_en: And when they had stripped him, and out off his head, and taken away his armour, they sent it into their land, to be carried about, and shown in the temples of the idols and to the people.
text_la: Cumque spoliassent eum, et amputassent caput, armisque nudassent, miserunt in terram suam, ut circumferretur, et ostenderetur idolorum templis, et populis:
text_pt: E o despojaram, e tomaram a sua cabeça e as suas armas, e as enviaram pela terra dos filisteus em redor, para o anunciarem a seus ídolos e ao povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέδυσαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἔλαβον τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπέστειλαν εἰς γῆν ἀλλοφύλων κύκλῳ τοῦ εὐαγγελίσασθαι τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν καὶ τῷ λαῷ

text_en: And his armour they dedicated in the temple of their god, and his head they fastened up in the temple of Dagon .
text_la: arma autem ejus consecraverunt in fano dei sui, et caput affixerunt in templo Dagon.
text_pt: E puseram as suas armas na casa do seu deus, e a sua cabeça afixaram na casa de Dagom.
text_el: καὶ ἔθηκαν τὰ σκεύη αὐτοῦ ἐν οἴκῳ θεοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ ἔθηκαν ἐν οἴκῳ Δαγων

text_en: And when the men of Jabes Galaad had heard this, to wit, all that the Philistines had done to Saul ,
text_la: Hoc cum audissent viri Jabes Galaad, omnia scilicet quæ Philisthiim fecerant super Saul,
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, toda a Jabes de Gileade tudo quanto os filisteus fizeram a Saul,
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες Γαλααδ ἅπαντα ἃ ἐποίησαν ἀλλόφυλοι τῷ Σαουλ καὶ τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: all the valiant men of them arose, and took the bodies of Saul and of his sons, and brought them to Jabes, and buried their bones under the oak that was in Jabes, and they fasted seven days.
text_la: consurrexerunt singuli virorum fortium, et tulerunt cadavera Saul et filiorum ejus : attuleruntque ea in Jabes, et sepelierunt ossa eorum subter quercum, quæ erat in Jabes, et jejunaverunt septem diebus.
text_pt: Então todos os homens valorosos se levantaram, e tomaram o corpo de Saul, e os corpos de seus filhos, e os trouxeram a Jabes; e sepultaram os seus ossos debaixo de um carvalho em Jabes, e jejuaram sete dias.
text_el: καὶ ἠγέρθησαν ἐκ Γαλααδ πᾶς ἀνὴρ δυνατὸς καὶ ἔλαβον τὸ σῶμα Σαουλ καὶ τὸ σῶμα τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἤνεγκαν αὐτὰ εἰς Ιαβις καὶ ἔθαψαν τὰ ὀστᾶ αὐτῶν ὑπὸ τὴν δρῦν ἐν Ιαβις καὶ ἐνήστευσαν ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: So Saul died for his iniquities , because he transgressed the commandment of the Lord , which he had commanded, and kept it not: and moreover consulted also a witch,
text_la: Mortuus est ergo Saul propter iniquitates suas, eo quod prævaricatus sit mandatum Domini quod præceperat, et non custodierit illud : sed insuper etiam pythonissam consuluerit,
text_pt: Assim morreu Saul por causa da transgressão que cometeu contra o Senhor, por causa da palavra do Senhor, a qual não havia guardado; e também porque buscou a adivinhadora para a consultar.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Σαουλ ἐν ταῖς ἀνομίαις αὐτοῦ αἷς ἠνόμησεν τῷ κυρίῳ κατὰ τὸν λόγον κυρίου διότι οὐκ ἐφύλαξεν ὅτι ἐπηρώτησεν Σαουλ ἐν τῷ ἐγγαστριμύθῳ τοῦ ζητῆσαι καὶ ἀπεκρίνατο αὐτῷ Σαμουηλ ὁ προφήτης

text_en: and trusted not in the Lord : therefore he slew him, and transferred his kingdom to David the son of Isai.
text_la: nec speraverit in Domino : propter quod interfecit eum, et transtulit regnum ejus ad David filium Isai.
text_pt: E não buscou ao Senhor, que por isso o matou, e transferiu o reino a Davi, filho de Jessé.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐζήτησεν κύριον καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν τὴν βασιλείαν τῷ Δαυιδ υἱῷ Ιεσσαι

text_en: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David in Hebron , saying: We are your bone, and your flesh.
text_la: Congregatus est igitur omnis Israël ad David in Hebron, dicens : Os tuum sumus, et caro tua.
text_pt: Então todo o Israel se ajuntou a Davi em Hebrom, dizendo: Eis que somos teus ossos e tua carne.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν πᾶς Ισραηλ πρὸς Δαυιδ ἐν Χεβρων λέγοντες ἰδοὺ ὀστᾶ σου καὶ σάρκες σου ἡμεῖς

text_en: Yesterday also, and the day before when Saul was king, you were he that led out and brought in Israel : for the Lord your God said to you: You shall feed my people Israel , and you shall be ruler over them.
text_la: Heri quoque et nudiustertius cum adhuc regnaret Saul, tu eras qui educebas et introducebas Israël : tibi enim dixit Dominus Deus tuus : Tu pasces populum meum Israël, et tu eris princeps super eum.
text_pt: E também outrora, sendo Saul ainda rei, eras tu o que fazias sair e entrar a Israel; também o Senhor teu Deus te disse: Tu apascentarás o meu povo Israel, e tu serás chefe sobre o meu povo Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐχθὲς καὶ τρίτην ὄντος Σαουλ βασιλέως σὺ ἦσθα ὁ ἐξάγων καὶ εἰσάγων τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεός σού σοι σὺ ποιμανεῖς τὸν λαόν μου τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ σὺ ἔσῃ εἰς ἡγούμενον ἐπὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: So all the ancients of Israel came to the king to Hebron , and David made a covenant with them before the Lord : and they anointed him king over Israel according to the word of the Lord which he spoke in the hand of Samuel.
text_la: Venerunt ergo omnes majores natu Israël ad regem in Hebron, et iniit David cum eis fœdus coram Domino : unxeruntque eum regem super Israël, juxta sermonem Domini quem locutus est in manu Samuel.
text_pt: Também vieram todos os anciãos de Israel ao rei, a Hebrom, e Davi fez com eles aliança em Hebrom, perante o Senhor; e ungiram a Davi rei sobre Israel, conforme a palavra do Senhor pelo ministério de Samuel.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον πάντες πρεσβύτεροι Ισραηλ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα εἰς Χεβρων καὶ διέθετο αὐτοῖς ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ διαθήκην ἐν Χεβρων ἐναντίον κυρίου καὶ ἔχρισαν τὸν Δαυιδ εἰς βασιλέα ἐπὶ Ισραηλ κατὰ τὸν λόγον κυρίου διὰ χειρὸς Σαμουηλ

text_en: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem , which is Jebus, where the Jebusites were the inhabitants of the land.
text_la: Abiit quoque David et omnis Israël in Jerusalem : hæc est Jebus, ubi erant Jebusæi habitatores terræ.
text_pt: E partiu Davi e todo o Israel para Jerusalém, que é Jebus; porque ali estavam os jebuseus, habitantes da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ ἄνδρες Ισραηλ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ αὕτη Ιεβους καὶ ἐκεῖ οἱ Ιεβουσαῖοι οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν γῆν

text_en: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David : You shall not come in here. But David took the castle of Sion, which is the city of David.
text_la: Dixeruntque qui habitabant in Jebus ad David : Non ingredieris huc. Porro David cepit arcem Sion, quæ est civitas David,
text_pt: E disseram os habitantes de Jebus a Davi: Tu não entrarás aqui. Porém Davi ganhou a fortaleza de Sião, que é a cidade de Davi.
text_el: εἶπαν δὲ οἱ κατοικοῦντες Ιεβους τῷ Δαυιδ οὐκ εἰσελεύσῃ ὧδε καὶ προκατελάβετο τὴν περιοχὴν Σιων αὕτη ἡ πόλις Δαυιδ

text_en: And he said: Whosoever shall first strike the Jebusites, shall be the head and chief captain . And Joab the son of Sarvia went up first, and was made the general.
text_la: dixitque : Omnis qui percusserit Jebusæum in primis, erit princeps et dux. Ascendit igitur primus Joab filius Sarviæ, et factus est princeps.
text_pt: Porque disse Davi: Qualquer que primeiro ferir os jebuseus será chefe e capitão. Então Joabe, filho de Zeruia, subiu primeiro a ela; pelo que foi feito chefe.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πᾶς τύπτων Ιεβουσαῖον ἐν πρώτοις καὶ ἔσται εἰς ἄρχοντα καὶ εἰς στρατηγόν καὶ ἀνέβη ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἐν πρώτοις Ιωαβ υἱὸς Σαρουια καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς ἄρχοντα

text_en: And David dwelt in the castle, and therefore it was called the city of David,
text_la: Habitavit autem David in arce, et idcirco appellata est civitas David.
text_pt: E Davi habitou na fortaleza; por isso foi chamada a cidade de Davi.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισεν Δαυιδ ἐν τῇ περιοχῇ διὰ τοῦτο ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὴν πόλιν Δαυιδ

text_en: and he built the city round about from Mello all round, and Joab built the rest of the city.
text_la: Ædificavitque urbem in circuitu a Mello usque ad gyrum; Joab autem reliqua urbis exstruxit.
text_pt: E edificou a cidade ao redor, desde Milo até ao circuito; e Joabe renovou o restante da cidade.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν πόλιν κύκλῳ καὶ ἐπολέμησεν καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν πόλιν

text_en: And David went on growing and increasing, and the Lord of hosts was with him.
text_la: Proficiebatque David vadens et crescens, et Dominus exercituum erat cum eo.
text_pt: E Davi tornava-se cada vez mais forte; porque o Senhor dos Exércitos era com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύετο Δαυιδ πορευόμενος καὶ μεγαλυνόμενος καὶ κύριος παντοκράτωρ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: These are the chief of the valiant man of David , who helped him to be made king over all Israel , according to the word of the Lord , which he spoke to Israel .
text_la: Hi principes virorum fortium David, qui adjuverunt eum ut rex fieret super omnem Israël, juxta verbum Domini quod locutus est ad Israël.
text_pt: E estes foram os chefes dos poderosos que Davi tinha, e que o apoiaram fortemente no seu reino, com todo o Israel, para o fazerem rei, conforme a palavra do Senhor, no tocante a Israel.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν δυνατῶν οἳ ἦσαν τῷ Δαυιδ οἱ κατισχύοντες μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ μετὰ παντὸς Ισραηλ τοῦ βασιλεῦσαι αὐτὸν κατὰ τὸν λόγον κυρίου ἐπὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And this is the number of the heroes of David : Jesbaam the son of Hachamoni the chief among the thirty: he lifted up his spear against three hundred wounded by him at one time.
text_la: Et iste numerus robustorum David : Jesbaam filius Hachamoni princeps inter triginta : iste levavit hastam suam super trecentos vulneratos una vice.
text_pt: E este é o número dos poderosos que Davi tinha: Jasobeão, hacmonita, chefe dos capitães, o qual, brandindo a sua lança contra trezentos, de uma vez os matou.
text_el: καὶ οὗτος ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν δυνατῶν τοῦ Δαυιδ Ιεσεβααλ υἱὸς Αχαμανι πρῶτος τῶν τριάκοντα οὗτος ἐσπάσατο τὴν ῥομφαίαν αὐτοῦ ἅπαξ ἐπὶ τριακοσίους τραυματίας ἐν καιρῷ ἑνί

text_en: And after him was Eleazar his uncle's son the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
text_la: Et post eum Eleazar filius patrui ejus Ahohites, qui erat inter tres potentes.
text_pt: E, depois dele Eleazar, filho de Dodó, o aoíta; ele estava entre os três poderosos.
text_el: καὶ μετ' αὐτὸν Ελεαζαρ υἱὸς Δωδαι ὁ Αχωχι οὗτος ἦν ἐν τοῖς τρισὶν δυνατοῖς

text_en: He was with David in Phesdomim, when the Philistines were gathered to that place to battle: and the field of that country was full of barley, and the people fled from before the Philistines .
text_la: Iste fuit cum David in Phesdomim, quando Philisthiim congregati sunt ad locum illum in prælium : et erat ager regionis illius plenus hordeo, fugeratque populus a facie Philisthinorum.
text_pt: Este esteve com Davi em Pas-Damim, quando os filisteus ali se ajuntaram à peleja, onde havia um pedaço de campo cheio de cevada; e o povo fugiu de diante dos filisteus.
text_el: οὗτος ἦν μετὰ Δαυιδ ἐν Φασοδομιν καὶ οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι συνήχθησαν ἐκεῖ εἰς πόλεμον καὶ ἦν μερὶς τοῦ ἀγροῦ πλήρης κριθῶν καὶ ὁ λαὸς ἔφυγεν ἀπὸ προσώπου ἀλλοφύλων

text_en: But these men stood in the midst of the field, and defended it: and they slew the Philistines , and the Lord gave a great deliverance to his people.
text_la: Hi steterunt in medio agri, et defenderunt eum : cumque percussissent Philisthæos, dedit Dominus salutem magnam populo suo.
text_pt: E puseram-se no meio daquele campo, e o defenderam, e feriram os filisteus; e o Senhor efetuou um grande livramento.
text_el: καὶ ἔστη ἐν μέσῳ τῆς μερίδος καὶ ἔσωσεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐπάταξεν τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους καὶ ἐποίησεν κύριος σωτηρίαν μεγάλην

text_en: And three of the thirty captains went down to the rock, wherein David was, to the cave of Odollam , when the Philistines encamped in the valley of Raphaim.
text_la: Descenderunt autem tres de triginta principibus ad petram, in qua erat David, ad speluncam Odollam, quando Philisthiim fuerant castrametati in valle Raphaim.
text_pt: E três dos trinta capitães desceram à penha, a ter com Davi, na caverna de Adulão; e o exército dos filisteus estava acampado no vale de Refaim.
text_el: καὶ κατέβησαν τρεῖς ἐκ τῶν τριάκοντα ἀρχόντων εἰς τὴν πέτραν πρὸς Δαυιδ εἰς τὸ σπήλαιον Οδολλαμ καὶ παρεμβολὴ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων παρεμβεβλήκει ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι τῶν γιγάντων

text_en: And David was in a hold, and the garrison of the Philistines in Bethlehem .
text_la: Porro David erat in præsidio, et statio Philisthinorum in Bethlehem.
text_pt: E Davi estava então no lugar forte; e o alojamento dos filisteus estava então em Belém.
text_el: καὶ Δαυιδ τότε ἐν τῇ περιοχῇ καὶ τὸ σύστεμα τῶν ἀλλοφύλων τότε ἐν Βαιθλεεμ

text_en: And David longed, and said: O that some man would give me water of the cistern of Bethlehem , which is in the gate.
text_la: Desideravit igitur David, et dixit : O si quis daret mihi aquam de cisterna Bethlehem, quæ est in porta!
text_pt: E desejou Davi, e disse: Quem me dera beber da água do poço de Belém, que está junto à porta!
text_el: καὶ ἐπεθύμησεν Δαυιδ καὶ εἶπεν τίς ποτιεῖ με ὕδωρ ἐκ τοῦ λάκκου Βαιθλεεμ τοῦ ἐν τῇ πύλῃ

text_en: And these three broke through the midst of the camp of the Philistines , and drew water out of the cistern of Bethlehem , which was in the gate, and brought it to David to drink: and he would not drink of it, but rather offered it to the Lord ,
text_la: Tres ergo isti per media castra Philisthinorum perrexerunt, et hauserunt aquam de cisterna Bethlehem quæ erat in porta, et attulerunt ad David ut biberet. Qui noluit, sed magis libavit illam Domino,
text_pt: Então aqueles três romperam pelo acampamento dos filisteus, e tiraram água do poço de Belém, que estava junto à porta, e tomaram dela e a trouxeram a Davi; porém Davi não a quis beber, mas a derramou ao Senhor,
text_el: καὶ διέρρηξαν οἱ τρεῖς τὴν παρεμβολὴν τῶν ἀλλοφύλων καὶ ὑδρεύσαντο ὕδωρ ἐκ τοῦ λάκκου τοῦ ἐν Βαιθλεεμ ὃς ἦν ἐν τῇ πύλῃ καὶ ἔλαβον καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς Δαυιδ καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν Δαυιδ τοῦ πιεῖν αὐτὸ καὶ ἔσπεισεν αὐτὸ τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: saying: God forbid that I should do this in the sight of my God , and should drink the blood of these men : for with the danger of their lives they have brought me the water. And therefore he would not drink. These things did the three most valiant .
text_la: dicens : Absit ut in conspectu Dei mei hoc faciam, et sanguinem istorum virorum bibam : quia in periculo animarum suarum attulerunt mihi aquam. Et ob hanc causam noluit bibere : hæc fecerunt tres robustissimi.
text_pt: E disse: Nunca meu Deus permita que faça tal! Beberia eu o sangue destes homens com as suas vidas? Pois com perigo das suas vidas a trouxeram. E ele não a quis beber. Isto fizeram aqueles três homens.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἵλεώς μοι ὁ θεὸς τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο εἰ αἷμα ἀνδρῶν τούτων πίομαι ἐν ψυχαῖς αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐν ψυχαῖς αὐτῶν ἤνεγκαν αὐτό καὶ οὐκ ἐβούλετο πιεῖν αὐτό ταῦτα ἐποίησαν οἱ τρεῖς δυνατοί

text_en: And Abisai the brother of Joab , he was chief of three, and he lifted up his spear against three hundred whom he slew, and he was renowned among the three,
text_la: Abisai quoque frater Joab ipse erat princeps trium, et ipse levavit hastam suam contra trecentos vulneratos, et ipse erat inter tres nominatissimus,
text_pt: E também Abisai, irmão de Joabe, era chefe de três, o qual, brandindo a sua lança contra trezentos, os feriu; e teve nome entre os três.
text_el: καὶ Αβεσσα ἀδελφὸς Ιωαβ οὗτος ἦν ἄρχων τῶν τριῶν οὗτος ἐσπάσατο τὴν ῥομφαίαν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τριακοσίους τραυματίας ἐν καιρῷ ἑνί καὶ οὗτος ἦν ὀνομαστὸς ἐν τοῖς τρισίν

text_en: and illustrious among the second three, and their captain : but yet he attained not to the first three.
text_la: et inter tres secundos inclytus, et princeps eorum : verumtamen usque ad tres primos non pervenerat.
text_pt: Ele foi o mais ilustre dos três, pelo que foi capitão deles; porém não igualou aos primeiros três.
text_el: ἀπὸ τῶν τριῶν ὑπὲρ τοὺς δύο ἔνδοξος καὶ ἦν αὐτοῖς εἰς ἄρχοντα καὶ ἕως τῶν τριῶν οὐκ ἤρχετο

text_en: Banaias the son of Joiada a most valiant man , of Cabseel, who had done many acts: he slew the two ariels of Moab : and he went down, and killed a lion in the midst of a pit in the time of snow.
text_la: Banaias filius Jojadæ viri robustissimi, qui multa opera perpetrarat, de Cabseel : ipse percussit duos ariel Moab, et ipse descendit et interfecit leonem in media cisterna tempore nivis.
text_pt: Também Benaia, filho de Joiada, filho de um homem poderoso de Cabzeel, grande em obras; ele feriu a dois heróis de Moabe; e também desceu, e feriu um leão dentro de uma cova, no tempo da neve.
text_el: καὶ Βαναιας υἱὸς Ιωδαε υἱὸς ἀνδρὸς δυνατοῦ πολλὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ὑπὲρ Καβασαηλ οὗτος ἐπάταξεν τοὺς δύο αριηλ Μωαβ καὶ οὗτος κατέβη καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν λέοντα ἐν τῷ λάκκῳ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ χιόνος

text_en: And he slew an Egyptian , whose stature was of five cubits, and who had a spear like a weaver's beam: and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked away the spear, that he held in his hand, and slew him with his own spear.
text_la: Et ipse percussit virum ægyptium, cujus statura erat quinque cubitorum, et habebat lanceam ut liciatorium texentium : descendit igitur ad eum cum virga, et rapuit hastam quam tenebat manu, et interfecit eum hasta sua.
text_pt: Também feriu ele a um homem egípcio, homem de grande altura, de cinco côvados; e trazia o egípcio uma lança na mão, como o órgão do tecelão; mas Benaia desceu contra ele com uma vara, e arrancou a lança da mão do egípcio, e com ela o matou.
text_el: καὶ οὗτος ἐπάταξεν τὸν ἄνδρα τὸν Αἰγύπτιον ἄνδρα ὁρατὸν πεντάπηχυν καὶ ἐν χειρὶ τοῦ Αἰγυπτίου δόρυ ὡς ἀντίον ὑφαινόντων καὶ κατέβη ἐπ' αὐτὸν Βαναιας ἐν ῥάβδῳ καὶ ἀφείλατο ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ Αἰγυπτίου τὸ δόρυ καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ δόρατι αὐτοῦ

text_en: These things did Banaias the son of Joiada , who was renowned among the three valiant ones,
text_la: Hæc fecit Banaias filius Jojadæ, qui erat inter tres robustos nominatissimus,
text_pt: Estas coisas fez Benaia, filho de Joiada; pelo que teve nome entre aqueles três poderosos.
text_el: ταῦτα ἐποίησεν Βαναιας υἱὸς Ιωδαε καὶ τούτῳ ὄνομα ἐν τοῖς τρισὶν τοῖς δυνατοῖς

text_en: and the first among the thirty, but yet to the three he attained not: and David made him of his council.
text_la: inter triginta primus, verumtamen ad tres usque non pervenerat : posuit autem eum David ad auriculam suam.
text_pt: Eis que dos trinta foi ele o mais ilustre; contudo não chegou aos primeiros três; e Davi o pôs sobre os da sua guarda.
text_el: ὑπὲρ τοὺς τριάκοντα ἔνδοξος οὗτος καὶ πρὸς τοὺς τρεῖς οὐκ ἤρχετο καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτὸν Δαυιδ ἐπὶ τὴν πατριὰν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Moreover the most valiant men of the army, were Asahel brother of Joab, and Elchanan the son of his uncle of Bethlehem,
text_la: Porro fortissimi viri in exercitu, Asahel frater Joab, et Elchanan filius patrui ejus de Bethlehem,
text_pt: E foram os poderosos dos exércitos: Asael, irmão de Joabe, El-Hanã, filho de Dodó, de Belém;
text_el: καὶ δυνατοὶ τῶν δυνάμεων Ασαηλ ἀδελφὸς Ιωαβ Ελεαναν υἱὸς Δωδω ἐκ Βαιθλαεμ

text_en: Sammoth an Arorite, Helles a Phalonite,
text_la: Sammoth Arorites, Helles Pharonites,
text_pt: Samote, o harorita; Helez, o pelonita;
text_el: Σαμμωθ ὁ Αδι Χελλης ὁ Φελωνι

text_en: Ira the son of Acces a Thecuite, Abiezer an Anathothite ,
text_la: Ira filius Acces Thecuites, Abiezer Anathothites,
text_pt: Ira, filho de Iques, o tecoíta; Abiezer, o anatotita;
text_el: Ωραι υἱὸς Εκκης ὁ Θεκωι Αβιεζερ ὁ Αναθωθι

text_en: Sobbochai a Husathite, Ilai an Ahohite,
text_la: Sobbochai Husathites, Ilai Ahohites,
text_pt: Sibecai, o husatita; Ilai, o aoíta;
text_el: Σοβοχαι ὁ Ασωθι Ηλι ὁ Αχωι

text_en: Maharai a Netophathite, Heled the son of Baana a Netophathite,
text_la: Maharai Netophathites, Heled filius Baana Netophathites,
text_pt: Maarai, o netofatita; Helede, filho de Baaná, o netofatita;
text_el: Μοοραι ὁ Νετωφαθι Χολοδ υἱὸς Νοοζα ὁ Νετωφαθι

text_en: Ethai the son of Ribai of Gabaath of the sons of Benjamin , Banai a Pharathonite,
text_la: Ethai filius Ribai de Gabaath filiorum Benjamin, Banaia Pharatonites,
text_pt: Itai, filho de Ribai, de Gileade, dos filhos de Benjamim; Benaia, o piratonita;
text_el: Αιθι υἱὸς Ριβαι ἐκ βουνοῦ Βενιαμιν Βαναιας ὁ Φαραθωνι

text_en: Hurai of the torrent Gaas, Abiel an Arbathite, Azmoth a Bauramite, Eliaba a Salabonite,
text_la: Hurai de torrente Gaas, Abiel Arbathites, Azmoth Bauramites, Eliaba Salabonites.
text_pt: Hurai, do ribeiro de Gaás; Abiel, o arbatita;
text_el: Ουρι ἐκ Ναχαλιγαας Αβιηλ ὁ Γαραβεθθι

text_en: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
text_pt: Azmavete, o baarumita; Eliabe, o saalbonita;
text_el: Αζμωθ ὁ Βεερμι Ελιαβα ὁ Σαλαβωνι

text_en: The sons of Assem a Gezonite, Jonathan the son of Sage an Ararite,
text_la: Filii Assem Gezonites, Jonathan filius Sage Ararites,
text_pt: Dos filhos de Hasém, o gizonita: Jônatas, filho de Sage, o hararita;
text_el: Βενναιας Οσομ ὁ Γεννουνι Ιωναθαν υἱὸς Σωλα ὁ Αραρι

text_en: Ahiam the son of Sachar an Ararite,
text_la: Ahiam filius Sachar Ararites,
text_pt: Aião, filho de Sacar, o hararita; Elifal, filho de Ur;
text_el: Αχιμ υἱὸς Σαχαρ ὁ Αραρι Ελφαλ υἱὸς Ουρ

text_en: Eliphal the son of Ur,
text_la: Eliphal filius Ur,
text_pt: Hefer, o mequeratita; Aías, o pelonita;
text_el: Οφαρ ὁ Μοχοραθι Αχια ὁ Φελωνι

text_en: Hepher a Mecherathite, Ahia a Phelonite,
text_la: Hepher Mecherathites, Ahia Phelonites,
text_pt: Hezro, o carmelita; Naarai, filho de Ezbai;
text_el: Ησεραι ὁ Χαρμαλι Νααραι υἱὸς Αζωβαι

text_en: Hesro a Carmelite, Naarai the son of Azbai,
text_la: Hesro Carmelites, Naarai filius Asbai,
text_pt: Joel, irmão de Natã; Mibar, filho de Hagri;
text_el: Ιωηλ ἀδελφὸς Ναθαν Μεβααρ υἱὸς Αγαρι

text_en: Joel the brother of Nathan , Mibahar the son of Agarai.
text_la: Joël frater Nathan, Mibahar filius Agarai,
text_pt: Zeleque, o amonita; Naarai, o beerotita, escudeiro de Joabe, filho de Zeruia;
text_el: Σεληκ ὁ Αμμωνι Ναχωρ ὁ Βερθι αἴρων σκεύη Ιωαβ υἱοῦ Σαρουια

text_en: Selec an Ammonite , Naharai a Berothite , the armourbearer of Joab the son of Sarvia.
text_la: Selec Ammonites, Naharai Berothites armiger Joab filii Sarviæ,
text_pt: Ira, o itrita; Garebe, o itrita;
text_el: Ιρα ὁ Ιεθηρι Γαρηβ ὁ Ιεθηρι

text_en: Ira a Jethrite, Gareb a Jethrite,
text_la: Ira Jethræus, Gareb Jethræus,
text_pt: Urias, o heteu; Zabade, filho de Alai;
text_el: Ουριας ὁ Χεττι Ζαβετ υἱὸς Αχλια

text_en: Urias a Hethite , Zabad the son of Oholi,
text_la: Urias Hethæus, Zabad filius Oholi,
text_pt: Adina, filho de Siza, o rubenita, capitão dos rubenitas, e com ele trinta;
text_el: Αδινα υἱὸς Σαιζα τοῦ Ρουβην ἄρχων καὶ ἐπ' αὐτῷ τριάκοντα

text_en: Adina the son of Siza a Rubenite the prince of the Rubenites , and thirty with him:
text_la: Adina filius Siza Rubenites princeps Rubenitarum, et cum eo triginta:
text_pt: Hanã, filho de Maaca; e Josafá, o mitatita;
text_el: Αναν υἱὸς Μοωχα καὶ Ιωσαφατ ὁ Βαιθανι

text_en: Hanan the son of Maacha, and Josaphat a Mathanite,
text_la: Hanan filius Maacha, et Josaphat Mathanites,
text_pt: Uzias, o asteratita; Sama e Jeiel, filhos de Hotão, o aroerita;
text_el: Οζια ὁ Ασταρωθι Σαμμα καὶ Ιιηλ υἱοὶ Χωθαν τοῦ Αραρι

text_en: Ozia an Astarothite, Samma, and Jehiel the sons of Hotham an Arorite,
text_la: Ozia Astarothites, Samma, et Jehiel filii Hotham Arorites,
text_pt: Jediael, filho de Sinri; e Joa, seu irmão, o tizita;
text_el: Ιεδιηλ υἱὸς Σαμερι καὶ Ιωαζαε ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ὁ Ιεασι

text_en: Jedihel the son of Zamri, and Joha his brother a Thosaite,
text_la: Jedihel filius Samri, et Joha frater ejus Thosaites,
text_pt: Eliel, o maavita; e Jeribai e Josavias, filhos de Elnaão; e Itma, o moabita;
text_el: Ελιηλ ὁ Μιι καὶ Ιαριβι καὶ Ιωσια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ Ελνααμ καὶ Ιεθεμα ὁ Μωαβίτης

text_en: Eliel a Mahumite, and Jeribai, and Josaia the sons of Elnaim, and Jethma a Moabite , Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel of Masobia.
text_la: Eliel Mahumites, et Jeribai, et Josaia filii Elnaëm, et Jethma Moabites, Eliel, et Obed, et Jasiel de Masobia.
text_pt: Eliel, Obede, e Jaasiel, o mesobaíta.
text_el: Αλιηλ καὶ Ωβηδ καὶ Ιεσιηλ ὁ Μισαβια

text_en: Now these are they that came to David to Siceleg, while he yet fled from Saul the son of Cis, and they were most valiant and excellent warriors,
text_la: Hi quoque venerunt ad David in Siceleg, cum adhuc fugeret Saul filium Cis, qui erant fortissimi et egregii pugnatores,
text_pt: Estes, porém, são os que vieram a Davi, a Ziclague, estando ele ainda escondido, por causa de Saul, filho de Quis; e eram dos valentes que o ajudaram na guerra.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἐλθόντες πρὸς Δαυιδ εἰς Σωκλαγ ἔτι συνεχομένου ἀπὸ προσώπου Σαουλ υἱοῦ Κις καὶ οὗτοι ἐν τοῖς δυνατοῖς βοηθοῦντες ἐν πολέμῳ

text_en: bending the bow, and using either hand in hurling stones with slings, and shooting arrows: of the brethren of Saul of Benjamin .
text_la: tendentes arcum, et utraque manu fundis saxa jacientes, et dirigentes sagittas, de fratribus Saul ex Benjamin.
text_pt: Estavam armados de arco, e usavam tanto da mão direita como da esquerda em atirar pedras e em atirar flechas com o arco; eram dos irmãos de Saul, benjamitas.
text_el: καὶ τόξῳ ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ ἐξ ἀριστερῶν καὶ σφενδονῆται ἐν λίθοις καὶ τόξοις ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν Σαουλ ἐκ Βενιαμιν

text_en: The chief was Ahiezer, and Joas, the sons of Samoa of Gabaath, and Jaziel, and Phallet the sons of Azmoth, and Beracha, and Jehu an Anathothite .
text_la: Princeps Ahiecer, et Joas filii Samaa Gabaathites, et Jaziel, et Phallet filii Azmoth, et Baracha, et Jehu Anathotites.
text_pt: Aiezer, o chefe, e Joás, filho de Semaa, o gibeatita, e Jeziel e Pelete, filhos de Azmavete; e Beraca, e Jeú, o anatotita,
text_el: ὁ ἄρχων Αχιεζερ καὶ Ιωας υἱὸς Ασμα τοῦ Γεβωθίτου καὶ Ιωηλ καὶ Ιωφαλητ υἱοὶ Ασμωθ καὶ Βερχια καὶ Ιηουλ ὁ Αναθωθι

text_en: And Samaias of Gabaon, the stoutest amongst the thirty and over the thirty;
text_la: Samaias quoque Gabaonites fortissimus inter triginta et super triginta.
text_pt: E Ismaías, o gibeonita, valente entre os trinta, líder deles; e Jeremias, e Jaaziel, e Joanã, e Jozabade, o gederatita,
text_el: καὶ Σαμαιας ὁ Γαβαωνίτης δυνατὸς ἐν τοῖς τριάκοντα καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν τριάκοντα

text_en: Jeremiah , and Jeheziel and Johanan, and Jozabad of Gaderoth;
text_la: Jeremias, et Jeheziel, et Johanan, et Jezabad Gaderothites.
text_pt: Eluzai, e Jerimote, e Bealias, e Samarias, e Sefatias, o harufita,
text_el: Ιερμιας καὶ Ιεζιηλ καὶ Ιωαναν καὶ Ιωζαβαδ ὁ Γαδαραθι

text_en: and Eluzai, and Jerimuth, and Baalia, and Samaria , and Saphatia the Haruphite;
text_la: Et Eluzai, et Jerimuth, et Baalia, et Samaria, et Saphatia Haruphites.
text_pt: Elcana, Issias, Azarel, Joezer, e Jasobeão, os coraítas,
text_el: Ελιαζαι καὶ Ιαριμουθ καὶ Βααλια καὶ Σαμαρια καὶ Σαφατια ὁ Χαραιφι

text_en: Elcana, and Jesia, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jesbaam of Carehim:
text_la: Elcana, et Jesia, et Azareel, et Joëzer, et Jesbaam de Carehim:
text_pt: E Joela, e Zabadias, filhos de Jeroão de Gedor.
text_el: Ηλκανα καὶ Ιησουνι καὶ Οζριηλ καὶ Ιωαζαρ καὶ Ιεσβοαμ οἱ Κορῖται

text_en: And Joela, and Zabadia the sons of Jeroham of Gedor .
text_la: Joëla quoque, et Zabadia filii Jeroham de Gedor.
text_pt: E dos gaditas se desertaram para Davi, ao lugar forte no deserto, valentes, homens de guerra para pelejar, armados com escudo e lança; e seus rostos eram como rostos de leões, e ligeiros como corças sobre os montes:
text_el: καὶ Ελια καὶ Ζαβαδια υἱοὶ Ιρααμ υἱοὶ τοῦ γεδωρ

text_en: From Gaddi also there went over to David , when he lay hid in the wilderness most valiant men , and excellent warriors, holding shield and spear: whose faces were like the faces of a lion, and they were swift like the roebucks on the mountains.
text_la: Sed et de Gaddi transfugerunt ad David cum lateret in deserto, viri robustissimi, et pugnatores optimi, tenentes clypeum et hastam : facies eorum quasi facies leonis, et veloces quasi capreæ in montibus:
text_pt: Ezer, o primeiro; Obadias, o segundo; Eliabe, o terceiro;
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ Γαδδι ἐχωρίσθησαν πρὸς Δαυιδ ἀπὸ τῆς ἐρήμου ἰσχυροὶ δυνατοὶ ἄνδρες παρατάξεως πολέμου αἴροντες θυρεοὺς καὶ δόρατα καὶ πρόσωπον λέοντος πρόσωπα αὐτῶν καὶ κοῦφοι ὡς δορκάδες ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων τῷ τάχει

text_en: Ezer the chief, Obdias the second, Eliab the third,
text_la: Ezer princeps, Obdias secundus, Eliab tertius,
text_pt: Mismana, o quarto; Jeremias, o quinto;
text_el: Αζερ ὁ ἄρχων Αβδια ὁ δεύτερος Ελιαβ ὁ τρίτος

text_en: Masmana the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
text_la: Masmana quartus, Jeremias quintus,
text_pt: Atai, o sexto; Eliel, o sétimo;
text_el: Μασεμαννη ὁ τέταρτος Ιερμια ὁ πέμπτος

text_en: Ethi the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
text_la: Ethi sextus, Eliel septimus,
text_pt: Joanã, o oitavo; Elzabade, o nono;
text_el: Εθθι ὁ ἕκτος Ελιαβ ὁ ἕβδομος

text_en: Johanan the eighth, Elzebad the ninth,
text_la: Johanan octavus, Elzebad nonus,
text_pt: Jeremias, o décimo; Macbanai, o undécimo;
text_el: Ιωαναν ὁ ὄγδοος Ελιαζερ ὁ ἔνατος

text_en: Jerenias the tenth, Machbani the eleventh,
text_la: Jeremias decimus, Machbanai undecimus.
text_pt: Estes, dos filhos de Gade, foram os capitães do exército; o menor tinha o encargo de cem homens e o maior de mil.
text_el: Ιερμια ὁ δέκατος Μαχαβανναι ὁ ἑνδέκατος

text_en: these were of the sons of Gad , captains of the army: the least of them was captain over a hundred soldiers, and the greatest over a thousand.
text_la: Hi de filiis Gad principes exercitus : novissimus centum militibus præerat, et maximus mille.
text_pt: Estes são os que passaram o Jordão no primeiro mês, quando ele transbordava por todas as suas ribanceiras, e fizeram fugir a todos os dos vales ao oriente e ao ocidente.
text_el: οὗτοι ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Γαδ ἄρχοντες τῆς στρατιᾶς εἷς τοῖς ἑκατὸν μικρὸς καὶ μέγας τοῖς χιλίοις

text_en: These are they who passed over the Jordan in the first month, when it is used to flow over its banks: and they put to flight all that dwelt in the valleys both toward the east and toward the west.
text_la: Isti sunt qui transierunt Jordanem mense primo, quando inundare consuevit super ripas suas : et omnes fugaverunt qui morabantur in vallibus ad orientalem plagam et occidentalem.
text_pt: Também alguns dos filhos de Benjamim e de Judá vieram a Davi, ao lugar forte.
text_el: οὗτοι οἱ διαβάντες τὸν Ιορδάνην ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πρώτῳ καὶ οὗτος πεπληρωκὼς ἐπὶ πᾶσαν κρηπῖδα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξεδίωξαν πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας αὐλῶνας ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν ἕως δυσμῶν

text_en: And there came also of the men of Benjamin , and of Juda to the hold, in which David abode.
text_la: Venerunt autem et de Benjamin et de Juda ad præsidium in quo morabatur David.
text_pt: E Davi lhes saiu ao encontro, e lhes falou, dizendo: Se vós vindes a mim pacificamente e para me ajudar, o meu coração se unirá convosco; porém, se é para me entregar aos meus inimigos, sem que haja deslealdade nas minhas mãos, o Deus de nossos pais o veja e o repreenda.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Βενιαμιν καὶ Ιουδα εἰς βοήθειαν τοῦ Δαυιδ

text_en: And David went out to meet them, and said: If you have come peaceably to me to help me, let my heart be joined to you: but if you plot against me for my enemies whereas I have no iniquity in my hands, let the God of our fathers see, and judge.
text_la: Egressusque est David obviam eis, et ait : Si pacifice venistis ad me ut auxiliemini mihi, cor meum jungatur vobis : si autem insidiamini mihi pro adversariis meis, cum ego iniquitatem in manibus non habeam, videat Deus patrum nostrorum, et judicet.
text_pt: Então veio o espírito sobre Amasai, chefe de trinta, e disse: Nós somos teus, ó Davi, e contigo estamos, ó filho de Jessé! Paz, paz contigo, e paz com quem te ajuda, pois que teu Deus te ajuda. E Davi os recebeu, e os fez capitães das tropas.
text_el: καὶ Δαυιδ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτῶν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς εἰ εἰς εἰρήνην ἥκατε πρός με εἴη μοι καρδία καθ' ἑαυτὴν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς καὶ εἰ τοῦ παραδοῦναί με τοῖς ἐχθροῖς μου οὐκ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ χειρός ἴδοι ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν καὶ ἐλέγξαιτο

text_en: But the spirit came upon Amasai the chief among thirty, and he said: We are yours, O David , and for you, O son of Isai: peace, peace be to you, and peace to your helpers. For your God helps you. So David received them, and made them captains of the band.
text_la: Spiritus vero induit Amasai principem inter triginta, et ait : Tui sumus, o David, et tecum, fili Isai. Pax, pax tibi, et pax adjutoribus tuis : te enim adjuvat Deus tuus. Suscepit ergo eos David, et constituit principes turmæ.
text_pt: Também de Manassés alguns passaram para Davi, quando veio com os filisteus para a batalha contra Saul; todavia Davi não os ajudou, porque os príncipes dos filisteus, tendo feito conselho, o despediram, dizendo: À custa de nossas cabeças passará a Saul, seu senhor.
text_el: καὶ πνεῦμα ἐνέδυσε τὸν Αμασαι ἄρχοντα τῶν τριάκοντα καὶ εἶπεν πορεύου καὶ ὁ λαός σου Δαυιδ υἱὸς Ιεσσαι εἰρήνη εἰρήνη σοι καὶ εἰρήνη τοῖς βοηθοῖς σου ὅτι ἐβοήθησέν σοι ὁ θεός σου καὶ προσεδέξατο αὐτοὺς Δαυιδ καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτοὺς ἄρχοντας τῶν δυνάμεων

text_en: And there were some of Manasses that went over to David , when he came with the Philistines against Saul to fight: but he did not fight with them: because the lords of the Philistines taking counsel sent him back, saying: With the danger of our heads he will return to his master Saul .
text_la: Porro de Manasse transfugerunt ad David, quando veniebat cum Philisthiim adversus Saul ut pugnaret : et non dimicavit cum eis, quia inito consilio remiserunt eum principes Philisthinorum, dicentes : Periculo capitis nostri revertetur ad dominum suum Saul.
text_pt: Voltando ele, pois, a Ziclague, passaram-se para ele, de Manassés, Adna, Jozabade, Jediael, Micael, Jozabade, Eliú, e Ziletai, capitães de milhares dos de Manassés.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ Μανασση προσεχώρησαν πρὸς Δαυιδ ἐν τῷ ἐλθεῖν τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους ἐπὶ Σαουλ εἰς πόλεμον καὶ οὐκ ἐβοήθησεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἐν βουλῇ ἐγένετο παρὰ τῶν στρατηγῶν τῶν ἀλλοφύλων λεγόντων ἐν ταῖς κεφαλαῖς τῶν ἀνδρῶν ἐκείνων ἐπιστρέψει πρὸς τὸν κύριον αὐτοῦ Σαουλ

text_en: So when he went back to Siceleg, there fled to him of Manasses , Ednas and Jozabad, and Jedihel, and Michael, and Ednas, and Jozabad, and Eliu, and Salathi, captains of thousands in Manasses .
text_la: Quando igitur reversus est in Siceleg, transfugerunt ad eum de Manasse, Ednas, et Jozabad, et Jedihel, et Michaël, et Ednas, et Jozabad, et Eliu, et Salathi, principes millium in Manasse.
text_pt: E estes ajudaram a Davi contra aquela tropa, porque todos eles eram heróis poderosos, e foram capitães no exército.
text_el: ἐν τῷ πορευθῆναι αὐτὸν εἰς Σωκλαγ προσεχώρησαν αὐτῷ ἀπὸ Μανασση Εδνα καὶ Ιωζαβαθ καὶ Ιωδιηλ καὶ Μιχαηλ καὶ Ιωσαβεθ καὶ Ελιμουθ καὶ Σελαθι ἀρχηγοὶ χιλιάδων εἰσὶν τοῦ Μανασση

text_en: These helped David against the rovers: for they were all most valiant men , and were made commanders in the army.
text_la: Hi præbuerunt auxilium David adversus latrunculos : omnes enim erant viri fortissimi, et facti sunt principes in exercitu.
text_pt: Porque naquele tempo, dia após dia, vinham a Davi para o ajudar, até que se fez um grande exército, como o exército de Deus.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ συνεμάχησαν τῷ Δαυιδ ἐπὶ τὸν γεδδουρ ὅτι δυνατοὶ ἰσχύος πάντες καὶ ἦσαν ἡγούμενοι ἐν τῇ στρατιᾷ ἐν τῇ δυνάμει

text_en: Moreover day by day there came some to David to help him till they became a great number, like the army of God .
text_la: Sed et per singulos dies veniebant ad David ad auxiliandum ei, usque dum fieret grandis numerus, quasi exercitus Dei.
text_pt: Ora este é o número dos chefes armados para a peleja, que vieram a Davi em Hebrom, para transferir a ele o reino de Saul, conforme a palavra do Senhor.
text_el: ὅτι ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας ἤρχοντο πρὸς Δαυιδ εἰς δύναμιν μεγάλην ὡς δύναμις θεοῦ

text_en: And this is the number of the chiefs of the army who came to David , when he was in Hebron , to transfer to him the kingdom of Saul , according to the word of the Lord .
text_la: Iste quoque est numerus principum exercitus qui venerunt ad David cum esset in Hebron, ut transferrent regnum Saul ad eum, juxta verbum Domini.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Judá, que traziam escudo e lança, seis mil e oitocentos, armados para a peleja;
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν ἀρχόντων τῆς στρατιᾶς οἱ ἐλθόντες πρὸς Δαυιδ εἰς Χεβρων τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι τὴν βασιλείαν Σαουλ πρὸς αὐτὸν κατὰ τὸν λόγον κυρίου

text_en: The sons of Juda bearing shield and spear, six thousand eight hundred well appointed to war .
text_la: Filii Juda portantes clypeum et hastam, sex millia octingenti expediti ad prælium.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Simeão, homens poderosos para pelejar, sete mil e cem;
text_el: υἱοὶ Ιουδα θυρεοφόροι καὶ δορατοφόροι ἓξ χιλιάδες καὶ ὀκτακόσιοι δυνατοὶ παρατάξεως

text_en: Of the sons of Simeon valiant men for war , seven thousand one hundred.
text_la: De filiis Simeon virorum fortissimorum ad pugnandum, septem millia centum.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Levi, quatro mil e seiscentos.
text_el: τῶν υἱῶν Συμεων δυνατοὶ ἰσχύος εἰς παράταξιν ἑπτὰ χιλιάδες καὶ ἑκατόν

text_en: Of the sons of Levi , four thousand six hundred.
text_la: De filiis Levi, quatuor millia sexcenti.
text_pt: Joiada, que era o líder dos de Arão, e com ele três mil e setecentos.
text_el: τῶν υἱῶν Λευι τετρακισχίλιοι ἑξακόσιοι

text_en: And Joiada prince of the race of Aaron , and with him three thousand seven hundred.
text_la: Jojoda quoque princeps de stirpe Aaron, et cum eo tria millia septingenti.
text_pt: E Zadoque, sendo ainda jovem, homem poderoso, com vinte e dois capitães da família de seu pai;
text_el: καὶ Ιωαδαε ὁ ἡγούμενος τῷ Ααρων καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ τρεῖς χιλιάδες καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι

text_en: Sadoc also a young man of excellent disposition, and the house of his father, twenty-two principal men .
text_la: Sadoc etiam puer egregiæ indolis, et domus patris ejus, principes viginti duo.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Benjamim, irmãos de Saul, três mil; porque até então havia ainda muitos deles que eram pela casa de Saul.
text_el: καὶ Σαδωκ νέος δυνατὸς ἰσχύι καὶ τῆς πατρικῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ ἄρχοντες εἴκοσι δύο

text_en: And of the sons of Benjamin the brethren of Saul , three thousand: for hitherto a great part of them followed the house of Saul .
text_la: De filiis autem Benjamin fratribus Saul, tria millia : magna enim pars eorum adhuc sequebatur domum Saul.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Efraim, vinte mil e oitocentos homens poderosos, homens de nome nas casas de seus pais.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Βενιαμιν τῶν ἀδελφῶν Σαουλ τρεῖς χιλιάδες καὶ ἔτι τὸ πλεῖστον αὐτῶν ἀπεσκόπει τὴν φυλακὴν οἴκου Σαουλ

text_en: And of the sons of Ephraim twenty thousand eight hundred, men of great valour renowned in their kindreds.
text_la: Porro de filiis Ephraim viginti millia octingenti, fortissimi robore, viri nominati in cognationibus suis.
text_pt: E da meia tribo de Manassés, dezoito mil, que foram apontados pelos seus nomes para virem fazer rei a Davi.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Εφραιμ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες καὶ ὀκτακόσιοι δυνατοὶ ἰσχύι ἄνδρες ὀνομαστοὶ κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And of the half tribe of Manasses , eighteen thousand, every one by their names , came to make David king.
text_la: Et ex dimidia tribu Manasse, decem et octo millia, singuli per nomina sua, venerunt ut constituerent regem David.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Issacar, duzentos de seus chefes, destros na ciência dos tempos, para saberem o que Israel devia fazer, e todos os seus irmãos seguiam suas ordens.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασση δέκα ὀκτὼ χιλιάδες οἳ ὠνομάσθησαν ἐν ὀνόματι τοῦ βασιλεῦσαι τὸν Δαυιδ

text_en: Also of the sons of Issachar men of understanding, that knew all times to order what Israel should do, two hundred principal men : and all the rest of the tribe followed their counsel.
text_la: De filiis quoque Issachar viri eruditi, qui noverant singula tempora ad præcipiendum quid facere deberet Israël, principes ducenti : omnis autem reliqua tribus eorum consilium sequebatur.
text_pt: De Zebulom, dos que podiam sair no exército, cinqüenta mil ordenados para a peleja com todas as armas de guerra; como também destros para ordenarem uma batalha, e não eram de coração dobre.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ισσαχαρ γινώσκοντες σύνεσιν εἰς τοὺς καιρούς γινώσκοντες τί ποιήσαι Ισραηλ εἰς τὰς ἀρχὰς αὐτῶν διακόσιοι καὶ πάντες ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν μετ' αὐτῶν

text_en: And of Zabulon such as went forth to battle, and stood in array well appointed with armour for war , there came fifty thousand to his aid, with no double heart.
text_la: Porro de Zabulon qui egrediebantur ad prælium, et stabant in acie instructi armis bellicis, quinquaginta millia venerunt in auxilium, non in corde duplici.
text_pt: E de Naftali, mil capitães, e com eles trinta e sete mil com escudo e lança.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ Ζαβουλων ἐκπορευόμενοι εἰς παράταξιν πολέμου ἐν πᾶσιν σκεύεσιν πολεμικοῖς πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες βοηθῆσαι τῷ Δαυιδ οὐχ ἑτεροκλινῶς

text_en: And of Nephtali , a thousand leaders: and with them seven and thirty thousand, furnished with shield and spear.
text_la: Et de Nephthali, principes mille, et cum eis instructi clypeo et hasta, triginta et septem millia.
text_pt: E dos danitas, ordenados para a peleja, vinte e oito mil e seiscentos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ Νεφθαλι ἄρχοντες χίλιοι καὶ μετ' αὐτῶν ἐν θυρεοῖς καὶ δόρασιν τριάκοντα ἑπτὰ χιλιάδες

text_en: Of Dan also twenty-eight thousand six hundred prepared for battle.
text_la: De Dan etiam præparati ad prælium, viginti octo millia sexcenti.
text_pt: E de Aser, dos que podiam sair no exército, para ordenarem a batalha, quarenta mil.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν Δανιτῶν παρατασσόμενοι εἰς πόλεμον εἴκοσι ὀκτὼ χιλιάδες καὶ ὀκτακόσιοι

text_en: And of Aser forty thousand going forth to fight, and challenging in battle.
text_la: Et de Aser egredientes ad pugnam, et in acie provocantes, quadraginta millia.
text_pt: E do outro lado do Jordão, dos rubenitas e gaditas, e da meia tribo de Manassés, com toda a sorte de instrumentos de guerra para pelejar, cento e vinte mil.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ Ασηρ ἐκπορευόμενοι βοηθῆσαι εἰς πόλεμον τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδες

text_en: And on the other side of the Jordan of the sons of Ruben , and of Gad , and of the half of the tribe of Manasses a hundred and twenty thousand, furnished with arms for war .
text_la: Trans Jordanem autem de filiis Ruben, et de Gad, et dimidia parte tribus Manasse, instructi armis bellicis, centum viginti millia.
text_pt: Todos estes homens de guerra, postos em ordem de batalha, vieram a Hebrom, com corações decididos, para constituírem a Davi rei sobre todo o Israel; e também todo o restante de Israel tinha o mesmo coração para constituir a Davi rei.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἀπὸ Ρουβην καὶ Γαδδι καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασση ἐν πᾶσιν σκεύεσιν πολεμικοῖς ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι χιλιάδες

text_en: All these men of war well appointed to fight, came with a perfect heart to Hebron , to make David king over all Israel : and all the rest also of Israel , were of one heart to make David king.
text_la: Omnes isti viri bellatores expediti ad pugnandum, corde perfecto venerunt in Hebron, ut constituerent regem David super universum Israël : sed et omnes reliqui ex Israël uno corde erant, ut rex fieret David.
text_pt: E estiveram ali com Davi três dias, comendo e bebendo; porque seus irmãos lhes tinham preparado as provisões.
text_el: πάντες οὗτοι ἄνδρες πολεμισταὶ παρατασσόμενοι παράταξιν ἐν ψυχῇ εἰρηνικῇ καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Χεβρων τοῦ βασιλεῦσαι τὸν Δαυιδ ἐπὶ πάντα Ισραηλ καὶ ὁ κατάλοιπος Ισραηλ ψυχὴ μία τοῦ βασιλεῦσαι τὸν Δαυιδ

text_en: And they were there with David three days eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
text_la: Fueruntque ibi apud David tribus diebus comedentes et bibentes : præparaverant enim eis fratres sui.
text_pt: E também seus vizinhos de mais perto, até Issacar, e Zebulom, e Naftali, trouxeram, sobre jumentos, e sobre camelos, e sobre mulos, e sobre bois, pão, provisões de farinha, pastas de figos e cachos de passas, e vinho, e azeite, e bois, gado miúdo em abundância; porque havia alegria em Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν ἐκεῖ ἡμέρας τρεῖς ἐσθίοντες καὶ πίνοντες ὅτι ἡτοίμασαν αὐτοῖς οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: Moreover they that were near them even as far as Issachar , and Zabulon , and Nephtali , brought loaves on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, to eat: meal, figs, raisins, wine, oil, and oxen, and sheep in abundance, for there was joy in Israel .
text_la: Sed et qui juxta eos erant, usque ad Issachar, et Zabulon, et Nephthali, afferebant panes in asinis, et camelis, et mulis, et bobus ad vescendum : farinam, palathas, uvam passam, vinum, oleum, boves, arietes ad omnem copiam : gaudium quippe erat in Israël.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ὁμοροῦντες αὐτοῖς ἕως Ισσαχαρ καὶ Ζαβουλων καὶ Νεφθαλι ἔφερον αὐτοῖς ἐπὶ τῶν καμήλων καὶ τῶν ὄνων καὶ τῶν ἡμιόνων καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν μόσχων βρώματα ἄλευρα παλάθας σταφίδας οἶνον καὶ ἔλαιον μόσχους καὶ πρόβατα εἰς πλῆθος ὅτι εὐφροσύνη ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: David consulted with the captains of thousands, and of hundreds , and with all the commanders.
text_la: Iniit autem consilium David cum tribunis, et centurionibus, et universis principibus,
text_pt: E Davi tomou conselho com os capitães dos milhares, e das centenas, e com todos os líderes.
text_el: καὶ ἐβουλεύσατο Δαυιδ μετὰ τῶν χιλιάρχων καὶ τῶν ἑκατοντάρχων παντὶ ἡγουμένῳ

text_en: And he said to all the assembly of Israel : If it please you; and if the words which I speak come from the Lord our God , let us send to the rest of our brethren into all the countries of Israel , and to the priests , and the Levites , that dwell in the suburbs of the cities, to gather themselves to us,
text_la: et ait ad omnem cœtum Israël : Si placet vobis, et a Domino Deo nostro egreditur sermo quem loquor, mittamus ad fratres nostros reliquos in universas regiones Israël, et ad sacerdotes et Levitas qui habitant in suburbanis urbium, ut congregentur ad nos,
text_pt: E disse Davi a toda a congregação de Israel: Se bem vos parece, e se isto vem do Senhor nosso Deus, enviemos depressa mensageiros a todos os nossos outros irmãos em todas as terras de Israel, e aos sacerdotes, e aos levitas nas suas cidades e nos seus arrabaldes, para que se reúnam conosco;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ τῇ πάσῃ ἐκκλησίᾳ Ισραηλ εἰ ἐφ' ὑμῖν ἀγαθὸν καὶ παρὰ κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν εὐοδωθῇ ἀποστείλωμεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ἡμῶν τοὺς ὑπολελειμμένους ἐν πάσῃ γῇ Ισραηλ καὶ μετ' αὐτῶν οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ Λευῖται ἐν πόλεσιν κατασχέσεως αὐτῶν καὶ συναχθήσονται πρὸς ἡμᾶς

text_en: and let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we sought it not in the days of Saul .
text_la: et reducamus arcam Dei nostri ad nos : non enim requisivimus eam in diebus Saul.
text_pt: E tornemos a trazer para nós a arca do nosso Deus; porque não a buscamos nos dias de Saul.
text_el: καὶ μετενέγκωμεν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν πρὸς ἡμᾶς ὅτι οὐκ ἐζήτησαν αὐτὴν ἀφ' ἡμερῶν Σαουλ

text_en: And all the multitude answered that it should be so: for the word pleased all the people.
text_la: Et respondit universa multitudo ut ita fieret : placuerat enim sermo omni populo.
text_pt: Então disse toda a congregação que se fizesse assim; porque este negócio pareceu reto aos olhos de todo o povo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν πᾶσα ἡ ἐκκλησία τοῦ ποιῆσαι οὕτως ὅτι εὐθὴς ὁ λόγος ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: So David assembled all Israel from Sihor of Egypt , even to the entering into Emath, to bring the ark of God from Cariathiarim.
text_la: Congregavit ergo David cunctum Israël, a Sihor Ægypti usque dum ingrediaris Emath, ut adduceret arcam Dei de Cariathiarim.
text_pt: Convocou, pois, Davi a todo o Israel desde Sior do Egito até chegar a Hamate; para trazer a arca de Deus de Quiriate-Jearim.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεκκλησίασεν Δαυιδ τὸν πάντα Ισραηλ ἀπὸ ὁρίων Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἕως εἰσόδου Ημαθ τοῦ εἰσενέγκαι τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκ πόλεως Ιαριμ

text_en: And David went up with all the men of Israel to the hill of Cariathiarim which is in Juda , to bring thence the ark of the Lord God sitting upon the cherubims , where his name is called upon.
text_la: Et ascendit David, et omnis vir Israël, ad collem Cariathiarim, qui est in Juda, ut afferret inde arcam Domini Dei sedentis super cherubim, ubi invocatum est nomen ejus.
text_pt: E então Davi com todo o Israel subiu a Baalá de Quiriate-Jearim, que está em Judá, para fazer subir dali a arca de Deus, o Senhor que habita entre os querubins, sobre a qual é invocado o seu nome.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήγαγεν αὐτὴν Δαυιδ καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ ἀνέβη εἰς πόλιν Δαυιδ ἣ ἦν τοῦ Ιουδα τοῦ ἀναγαγεῖν ἐκεῖθεν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ κυρίου καθημένου ἐπὶ χερουβιν οὗ ἐπεκλήθη ὄνομα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they carried the ark of God upon a new cart out of the house of Abinadab. And Oza and his brother drove the cart.
text_la: Imposueruntque arcam Dei super plaustrum novum, de domo Abinadab : Oza autem, et frater ejus minabant plaustrum.
text_pt: E levaram a arca de Deus, da casa de Abinadabe, sobre um carro novo; e Uzá e Aiô guiavam o carro.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέθηκαν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ἐπὶ ἅμαξαν καινὴν ἐξ οἴκου Αμιναδαβ καὶ Οζα καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἦγον τὴν ἅμαξαν

text_en: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might with hymns, and with harps, and with psalteries, and timbrels, and cymbals, and trumpets,
text_la: Porro David, et universus Israël, ludebant coram Deo omni virtute in canticis, et in citharis, et psalteriis, et tympanis, et cymbalis, et tubis.
text_pt: E Davi e todo o Israel, alegraram-se perante Deus com todas as suas forças; com cânticos, e com harpas, e com saltérios, e com tamborins, e com címbalos, e com trombetas.
text_el: καὶ Δαυιδ καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ παίζοντες ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει καὶ ἐν ψαλτῳδοῖς καὶ ἐν κινύραις καὶ ἐν νάβλαις ἐν τυμπάνοις καὶ ἐν κυμβάλοις καὶ ἐν σάλπιγξιν

text_en: and when they came to the floor of Chidon, Oza put forth his hand, to hold up the ark : for the ox being wanton had made it lean a little on one side.
text_la: Cum autem pervenisset ad aream Chidon, tetendit Oza manum suam, ut sustentaret arcam : bos quippe lasciviens paululum inclinaverat eam.
text_pt: E, chegando à eira de Quidom, estendeu Uzá a sua mão, para segurar a arca, porque os bois tropeçavam.
text_el: καὶ ἤλθοσαν ἕως τῆς ἅλωνος καὶ ἐξέτεινεν Οζα τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ τοῦ κατασχεῖν τὴν κιβωτόν ὅτι ἐξέκλινεν αὐτὴν ὁ μόσχος

text_en: And the Lord was angry with Oza, and struck him, because he had touched the ark ; and he died there before the Lord .
text_la: Iratus est itaque Dominus contra Ozam, et percussit eum, eo quod tetigisset arcam : et mortuus est ibi coram Domino.
text_pt: Então se acendeu a ira do Senhor contra Uzá, e o feriu, por ter estendido a sua mão à arca; e morreu ali perante Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐθυμώθη ὀργῇ κύριος ἐπὶ Οζα καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ διὰ τὸ ἐκτεῖναι τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν κιβωτόν καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐκεῖ ἀπέναντι τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And David was troubled because the Lord had divided Oza: and he called that place the Breach of Oza to this day.
text_la: Contristatusque est David, eo quod divisisset Dominus Ozam : vocavitque locum illum Divisio Ozæ, usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: E Davi se encheu de tristeza porque o Senhor havia aberto brecha em Uzá; pelo que chamou aquele lugar Perez-Uzá, até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἠθύμησεν Δαυιδ ὅτι διέκοψεν κύριος διακοπὴν ἐν Οζα καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸν τόπον ἐκεῖνον Διακοπὴ Οζα ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: And he feared God at that time, saying: How can I bring in the ark of God to me?
text_la: Et timuit Deum tunc temporis, dicens : Quomodo possum ad me introducere arcam Dei?
text_pt: E aquele dia temeu Davi a Deus, dizendo: Como trarei a mim a arca de Deus?
text_el: καὶ ἐφοβήθη Δαυιδ τὸν θεὸν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ λέγων πῶς εἰσοίσω πρὸς ἐμαυτὸν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And therefore he brought it not home to himself, that is, into the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gethite.
text_la: et ob hanc causam non adduxit eam ad se, hoc est, in civitatem David, sed avertit in domum Obededom Gethæi.
text_pt: Por isso Davi não trouxe a arca a si, à cidade de Davi; porém a fez levar à casa de Obede-Edom, o giteu.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀπέστρεψεν Δαυιδ τὴν κιβωτὸν πρὸς ἑαυτὸν εἰς πόλιν Δαυιδ καὶ ἐξέκλινεν αὐτὴν εἰς οἶκον Αβεδδαρα τοῦ Γεθθαίου

text_en: And the ark of God remained in the house of Obededom three months: and the Lord blessed his house, and all that he had.
text_la: Mansit ergo arca Dei in domo Obededom tribus mensibus : et benedixit Dominus domui ejus, et omnibus quæ habebat.
text_pt: Assim ficou a arca de Deus com a família de Obede-Edom, três meses em sua casa; e o Senhor abençoou a casa de Obede-Edom, e tudo quanto tinha.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἡ κιβωτὸς τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν οἴκῳ Αβεδδαρα τρεῖς μῆνας καὶ εὐλόγησεν ὁ θεὸς Αβεδδαραμ καὶ πάντα τὰ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David , and cedar trees , and masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.
text_la: Misit quoque Hiram rex Tyri nuntios ad David, et ligna cedrina, et artifices parietum, lignorumque, ut ædificarent ei domum.
text_pt: Então Hirão, rei de Tiro, mandou mensageiros a Davi, e madeira de cedro, e pedreiros, e carpinteiros, para lhe edificarem uma casa.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Χιραμ βασιλεὺς Τύρου ἀγγέλους πρὸς Δαυιδ καὶ ξύλα κέδρινα καὶ οἰκοδόμους τοίχων καὶ τέκτονας ξύλων τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι αὐτῷ οἶκον

text_en: And David perceived that the Lord had confirmed him king over Israel , and that his kingdom was exalted over his people Israel .
text_la: Cognovitque David quod confirmasset eum Dominus in regem super Israël, et sublevatum esset regnum suum super populum ejus Israël.
text_pt: E entendeu Davi que o Senhor o tinha confirmado rei sobre Israel; porque o seu reino tinha sido muito exaltado por amor do seu povo Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔγνω Δαυιδ ὅτι ἡτοίμησεν αὐτὸν κύριος ἐπὶ Ισραηλ ὅτι ηὐξήθη εἰς ὕψος ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ διὰ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And David took other wives in Jerusalem : and he begot sons, and daughters.
text_la: Accepit quoque David alias uxores in Jerusalem, genuitque filios et filias.
text_pt: E Davi tomou ainda mais mulheres em Jerusalém; e gerou Davi ainda mais filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Δαυιδ ἔτι γυναῖκας ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐτέχθησαν Δαυιδ ἔτι υἱοὶ καὶ θυγατέρες

text_en: Now these are the names of them that were born to him in Jerusalem : Samua, and Sobad, Nathan , and Solomon ,
text_la: Et hæc nomina eorum, qui nati sunt ei in Jerusalem : Samua, et Sobab, Nathan, et Salomon,
text_pt: E estes são os nomes dos filhos que teve em Jerusalém: Samua, Sobabe, Natã, Salomão,
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν τῶν τεχθέντων οἳ ἦσαν αὐτῷ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ Σαμαα Ισοβααμ Ναθαν Σαλωμων

text_en: Jebahar, and Elisua, and Eliphalet,
text_la: Jebahar, et Elisua, et Eliphalet,
text_pt: E Ibar, Elisua, Elpelete,
text_el: καὶ Ιβααρ καὶ Ελισαε καὶ Ελιφαλετ

text_en: and Noga, and Napheg, and Japhia,
text_la: Noga quoque, et Napheg, et Japhia,
text_pt: E Nogá, Nefegue, Jafia,
text_el: καὶ Ναγε καὶ Ναφαγ καὶ Ιανουου

text_en: Elisama, and Baaliada, and Eliphalet.
text_la: Elisama, et Baaliada, et Eliphalet.
text_pt: E Elisama, Eliada, e Elifelete.
text_el: καὶ Ελισαμαε καὶ Βαλεγδαε καὶ Ελιφαλετ

text_en: And the Philistines hearing that David was anointed king over all Israel , went all up to seek him: and David heard of it, and went out against them.
text_la: Audientes autem Philisthiim eo quod unctus esset David regem super universum Israël, ascenderunt omnes ut quærerent eum : quod cum audisset David, egressus est obviam eis.
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, os filisteus que Davi havia sido ungido rei sobre todo o Israel, todos os filisteus subiram em busca de Davi; o que ouvindo Davi, logo saiu contra eles.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν ἀλλόφυλοι ὅτι ἐχρίσθη Δαυιδ βασιλεὺς ἐπὶ πάντα Ισραηλ καὶ ἀνέβησαν πάντες οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι ζητῆσαι τὸν Δαυιδ καὶ ἤκουσεν Δαυιδ καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the vale of Raphaim.
text_la: Porro Philisthiim venientes, diffusi sunt in valle Raphaim.
text_pt: E vindo os filisteus, se estenderam pelo vale de Refaim.
text_el: καὶ ἀλλόφυλοι ἦλθον καὶ συνέπεσον ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι τῶν γιγάντων

text_en: And David consulted the Lord , saying: Shall I go up against the Philistines , and will you deliver them into my hand? And the Lord said to him: Go up, and I will deliver them into your hand.
text_la: Consuluitque David Dominum, dicens : Si ascendam ad Philisthæos, et si trades eos in manu mea? Et dixit ei Dominus : Ascende, et tradam eos in manu tua.
text_pt: Então consultou Davi a Deus, dizendo: Subirei contra os filisteus, e nas minhas mãos os entregarás? E o Senhor lhe disse: Sobe, porque os entregarei nas tuas mãos.
text_el: καὶ ἠρώτησεν Δαυιδ διὰ τοῦ θεοῦ λέγων εἰ ἀναβῶ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους καὶ δώσεις αὐτοὺς εἰς τὰς χεῖράς μου καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ κύριος ἀνάβηθι καὶ δώσω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου

text_en: And when they had come to Baalpharasim, David defeated them there, and he said: God has divided my enemies by my hand, as waters are divided: and therefore the name of that place was called Baalpharasim.
text_la: Cumque illi ascendissent in Baalpharasim, percussit eos ibi David, et dixit : Divisit Deus inimicos meos per manum meam, sicut dividuntur aquæ : et idcirco vocatum est nomen illius loci Baalpharasim.
text_pt: E, subindo a Baal-Perazim, Davi ali os feriu; e disse Davi: Por minha mão Deus derrotou a meus inimigos, como se rompem as águas. Pelo que chamaram aquele lugar, Baal-Perazim.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς Βααλφαρασιν καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ Δαυιδ καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ διέκοψεν ὁ θεὸς τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ἐν χειρί μου ὡς διακοπὴν ὕδατος διὰ τοῦτο ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου Διακοπὴ φαρασιν

text_en: And they left there their gods, and David commanded that they should be burnt.
text_la: Dereliqueruntque ibi deos suos, quos David jussit exuri.
text_pt: E deixaram ali seus deuses; e ordenou Davi que se queimassem a fogo;
text_el: καὶ ἐγκατέλιπον ἐκεῖ τοὺς θεοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ κατακαῦσαι αὐτοὺς ἐν πυρί

text_en: Another time also the Philistines made an irruption, and spread themselves abroad in the valley.
text_la: Alia etiam vice Philisthiim irruerunt, et diffusi sunt in valle.
text_pt: Porém os filisteus tornaram, e se estenderam pelo vale.
text_el: καὶ προσέθεντο ἔτι ἀλλόφυλοι καὶ συνέπεσαν ἔτι ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι τῶν γιγάντων

text_en: And David consulted God again, and God said to him: Go not up after them, turn away from them, and come upon them over against the pear trees.
text_la: Consuluitque rursum David Deum, et dixit ei Deus : Non ascendas post eos : recede ab eis, et venies contra illos ex adverso pyrorum.
text_pt: E tornou Davi a consultar a Deus; e disse-lhe Deus: Não subirás atrás deles; mas rodeia-os por detrás, e vem a eles por defronte das amoreiras;
text_el: καὶ ἠρώτησεν Δαυιδ ἔτι ἐν θεῷ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεός οὐ πορεύσῃ ὀπίσω αὐτῶν ἀποστρέφου ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ παρέσῃ αὐτοῖς πλησίον τῶν ἀπίων

text_en: And when you shall hear the sound of one going in the tops of the pear trees, then shall you go out to battle. For God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines .
text_la: Cumque audieris sonitum gradientis in cacumine pyrorum, tunc egredieris ad bellum : egressus est enim Deus ante te, ut percutiat castra Philisthiim.
text_pt: E há de ser que, ouvindo tu um ruído de marcha pelas copas das amoreiras, então sairás à peleja; porque Deus terá saído diante de ti, para ferir o exército dos filisteus.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῷ ἀκοῦσαί σε τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ συσσεισμοῦ τῶν ἄκρων τῶν ἀπίων τότε ἐξελεύσῃ εἰς τὸν πόλεμον ὅτι ἐξῆλθεν ὁ θεὸς ἔμπροσθέν σου τοῦ πατάξαι τὴν παρεμβολὴν τῶν ἀλλοφύλων

text_en: And David did as God had commanded him, and defeated the army of the Philistines , slaying them from Gabaon to Gazera.
text_la: Fecit ergo David sicut præceperat ei Deus, et percussit castra Philisthinorum, de Gabaon usque Gazera.
text_pt: E fez Davi como Deus lhe ordenara; e feriram o exército dos filisteus desde Gibeom até Gezer.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν καθὼς ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ ὁ θεός καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὴν παρεμβολὴν τῶν ἀλλοφύλων ἀπὸ Γαβαων ἕως Γαζαρα

text_en: And the name of David became famous in all countries, and the Lord made all nations fear aim.
text_la: Divulgatumque est nomen David in universis regionibus, et Dominus dedit pavorem ejus super omnes gentes.
text_pt: Assim se espalhou o nome de Davi por todas aquelas terras; e o Senhor pôs o temor dele sobre todas aquelas nações.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὄνομα Δαυιδ ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ καὶ κύριος ἔδωκεν τὸν φόβον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: He made also houses for himself in the city of David: and built a place for the ark of God , and pitched a tabernacle for it.
text_la: Fecit quoque sibi domos in civitate David : et ædificavit locum arcæ Dei, tetenditque ei tabernaculum.
text_pt: Davi também fez casa para si na cidade de Davi; e preparou um lugar para a arca de Deus, e armou-lhe uma tenda.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτῷ οἰκίας ἐν πόλει Δαυιδ καὶ ἡτοίμασεν τὸν τόπον τῇ κιβωτῷ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτῇ σκηνήν

text_en: Then David said: No one ought to carry the ark of God , but the Levites , whom the Lord has chosen to carry it, and to minister unto himself for ever.
text_la: Tunc dixit David : Illicitum est ut a quocumque portetur arca Dei nisi a Levitis, quos elegit Dominus ad portandum eam, et ad ministrandum sibi usque in æternum.
text_pt: Então disse Davi: Ninguém pode levar a arca de Deus, senão os levitas; porque o Senhor os escolheu, para levar a arca de Deus, e para o servirem eternamente.
text_el: τότε εἶπεν Δαυιδ οὐκ ἔστιν ἆραι τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ἀλλ' ἢ τοὺς Λευίτας ὅτι αὐτοὺς ἐξελέξατο κύριος αἴρειν τὴν κιβωτὸν κυρίου καὶ λειτουργεῖν αὐτῷ ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: And he gathered all Israel together into Jerusalem , that the ark of God might be brought into its place, which he had prepared for it.
text_la: Congregavitque universum Israël in Jerusalem, ut afferretur arca Dei in locum suum, quem præparaverat ei:
text_pt: E Davi convocou a todo o Israel em Jerusalém, para fazer subir a arca do Senhor ao seu lugar, que lhe tinha preparado.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεκκλησίασεν Δαυιδ τὸν πάντα Ισραηλ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ τοῦ ἀνενέγκαι τὴν κιβωτὸν κυρίου εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν ἡτοίμασεν αὐτῇ

text_en: And the sons of Aaron also, and the Levites .
text_la: necnon et filios Aaron, et Levitas.
text_pt: E Davi reuniu os filhos de Arão e os levitas:
text_el: καὶ συνήγαγεν Δαυιδ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ααρων καὶ τοὺς Λευίτας

text_en: Of the children of Caath, Uriel was the chief, and his brethren a hundred and twenty.
text_la: De filiis Caath, Uriel princeps fuit, et fratres ejus centum viginti.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Coate: Uriel, o chefe, e de seus irmãos cento e vinte.
text_el: τῶν υἱῶν Κααθ Ουριηλ ὁ ἄρχων καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι

text_en: Of the sons of Merari, Asaia the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty.
text_la: De filiis Merari, Asaia princeps : et fratres ejus ducenti viginti.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Merari: Asaías, o chefe, e de seus irmãos duzentos e vinte.
text_el: τῶν υἱῶν Μεραρι Ασαια ὁ ἄρχων καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ διακόσιοι πεντήκοντα

text_en: Of the sons of Gersom, Joel the chief, and his brethren a hundred and thirty.
text_la: De filiis Gersom, Joël princeps : et fratres ejus centum triginta.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Gérson: Joel, o chefe, e de seus irmãos cento e trinta.
text_el: τῶν υἱῶν Γηρσαμ Ιωηλ ὁ ἄρχων καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἑκατὸν πεντήκοντα

text_en: Of the sons of Elisaphan, Semeias the chief: and his brethren two hundred.
text_la: De filiis Elisaphan, Semeias princeps : et fratres ejus ducenti.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Elizafã: Semaías, o chefe, e de seus irmãos duzentos.
text_el: τῶν υἱῶν Ελισαφαν Σαμαιας ὁ ἄρχων καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ διακόσιοι

text_en: Of the sons of Hebron , Eliel the chief: and his brethren eighty.
text_la: De filiis Hebron, Eliel princeps : et fratres ejus octoginta.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Hebrom: Eliel, o chefe, e de seus irmãos oitenta.
text_el: τῶν υἱῶν Χεβρων Ελιηλ ὁ ἄρχων καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ὀγδοήκοντα

text_en: Of the sons of Oziel, Aminadab the chief: and his brethren a hundred and twelve.
text_la: De filiis Oziel, Aminadab princeps : et fratres ejus centum duodecim.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Uziel: Aminadabe, o chefe, e de seus irmãos cento e doze.
text_el: τῶν υἱῶν Οζιηλ Αμιναδαβ ὁ ἄρχων καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἑκατὸν δέκα δύο

text_en: And David called Sadoc, and Abiathar the priests , and the Levites , Uriel, Asaia, Joel, Semeia, Eliel, and Aminadab:
text_la: Vocavitque David Sadoc et Abiathar sacerdotes, et Levitas, Uriel, Asaiam, Joël, Semeiam, Eliel, et Aminadab:
text_pt: E chamou Davi os sacerdotes Zadoque e Abiatar, e os levitas, Uriel, Asaías, Joel, Semaías, Eliel, e Aminadabe.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Δαυιδ τὸν Σαδωκ καὶ Αβιαθαρ τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ τοὺς Λευίτας τὸν Ουριηλ Ασαια Ιωηλ Σαμαιαν Ελιηλ Αμιναδαβ

text_en: And he said to them: You that are the heads of the Levitical families , be sanctified with your brethren, and bring the ark of the Lord the God of Israel to the place, which is prepared for it:
text_la: et dixit ad eos : Vos, qui estis principes familiarum Leviticarum, sanctificamini cum fratribus vestris, et afferte arcam Domini Dei Israël ad locum qui ei præparatus est:
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Vós sois os chefes dos pais entre os levitas; santificai-vos, vós e vossos irmãos, para que façais subir a arca do Senhor Deus de Israel, ao lugar que lhe tenho preparado.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὑμεῖς ἄρχοντες πατριῶν τῶν Λευιτῶν ἁγνίσθητε ὑμεῖς καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ὑμῶν καὶ ἀνοίσετε τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ Ισραηλ οὗ ἡτοίμασα αὐτῇ

text_en: Lest as the Lord at first struck us, because you were not present, the same should now also come to pass, by our doing some thing against the law.
text_la: ne ut a principio, quia non eratis præsentes, percussit nos Dominus; sic et nunc fiat, illicitum quid nobis agentibus.
text_pt: Porquanto vós não a levastes na primeira vez, o Senhor nosso Deus fez rotura em nós, porque não o buscamos segundo a ordenança.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἐν τῷ πρότερον ὑμᾶς εἶναι διέκοψεν ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν ἡμῖν ὅτι οὐκ ἐζητήσαμεν ἐν κρίματι

text_en: So the priests and the Levites were sanctified , to carry the ark of the Lord the God of Israel .
text_la: Sanctificati sunt ergo sacerdotes et Levitæ ut portarent arcam Domini Dei Israël.
text_pt: Santificaram-se, pois, os sacerdotes e os levitas, para fazerem subir a arca do Senhor Deus de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἡγνίσθησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται τοῦ ἀνενέγκαι τὴν κιβωτὸν θεοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And the sons of Levi took the ark of God as Moses had commanded, according to the word of the Lord , upon their shoulders, with the staves.
text_la: Et tulerunt filii Levi arcam Dei, sicut præceperat Moyses juxta verbum Domini, humeris suis in vectibus.
text_pt: E os filhos dos levitas trouxeram a arca de Deus sobre os seus ombros, pelas varas que nela havia, como Moisés tinha ordenado conforme a palavra do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν Λευιτῶν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ ὡς ἐνετείλατο Μωυσῆς ἐν λόγῳ θεοῦ κατὰ τὴν γραφήν ἐν ἀναφορεῦσιν ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And David spoke to the chiefs of the Levites , to appoint some of their brethren to be singers with musical instruments, to wit, on psalteries, and harps, and cymbals, that the joyful noise might resound on high.
text_la: Dixitque David principibus Levitarum, ut constituerent de fratribus suis cantores in organis musicorum, nablis videlicet, et lyris, et cymbalis, ut resonaret in excelsis sonitus lætitiæ.
text_pt: E disse Davi aos chefes dos levitas que constituíssem, de seus irmãos, cantores, para que com instrumentos musicais, com alaúdes, harpas e címbalos, se fizessem ouvir, levantando a voz com alegria.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ τοῖς ἄρχουσιν τῶν Λευιτῶν στήσατε τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῶν τοὺς ψαλτῳδοὺς ἐν ὀργάνοις ᾠδῶν νάβλαις καὶ κινύραις καὶ κυμβάλοις τοῦ φωνῆσαι εἰς ὕψος ἐν φωνῇ εὐφροσύνης

text_en: And they appointed Levites , Hemam the son of Joel, and of his brethren Asaph the son of Barachias: and of the sons of Merari, their brethren: Ethan the son of Casaia.
text_la: Constitueruntque Levitas : Heman filium Joël, et de fratribus ejus Asaph filium Barachiæ : de filiis vero Merari, fratribus eorum : Ethan filium Casaiæ.
text_pt: Designaram, pois, os levitas a Hemã, filho de Joel; e dos seus irmãos, Asafe, filho de Berequias; e dos filhos de Merari, seus irmãos, Etã, filho de Cusaías.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησαν οἱ Λευῖται τὸν Αιμαν υἱὸν Ιωηλ ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ Ασαφ υἱὸς Βαραχια καὶ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Μεραρι ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ Αιθαν υἱὸς Κισαιου

text_en: And with them their brethren: in the second rank, Zacharias, and Ben, and Jaziel, and Semiramoth, and Jahiel, and Ani, and Eliab, and Banaias , and Maasias, and Mathathias , and Eliphalu, and Macenias, and Obededom, and Jehiel, the porters.
text_la: Et cum eis fratres eorum : in secundo ordine, Zachariam, et Ben, et Jaziel, et Semiramoth, et Jahiel, et Ani, Eliab, et Banaiam, et Maasiam, et Mathathiam, et Eliphalu, et Maceniam, et Obededom, et Jehiel, janitores.
text_pt: E com eles a seus irmãos da segunda ordem: a Zacarias, Bene, Jaaziel, Semiramote, Jeiel, Uni, Eliabe, Benaia, Maaséias, Matitias, Elifeleu, Micnéias, Obede-Edom, e Jeiel, os porteiros.
text_el: καὶ μετ' αὐτῶν ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν οἱ δεύτεροι Ζαχαριας καὶ Οζιηλ καὶ Σεμιραμωθ καὶ Ιιηλ καὶ Ωνι καὶ Ελιαβ καὶ Βαναια καὶ Μαασαια καὶ Ματταθια καὶ Ελιφαλια καὶ Μακενια καὶ Αβδεδομ καὶ Ιιηλ καὶ Οζιας οἱ πυλωροί

text_en: Now the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, sounded with cymbals of brass.
text_la: Porro cantores, Heman, Asaph, et Ethan, in cymbalis æneis concrepantes.
text_pt: E os cantores, Hemã, Asafe e Etã, se faziam ouvir com címbalos de metal;
text_el: καὶ οἱ ψαλτῳδοί Αιμαν Ασαφ καὶ Αιθαν ἐν κυμβάλοις χαλκοῖς τοῦ ἀκουσθῆναι ποιῆσαι

text_en: And Zacharias, and Oziel, and Semiramoth, and Jehiel, and Ani, and Eliab, and Maasias, and Banaias , sung mysteries upon psalteries.
text_la: Zacharias autem, et Oziel, et Semiramoth, et Jahiel, et Ani, et Eliab, et Maasias, et Banaias in nablis arcana cantabant.
text_pt: E Zacarias, Aziel, Semiramote, Jeiel, Uni, Eliabe, Maaséias, e Benaia, com alaúdes, sobre Alamote:
text_el: Ζαχαριας καὶ Οζιηλ Σεμιραμωθ Ιιηλ Ωνι Ελιαβ Μασαιας Βαναιας ἐν νάβλαις ἐπὶ αλαιμωθ

text_en: And Mathathias , and Eliphalu, and Macenias and Obededom, and Jehiel and Ozaziu, sung a song of victory for the octave upon harps.
text_la: Porro Mathathias, et Eliphalu, et Macenias, et Obededom, et Jehiel, et Ozaziu, in citharis pro octava canebant epinicion.
text_pt: E Matitias, Elifeleu, Micnéias, Obede-Edom, Jeiel, e Azazias, com harpas, sobre Seminite, para sobressaírem.
text_el: καὶ Ματταθιας καὶ Ελιφαλιας καὶ Μακενιας καὶ Αβδεδομ καὶ Ιιηλ καὶ Οζιας ἐν κινύραις αμασενιθ τοῦ ἐνισχῦσαι

text_en: And Chonenias chief of the Levites , presided over the prophecy , to give out the tunes: for he was very skilful.
text_la: Chonenias autem princeps Levitarum, prophetiæ præerat, ad præcinendam melodiam : erat quippe valde sapiens.
text_pt: E Quenanias, chefe dos levitas, tinha o encargo de dirigir o canto; ensinava-os a entoá-lo, porque era entendido.
text_el: καὶ Χωνενια ἄρχων τῶν Λευιτῶν ἄρχων τῶν ᾠδῶν ὅτι συνετὸς ἦν

text_en: And Barachias, and Elcana, were doorkeepers of the ark .
text_la: Et Barachias, et Elcana, janitores arcæ.
text_pt: E Berequias e Elcana eram porteiros da arca.
text_el: καὶ Βαραχια καὶ Ηλκανα πυλωροὶ τῆς κιβωτοῦ

text_en: And Sebenias, and Josaphat, and Nathanael, and Amasai, and Zacharias, and Banaias , and Eliezer the priests , sounded with trumpets, before the ark of God : and Obededom and Jehias were porters of the ark .
text_la: Porro Sebenias, et Josaphat, et Nathanaël, et Amasai, et Zacharias, et Banaias, et Eliezer sacerdotes, clangebant tubis coram arca Dei : et Obededom et Jehias erant janitores arcæ.
text_pt: E Sebanias, Jeosafá, Netanel, Amasai, Zacarias, Benaia, e Eliezer, os sacerdotes, tocavam as trombetas perante a arca de Deus; e Obede-Edom e Jeías eram porteiros da arca.
text_el: καὶ Σοβνια καὶ Ιωσαφατ καὶ Ναθαναηλ καὶ Αμασαι καὶ Ζαχαρια καὶ Βαναι καὶ Ελιεζερ οἱ ἱερεῖς σαλπίζοντες ταῖς σάλπιγξιν ἔμπροσθεν τῆς κιβωτοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ Αβδεδομ καὶ Ιια πυλωροὶ τῆς κιβωτοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: So David and all the ancients of Israel , and the captains over thousands, went to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the house of Obededom with joy .
text_la: Igitur David, et omnes majores natu Israël, et tribuni, ierunt ad deportandam arcam fœderis Domini de domo Obededom cum lætitia.
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que Davi e os anciãos de Israel, e os capitães dos milhares, foram, com alegria, para fazer subir a arca da aliança do Senhor, da casa de Obede-Edom.
text_el: καὶ ἦν Δαυιδ καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Ισραηλ καὶ οἱ χιλίαρχοι οἱ πορευόμενοι τοῦ ἀναγαγεῖν τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου ἐξ οἴκου Αβδεδομ ἐν εὐφροσύνῃ

text_en: And when God had helped the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord , they offered in sacrifice seven oxen, and seven rams.
text_la: Cumque adjuvisset Deus Levitas qui portabant arcam fœderis Domini, immolabantur septem tauri, et septem arietes.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ajudando Deus os levitas que levavam a arca da aliança do Senhor, sacrificaram sete novilhos e sete carneiros.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ κατισχῦσαι τὸν θεὸν τοὺς Λευίτας αἴροντας τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης κυρίου καὶ ἔθυσαν ἑπτὰ μόσχους καὶ ἑπτὰ κριούς

text_en: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that carried the ark , and the singing men , and Chonenias the ruler of the prophecy among the singers: and David also had on him an ephod of linen.
text_la: Porro David erat indutus stola byssina, et universi Levitæ qui portabant arcam, cantoresque, et Chonenias princeps prophetiæ inter cantores : David autem etiam indutus erat ephod lineo.
text_pt: E Davi ia vestido de um manto de linho fino, como também todos os levitas que levavam a arca, e os cantores, e Quenanias, mestre dos cantores; também Davi levava sobre si um éfode de linho,
text_el: καὶ Δαυιδ περιεζωσμένος ἐν στολῇ βυσσίνῃ καὶ πάντες οἱ Λευῖται αἴροντες τὴν κιβωτὸν διαθήκης κυρίου καὶ οἱ ψαλτῳδοὶ καὶ Χωνενιας ὁ ἄρχων τῶν ᾠδῶν τῶν ᾀδόντων καὶ ἐπὶ Δαυιδ στολὴ βυσσίνη

text_en: And all Israel brought the ark of the covenant of the Lord with joyful shouting, and sounding with the sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and cymbals, and psalteries, and harps.
text_la: Universusque Israël deducebant arcam fœderis Domini in jubilo, et sonitu buccinæ, et tubis, et cymbalis, et nablis, et citharis concrepantes.
text_pt: E todo o Israel fez subir a arca da aliança do Senhor, com júbilo, e ao som de buzinas, e de trombetas, e de címbalos, fazendo ressoar alaúdes e harpas.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ ἀνάγοντες τὴν κιβωτὸν διαθήκης κυρίου ἐν σημασίᾳ καὶ ἐν φωνῇ σωφερ καὶ ἐν σάλπιγξιν καὶ ἐν κυμβάλοις ἀναφωνοῦντες νάβλαις καὶ ἐν κινύραις

text_en: And when the ark of the covenant of the Lord had come to the city of David, Michol the daughter of Saul looking out at a window, saw King David dancing and playing , and she despised him in her heart.
text_la: Cumque pervenisset arca fœderis Domini usque ad civitatem David, Michol filia Saul prospiciens per fenestram vidit regem David saltantem atque ludentem, et despexit eum in corde suo.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, chegando a arca da aliança do Senhor à cidade de Davi, Mical, a filha de Saul, olhou de uma janela, e, vendo a Davi dançar e tocar, o desprezou no seu coração.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο κιβωτὸς διαθήκης κυρίου καὶ ἦλθεν ἕως πόλεως Δαυιδ καὶ Μελχολ θυγάτηρ Σαουλ παρέκυψεν διὰ τῆς θυρίδος καὶ εἶδεν τὸν βασιλέα Δαυιδ ὀρχούμενον καὶ παίζοντα καὶ ἐξουδένωσεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτῆς

text_en: So they brought the ark of God , and set it in the midst of the tent, which David had pitched for it: and they offered holocausts , and peace offerings before God .
text_la: Attulerunt igitur arcam Dei, et constituerunt eam in medio tabernaculi quod tetenderat ei David : et obtulerunt holocausta et pacifica coram Deo.
text_pt: Trouxeram, pois, a arca de Deus, e a puseram no meio da tenda que Davi lhe tinha armado; e ofereceram holocaustos e sacrifícios pacíficos perante Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήνεγκαν τὴν κιβωτὸν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἀπηρείσαντο αὐτὴν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς σκηνῆς ἧς ἔπηξεν αὐτῇ Δαυιδ καὶ προσήνεγκαν ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ σωτηρίου ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And when David had made an end of offering holocausts , and peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the Lord .
text_la: Cumque complesset David offerens holocausta et pacifica, benedixit populo in nomine Domini.
text_pt: E, acabando Davi de oferecer os holocaustos e sacrifícios pacíficos, abençoou o povo em nome do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ συνετέλεσεν Δαυιδ ἀναφέρων ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ σωτηρίου καὶ εὐλόγησεν τὸν λαὸν ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου

text_en: And he divided to all and every one, both men and women , a loaf of bread, and a piece of roasted beef, and flour fried with oil.
text_la: Et divisit universis per singulos, a viro usque ad mulierem, tortam panis, et partem assæ carnis bubalæ, et frixam oleo similam.
text_pt: E repartiu a todos em Israel, tanto a homens como a mulheres, a cada um, um pão, e um bom pedaço de carne, e um frasco de vinho.
text_el: καὶ διεμέρισεν παντὶ ἀνδρὶ Ισραηλ ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς καὶ ἕως γυναικὸς τῷ ἀνδρὶ ἄρτον ἕνα ἀρτοκοπικὸν καὶ ἀμορίτην

text_en: And he appointed Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord , and to remember his works, and to glorify , and praise the Lord God of Israel .
text_la: Constituitque coram arca Domini de Levitis, qui ministrarent, et recordarentur operum ejus, et glorificarent atque laudarent Dominum Deum Israël:
text_pt: E pôs alguns dos levitas por ministros perante a arca do Senhor; isto para recordarem, e louvarem, e celebrarem ao Senhor Deus de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔταξεν κατὰ πρόσωπον τῆς κιβωτοῦ διαθήκης κυρίου ἐκ τῶν Λευιτῶν λειτουργοῦντας ἀναφωνοῦντας καὶ ἐξομολογεῖσθαι καὶ αἰνεῖν κύριον τὸν θεὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: Asaph the chief, and next after him Zacharias: moreover Jahiel, and Semiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mathathias , and Eliab, and Banaias , and Obededom: and Jehiel over the instruments of psaltery, and harps: and Asaph sounded with cymbals:
text_la: Asaph principem, et secundum ejus Zachariam : porro Jahiel, et Semiramoth, et Jehiel, et Mathathiam, et Eliab, et Banaiam, et Obededom : Jehiel super organa psalterii et lyras : Asaph autem ut cymbalis personaret:
text_pt: Era Asafe, o chefe, e Zacarias o segundo depois dele; Jeiel, e Semiramote, e Jeiel, e Matitias, e Eliabe, e Benaia, e Obede-Edom, e Jeiel, com alaúdes e com harpas; e Asafe se fazia ouvir com címbalos;
text_el: Ασαφ ὁ ἡγούμενος καὶ δευτερεύων αὐτῷ Ζαχαριας Ιιηλ Σεμιραμωθ Ιιηλ Ματταθιας Ελιαβ καὶ Βαναιας καὶ Αβδεδομ καὶ Ιιηλ ἐν ὀργάνοις νάβλαις καὶ κινύραις καὶ Ασαφ ἐν κυμβάλοις ἀναφωνῶν

text_en: But Banaias , and Jaziel the priests , to sound the trumpet continually before the ark of the covenant of the Lord .
text_la: Banaiam vero et Jaziel sacerdotes canere tuba jugiter coram arca fœderis Domini.
text_pt: Também Benaia, e Jaaziel, os sacerdotes, continuamente tocavam trombetas, perante a arca da aliança de Deus.
text_el: καὶ Βαναιας καὶ Οζιηλ οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐν ταῖς σάλπιγξιν διὰ παντὸς ἐναντίον τῆς κιβωτοῦ τῆς διαθήκης τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: In that day David made Asaph the chief to give praise to the Lord with his brethren.
text_la: In illo die fecit David principem ad confitendum Domino Asaph et fratres ejus:
text_pt: Então naquele mesmo dia Davi, em primeiro lugar, deu o seguinte salmo para que, pelo ministério de Asafe e de seus irmãos, louvassem ao Senhor;
