text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ τότε ἔταξεν Δαυιδ ἐν ἀρχῇ τοῦ αἰνεῖν τὸν κύριον ἐν χειρὶ Ασαφ καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Praise the Lord , and call upon his name : make known his doings among the nations.
text_la: Confitemini Domino, et invocate nomen ejus : notas facite in populis adinventiones ejus.
text_pt: Louvai ao Senhor, invocai o seu nome, fazei conhecidas as suas obras entre os povos.
text_el: ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐπικαλεῖσθε αὐτὸν ἐν ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ γνωρίσατε ἐν λαοῖς τὰ ἐπιτηδεύματα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Sing to him, yea, sing praises to him: and relate all his wondrous works.
text_la: Cantate ei, et psallite ei, et narrate omnia mirabilia ejus.
text_pt: Cantai-lhe, salmodiai-lhe, atentamente falai de todas as suas maravilhas.
text_el: ᾄσατε αὐτῷ καὶ ὑμνήσατε αὐτῷ διηγήσασθε πᾶσιν τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ ἃ ἐποίησεν κύριος

text_en: Praise his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice, that seek the Lord .
text_la: Laudate nomen sanctum ejus : lætetur cor quærentium Dominum.
text_pt: Gloriai-vos no seu santo nome; alegre-se o coração dos que buscam ao Senhor.
text_el: αἰνεῖτε ἐν ὀνόματι ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ εὐφρανθήσεται καρδία ζητοῦσα τὴν εὐδοκίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Seek the Lord , and his power: seek his face evermore.
text_la: Quærite Dominum, et virtutem ejus : quærite faciem ejus semper.
text_pt: Buscai ao Senhor e a sua força; buscai a sua face continuamente.
text_el: ζητήσατε τὸν κύριον καὶ ἰσχύσατε ζητήσατε τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ διὰ παντός

text_en: Remember his wonderful works, which he has done: his signs, and the judgments of his mouth.
text_la: Recordamini mirabilium ejus quæ fecit; signorum illius, et judiciorum oris ejus,
text_pt: Lembrai-vos das maravilhas que fez, de seus prodígios, e dos juízos da sua boca;
text_el: μνημονεύετε τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ ἃ ἐποίησεν τέρατα καὶ κρίματα τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ

text_en: O you seed of Israel his servants, you children of Jacob his chosen.
text_la: semen Israël servi ejus, filii Jacob electi ejus.
text_pt: Vós, semente de Israel, seus servos, vós, filhos de Jacó, seus escolhidos.
text_el: σπέρμα Ισραηλ παῖδες αὐτοῦ υἱοὶ Ιακωβ ἐκλεκτοὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: He is the Lord our God : his judgments are in all the earth.
text_la: Ipse Dominus Deus noster : in universa terra judicia ejus.
text_pt: Ele é o Senhor nosso Deus; os seus juízos estão em toda a terra.
text_el: αὐτὸς κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Remember for ever his covenant: the word, which he commanded to a thousand generations .
text_la: Recordamini in sempiternum pacti ejus : sermonis quem præcepit in mille generationes,
text_pt: Lembrai-vos perpetuamente da sua aliança e da palavra que prescreveu para mil gerações;
text_el: μνημονεύων εἰς αἰῶνα διαθήκης αὐτοῦ λόγον αὐτοῦ ὃν ἐνετείλατο εἰς χιλίας γενεάς

text_en: The covenant which he made with Abraham : and his oath to Isaac .
text_la: quem pepigit cum Abraham, et juramenti illius cum Isaac.
text_pt: Da aliança que fez com Abraão, e do seu juramento a Isaque;
text_el: ὃν διέθετο τῷ Αβρααμ καὶ τὸν ὅρκον αὐτοῦ τῷ Ισαακ

text_en: And he appointed the same to Jacob for a precept: and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
text_la: Et constituit illud Jacob in præceptum, et Israël in pactum sempiternum,
text_pt: O qual também a Jacó confirmou por estatuto, e a Israel por aliança eterna,
text_el: ἔστησεν αὐτὸν τῷ Ιακωβ εἰς πρόσταγμα τῷ Ισραηλ διαθήκην αἰώνιον

text_en: Saying: To you will I give the land of Chanaan : the lot of your inheritance.
text_la: dicens : Tibi dabo terram Chanaan, funiculum hæreditatis vestræ :
text_pt: Dizendo: A ti te darei a terra de Canaã, quinhão da vossa herança.
text_el: λέγων σοὶ δώσω τὴν γῆν Χανααν σχοίνισμα κληρονομίας ὑμῶν

text_en: When they were but a small number: very few and sojourners in it.
text_la: cum essent pauci numero, parvi et coloni ejus.
text_pt: Quando eram poucos homens em número, sim, mui poucos, e estrangeiros nela,
text_el: ἐν τῷ γενέσθαι αὐτοὺς ὀλιγοστοὺς ἀριθμῷ ὡς ἐσμικρύνθησαν καὶ παρῴκησαν ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And they passed from nation to nation: and from a kingdom to another people.
text_la: Et transierunt de gente in gentem, et de regno ad populum alterum.
text_pt: Quando andavam de nação em nação, e de um reino para outro povo,
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ἀπὸ ἔθνους εἰς ἔθνος καὶ ἀπὸ βασιλείας εἰς λαὸν ἕτερον

text_en: He suffered no man to do them wrong: and reproved kings for their sake.
text_la: Non dimisit quemquam calumniari eos, sed increpavit pro eis reges.
text_pt: A ninguém permitiu que os oprimisse, e por amor deles repreendeu reis, dizendo:
text_el: οὐκ ἀφῆκεν ἄνδρα τοῦ δυναστεῦσαι αὐτοὺς καὶ ἤλεγξεν περὶ αὐτῶν βασιλεῖς

text_en: Touch not my anointed: and do no evil to my prophets .
text_la: Nolite tangere christos meos, et in prophetis meis nolite malignari.
text_pt: Não toqueis os meus ungidos, e aos meus profetas não façais mal.
text_el: μὴ ἅψησθε τῶν χριστῶν μου καὶ ἐν τοῖς προφήταις μου μὴ πονηρεύεσθε

text_en: Sing to the Lord , all the earth: show forth from day to day his salvation .
text_la: Cantate Domino omnis terra; annuntiate ex die in diem salutare ejus :
text_pt: Cantai ao Senhor em toda a terra; anunciai de dia em dia a sua salvação.
text_el: ᾄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ ἀναγγείλατε ἐξ ἡμέρας εἰς ἡμέραν σωτηρίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Declare his glory among the Gentiles : his wonders among all people.
text_la: narrate in gentibus gloriam ejus; in cunctis populis mirabilia ejus.
text_pt: Contai entre as nações a sua glória, entre todos os povos as suas maravilhas.

text_en: For the Lord is great and exceedingly to be praised: and he is to be feared above all gods.
text_la: Quia magnus Dominus, et laudabilis nimis, et horribilis super omnes deos.
text_pt: Porque grande é o Senhor, e mui digno de louvor, e mais temível é do que todos os deuses.
text_el: ὅτι μέγας κύριος καὶ αἰνετὸς σφόδρα φοβερός ἐστιν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς θεούς

text_en: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens .
text_la: Omnes enim dii populorum idola : Dominus autem cælos fecit.
text_pt: Porque todos os deuses dos povos são ídolos; porém o Senhor fez os céus.
text_el: ὅτι πάντες οἱ θεοὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν εἴδωλα καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν οὐρανὸν ἐποίησεν

text_en: Praise and magnificence are before him: strength and joy in his place.
text_la: Confessio et magnificentia coram eo : fortitudo et gaudium in loco ejus.
text_pt: Louvor e majestade há diante dele, força e alegria no seu lugar.
text_el: δόξα καὶ ἔπαινος κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἰσχὺς καὶ καύχημα ἐν τόπῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Bring to the Lord , O you families of the nations: bring to the Lord glory and empire.
text_la: Afferte Domino, familiæ populorum : afferte Domino gloriam et imperium.
text_pt: Tributai ao Senhor, ó famílias dos povos, tributai ao Senhor glória e força.
text_el: δότε τῷ κυρίῳ πατριαὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν δότε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν καὶ ἰσχύν

text_en: Give to the Lord glory to his name , bring up sacrifice , and come in his sight: and adore the Lord in holy becomingness.
text_la: Date Domino gloriam; nomini ejus levate sacrificium, et venite in conspectu ejus : et adorate Dominum in decore sancto.
text_pt: Tributai ao Senhor a glória de seu nome; trazei presentes, e vinde perante ele; adorai ao Senhor na beleza da sua santidade.
text_el: δότε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ λάβετε δῶρα καὶ ἐνέγκατε κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ προσκυνήσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν αὐλαῖς ἁγίαις αὐτοῦ

text_en: Let all the earth be moved at his presence: for he has founded the world immoveable.
text_la: Commoveatur a facie ejus omnis terra : ipse enim fundavit orbem immobilem.
text_pt: Trema perante ele, trema toda a terra; pois o mundo se firmará, para que não se abale.
text_el: φοβηθήτω ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ κατορθωθήτω ἡ γῆ καὶ μὴ σαλευθήτω

text_en: Let the heavens rejoice, and the earth be glad: and let them say among the nations: The Lord has reigned.
text_la: Lætentur cæli, et exultet terra, et dicant in nationibus : Dominus regnavit.
text_pt: Alegrem-se os céus, e regozije-se a terra; e diga-se entre as nações: O Senhor reina.
text_el: εὐφρανθήτω ὁ οὐρανός καὶ ἀγαλλιάσθω ἡ γῆ καὶ εἰπάτωσαν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν κύριος βασιλεύων

text_en: Let the sea roar, and the fullness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all things that are in them.
text_la: Tonet mare et plenitudo ejus; exultent agri, et omnia quæ in eis sunt.
text_pt: Brame o mar com a sua plenitude; exulte o campo com tudo o que nele há;
text_el: βομβήσει ἡ θάλασσα σὺν τῷ πληρώματι καὶ ξύλον ἀγροῦ καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: Then shall the trees of the wood give praise before the Lord : because he has come to judge the earth.
text_la: Tunc laudabunt ligna saltus coram Domino : quia venit judicare terram.
text_pt: Então jubilarão as árvores dos bosques perante o Senhor; porquanto vem julgar a terra.
text_el: τότε εὐφρανθήσεται τὰ ξύλα τοῦ δρυμοῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου ὅτι ἦλθεν κρῖναι τὴν γῆν

text_en: Give glory to the Lord , for he is good : for his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Confitemini Domino, quoniam bonus : quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: Louvai ao Senhor, porque é bom; pois a sua benignidade dura perpetuamente.
text_el: ἐξομολογεῖσθε τῷ κυρίῳ ὅτι ἀγαθόν ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And say: Save us, O God our savior: and gather us together, and deliver us from the nations, that we may give glory to your holy name , and may rejoice in singing your praises.
text_la: Et dicite : Salva nos, Deus salvator noster, et congrega nos, et erue de gentibus : ut confiteamur nomini sancto tuo, et exultemus in carminibus tuis.
text_pt: E dizei: Salva-nos, ó Deus da nossa salvação, e ajunta-nos, e livra-nos das nações, para que louvemos o teu santo nome, e nos gloriemos no teu louvor.
text_el: καὶ εἴπατε σῶσον ἡμᾶς ὁ θεὸς τῆς σωτηρίας ἡμῶν καὶ ἐξελοῦ ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῶν ἐθνῶν τοῦ αἰνεῖν τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ἅγιόν σου καὶ καυχᾶσθαι ἐν ταῖς αἰνέσεσίν σου

text_en: Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel from eternity to eternity: and let all the people say Amen , and a hymn to God .
text_la: Benedictus Dominus Deus Israël, ab æterno usque in æternum. Et dicat omnis populo : Amen, et hymnum Domino.
text_pt: Bendito seja o Senhor Deus de Israel, de eternidade a eternidade. E todo o povo disse: Amém! E louvou ao Senhor.
text_el: εὐλογημένος κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἐρεῖ πᾶς ὁ λαός αμην καὶ ᾔνεσαν τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord , Asaph and his brethren to minister in the presence of the ark continually day by day, and in their courses.
text_la: Reliquit itaque ibi coram arca fœderis Domini Asaph et fratres ejus, ut ministrarent in conspectu arcæ jugiter per singulos dies, et vices suas.
text_pt: Então Davi deixou ali, diante da arca da aliança do Senhor, a Asafe e a seus irmãos, para ministrarem continuamente perante a arca, segundo se ordenara para cada dia.
text_el: καὶ κατέλιπον ἐκεῖ ἔναντι τῆς κιβωτοῦ διαθήκης κυρίου τὸν Ασαφ καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ τοῦ λειτουργεῖν ἐναντίον τῆς κιβωτοῦ διὰ παντὸς τὸ τῆς ἡμέρας εἰς ἡμέραν

text_en: And Obededom, with his brethren sixty-eight: and Obededom the son of Idithun, and Hosa he appointed to be porters.
text_la: Porro Obededom, et fratres ejus sexaginta octo : et Obededom filium Idithun, et Hosa, constituit janitores;
text_pt: E mais a Obede-Edom, com seus irmãos, sessenta e oito; a este Obede-Edom, filho de Jedutum, e a Hosa, deixou por porteiros.
text_el: καὶ Αβδεδομ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἑξήκοντα καὶ ὀκτώ καὶ Αβδεδομ υἱὸς Ιδιθων καὶ Οσσα εἰς πυλωρούς

text_en: And Sadoc the priest , and his brethren priests , before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place, which was in Gabaon.
text_la: Sadoc autem sacerdotem, et fratres ejus sacerdotes, coram tabernaculo Domini in excelso quod erat in Gabaon,
text_pt: E deixou a Zadoque, o sacerdote, e a seus irmãos, os sacerdotes, diante do tabernáculo do Senhor, no alto que está em Gibeom,
text_el: καὶ τὸν Σαδωκ τὸν ἱερέα καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ τοὺς ἱερεῖς ἐναντίον σκηνῆς κυρίου ἐν Βαμα τῇ ἐν Γαβαων

text_en: That they should offer holocausts to the Lord upon the altar of holocausts continually, morning and evening, according to all that is written in the law of the Lord , which he commanded Israel .
text_la: ut offerrent holocausta Domino super altare holocautomatis jugiter, mane et vespere, juxta omnia quæ scripta sunt in lege Domini, quam præcepit Israëli.
text_pt: Para oferecerem holocaustos ao Senhor continuamente, pela manhã e à tarde, sobre o altar dos holocaustos; e isto segundo tudo o que está escrito na lei do Senhor que tinha prescrito a Israel.
text_el: τοῦ ἀναφέρειν ὁλοκαυτώματα τῷ κυρίῳ ἐπὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τῶν ὁλοκαυτωμάτων διὰ παντὸς τὸ πρωὶ καὶ τὸ ἑσπέρας καὶ κατὰ πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα ἐν νόμῳ κυρίου ὅσα ἐνετείλατο ἐφ' υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ τοῦ θεράποντος τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And after him Heman, and Idithun, and the rest that were chosen, every one by his name to give praise to the Lord : because his mercy endures for ever.
text_la: Et post eum Heman, et Idithun, et reliquos electos, unumquemque vocabulo suo ad confitendum Domino, quoniam in æternum misericordia ejus.
text_pt: E com eles a Hemã, e a Jedutum, e aos mais escolhidos, que foram apontados pelos seus nomes, para louvarem ao Senhor, porque a sua benignidade dura perpetuamente.
text_el: καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ Αιμαν καὶ Ιδιθων καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ ἐκλεγέντες ἐπ' ὀνόματος τοῦ αἰνεῖν τὸν κύριον ὅτι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τὸ ἔλεος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Heman and Idithun sounded the trumpet, and played on the cymbals, and all kinds of musical instruments to sing praises to God : and the sons of Idithun he made porters.
text_la: Heman quoque et Idithun canentes tuba, et quatientes cymbala et omnia musicorum organa ad canendum Deo : filios autem Idithun fecit esse portarios.
text_pt: Com eles, pois, estavam Hemã e Jedutum, com trombetas e címbalos, para os que haviam de tocar, e com outros instrumentos de música de Deus; porém os filhos de Jedutum estavam à porta.
text_el: καὶ μετ' αὐτῶν σάλπιγγες καὶ κύμβαλα τοῦ ἀναφωνεῖν καὶ ὄργανα τῶν ᾠδῶν τοῦ θεοῦ υἱοὶ Ιδιθων εἰς τὴν πύλην

text_en: And all the people returned to their houses: and David to bless also his own house.
text_la: Reversusque est omnis populus in domum suam : et David, ut benediceret etiam domui suæ.
text_pt: Então todo o povo se retirou, cada um para a sua casa; e voltou Davi, para abençoar a sua casa.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἅπας ὁ λαὸς ἕκαστος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν Δαυιδ τοῦ εὐλογῆσαι τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Now when David was dwelling in his house, he said to Nathan the prophet : Behold I dwell in a house of cedar : and the ark of the covenant of the Lord is under skins.
text_la: Cum autem habitaret David in domo sua, dixit ad Nathan prophetam : Ecce ego habito in domo cedrina : arca autem fœderis Domini sub pellibus est.
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que, morando Davi já em sua casa, disse ao profeta Natã: Eis que moro em casa de cedro, mas a arca da aliança do SENHOR está debaixo de cortinas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς κατῴκησεν Δαυιδ ἐν οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Ναθαν τὸν προφήτην ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ κατοικῶ ἐν οἴκῳ κεδρίνῳ καὶ ἡ κιβωτὸς διαθήκης κυρίου ὑποκάτω δέρρεων

text_en: And Nathan said to David : Do all that is in your heart: for God is with you.
text_la: Et ait Nathan ad David : Omnia quæ in corde tuo sunt, fac : Deus enim tecum est.
text_pt: Então Natã disse a Davi: Tudo quanto tens no teu coração faze, porque Deus é contigo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ναθαν πρὸς Δαυιδ πᾶν τὸ ἐν τῇ ψυχῇ σου ποίει ὅτι ὁ θεὸς μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: Now that night the word of God came to Nathan , saying:
text_la: Igitur nocte illa factus est sermo Dei ad Nathan, dicens:
text_pt: Mas sucedeu, na mesma noite, que a palavra de Deus veio a Natã, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος κυρίου πρὸς Ναθαν λέγων

text_en: Go, and speak to David my servant: Thus says the Lord : You shall not build me a house to dwell in.
text_la: Vade, et loquere David servo meo : Hæc dicit Dominus : Non ædificabis tu mihi domum ad habitandum.
text_pt: Vai, e dize a Davi meu servo: Assim diz o Senhor: Tu não me edificarás uma casa para eu morar;
text_el: πορεύου καὶ εἰπὸν πρὸς Δαυιδ τὸν παῖδά μου οὕτως εἶπεν κύριος οὐ σὺ οἰκοδομήσεις μοι οἶκον τοῦ κατοικῆσαί με ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: For I have not remained in a house from the time that I brought up Israel , to this day: but I have been always changing places in a tabernacle , and in a tent,
text_la: Neque enim mansi in domo ex eo tempore quo eduxi Israël usque ad diem hanc : sed fui semper mutans loca tabernaculi, et in tentorio
text_pt: Porque em casa nenhuma morei, desde o dia em que fiz subir a Israel até ao dia de hoje; mas fui de tenda em tenda, e de tabernáculo em tabernáculo.
text_el: ὅτι οὐ κατῴκησα ἐν οἴκῳ ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς ἀνήγαγον τὸν Ισραηλ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης καὶ ἤμην ἐν σκηνῇ καὶ ἐν καταλύματι

text_en: abiding with all Israel . Did I ever speak to any one, of all the judges of Israel whom I charged to feed my people, saying: Why have you not built me a house of cedar ?
text_la: manens cum omni Israël. Numquid locutus sum saltem uni judicum Israël, quibus præceperam ut pascerent populum meum, et dixi : Quare non ædificastis mihi domum cedrinam?
text_pt: Por todas as partes por onde andei com todo o Israel, porventura falei alguma palavra a algum dos juízes de Israel, a quem ordenei que apascentasse o meu povo, dizendo: Por que não me edificais uma casa de cedro?
text_el: ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς διῆλθον ἐν παντὶ Ισραηλ εἰ λαλῶν ἐλάλησα πρὸς μίαν φυλὴν Ισραηλ τοῦ ποιμαίνειν τὸν λαόν μου λέγων ὅτι οὐκ ᾠκοδομήκατέ μοι οἶκον κέδρινον

text_en: Now therefore thus shall you say to my servant David : Thus says the Lord of hosts : I took you from the pastures, from following the flock, that you should be ruler of my people Israel .
text_la: Nunc itaque sic loqueris ad servum meum David : Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum : Ego tuli te, cum in pascuis sequereris gregem, ut esses dux populi mei Israël:
text_pt: Agora, pois, assim dirás a meu servo Davi: Assim diz o Senhor dos Exércitos: Eu te tirei do curral, de detrás das ovelhas, para que fosses chefe do meu povo Israel.
text_el: καὶ νῦν οὕτως ἐρεῖς τῷ δούλῳ μου Δαυιδ τάδε λέγει κύριος παντοκράτωρ ἔλαβόν σε ἐκ τῆς μάνδρας ἐξόπισθεν τῶν ποιμνίων τοῦ εἶναι εἰς ἡγούμενον ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν μου Ισραηλ

text_en: And I have been with you wherever you have gone: and have slain all your enemies before you, and have made you a name like that of one of the great ones that are renowned in the earth.
text_la: et fui tecum quocumque perrexisti, et interfeci omnes inimicos tuos coram te, fecique tibi nomen quasi unius magnorum qui celebrantur in terra.
text_pt: E estive contigo por toda a parte, por onde foste, e de diante de ti exterminei todos os teus inimigos, e te fiz um nome como o nome dos grandes que estão na terra,
text_el: καὶ ἤμην μετὰ σοῦ ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐπορεύθης καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσα πάντας τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ἀπὸ προσώπου σου καὶ ἐποίησά σοι ὄνομα κατὰ τὸ ὄνομα τῶν μεγάλων τῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And I have given a place my people Israel : they shall be planted, and shall dwell therein, and shall be moved no more, neither shall the children of iniquity waste them, as at the beginning,
text_la: Et dedi locum populo meo Israël : plantabitur, et habitabit in eo, et ultra non commovebitur : nec filii iniquitatis atterent eos, sicut a principio,
text_pt: E ordenarei um lugar para o meu povo Israel, e o plantarei, para que habite no seu lugar, e nunca mais seja removido de uma para outra parte; e nunca mais os filhos da perversidade o debilitarão como dantes,
text_el: καὶ θήσομαι τόπον τῷ λαῷ μου Ισραηλ καὶ καταφυτεύσω αὐτόν καὶ κατασκηνώσει καθ' ἑαυτὸν καὶ οὐ μεριμνήσει ἔτι καὶ οὐ προσθήσει ἀδικία τοῦ ταπεινῶσαι αὐτὸν καθὼς ἀπ' ἀρχῆς

text_en: since the days that I gave judges to my people Israel , and have humbled all your enemies. And I declare to you, that the Lord will build you a house.
text_la: ex diebus quibus dedi judices populo meo Israël, et humiliavi universos inimicos tuos. Annuntio ergo tibi, quod ædificaturus sit tibi Dominus domum.
text_pt: E desde os dias em que ordenei juízes sobre o meu povo Israel. Assim abaterei a todos os teus inimigos; também te faço saber que o Senhor te edificará uma casa.
text_el: καὶ ἀφ' ἡμερῶν ὧν ἔταξα κριτὰς ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν μου Ισραηλ καὶ ἐταπείνωσα ἅπαντας τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου καὶ αὐξήσω σε καὶ οἶκον οἰκοδομήσει σοι κύριος

text_en: And when you shall have ended your days to go to your fathers, I will raise up your seed after you, which shall be of your sons: and I will establish his kingdom.
text_la: Cumque impleveris dies tuos ut vadas ad patres tuos, suscitabo semen tuum post te, quod erit de filiis tuis : et stabiliam regnum ejus.
text_pt: E há de ser que, quando forem cumpridos os teus dias, para ires a teus pais, suscitarei a tua descendência depois de ti, um dos teus filhos, e estabelecerei o seu reino.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὅταν πληρωθῶσιν αἱ ἡμέραι σου καὶ κοιμηθήσῃ μετὰ τῶν πατέρων σου καὶ ἀναστήσω τὸ σπέρμα σου μετὰ σέ ὃς ἔσται ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας σου καὶ ἑτοιμάσω τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: He shall build me a house, and I will establish his throne for ever.
text_la: Ipse ædificabit mihi domum, et firmabo solium ejus usque in æternum.
text_pt: Este me edificará casa; e eu confirmarei o seu trono para sempre.
text_el: αὐτὸς οἰκοδομήσει μοι οἶκον καὶ ἀνορθώσω τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: I will be to him a father, and he shall be to me a son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before you.
text_la: Ego ero ei in patrem, et ipse erit mihi in filium : et misericordiam meam non auferam ab eo, sicut abstuli ab eo qui ante te fuit.
text_pt: Eu lhe serei por pai, e ele me será por filho; e a minha benignidade não retirarei dele, como a tirei daquele, que foi antes de ti.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἔσομαι αὐτῷ εἰς πατέρα καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται μοι εἰς υἱόν καὶ τὸ ἔλεός μου οὐκ ἀποστήσω ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ὡς ἀπέστησα ἀπὸ τῶν ὄντων ἔμπροσθέν σου

text_en: But I will settle him in my house, and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be most firm for ever.
text_la: Et statuam eum in domo mea, et in regno meo usque in sempiternum : et thronus ejus erit firmissimus in perpetuum.
text_pt: Mas o confirmarei na minha casa e no meu reino para sempre, e o seu trono será firme para sempre.
text_el: καὶ πιστώσω αὐτὸν ἐν οἴκῳ μου καὶ ἐν βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος καὶ ὁ θρόνος αὐτοῦ ἔσται ἀνωρθωμένος ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak to David .
text_la: Juxta omnia verba hæc, et juxta universam visionem istam, sic locutus est Nathan ad David.
text_pt: Conforme todas estas palavras, e conforme toda esta visão, assim falou Natã a Davi.
text_el: κατὰ πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ κατὰ πᾶσαν τὴν ὅρασιν ταύτην οὕτως ἐλάλησεν Ναθαν πρὸς Δαυιδ

text_en: And King David came and sat before the Lord , and said: Who am I, O Lord God , and what is my house, that you should give such things to me?
text_la: Cumque venisset rex David, et sedisset coram Domino, dixit : Quis ego sum, Domine Deus, et quæ domus mea, ut præstares mihi talia?
text_pt: Então entrou o rei Davi, e ficou perante o Senhor; e disse: Quem sou eu, Senhor Deus? e qual é a minha casa, para que me tenhas trazido até aqui?
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἀπέναντι κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν τίς εἰμι ἐγώ κύριε ὁ θεός καὶ τίς ὁ οἶκός μου ὅτι ἠγάπησάς με ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: But even this has seemed little in your sight, and therefore you have also spoken concerning the house of your servant for the time to come: and have made me remarkable above all men , O Lord God .
text_la: sed et hoc parum visum est in conspectu tuo, ideoque locutus es super domum servi tui etiam in futurum : et fecisti me spectabilem super omnes homines, Domine Deus.
text_pt: E ainda isto, ó Deus, foi pouco aos teus olhos; pelo que falaste da casa de teu servo para tempos distantes; e trataste-me como a um homem ilustre, ó Senhor Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐσμικρύνθη ταῦτα ἐνώπιόν σου ὁ θεός καὶ ἐλάλησας ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ παιδός σου ἐκ μακρῶν καὶ ἐπεῖδές με ὡς ὅρασις ἀνθρώπου καὶ ὕψωσάς με κύριε ὁ θεός

text_en: What can David add more, seeing you have thus glorified your servant, and known him?
text_la: Quid ultra addere potest David, cum ita glorificaveris servum tuum, et cognoveris eum?
text_pt: Que mais te dirá Davi, acerca da honra feita a teu servo? Porém tu conheces bem a teu servo.
text_el: τί προσθήσει ἔτι Δαυιδ πρὸς σὲ τοῦ δοξάσαι καὶ σὺ τὸν δοῦλόν σου οἶδας

text_en: O Lord , for your servant's sake, according to your own heart, you have shown all this magnificence, and would have all the great things to be known.
text_la: Domine, propter famulum tuum juxta cor tuum fecisti omnem magnificentiam hanc, et nota esse voluisti universa magnalia.
text_pt: Ó Senhor, por amor de teu servo, e segundo o teu coração, fizeste toda esta grandeza, para fazer notória todas estas grandes coisas.
text_el: καὶ κατὰ τὴν καρδίαν σου ἐποίησας τὴν πᾶσαν μεγαλωσύνην

text_en: O Lord there is none like you: and here is no other God beside you, of all whom we have heard of with our ears.
text_la: Domine, non est similis tui, et non est alius deus absque te, ex omnibus quos audivimus auribus nostris.
text_pt: Senhor, ninguém há como tu, e não há Deus fora de ti, segundo tudo quanto ouvimos com os nossos ouvidos.
text_el: κύριε οὐκ ἔστιν ὅμοιός σοι καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν πλὴν σοῦ κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἠκούσαμεν ἐν ὠσὶν ἡμῶν

text_en: For what other nation is there upon earth like your people Israel , whom God went to deliver, and make a people for himself, and by his greatness and terrors cast out nations before their face whom he had delivered out of Egypt ?
text_la: Quis enim est alius, ut populus tuus Israël, gens una in terra, ad quam perrexit Deus ut liberaret et faceret populum sibi, et magnitudine sua atque terroribus ejiceret nationes a facie ejus, quem de Ægypto liberarat?
text_pt: E quem há como o teu povo Israel, única gente na terra, a quem Deus foi resgatar para seu povo, fazendo-te nome com coisas grandes e temerosas, lançando as nações de diante do teu povo, que resgataste do Egito?
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὡς ὁ λαός σου Ισραηλ ἔθνος ἔτι ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὡς ὡδήγησεν αὐτὸν ὁ θεὸς τοῦ λυτρώσασθαι ἑαυτῷ λαὸν τοῦ θέσθαι ἑαυτῷ ὄνομα μέγα καὶ ἐπιφανὲς τοῦ ἐκβαλεῖν ἀπὸ προσώπου λαοῦ σου οὓς ἐλυτρώσω ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἔθνη

text_en: And you have made your people Israel to be your own people for ever, and you, O Lord , have become their God .
text_la: Et posuisti populum tuum Israël tibi in populum usque in æternum, et tu, Domine, factus es Deus ejus.
text_pt: E confirmaste o teu povo Israel para ser teu povo para sempre; e tu, Senhor, lhe foste por Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκας τὸν λαόν σου Ισραηλ σεαυτῷ λαὸν ἕως αἰῶνος καὶ σύ κύριε αὐτοῖς εἰς θεόν

text_en: Now therefore, O Lord , let the word which you have spoken to your servant, and concerning his house, be established for ever, and do as you have said.
text_la: Nunc igitur Domine, sermo quem locutus es famulo tuo et super domum ejus confirmetur in perpetuum, et fac sicut locutus es.
text_pt: Agora, pois, Senhor, a palavra que falaste de teu servo, e acerca da sua casa, confirma-a para sempre; e faze como falaste.
text_el: καὶ νῦν κύριε ὁ λόγος σου ὃν ἐλάλησας πρὸς τὸν παῖδά σου καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ πιστωθήτω ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: And let your name remain and be magnified for ever: and let it be said: The Lord of hosts is God of Israel , and the house of David his servant remains before him.
text_la: Permaneatque et magnificetur nomen tuum usque in sempiternum, et dicatur : Dominus exercituum Deus Israël, et domus David servi ejus permanens coram eo.
text_pt: Confirme-se e engrandeça-se o teu nome para sempre, e diga-se: O Senhor dos Exércitos é o Deus de Israel, é Deus para Israel; e permaneça firme diante de ti a casa de Davi, teu servo.
text_el: λεγόντων κύριε κύριε παντοκράτωρ θεὸς Ισραηλ καὶ ὁ οἶκος Δαυιδ παιδός σου ἀνωρθωμένος ἐναντίον σου

text_en: For you, O Lord my God , have revealed to the ear of your servant, that you will build him a house: and therefore your servant has found confidence to pray before you.
text_la: Tu enim, Domine Deus meus, revelasti auriculam servi tui, ut ædificares ei domum : et idcirco invenit servus tuus fiduciam, ut oret coram te.
text_pt: Porque tu, Deus meu, revelaste ao ouvido de teu servo que lhe edificarias casa; pelo que o teu servo achou confiança para orar em tua presença.
text_el: ὅτι σύ κύριε ἤνοιξας τὸ οὖς τοῦ παιδός σου τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι αὐτῷ οἶκον διὰ τοῦτο εὗρεν ὁ παῖς σου τοῦ προσεύξασθαι κατὰ πρόσωπόν σου

text_en: And now O Lord , you are God : and you have promised to your servant such great benefits.
text_la: Nunc ergo Domine, tu es Deus, et locutus es ad servum tuum tanta beneficia.
text_pt: Agora, pois, Senhor, tu és o mesmo Deus, e falaste este bem acerca de teu servo.
text_el: καὶ νῦν κύριε σὺ εἶ αὐτὸς ὁ θεὸς καὶ ἐλάλησας ἐπὶ τὸν δοῦλόν σου τὰ ἀγαθὰ ταῦτα

text_en: And you have begun to bless the house of your servant, that it may be always before you: for seeing you bless it, O Lord , it shall be blessed for ever.
text_la: Et cœpisti benedicere domui servi tui, ut sit semper coram te : te enim, Domine, benedicente, benedicta erit in perpetuum.
text_pt: Agora, pois, foste servido abençoar a casa de teu servo, para que permaneça para sempre diante de ti: porque tu, Senhor, a abençoaste, e ficará abençoada para sempre.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἤρξω τοῦ εὐλογῆσαι τὸν οἶκον τοῦ παιδός σου τοῦ εἶναι εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἐναντίον σου ὅτι σύ κύριε εὐλόγησας καὶ εὐλόγησον εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And it came to pass after this, that David defeated the Philistines , and humbled them, and took away Geth, and her daughters out of the hands of the Philistines ,
text_la: Factum est autem post hæc, ut percuteret David Philisthiim, et humiliaret eos, et tolleret Geth et filias ejus de manu Philisthiim,
text_pt: E depois disto aconteceu que Davi derrotou os filisteus, e os sujeitou; e tomou a Gate, e os lugares da sua jurisdição, da mão dos filisteus.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἐπάταξεν Δαυιδ τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους καὶ ἐτροπώσατο αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν Γεθ καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς ἐκ χειρὸς ἀλλοφύλων

text_en: and he defeated Moab , and the Moabites were made David's servants, and brought him gifts.
text_la: percuteretque Moab, et fierent Moabitæ servi David, offerentes ei munera.
text_pt: Também derrotou os moabitas; e os moabitas ficaram por servos de Davi, pagando tributos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὴν Μωαβ καὶ ἦσαν Μωαβ παῖδες τῷ Δαυιδ φέροντες δῶρα

text_en: At that time David defeated also Adarezer king of Soba of the land of Hemath, when he went to extend his dominions as far as the river Euphrates.
text_la: Eo tempore percussit David etiam Adarezer regem Soba regionis Hemath, quando perrexit ut dilataret imperium suum usque ad flumen Euphraten.
text_pt: Também Davi derrotou a Hadar-Ezer, rei de Zobá, junto a Hamate, quando ele ia estabelecer o seu domínio sobre o rio Eufrates.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν Δαυιδ τὸν Αδρααζαρ βασιλέα Σουβα Ημαθ πορευομένου αὐτοῦ ἐπιστῆσαι χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ ποταμὸν Εὐφράτην

text_en: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen, and he houghed all the chariot horses, only a hundred chariots, which he reserved for himself.
text_la: Cepit ergo David mille quadrigas ejus, et septem millia equitum, ac viginti millia virorum peditum, subnervavitque omnes equos curruum, exceptis centum quadrigis, quas reservavit sibi.
text_pt: E Davi lhe tomou mil carros, e sete mil cavaleiros, e vinte mil homens de pé; e Davi jarretou todos os cavalos dos carros; porém reservou deles para cem carros.
text_el: καὶ προκατελάβετο Δαυιδ αὐτῶν χίλια ἅρματα καὶ ἑπτὰ χιλιάδας ἵππων καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν πεζῶν καὶ παρέλυσεν Δαυιδ πάντα τὰ ἅρματα καὶ ὑπελίπετο ἐξ αὐτῶν ἑκατὸν ἅρματα

text_en: And the Syrians of Damascus came also to help Adarezer king of Soba: and David slew of them likewise two and twenty thousand men .
text_la: Supervenit autem et Syrus Damascenus, ut auxilium præberet Adarezer regi Soba : sed et hujus percussit David viginti duo millia virorum.
text_pt: E vieram os sírios de Damasco a socorrer a Hadar-Ezer, rei de Zobá; porém Davi feriu dos sírios vinte e dois mil homens.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Σύρος ἐκ Δαμασκοῦ βοηθῆσαι Αδρααζαρ βασιλεῖ Σουβα καὶ ἐπάταξεν Δαυιδ ἐν τῷ Σύρῳ εἴκοσι καὶ δύο χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν

text_en: And he put a garrison in Damascus , that Syria also should serve him, and bring gifts. And the Lord assisted him in all things to which he went.
text_la: Et posuit milites in Damasco, ut Syria quoque serviret sibi, et offerret munera. Adjuvitque eum Dominus in cunctis ad quæ perrexerat.
text_pt: E Davi pôs guarnições na Síria de Damasco, e os sírios ficaram por servos de Davi, pagando-lhe tributo; e o Senhor guardava a Davi, por onde quer que ia.
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο Δαυιδ φρουρὰν ἐν Συρίᾳ τῇ κατὰ Δαμασκόν καὶ ἦσαν τῷ Δαυιδ εἰς παῖδας φέροντας δῶρα καὶ ἔσῳζεν κύριος τὸν Δαυιδ ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐπορεύετο

text_en: And David took the golden quivers which the servants of Adarezer had, and he brought them to Jerusalem .
text_la: Tulit quoque David pharetras aureas, quas habuerant servi Adarezer, et attulit eas in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E Davi tomou os escudos de ouro, que tinham os servos de Hadar-Ezer, e os trouxe a Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Δαυιδ τοὺς κλοιοὺς τοὺς χρυσοῦς οἳ ἦσαν ἐπὶ τοὺς παῖδας Αδρααζαρ καὶ ἤνεγκεν αὐτοὺς εἰς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Likewise out of Thebath and Chun, cities of Adarezer, he brought very much brass, of which Solomon made the brazen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
text_la: Necnon de Thebath et Chun urbibus Adarezer æris plurimum, de quo fecit Salomon mare æneum, et columnas, et vasa ænea.
text_pt: Também de Tibate, e de Cum, cidades de Hadar-Ezer, tomou Davi muitíssimo cobre, de que Salomão fez o mar de cobre, e as colunas, e os utensílios de cobre.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τῆς μεταβηχας καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν πόλεων τῶν Αδρααζαρ ἔλαβεν Δαυιδ χαλκὸν πολὺν σφόδρα ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἐποίησεν Σαλωμων τὴν θάλασσαν τὴν χαλκῆν καὶ τοὺς στύλους καὶ τὰ σκεύη τὰ χαλκᾶ

text_en: Now when you king of Hemath heard that David had defeated all the army of Adarezer king of Soba,
text_la: Quod cum audisset Thou rex Hemath, percussisse videlicet David omnem exercitum Adarezer regis Soba,
text_pt: E ouvindo Toí, rei de Hamate, que Davi destruíra todo o exército de Hadar-Ezer, rei de Zobá,
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Θωα βασιλεὺς Ημαθ ὅτι ἐπάταξεν Δαυιδ τὴν πᾶσαν δύναμιν Αδρααζαρ βασιλέως Σουβα

text_en: he sent Adoram his son to King David to desire peace of him, and to congratulate him that he had defeated and overthrown Adarezer: for you were an enemy to Adarezer.
text_la: misit Adoram filium suum ad regem David, ut postularet ab eo pacem, et congratularetur ei quod percussisset et expugnasset Adarezer : adversarius quippe erat Thou Adarezer.
text_pt: Mandou seu filho Hadorão a Davi, para lhe perguntar como estava, e para o abençoar, por haver pelejado contra Hadar-Ezer, e por havê-lo ferido (porque Hadar-Ezer fazia guerra a Toí), enviando-lhe também toda a sorte de vasos de ouro, e de prata, e de cobre.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸν Ιδουραμ υἱὸν αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα Δαυιδ τοῦ ἐρωτῆσαι αὐτὸν τὰ εἰς εἰρήνην καὶ τοῦ εὐλογῆσαι αὐτὸν ὑπὲρ οὗ ἐπολέμησεν τὸν Αδρααζαρ καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτόν ὅτι ἀνὴρ πολέμιος Θωα ἦν τῷ Αδρααζαρ καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη ἀργυρᾶ καὶ χρυσᾶ

text_en: And all the vessels of gold, and silver and brass King David consecrated to the Lord , with the silver and gold which he had taken from all the nations, as well from Edom , and from Moab , and from the sons of Ammon , as from the Philistines , and from Amalec .
text_la: Sed et omnia vasa aurea, et argentea, et ænea consecravit David rex Domino, cum argento et auro quod tulerat ex universis gentibus, tam de Idumæa, et Moab, et filiis Ammon, quam de Philisthiim et Amalec.
text_pt: Os quais Davi também consagrou ao Senhor, juntamente com a prata e ouro que trouxera de todas as demais nações: dos edomeus, e dos moabitas, e dos filhos de Amom, e dos filisteus, e dos amalequitas.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα ἡγίασεν Δαυιδ τῷ κυρίῳ μετὰ τοῦ ἀργυρίου καὶ τοῦ χρυσίου οὗ ἔλαβεν ἐκ πάντων τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐξ Ιδουμαίας καὶ Μωαβ καὶ ἐξ υἱῶν Αμμων καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων καὶ ἐξ Αμαληκ

text_en: And Abisai the son of Sarvia slew of the Edomites in the vale of the saltpits, eighteen thousand:
text_la: Abisai vero filius Sarviæ percussit Edom in valle Salinarum, decem et octo millia:
text_pt: Também Abisai, filho de Zeruia, feriu a dezoito mil edomeus no Vale do Sal.
text_el: καὶ Αβεσσα υἱὸς Σαρουια ἐπάταξεν τὴν Ιδουμαίαν ἐν κοιλάδι τῶν ἁλῶν ὀκτὼ καὶ δέκα χιλιάδας

text_en: And he put a garrison in Edom , that Edom should serve David : and the Lord preserved David in all things to which he went.
text_la: et constituit in Edom præsidium, ut serviret Idumæa David : salvavitque Dominus David in cunctis ad quæ perrexerat.
text_pt: E pôs guarnições em Edom, e todos os edomeus ficaram por servos de Davi; e o Senhor guardava a Davi, por onde quer que ia.
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι φρουράς καὶ ἦσαν πάντες οἱ Ιδουμαῖοι παῖδες Δαυιδ καὶ ἔσῳζεν κύριος τὸν Δαυιδ ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐπορεύετο

text_en: So David reigned over all Israel , and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
text_la: Regnavit ergo David super universum Israël, et faciebat judicium atque justitiam cuncto populo suo.
text_pt: E Davi reinou sobre todo o Israel; e fazia juízo e justiça a todo o seu povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Δαυιδ ἐπὶ πάντα Ισραηλ καὶ ἦν ποιῶν κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνην τῷ παντὶ λαῷ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Joab the son of Sarvia was over the army, and Josaphat the son of Ahilud recorder.
text_la: Porro Joab filius Sarviæ erat super exercitum, et Josaphat filius Ahilud a commentariis:
text_pt: E Joabe, filho de Zeruia, comandava o exército; Jeosafá, filho de Ailude, era cronista.
text_el: καὶ Ιωαβ υἱὸς Σαρουια ἐπὶ τῆς στρατιᾶς καὶ Ιωσαφατ υἱὸς Αχιλουδ ὑπομνηματογράφος

text_en: And Sadoc the son of Achitob, and Achimelech the son of Abiathar , were the priests : and Susa, scribe.
text_la: Sadoc autem filius Achitob, et Ahimelech filius Abiathar, sacerdotes : et Susa, scriba:
text_pt: E Zadoque, filho de Aitube, e Abimeleque, filho de Abiatar, eram sacerdotes; e Savsa escrivão.
text_el: καὶ Σαδωκ υἱὸς Αχιτωβ καὶ Αχιμελεχ υἱὸς Αβιαθαρ ἱερεῖς καὶ Σουσα γραμματεὺς

text_en: And Banaias the son of Joiada was over the bands of the Cerethi, and the Phelethi: and the sons of David were chief about the king.
text_la: Banaias quoque filius Jojadæ super legiones Cerethi et Phelethi : porro filii David, primi ad manum regis.
text_pt: E Benaia, filho de Joiada, estava sobre os quereteus e peleteus; porém os filhos de Davi eram os primeiros junto ao rei.
text_el: καὶ Βαναιας υἱὸς Ιωδαε ἐπὶ τοῦ χερεθθι καὶ τοῦ φελεθθι καὶ υἱοὶ Δαυιδ οἱ πρῶτοι διάδοχοι τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: Now it came to pass that Naas the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
text_la: Accidit autem ut moreretur Naas rex filiorum Ammon, et regnaret filius ejus pro eo.
text_pt: E aconteceu, depois disto que Naás, rei dos filhos de Amom, morreu; e seu filho reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ταῦτα ἀπέθανεν Ναας βασιλεὺς υἱῶν Αμμων καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Αναν υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And David said: I will show kindness to Hanon the son of Naas: for his father did a favour tome. And David sent messengers to comfort him upon the death of his father. But when they had come into the land of the children of Ammon , to comfort Hanon,
text_la: Dixitque David : Faciam misericordiam cum Hanon filio Naas : præstitit enim mihi pater ejus gratiam. Misitque David nuntios ad consolandum eum super morte patris sui. Qui cum pervenissent in terram filiorum Ammon ut consolarentur Hanon,
text_pt: Então disse Davi: Usarei de benevolência com Hanum, filho de Naás, porque seu pai usou de benevolência comigo. Por isso Davi enviou mensageiros para o consolarem acerca de seu pai. E, chegando os servos de Davi à terra dos filhos de Amom, a Hanum, para o consolarem,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ ποιήσω ἔλεος μετὰ Αναν υἱοῦ Ναας ὡς ἐποίησεν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ μετ' ἐμοῦ ἔλεος καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ἀγγέλους Δαυιδ τοῦ παρακαλέσαι αὐτὸν περὶ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἦλθον παῖδες Δαυιδ εἰς γῆν υἱῶν Αμμων τοῦ παρακαλέσαι αὐτόν

text_en: the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanon: You think perhaps that David to do honour to your father has sent comforters to you: and you do not take notice, that his servants have come to you to consider, and search, and spy out your land.
text_la: dixerunt principes filiorum Ammon ad Hanon : Tu forsitan putas, quod David honoris causa in patrem tuum miserit qui consolentur te : nec animadvertis quod ut explorent, et investigent, et scrutentur terram tuam, venerint ad te servi ejus.
text_pt: Disseram os príncipes dos filhos de Amom a Hanum: Pensas porventura, que foi para honrar teu pai aos teus olhos, que Davi te mandou consoladores? Não vieram seus servos a ti, a esquadrinhar, e a transtornar, e a espiar a terra?
text_el: καὶ εἶπον ἄρχοντες Αμμων πρὸς Αναν μὴ δοξάζων Δαυιδ τὸν πατέρα σου ἐναντίον σου ἀπέστειλέν σοι παρακαλοῦντας οὐχ ὅπως ἐξερευνήσωσιν τὴν πόλιν τοῦ κατασκοπῆσαι τὴν γῆν ἦλθον παῖδες αὐτοῦ πρὸς σέ

text_en: Wherefore Hanon shaved the heads and beards of the servants of David , and cut away their garments from the buttocks to the feet, and sent them away.
text_la: Igitur Hanon pueros David decalvavit, et rasit, et præcidit tunicas eorum a natibus usque ad pedes, et dimisit eos.
text_pt: Por isso Hanum tomou os servos de Davi, e raspou-os, e cortou-lhes as vestes no meio até à coxa da perna, e os despediu.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Αναν τοὺς παῖδας Δαυιδ καὶ ἐξύρησεν αὐτοὺς καὶ ἀφεῖλεν τῶν μανδυῶν αὐτῶν τὸ ἥμισυ ἕως τῆς ἀναβολῆς καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτούς

text_en: And when they had gone, they sent word to David , who sent to meet them (for they had suffered a great affront) and ordered them to stay at Jericho till their beards grew and then to return.
text_la: Qui cum abiissent, et hoc mandassent David, misit in occursum eorum (grandem enim contumeliam sustinuerant) et præcepit ut manerent in Jericho, donec cresceret barba eorum, et tunc reverterentur.
text_pt: E foram-se, e avisaram a Davi acerca daqueles homens; e enviou ele mensageiros a encontrá-los; porque aqueles homens estavam sobremaneira envergonhados. Disse, pois, o rei: Deixai-vos ficar em Jericó, até que vos torne a crescer a barba, e então voltai.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον ἀπαγγεῖλαι τῷ Δαυιδ περὶ τῶν ἀνδρῶν καὶ ἀπέστειλεν εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἦσαν ἠτιμωμένοι σφόδρα καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς καθίσατε ἐν Ιεριχω ἕως τοῦ ἀνατεῖλαι τοὺς πώγωνας ὑμῶν καὶ ἀνακάμψατε

text_en: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had done an injury to David , Hanon and the rest of the people sent a thousand talents of silver, to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia and out of Syria Maacha, and out of Soba.
text_la: Videntes autem filii Ammon quod injuriam fecissent David, tam Hanon quam reliquus populus, miserunt mille talenta argenti, ut conducerent sibi de Mesopotamia, et de Syria Maacha, et de Soba currus et equites.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, os filhos de Amom que se tinham feito odiosos para com Davi, enviou Hanum, e os filhos de Amom, mil talentos de prata para alugarem para si carros e cavaleiros da Mesopotâmia, e da Síria de Maaca, e de Zobá.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων ὅτι ᾐσχύνθη λαὸς Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Αναν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων χίλια τάλαντα ἀργυρίου τοῦ μισθώσασθαι ἑαυτοῖς ἐκ Συρίας Μεσοποταμίας καὶ ἐκ Συρίας Μοοχα καὶ ἐκ Σωβα ἅρματα καὶ ἱππεῖς

text_en: And they hired two and thirty thousand chariots, and the king of Maacha, with his people. And they came and camped over against Medaba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together out of their cities, and came to battle.
text_la: Conduxeruntque triginta duo millia curruum, et regem Maacha cum populo ejus. Qui cum venissent, castrametati sunt e regione Medaba. Filii quoque Ammon congregati de urbibus suis venerunt ad bellum.
text_pt: E alugaram para si trinta e dois mil carros, e o rei de Maaca e o seu povo, e eles vieram, e se acamparam diante de Medeba; também os filhos de Amom se ajuntaram das suas cidades, e vieram para a guerra.
text_el: καὶ ἐμισθώσαντο ἑαυτοῖς δύο καὶ τριάκοντα χιλιάδας ἁρμάτων καὶ τὸν βασιλέα Μωχα καὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἦλθον καὶ παρενέβαλον κατέναντι Μαιδαβα καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων συνήχθησαν ἐκ τῶν πόλεων αὐτῶν καὶ ἦλθον εἰς τὸ πολεμῆσαι

text_en: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the army of valiant men :
text_la: Quod cum audisset David, misit Joab, et omnem exercitum virorum fortium:
text_pt: O que ouvindo Davi, enviou Joabe e todo o exército dos homens valentes.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸν Ιωαβ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν στρατιὰν τῶν δυνατῶν

text_en: And the children of Ammon came out and put their army in array before the gate of the city: and the kings, that had come to their aid, stood apart in the field.
text_la: egressique filii Ammon, direxerunt aciem juxta portam civitatis; reges autem, qui ad auxilium ejus venerant, separatim in agro steterunt.
text_pt: E, saindo os filhos de Amom, ordenaram a batalha à porta da cidade; porém os reis que vieram se puseram à parte no campo.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων καὶ παρατάσσονται εἰς πόλεμον παρὰ τὸν πυλῶνα τῆς πόλεως καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς οἱ ἐλθόντες παρενέβαλον καθ' ἑαυτοὺς ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ

text_en: Wherefore Joab understanding that the battle was set against him before and behind, chose out the bravest men of all Israel , and marched against the Syrians ,
text_la: Igitur Joab, intelligens bellum ex adverso et post tergum contra se fieri, elegit viros fortissimos de universo Israël, et perrexit contra Syrum.
text_pt: E, vendo Joabe que a batalha estava preparada contra ele, pela frente e pela retaguarda, separou dentre os mais escolhidos de Israel, e os ordenou contra os sírios.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Ιωαβ ὅτι γεγόνασιν ἀντιπρόσωποι τοῦ πολεμεῖν πρὸς αὐτὸν κατὰ πρόσωπον καὶ ἐξόπισθεν καὶ ἐξελέξατο ἐκ παντὸς νεανίου ἐξ Ισραηλ καὶ παρετάξαντο ἐναντίον τοῦ Σύρου

text_en: and the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abisai his brother, and they went against the children of Ammon .
text_la: Reliquam autem partem populi dedit sub manu Abisai fratris sui : et perrexerunt contra filios Ammon.
text_pt: E o resto do povo entregou na mão de Abisai, seu irmão; e puseram-se em ordem de batalha contra os filhos de Amom.
text_el: καὶ τὸ κατάλοιπον τοῦ λαοῦ ἔδωκεν ἐν χειρὶ Αβεσσα ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ παρετάξαντο ἐξ ἐναντίας υἱῶν Αμμων

text_en: And he said: If the Syrians be too strong for me, then you shall help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for you, I will help you.
text_la: Dixitque : Si vicerit me Syrus, auxilio eris mihi : si autem superaverint te filii Ammon, ero tibi in præsidium.
text_pt: E disse: Se os sírios forem mais fortes do que eu, tu virás socorrer-me; e, se os filhos de Amom forem mais fortes do que tu, então eu te socorrerei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἐὰν κρατήσῃ ὑπὲρ ἐμὲ Σύρος καὶ ἔσῃ μοι εἰς σωτηρίαν καὶ ἐὰν υἱοὶ Αμμων κρατήσωσιν ὑπὲρ σέ καὶ σώσω σε

text_en: Be of good courage and let us behave ourselves manfully for our people, and for the cities of our God : and the Lord will do that which is good in his sight.
text_la: Confortare, et agamus viriliter pro populo nostro, et pro urbibus Dei nostri : Dominus autem, quod in conspectu suo bonum est, faciet.
text_pt: Esforça-te, e esforcemo-nos pelo nosso povo, e pelas cidades do nosso Deus, e faça o Senhor o que parecer bem aos seus olhos.
text_el: ἀνδρίζου καὶ ἐνισχύσωμεν περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ περὶ τῶν πόλεων τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ κύριος τὸ ἀγαθὸν ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ ποιήσει

text_en: So Joab and the people that were with him, went against the Syrians to the battle: and he put them to flight.
text_la: Perrexit ergo Joab et populus qui cum eo erat, contra Syrum ad prælium : et fugavit eos.
text_pt: Então se chegou Joabe, e o povo que tinha consigo, diante dos sírios, para a batalha; e fugiram de diante dele.
text_el: καὶ παρετάξατο Ιωαβ καὶ ὁ λαὸς ὁ μετ' αὐτοῦ κατέναντι Σύρων εἰς πόλεμον καὶ ἔφυγον ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the children of Ammon seeing that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled from Abisai his brother, and went into the city: and Joab also returned to Jerusalem .
text_la: Porro filii Ammon videntes quod fugisset Syrus, ipsi quoque fugerunt Abisai fratrem ejus, et ingressi sunt civitatem : reversusque est etiam Joab in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, os filhos de Amom que os sírios fugiram, também eles fugiram de diante de Abisai, seu irmão, e entraram na cidade; e veio Joabe para Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Αμμων εἶδον ὅτι ἔφυγον Σύροι καὶ ἔφυγον καὶ αὐτοὶ ἀπὸ προσώπου Ιωαβ καὶ ἀπὸ προσώπου Αβεσσα τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ ἦλθεν Ιωαβ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: But the Syrians seeing that they had fallen before Israel , sent messengers, and brought to them the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Sophach, general of the army of Adarezer, was their leader.
text_la: Videns autem Syrus quod cecidisset coram Israël, misit nuntios, et adduxit Syrum, qui erat trans fluvium : Sophach autem princeps militiæ Adarezer erat dux eorum.
text_pt: E, vendo os sírios que foram derrotados diante de Israel, enviaram mensageiros, e fizeram sair os sírios que habitavam do outro lado do rio; e Sofaque, capitão do exército de Hadar-Ezer, marchava diante deles.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Σύρος ὅτι ἐτροπώσατο αὐτὸν Ισραηλ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ἀγγέλους καὶ ἐξήγαγον τὸν Σύρον ἐκ τοῦ πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ Σωφαχ ἀρχιστράτηγος δυνάμεως Αδρααζαρ ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν

text_en: And it was told David , and he gathered together all Israel , and passed the Jordan , and came upon them, and put his army in array against them, and they fought with him.
text_la: Quod cum nuntiatum esset David, congregavit universum Israël, et transivit Jordanem, irruitque in eos et direxit ex adverso aciem, illis contra pugnantibus.
text_pt: Do que avisado Davi, ajuntou a todo o Israel, e passou o Jordão, e foi ter com eles, e ordenou contra eles a batalha; e, tendo Davi ordenado a batalha contra os sírios, pelejaram contra ele.
text_el: καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Δαυιδ καὶ συνήγαγεν τὸν πάντα Ισραηλ καὶ διέβη τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ ἦλθεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ παρετάξατο ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ παρατάσσεται Σύρος ἐξ ἐναντίας Δαυιδ καὶ ἐπολέμησαν αὐτόν

text_en: But the Syrian fled before Israel : and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and Sophach the general of the army.
text_la: Fugit autem Syrus Israël, et interfecit David de Syris septem millia curruum, et quadraginta millia peditum, et Sophach exercitus principem.
text_pt: Porém os sírios fugiram de diante de Israel, e feriu Davi, dos sírios, os homens de sete mil carros, e quarenta mil homens de pé; e a Sofaque, capitão do exército, matou.
text_el: καὶ ἔφυγεν Σύρος ἀπὸ προσώπου Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν Δαυιδ ἀπὸ τοῦ Σύρου ἑπτὰ χιλιάδας ἁρμάτων καὶ τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδας πεζῶν καὶ τὸν Σωφαχ ἀρχιστράτηγον δυνάμεως ἀπέκτεινεν

text_en: And when the servants of Adarezer saw themselves overcome by Israel , they went over to David , and served him: and Syria would not help the children of Ammon any more.
text_la: Videntes autem servi Adarezer se ab Israël esse superatos, transfugerunt ad David, et servierunt ei : noluitque ultra Syria auxilium præbere filiis Ammon.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, os servos de Hadar-Ezer que tinham sido feridos diante de Israel, fizeram paz com Davi, e o serviram; e os sírios nunca mais quiseram socorrer os filhos de Amom.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον παῖδες Αδρααζαρ ὅτι ἐπταίκασιν ἀπὸ προσώπου Ισραηλ καὶ διέθεντο μετὰ Δαυιδ καὶ ἐδούλευσαν αὐτῷ καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν Σύρος τοῦ βοηθῆσαι τοῖς υἱοῖς Αμμων ἔτι

text_en: And it came to pass after the course of a year, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab gathered together an army and the strength of the troops, and wasted the land of the children of Ammon : and went and besieged Rabba. But David stayed at Jerusalem , when Joab smote Rabba, and destroyed it.
text_la: Factum est autem post anni circulum, eo tempore quo solent reges ad bella procedere, congregavit Joab exercitum, et robur militiæ, et vastavit terram filiorum Ammon : perrexitque et obsedit Rabba. Porro David manebat in Jerusalem, quando Joab percussit Rabba et destruxit eam.
text_pt: Aconteceu que, no decurso de um ano, no tempo em que os reis costumam sair para a guerra, Joabe levou o exército, e destruiu a terra dos filhos de Amom, e veio, e cercou a Rabá; porém Davi ficou em Jerusalém; e Joabe feriu a Rabá, e a destruiu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐπιόντι ἔτει ἐν τῇ ἐξόδῳ τῶν βασιλέων καὶ ἤγαγεν Ιωαβ πᾶσαν τὴν δύναμιν τῆς στρατιᾶς καὶ ἔφθειραν τὴν χώραν υἱῶν Αμμων καὶ ἦλθεν καὶ περιεκάθισεν τὴν Ραββα καὶ Δαυιδ ἐκάθητο ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐπάταξεν Ιωαβ τὴν Ραββα καὶ κατέσκαψεν αὐτήν

text_en: And David took the crown of Melchom from his head, and found in it a talent weight of gold, and most precious stones , and he made himself a diadem of it: he took also the spoils of the city which were very great.
text_la: Tulit autem David coronam Melchom de capite ejus, et invenit in ea auri pondo talentum, et pretiosissimas gemmas, fecitque sibi inde diadema : manubias quoque urbis plurimas tulit;
text_pt: E Davi tirou a coroa da cabeça do rei deles, e achou nela o peso de um talento de ouro, e havia nela pedras preciosas; e foi posta sobre a cabeça de Davi; e levou da cidade mui grande despojo.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Δαυιδ τὸν στέφανον Μολχολ βασιλέως αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ εὑρέθη ὁ σταθμὸς αὐτοῦ τάλαντον χρυσίου καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ λίθος τίμιος καὶ ἦν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Δαυιδ καὶ σκῦλα τῆς πόλεως ἐξήνεγκεν πολλὰ σφόδρα

text_en: And the people that were therein he brought out: and made harrows, and sleds, and chariots of iron to go over them, so that they were cut and bruised to pieces: in this manner David dealt with all the cities of the children of Ammon : and he returned with all his people to Jerusalem .
text_la: populum autem, qui erat in ea, eduxit, et fecit super eos tribulas, et trahas, et ferrata carpenta transire, ita ut dissecarentur et contererentur. Sic fecit David cunctis urbibus filiorum Ammon : et reversus est cum omni populo suo in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Também levou o povo que estava nela, e os fez trabalhar com a serra, e com talhadeiras de ferro e com machados; e assim fez Davi com todas as cidades dos filhos de Amom; então voltou Davi, com todo o povo, para Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ τὸν λαὸν τὸν ἐν αὐτῇ ἐξήγαγεν καὶ διέπρισεν πρίοσιν καὶ ἐν σκεπάρνοις σιδηροῖς καὶ οὕτως ἐποίησεν Δαυιδ τοῖς πᾶσιν υἱοῖς Αμμων καὶ ἀνέστρεψεν Δαυιδ καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς αὐτοῦ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: After this there arose a war at Gazer against the Philistines : in which Sabachai the Husathite slew Saphai of the race of Raphaim, and humbled them.
text_la: Post hæc initum est bellum in Gazer adversum Philisthæos, in quo percussit Sobochai Husathites, Saphai de genere Raphaim, et humiliavit eos.
text_pt: E, depois disto, aconteceu que, levantando-se guerra em Gezer, com os filisteus, então Sibecai, o husatita, feriu a Sipai, dos filhos do gigante; e ficaram subjugados.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἐγένετο ἔτι πόλεμος ἐν Γαζερ μετὰ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων τότε ἐπάταξεν Σοβοχαι ὁ Ουσαθι τὸν Σαφου ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν τῶν γιγάντων καὶ ἐταπείνωσεν αὐτόν

text_en: Another battle also was fought against the Philistines , in which Adeodatus the son of Saltus a Bethlehemite slew the brother of Goliath the Gethite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.
text_la: Aliud quoque bellum gestum est adversus Philisthæos, in quo percussit Adeodatus filius Saltus Bethlehemites fratrem Goliath Gethæi, cujus hastæ lignum erat quasi liciatorium texentium.
text_pt: E tornou a haver guerra com os filisteus; e El-Hanã, filho de Jair, feriu a Lami, irmão de Golias, o giteu, cuja haste da lança era como órgão de tecelão.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἔτι πόλεμος μετὰ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων καὶ ἐπάταξεν Ελλαναν υἱὸς Ιαϊρ τὸν Λεεμι ἀδελφὸν Γολιαθ τοῦ Γεθθαίου καὶ ξύλον δόρατος αὐτοῦ ὡς ἀντίον ὑφαινόντων

text_en: There was another battle also in Geth, in which there was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand and foot: who also was born of the stock of Rapha.
text_la: Sed et aliud bellum accidit in Geth, in quo fuit homo longissimus, senos habens digitos, id est, simul viginti quatuor : qui et ipse de Rapha fuerat stirpe generatus.
text_pt: E houve ainda outra guerra em Gate; onde havia um homem de grande estatura, e tinha vinte e quatro dedos, seis em cada mão, e seis em cada pé, e que também era filho do gigante.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἔτι πόλεμος ἐν Γεθ καὶ ἦν ἀνὴρ ὑπερμεγέθης καὶ δάκτυλοι αὐτοῦ ἓξ καὶ ἕξ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες καὶ οὗτος ἦν ἀπόγονος γιγάντων

text_en: He reviled Israel : but Jonathan the son of Samaa the brother of David slew him.
text_la: Hic blasphemavit Israël : et percussit eum Jonathan filius Samaa fratris David.
text_pt: E injuriou a Israel; porém Jônatas, filho de Simei, irmão de Davi, o feriu;
text_el: καὶ ὠνείδισεν τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν Ιωναθαν υἱὸς Σαμαα ἀδελφοῦ Δαυιδ

text_en: These were the sons of Rapha in Geth, who fell by the hand of David and his servants.
text_la: Hi sunt filii Rapha in Geth, qui ceciderunt in manu David et servorum ejus.
text_pt: Estes nasceram ao gigante em Gate; e caíram pela mão de Davi e pela mão dos seus servos.
text_el: οὗτοι ἐγένοντο Ραφα ἐν Γεθ πάντες ἦσαν τέσσαρες γίγαντες καὶ ἔπεσον ἐν χειρὶ Δαυιδ καὶ ἐν χειρὶ παίδων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Satan rose up against Israel : and moved David to number Israel .
text_la: Consurrexit autem Satan contra Israël, et concitavit David ut numeraret Israël.
text_pt: Então Satanás se levantou contra Israel, e incitou Davi a numerar a Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔστη διάβολος ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπέσεισεν τὸν Δαυιδ τοῦ ἀριθμῆσαι τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And David said to Joab, and to the rulers of the people: Go, and number Israel from Bersabee even to Dan , and bring me the number of them that I may know it.
text_la: Dixitque David ad Joab et ad principes populi : Ite, et numerate Israël a Bersabee usque Dan : et afferte mihi numerum ut sciam.
text_pt: E disse Davi a Joabe e aos maiorais do povo: Ide, numerai a Israel, desde Berseba até Dã; e trazei-me a conta para que saiba o número deles.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ πρὸς Ιωαβ καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῆς δυνάμεως πορεύθητε ἀριθμήσατε τὸν Ισραηλ ἀπὸ Βηρσαβεε καὶ ἕως Δαν καὶ ἐνέγκατε πρός με καὶ γνώσομαι τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν

text_en: And Joab answered: The Lord make his people a hundred times more than they are: but, my lord the king, are they not all your servants: why does my lord seek this thing, which may be imputed as a sin to Israel ?
text_la: Responditque Joab : Augeat Dominus populum suum centuplum quam sunt : nonne, domine mi rex, omnes servi tui sunt? quare hoc quærit dominus meus, quod in peccatum reputetur Israëli?
text_pt: Então disse Joabe: O SENHOR acrescente ao seu povo cem vezes tanto como é; porventura, ó rei meu senhor, não são todos servos de meu senhor? Por que procura isto o meu senhor? Porque seria isto causa de delito para com Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωαβ προσθείη κύριος ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ὡς αὐτοὶ ἑκατονταπλασίως καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ κυρίου μου τοῦ βασιλέως βλέποντες πάντες τῷ κυρίῳ μου παῖδες ἵνα τί ζητεῖ ὁ κύριός μου τοῦτο ἵνα μὴ γένηται εἰς ἁμαρτίαν τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: But the king's word rather prevailed: and Joab departed, and went through all Israel : and returned to Jerusalem .
text_la: Sed sermo regis magis prævaluit : egressusque est Joab, et circuivit universum Israël : et reversus est Jerusalem,
text_pt: Porém a palavra do rei prevaleceu contra Joabe; por isso saiu Joabe, e passou por todo o Israel; então voltou para Jerusalém.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ῥῆμα τοῦ βασιλέως ἐκραταιώθη ἐπὶ τῷ Ιωαβ καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ιωαβ καὶ διῆλθεν ἐν παντὶ ὁρίῳ Ισραηλ καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And he gave David the number of them, whom he had surveyed: and all the number of Israel was found to be eleven hundred thousand men that drew the sword: and of Juda four hundred and seventy thousand fighting men .
text_la: deditque David numerum eorum quos circuierat : et inventus est omnis numerus Israël, mille millia et centum millia virorum educentium gladium : de Juda autem quadringenta septuaginta millia bellatorum.
text_pt: E Joabe deu a Davi a soma do número do povo; e era todo o Israel um milhão e cem mil homens, dos que arrancavam da espada; e de Judá quatrocentos e setenta mil homens, dos que arrancavam da espada.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν Ιωαβ τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῆς ἐπισκέψεως τοῦ λαοῦ τῷ Δαυιδ καὶ ἦν πᾶς Ισραηλ χίλιαι χιλιάδες καὶ ἑκατὸν χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν ἐσπασμένων μάχαιραν καὶ Ιουδας τετρακόσιαι καὶ ὀγδοήκοντα χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν ἐσπασμένων μάχαιραν

text_en: But Levi and Benjamin he did not number: for Joab unwillingly executed the king's orders.
text_la: Nam Levi et Benjamin non numeravit : eo quod Joab invitus exsequeretur regis imperium.
text_pt: Porém os de Levi e Benjamim não contou entre eles, porque a palavra do rei foi abominável a Joabe.
text_el: καὶ τὸν Λευι καὶ τὸν Βενιαμιν οὐκ ἠρίθμησεν ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν ὅτι κατίσχυσεν λόγος τοῦ βασιλέως τὸν Ιωαβ

text_en: And God was displeased with this thing that was commanded: and he struck Israel .
text_la: Displicuit autem Deo quod jussum erat : et percussit Israël.
text_pt: E este negócio também pareceu mau aos olhos de Deus; por isso feriu a Israel.
text_el: καὶ πονηρὸν ἐφάνη ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ περὶ τοῦ πράγματος τούτου καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And David said to God : I have sinned exceedingly in doing this: I beseech you take away the iniquity of your servant, for I have done foolishly.
text_la: Dixitque David ad Deum : Peccavi nimis ut hoc facerem : obsecro, aufer iniquitatem servi tui, quia insipienter egi.
text_pt: Então disse Davi a Deus: Gravemente pequei em fazer este negócio; porém agora sê servido tirar a iniqüidade de teu servo, porque procedi mui loucamente.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς τὸν θεόν ἡμάρτηκα σφόδρα ὅτι ἐποίησα τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο καὶ νῦν περίελε δὴ τὴν κακίαν παιδός σου ὅτι ἐματαιώθην σφόδρα

text_en: And the Lord spoke to Gad the seer of David , saying:
text_la: Et locutus est Dominus ad Gad videntem Davidis, dicens:
text_pt: Falou, pois, o Senhor a Gade, o vidente de Davi, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν κύριος πρὸς Γαδ ὁρῶντα Δαυιδ λέγων

text_en: Go, and speak to David , and tell him: Thus says the Lord : I give you the choice of three things: choose one which you will, and I will do it to you.
text_la: Vade, et loquere ad David, et dic ei : Hæc dicit Dominus : Trium tibi optionem do : unum, quod volueris, elige, et faciam tibi.
text_pt: Vai, e fala a Davi, dizendo: Assim diz o Senhor: Três coisas te proponho; escolhe uma delas, para que eu ta faça.
text_el: πορεύου καὶ λάλησον πρὸς Δαυιδ λέγων οὕτως λέγει κύριος τρία αἴρω ἐγὼ ἐπὶ σέ ἔκλεξαι σεαυτῷ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν καὶ ποιήσω σοι

text_en: And when Gad had come to David , he said to him: Thus says the Lord : choose which you will:
text_la: Cumque venisset Gad ad David, dixit ei : Hæc dicit Dominus : Elige, quod volueris:
text_pt: E Gade veio a Davi, e lhe disse: Assim diz o Senhor: Escolhe para ti,
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Γαδ πρὸς Δαυιδ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ οὕτως λέγει κύριος ἔκλεξαι σεαυτῷ

text_en: Either three years famine: or three months to flee from your enemies, and not to be able to escape their sword: or three days to have the sword of the Lord , and pestilence in the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying in all the coasts of Israel : now therefore see what I shall answer him who sent me.
text_la: aut tribus annis famem; aut tribus mensibus te fugere hostes tuos, et gladium eorum non posse evadere; aut tribus diebus gladium Domini, et pestilentiam versari in terra, et angelum Domini interficere in universis finibus Israël : nunc igitur vide quid respondeam ei qui misit me.
text_pt: Ou três anos de fome, ou que três meses sejas consumido diante dos teus adversários, e a espada de teus inimigos te alcance, ou que três dias a espada do Senhor, isto é, a peste na terra, e o anjo do Senhor destrua todos os termos de Israel; vê, pois, agora, que resposta hei de levar a quem me enviou.
text_el: ἢ τρία ἔτη λιμοῦ ἢ τρεῖς μῆνας φεύγειν σε ἐκ προσώπου ἐχθρῶν σου καὶ μάχαιραν ἐχθρῶν σου τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι ἢ τρεῖς ἡμέρας ῥομφαίαν κυρίου καὶ θάνατον ἐν τῇ γῇ καὶ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐξολεθρεύων ἐν πάσῃ κληρονομίᾳ Ισραηλ καὶ νῦν ἰδὲ τί ἀποκριθῶ τῷ ἀποστείλαντί με λόγον

text_en: And David said to Gad : I am on every side in a great strait: but it is better for me to fall into the hands of the Lord , for his mercies are many, than into the hands of men .
text_la: Et dixit David ad Gad : Ex omni parte me angustiæ premunt : sed melius mihi est ut incidam in manus Domini, quia multæ sunt miserationes ejus, quam in manus hominum.
text_pt: Então disse Davi a Gade: Estou em grande angústia; caia eu, pois, nas mãos do Senhor, porque são muitíssimas as suas misericórdias; mas que eu não caia nas mãos dos homens.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Γαδ στενά μοι καὶ τὰ τρία σφόδρα ἐμπεσοῦμαι δὴ εἰς χεῖρας κυρίου ὅτι πολλοὶ οἱ οἰκτιρμοὶ αὐτοῦ σφόδρα καὶ εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων οὐ μὴ ἐμπέσω

text_en: So the Lord sent a pestilence upon Israel . And there fell of Israel seventy thousand men .
text_la: Misit ergo Dominus pestilentiam in Israël : et ceciderunt de Israël septuaginta millia virorum.
text_pt: Mandou, pois, o Senhor a peste a Israel; e caíram de Israel setenta mil homens.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν κύριος θάνατον ἐν Ισραηλ καὶ ἔπεσον ἐξ Ισραηλ ἑβδομήκοντα χιλιάδες ἀνδρῶν

text_en: And he sent an angel to Jerusalem , to strike it: and as he was striking it, the Lord beheld, and took pity for the greatness of the evil : and said to the angel that destroyed: It is enough, now stop your hand. And the angel of the Lord stood by the thrashingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
text_la: Misit quoque angelum in Jerusalem ut percuteret eam : cumque percuteretur, vidit Dominus, et misertus est super magnitudine mali : et imperavit angelo qui percutiebat : Sufficit, jam cesset manus tua. Porro angelus Domini stabat juxta aream Ornan Jebusæi.
text_pt: E Deus mandou um anjo a Jerusalém para a destruir; e, destruindo-a ele, o Senhor olhou, e se arrependeu daquele mal, e disse ao anjo destruidor: Basta, agora retira a tua mão. E o anjo do Senhor estava junto à eira de Ornã, o jebuseu.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς ἄγγελον εἰς Ιερουσαλημ τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι αὐτήν καὶ ὡς ἐξωλέθρευσεν εἶδεν κύριος καὶ μετεμελήθη ἐπὶ τῇ κακίᾳ καὶ εἶπεν τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῷ ἐξολεθρεύοντι ἱκανούσθω σοι ἄνες τὴν χεῖρά σου καὶ ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἑστὼς ἐν τῷ ἅλῳ Ορνα τοῦ Ιεβουσαίου

text_en: And David lifting up his eyes, saw the angel of the Lord standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand, turned against Jerusalem : and both he and the ancients clothed in haircloth, fell down flat on the ground.
text_la: Levansque David oculos suos, vidit angelum Domini stantem inter cælum et terram, et evaginatum gladium in manu ejus, et versum contra Jerusalem : et ceciderunt tam ipse quam majores natu, vestiti ciliciis, proni in terram.
text_pt: E, levantando Davi os seus olhos, viu o anjo do Senhor, que estava entre a terra e o céu, com a sua espada desembainhada na sua mão estendida contra Jerusalém; então Davi e os anciãos, cobertos de sacos, se prostraram sobre os seus rostos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπῆρεν Δαυιδ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶδεν τὸν ἄγγελον κυρίου ἑστῶτα ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς γῆς καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἡ ῥομφαία αὐτοῦ ἐσπασμένη ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ἐκτεταμένη ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἔπεσεν Δαυιδ καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι περιβεβλημένοι ἐν σάκκοις ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν

text_en: And David said to God : Am not I he that commanded the people to be numbered? It is I that have sinned : it is I that have done the evil : but as for this flock, what has it deserved? O Lord my God , let your hand be turned, I beseech you, upon me, and upon my father's house: and let not your people be destroyed.
text_la: Dixitque David ad Deum : Nonne ego sum, qui jussi ut numeraretur populus? ego, qui peccavi? ego, qui malum feci? iste grex, quid commeruit? Domine Deus meus, vertatur, obsecro, manus tua in me, et in domum patris mei : populus autem tuus non percutiatur.
text_pt: E disse Davi a Deus: Não sou eu o que disse que se contasse o povo? E eu mesmo sou o que pequei, e fiz muito mal; mas estas ovelhas que fizeram? Ah! Senhor, meu Deus, seja a tua mão contra mim, e contra a casa de meu pai, e não para castigo de teu povo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς τὸν θεόν οὐκ ἐγὼ εἶπα τοῦ ἀριθμῆσαι ἐν τῷ λαῷ καὶ ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἁμαρτών κακοποιῶν ἐκακοποίησα καὶ ταῦτα τὰ πρόβατα τί ἐποίησαν κύριε ὁ θεός γενηθήτω ἡ χείρ σου ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ μὴ ἐν τῷ λαῷ σου εἰς ἀπώλειαν κύριε

text_en: And the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to tell David , to go up, and build an altar to the Lord God in the thrashingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
text_la: Angelus autem Domini præcepit Gad ut diceret Davidi ut ascenderet, exstrueretque altare Domino Deo in area Ornan Jebusæi.
text_pt: Então o anjo do Senhor ordenou a Gade que dissesse a Davi para subir e levantar um altar ao Senhor na eira de Ornã, o jebuseu.
text_el: καὶ ἄγγελος κυρίου εἶπεν τῷ Γαδ τοῦ εἰπεῖν πρὸς Δαυιδ ἵνα ἀναβῇ τοῦ στῆσαι θυσιαστήριον τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν ἅλῳ Ορνα τοῦ Ιεβουσαίου

text_en: And David went up, according to the word of Gad , which he spoke to him in the name of the Lord .
text_la: Ascendit ergo David juxta sermonem Gad, quem locutus ei fuerat ex nomine Domini.
text_pt: Subiu, pois, Davi, conforme a palavra de Gade, que falara em nome do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη Δαυιδ κατὰ τὸν λόγον Γαδ ὃν ἐλάλησεν ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου

text_en: Now when Ornan looked up, and saw the angel , he and his four sons hid themselves: for at that time he was thrashing wheat in the floor.
text_la: Porro Ornan cum suspexisset et vidisset angelum, quatuorque filii ejus cum eo, absconderunt se : nam eo tempore terebat in area triticum.
text_pt: E, virando-se Ornã, viu o anjo, e esconderam-se seus quatro filhos que estavam com ele; e Ornã estava trilhando o trigo.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν Ορνα καὶ εἶδεν τὸν βασιλέα καὶ τέσσαρες υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ μεθαχαβιν καὶ Ορνα ἦν ἀλοῶν πυρούς

text_en: And as David was coming to Ornan, Ornan saw him, and went out of the thrashingfloor to meet him, and bowed down to him with his face to the ground.
text_la: Igitur cum veniret David ad Ornan, conspexit eum Ornan, et processit ei obviam de area, et adoravit eum pronus in terram.
text_pt: E Davi veio a Ornã; e olhou Ornã, e viu a Davi, e saiu da eira, e se prostrou perante Davi com o rosto em terra.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Ορναν καὶ Ορνα ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τῆς ἅλω καὶ προσεκύνησεν τῷ Δαυιδ τῷ προσώπῳ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And David said to him: Give me this place of your thrashingfloor, that I may build therein an altar to the Lord : but you shall take of me as much money as it is worth, that the plague may cease from the people.
text_la: Dixitque ei David : Da mihi locum areæ tuæ, ut ædificem in ea altare Domino : ita ut quantum valet argenti accipias, et cesset plaga a populo.
text_pt: E disse Davi a Ornã: Dá-me este lugar da eira, para edificar nele um altar ao Senhor; dá-mo pelo seu valor, para que cesse este castigo sobre o povo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ πρὸς Ορνα δός μοι τὸν τόπον σου τῆς ἅλω καὶ οἰκοδομήσω ἐπ' αὐτῷ θυσιαστήριον τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν ἀργυρίῳ ἀξίῳ δός μοι αὐτόν καὶ παύσεται ἡ πληγὴ ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ

text_en: And Ornan said to David : Take it, and let my lord the king do all that pleases him: and moreover the oxen also I give for a holocaust , and the drays for wood, and the wheat for the sacrifice : I will give it all willingly.
text_la: Dixit autem Ornan ad David : Tolle, et faciat dominus meus rex quodcumque ei placet : sed et boves do in holocaustum, et tribulas in ligna, et triticum in sacrificium : omnia libens præbebo.
text_pt: Então disse Ornã a Davi: Toma-o para ti, e faça o rei meu senhor dele o que parecer bem aos seus olhos; eis que dou os bois para holocaustos, e os trilhos para lenha, e o trigo para oferta de alimentos; tudo dou.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ορνα πρὸς Δαυιδ λαβὲ σεαυτῷ καὶ ποιησάτω ὁ κύριός μου ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸ ἀγαθὸν ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ἰδὲ δέδωκα τοὺς μόσχους εἰς ὁλοκαύτωσιν καὶ τὸ ἄροτρον καὶ τὰς ἁμάξας εἰς ξύλα καὶ τὸν σῖτον εἰς θυσίαν τὰ πάντα δέδωκα

text_en: And King David said to him: It shall not be so, but I will give you money as much as it is worth: for I must not take it from you, and so offer to the Lord holocausts free cost.
text_la: Dixitque ei rex David : Nequaquam ita fiet, sed argentum dabo quantum valet : neque enim tibi auferre debeo, et sic offerre Domino holocausta gratuita.
text_pt: E disse o rei Davi a Ornã: Não, antes, pelo seu valor, a quero comprar; porque não tomarei o que é teu, para o Senhor, para que não ofereça holocausto sem custo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυιδ τῷ Ορνα οὐχί ὅτι ἀγοράζων ἀγοράζω ἐν ἀργυρίῳ ἀξίῳ ὅτι οὐ μὴ λάβω ἅ ἐστίν σοι κυρίῳ τοῦ ἀνενέγκαι ὁλοκαύτωσιν δωρεὰν κυρίῳ

text_en: So David gave to Ornan for the place, six hundred sicles of gold of just weight.
text_la: Dedit ergo David Ornan pro loco siclos auri justissimi ponderis sexcentos.
text_pt: E Davi deu a Ornã, por aquele lugar, o peso de seiscentos siclos de ouro.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν Δαυιδ τῷ Ορνα ἐν τῷ τόπῳ αὐτοῦ σίκλους χρυσίου ὁλκῆς ἑξακοσίους

text_en: And he built there an altar to the Lord : and he offered holocausts , and peace offerings , and he called upon the Lord , and he heard him by sending fire from heaven upon the altar of the holocaust .
text_la: Et ædificavit ibi altare Domino, obtulitque holocausta et pacifica, et invocavit Dominum; et exaudivit eum in igne de cælo super altare holocausti.
text_pt: Então Davi edificou ali um altar ao Senhor, e ofereceu nele holocaustos e sacrifícios pacíficos; e invocou o Senhor, o qual lhe respondeu com fogo do céu sobre o altar do holocausto.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν Δαυιδ ἐκεῖ θυσιαστήριον κυρίῳ καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ σωτηρίου καὶ ἐβόησεν πρὸς κύριον καὶ ἐπήκουσεν αὐτῷ ἐν πυρὶ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τῆς ὁλοκαυτώσεως καὶ κατανάλωσεν τὴν ὁλοκαύτωσιν

text_en: And the Lord commanded the angel : and he put up his sword again into the sheath.
text_la: Præcepitque Dominus angelo, et convertit gladium suum in vaginam.
text_pt: E o Senhor deu ordem ao anjo, e ele tornou a sua espada à bainha.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς τὸν ἄγγελον καὶ κατέθηκεν τὴν ῥομφαίαν εἰς τὸν κολεόν

text_en: And David seeing that the Lord had heard him in the thrashingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, forthwith offered victims there.
text_la: Protinus ergo David, videns quod exaudisset eum Dominus in area Ornan Jebusæi, immolavit ibi victimas.
text_pt: Vendo Davi, no mesmo tempo, que o Senhor lhe respondera na eira de Ornã, o jebuseu, sacrificou ali.
text_el: ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἐν τῷ ἰδεῖν τὸν Δαυιδ ὅτι ἐπήκουσεν αὐτῷ κύριος ἐν τῷ ἅλῳ Ορνα τοῦ Ιεβουσαίου καὶ ἐθυσίασεν ἐκεῖ

text_en: But the tabernacle of the Lord , which Moses made in the desert , and the altar of holocausts , was at that time in the high place of Gabaon.
text_la: Tabernaculum autem Domini, quod fecerat Moyses in deserto, et altare holocaustorum, ea tempestate erat in excelso Gabaon.
text_pt: Porque o tabernáculo do Senhor, que Moisés fizera no deserto, e o altar do holocausto, estavam naquele tempo no alto de Gibeom.
text_el: καὶ σκηνὴ κυρίου ἣν ἐποίησεν Μωυσῆς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ θυσιαστήριον τῶν ὁλοκαυτωμάτων ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἐν Βαμα ἐν Γαβαων

text_en: And David could not go to the altar there to pray to God : for he was seized with an exceeding great fear, seeing the sword of the angel of the Lord .
text_la: Et non prævaluit David ire ad altare ut ibi obsecraret Deum : nimio enim fuerat in timore perterritus, videns gladium angeli Domini.
text_pt: E não podia Davi ir perante ele consultar a Deus; porque estava aterrorizado por causa da espada do anjo do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠδύνατο Δαυιδ τοῦ πορευθῆναι ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ τοῦ ζητῆσαι τὸν θεόν ὅτι κατέσπευσεν ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς ῥομφαίας ἀγγέλου κυρίου

text_en: Then David said: This is the house of God , And this is the altar for the holocaust of Israel .
text_la: Dixitque David : Hæc est domus Dei, et hoc altare in holocaustum Israëli.
text_pt: E disse Davi: Esta será a casa do SENHOR Deus, e este será o altar do holocausto para Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ οἶκος κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦτο τὸ θυσιαστήριον εἰς ὁλοκαύτωσιν τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: And he commanded to gather together all the proselytes of the land of Israel , and out of them he appointed stonecutters to hew stones and polish them, to build the house of God .
text_la: Et præcepit ut congregarentur omnes proselyti de terra Israël, et constituit ex eis latomos ad cædendos lapides et poliendos, ut ædificaretur domus Dei.
text_pt: E deu ordem Davi que se ajuntassem os estrangeiros que estavam na terra de Israel; e ordenou cortadores de pedras, para que lavrassem pedras de cantaria, para edificar a casa de Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ συναγαγεῖν πάντας τοὺς προσηλύτους ἐν γῇ Ισραηλ καὶ κατέστησεν λατόμους λατομῆσαι λίθους ξυστοὺς τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι οἶκον τῷ θεῷ

text_en: And David prepared in abundance iron for the nails of the gates, and for the closures and joinings: and of brass an immense weight.
text_la: Ferrum quoque plurimum ad clavos januarum, et ad commissuras atque juncturas, præparavit David : et æris pondus innumerabile.
text_pt: E aparelhou Davi ferro em abundância, para os pregos das portas das entradas, e para as junturas; como também cobre em abundância, que não foi pesado;
text_el: καὶ σίδηρον πολὺν εἰς τοὺς ἥλους τῶν θυρωμάτων καὶ τῶν πυλῶν καὶ τοὺς στροφεῖς ἡτοίμασεν Δαυιδ καὶ χαλκὸν εἰς πλῆθος οὐκ ἦν σταθμός

text_en: And the cedar trees were without number, which the Sidonians , and Tyrians brought to David .
text_la: Ligna quoque cedrina non poterant æstimari, quæ Sidonii et Tyrii deportaverant ad David.
text_pt: E madeira de cedro sem conta; porque os sidônios e tírios traziam a Davi madeira de cedro em abundância.
text_el: καὶ ξύλα κέδρινα οὐκ ἦν ἀριθμός ὅτι ἐφέροσαν οἱ Σιδώνιοι καὶ οἱ Τύριοι ξύλα κέδρινα εἰς πλῆθος τῷ Δαυιδ

text_en: And David said: Solomon my son is very young and tender, and the house which I would have to be built to the Lord , must be such as to be renowned in all countries: therefore I will prepare him necessaries. And therefore before his death he prepared all the charges.
text_la: Et dixit David : Solomon filius meus puer parvulus est et delicatus : domus autem, quam ædificari volo Domino, talis esse debet ut in cunctis regionibus nominetur : præparabo ergo ei necessaria. Et ob hanc causam ante mortem suam omnes præparavit impensas.
text_pt: Porque dizia Davi: Salomão, meu filho, ainda é moço e tenro, e a casa que se há de edificar para o Senhor deve ser magnífica em excelência, para nome e glória em todas as terras; eu, pois, agora lhe prepararei materiais. Assim preparou Davi materiais em abundância, antes da sua morte.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ Σαλωμων ὁ υἱός μου παιδάριον ἁπαλόν καὶ ὁ οἶκος τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι τῷ κυρίῳ εἰς μεγαλωσύνην ἄνω εἰς ὄνομα καὶ εἰς δόξαν εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἑτοιμάσω αὐτῷ καὶ ἡτοίμασεν Δαυιδ εἰς πλῆθος ἔμπροσθεν τῆς τελευτῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he called for Solomon his son: and commanded him to build a house to the Lord the God of Israel .
text_la: Vocavitque Salomonem filium suum, et præcepit ei ut ædificaret domum Domino Deo Israël.
text_pt: Então chamou a Salomão seu filho, e lhe ordenou que edificasse uma casa ao Senhor Deus de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Σαλωμων τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι τὸν οἶκον τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: And David said to Solomon : My son, it was my desire to have built a house to the name of the Lord my God .
text_la: Dixitque David ad Salomonem : Fili mi, voluntatis meæ fuit ut ædificarem domum nomini Domini Dei mei:
