text_pt: E disse Davi a Salomão: Filho meu, quanto a mim, tive em meu coração o propósito de edificar uma casa ao nome do Senhor meu Deus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυιδ Σαλωμων τέκνον ἐμοὶ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ ψυχῇ τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι οἶκον τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου θεοῦ

text_en: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying: You have shed much blood, and fought many battles, so you cannot not build house to my name , after shedding so much blood before me:
text_la: sed factus est sermo Domini ad me, dicens : Multum sanguinem effudisti, et plurima bella bellasti : non poteris ædificare domum nomini meo, tanto effuso sanguine coram me:
text_pt: Porém, veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo: Tu derramaste sangue em abundância, e fizeste grandes guerras; não edificarás casa ao meu nome; porquanto muito sangue tens derramado na terra, perante mim.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐπ' ἐμοὶ λόγος κυρίου λέγων αἷμα εἰς πλῆθος ἐξέχεας καὶ πολέμους μεγάλους ἐποίησας οὐκ οἰκοδομήσεις οἶκον τῷ ὀνόματί μου ὅτι αἵματα πολλὰ ἐξέχεας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐναντίον μου

text_en: The son, that shall be born to you, shall be a most quiet man : for I will make him rest from all his enemies round about: and therefore he shall be called Peaceable: and I will give peace and quietness to Israel all his days.
text_la: filius qui nascetur tibi, erit vir quietissimus : faciam enim eum requiescere ab omnibus inimicis suis per circuitum : et ob hanc causam Pacificus vocabitur : et pacem et otium dabo in Israël cunctis diebus ejus.
text_pt: Eis que o filho que te nascer será homem de repouso; porque repouso lhe hei de dar de todos os seus inimigos ao redor; portanto, Salomão será o seu nome, e paz e descanso darei a Israel nos seus dias.
text_el: ἰδοὺ υἱὸς τίκτεταί σοι οὗτος ἔσται ἀνὴρ ἀναπαύσεως καὶ ἀναπαύσω αὐτὸν ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν κυκλόθεν ὅτι Σαλωμων ὄνομα αὐτῷ καὶ εἰρήνην καὶ ἡσυχίαν δώσω ἐπὶ Ισραηλ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ

text_en: He shall build a house to my name , and he shall be a son to me, and I will be a father to him: and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
text_la: Ipse ædificabit domum nomini meo, et ipse erit mihi in filium, et ego ero illi in patrem : firmaboque solium regni ejus super Israël in æternum.
text_pt: Ele edificará uma casa ao meu nome, e me será por filho, e eu lhe serei por pai, e confirmarei o trono de seu reino sobre Israel, para sempre.
text_el: οὗτος οἰκοδομήσει οἶκον τῷ ὀνόματί μου καὶ οὗτος ἔσται μοι εἰς υἱὸν κἀγὼ αὐτῷ εἰς πατέρα καὶ ἀνορθώσω θρόνον βασιλείας αὐτοῦ ἐν Ισραηλ ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: Now then, my son, the Lord be with you, and prosper, and build the house to the Lord your God , as he has spoken of you.
text_la: Nunc ergo fili mi, sit Dominus tecum, et prosperare, et ædifica domum Domino Deo tuo sicut locutus est de te.
text_pt: Agora, pois, meu filho, o Senhor seja contigo; e prospera, e edifica a casa do Senhor teu Deus, como ele disse de ti.
text_el: καὶ νῦν υἱέ μου ἔσται μετὰ σοῦ κύριος καὶ εὐοδώσει καὶ οἰκοδομήσεις οἶκον τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ σου ὡς ἐλάλησεν περὶ σοῦ

text_en: The Lord also give you wisdom and understanding, that you may be able to rule Israel , and to keep the law of the Lord your God .
text_la: Det quoque Dominus prudentiam et sensum ut regere possis Israël, et custodire legem Domini Dei tui.
text_pt: O Senhor te dê tão-somente prudência e entendimento, e te instrua acerca de Israel; e isso para guardar a lei do Senhor teu Deus.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ δῴη σοι σοφίαν καὶ σύνεσιν κύριος καὶ κατισχύσαι σε ἐπὶ Ισραηλ καὶ τοῦ φυλάσσεσθαι καὶ τοῦ ποιεῖν τὸν νόμον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου

text_en: For then you shall be able to prosper, if you keep the commandments, and judgments, which the Lord commanded Moses to teach Israel : take courage and act manfully, fear not, nor be dismayed.
text_la: Tunc enim proficere poteris, si custodieris mandata et judicia quæ præcepit Dominus Moysi ut doceret Israël. Confortare, et viriliter age : ne timeas, neque paveas.
text_pt: Então prosperarás, se tiveres cuidado de cumprir os estatutos e os juízos, que o Senhor mandou a Moisés acerca de Israel; esforça-te, e tem bom ânimo; não temas, nem tenhas pavor.
text_el: τότε εὐοδώσει ἐὰν φυλάξῃς τοῦ ποιεῖν τὰ προστάγματα καὶ τὰ κρίματα ἃ ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ ἐπὶ Ισραηλ ἀνδρίζου καὶ ἴσχυε μὴ φοβοῦ μηδὲ πτοηθῇς

text_en: Behold I in my poverty have prepared the charges of the house of the Lord , of gold a hundred thousand talents, and of silver a million of talents: but of brass, and of iron there is no weight, for the abundance surpasses all account: timber also and stones I have prepared for all the charges.
text_la: Ecce ego in paupertate mea præparavi impensas domus Domini, auri talenta centum millia, et argenti mille millia talentorum : æris vero et ferri non est pondus, vincitur enim numerus magnitudine; ligna et lapides præparavi ad universa impendia.
text_pt: Eis que na minha aflição preparei para a casa do Senhor cem mil talentos de ouro, e um milhão de talentos de prata, e de cobre e de ferro que não se pesou, porque era em abundância; também madeira e pedras preparei, e tu suprirás o que faltar.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ κατὰ τὴν πτωχείαν μου ἡτοίμασα εἰς οἶκον κυρίου χρυσίου ταλάντων ἑκατὸν χιλιάδας καὶ ἀργυρίου ταλάντων χιλίας χιλιάδας καὶ χαλκὸν καὶ σίδηρον οὗ οὐκ ἔστιν σταθμός ὅτι εἰς πλῆθός ἐστιν καὶ ξύλα καὶ λίθους ἡτοίμασα καὶ πρὸς ταῦτα πρόσθες

text_en: You have also workmen in abundance, hewers of stones, and masons, and carpenters, and of all trades the most skilful in their work,
text_la: Habes quoque plurimos artifices, latomos, et cæmentarios, artificesque lignorum, et omnium artium ad faciendum opus prudentissimos,
text_pt: Também tens contigo obreiros em grande número, cortadores e artífices em obra de pedra e madeira; e toda a sorte de peritos em toda a espécie de obra.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ σοῦ εἰς πλῆθος ποιούντων ἔργα τεχνῖται καὶ οἰκοδόμοι λίθων καὶ τέκτονες ξύλων καὶ πᾶς σοφὸς ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ

text_en: in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, whereof there is no number. Arise then, and be doing, and the Lord will be with you.
text_la: in auro et argento et ære et ferro, cujus non est numerus. Surge igitur et fac, et erit Dominus tecum.
text_pt: Do ouro, da prata, e do cobre, e do ferro não há conta. Levanta-te, pois, e faze a obra, e o Senhor seja contigo.
text_el: ἐν χρυσίῳ ἐν ἀργυρίῳ ἐν χαλκῷ καὶ ἐν σιδήρῳ οὐκ ἔστιν ἀριθμός ἀνάστηθι καὶ ποίει καὶ κύριος μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: David also charged all the princes of Israel , to help Solomon his son,
text_la: Præcepit quoque David cunctis principibus Israël ut adjuvarent Salomonem filium suum:
text_pt: E Davi deu ordem a todos os príncipes de Israel que ajudassem a Salomão, seu filho, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο Δαυιδ τοῖς πᾶσιν ἄρχουσιν Ισραηλ ἀντιλαβέσθαι τῷ Σαλωμων υἱῷ αὐτοῦ

text_en: saying: You see, that the Lord your God is with you, and has given you rest round about, and has delivered all your enemies into your hands, and the land is subdued before the Lord , and before his people.
text_la: Cernitis, inquiens, quod Dominus Deus vester vobiscum sit, et dederit vobis requiem per circuitum, et tradiderit omnes inimicos vestros in manus vestras, et subjecta sit terra coram Domino, et coram populo ejus.
text_pt: Porventura não está convosco o Senhor vosso Deus, e não vos deu repouso ao redor? Porque entregou na minha mão os moradores da terra; e a terra foi sujeita perante o Senhor e perante o seu povo.
text_el: οὐχὶ κύριος μεθ' ὑμῶν καὶ ἀνέπαυσεν ὑμᾶς κυκλόθεν ὅτι ἔδωκεν ἐν χερσὶν τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν καὶ ὑπετάγη ἡ γῆ ἐναντίον κυρίου καὶ ἐναντίον λαοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Give therefore your hearts and your souls , to seek the Lord your God and arise, and build a sanctuary to the Lord God , that the ark of the covenant of the Lord , and the vessels consecrated to the Lord , may be brought into the house, which is built to the name of the Lord .
text_la: Præbete igitur corda vestra et animas vestras, ut quæratis Dominum Deum vestrum : et consurgite, et ædificate sanctuarium Domino Deo, ut introducatur arca fœderis Domini, et vasa Domino consecrata, in domum quæ ædificatur nomini Domini.
text_pt: Disponde, pois, agora o vosso coração e a vossa alma para buscardes ao Senhor vosso Deus; e levantai-vos, e edificai o santuário do Senhor Deus, para que a arca da aliança do Senhor, e os vasos sagrados de Deus se tragam a esta casa, que se há de edificar ao nome do Senhor.
text_el: νῦν δότε καρδίας ὑμῶν καὶ ψυχὰς ὑμῶν τοῦ ζητῆσαι τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ ὑμῶν καὶ ἐγέρθητε καὶ οἰκοδομήσατε ἁγίασμα κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ ὑμῶν τοῦ εἰσενέγκαι τὴν κιβωτὸν διαθήκης κυρίου καὶ σκεύη τὰ ἅγια τοῦ θεοῦ εἰς οἶκον τὸν οἰκοδομούμενον τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου

text_en: David being old and full of days, made Solomon his son king over Israel .
text_la: Igitur David, senex et plenus dierum, regem constituit Salomonem filium suum super Israël.
text_pt: Sendo, pois, Davi já velho, e cheio de dias, fez a Salomão, seu filho, rei sobre Israel.
text_el: καὶ Δαυιδ πρεσβύτης καὶ πλήρης ἡμερῶν καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Σαλωμων τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel , and the priests and Levites .
text_la: Et congregavit omnes principes Israël, et sacerdotes atque Levitas.
text_pt: E reuniu a todos os príncipes de Israel, como também aos sacerdotes e levitas.
text_el: καὶ συνήγαγεν τοὺς πάντας ἄρχοντας Ισραηλ καὶ τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ τοὺς Λευίτας

text_en: And the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years, and upwards: and there were found of them thirty-eight thousand men .
text_la: Numeratique sunt Levitæ a triginta annis et supra: et inventa sunt triginta octo millia virorum.
text_pt: E foram contados os levitas de trinta anos para cima; e foi o número deles, segundo as suas cabeças, trinta e oito mil homens.
text_el: καὶ ἠριθμήθησαν οἱ Λευῖται ἀπὸ τριακονταετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν εἰς ἄνδρας τριάκοντα καὶ ὀκτὼ χιλιάδας

text_en: Of these twenty-four thousand were chosen, and distributed unto the ministry of the house of the Lord : and six thousand were the overseers and judges.
text_la: Ex his electi sunt, et distributi in ministerium domus Domini, viginti quatuor millia : præpositorum autem et judicum, sex millia.
text_pt: Destes havia vinte e quatro mil, para promoverem a obra da casa do Senhor, e seis mil oficiais e juízes,
text_el: ἀπὸ τούτων ἐργοδιῶκται ἐπὶ τὰ ἔργα οἴκου κυρίου εἴκοσι τέσσαρες χιλιάδες καὶ γραμματεῖς καὶ κριταὶ ἑξακισχίλιοι

text_en: Moreover four thousand were porters: and as many singers singing to the Lord with the instruments, which he had made to sing with.
text_la: Porro quatuor millia janitores, et totidem psaltæ, canentes Domino in organis quæ fecerat ad canendum.
text_pt: E quatro mil porteiros, e quatro mil para louvarem ao Senhor com os instrumentos, que eu fiz para o louvar, disse Davi.
text_el: καὶ τέσσαρες χιλιάδες πυλωροὶ καὶ τέσσαρες χιλιάδες αἰνοῦντες τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν τοῖς ὀργάνοις οἷς ἐποίησεν τοῦ αἰνεῖν τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: And David distributed them into courses by the families of the sons of Levi , to wit, of Gerson, and of Caath, and of Merari.
text_la: Et distribuit eos David per vices filiorum Levi, Gerson videlicet, et Caath, et Merari.
text_pt: E Davi os repartiu por turnos, segundo os filhos de Levi, Gérson, Coate e Merari.
text_el: καὶ διεῖλεν αὐτοὺς Δαυιδ ἐφημερίας τοῖς υἱοῖς Λευι τῷ Γεδσων Κααθ Μεραρι

text_en: The sons of Gerson were Leedan and Semei.
text_la: Filii Gerson : Leedan, et Semei.
text_pt: Dos gersonitas: Ladã e Simei.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Παροσωμ τῷ Εδαν καὶ τῷ Σεμεϊ

text_en: The sons of Leedan: the chief Jahiel, and Zethan, and Joel, three.
text_la: Filii Leedan : princeps Jahiel, et Zethan, et Joël, tres.
text_pt: Os filhos de Ladã: Jeiel, o chefe, e Zetã, e Joel, três.
text_el: υἱοὶ τῷ Εδαν ὁ ἄρχων Ιιηλ καὶ Ζεθομ καὶ Ιωηλ τρεῖς

text_en: The sons of Semei: Salomith, and Hosiel, and Aran, three: these were the heads of the families of Leedan.
text_la: Filii Semei : Salomith, et Hosiel, et Aran, tres : isti principes familiarum Leedan.
text_pt: Os filhos de Simei: Selomite, Haziel, e Harã, três; estes foram os chefes dos pais de Ladã.
text_el: υἱοὶ Σεμεϊ Σαλωμιθ καὶ Ιιηλ καὶ Αιδαν τρεῖς οὗτοι ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν τῷ Εδαν

text_en: And the sons of Semei were Leheth, and Ziza, and Jaus, and Baria: these were the sons of Semei, four.
text_la: Porro filii Semei : Leheth, et Ziza, et Jaus, et Baria : isti filii Semei, quatuor.
text_pt: E os filhos de Simei: Jaate, Ziza, Jeús, e Berias; estes foram os filhos de Simei, quatro.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Σεμεϊ Ιεθ καὶ Ζιζα καὶ Ιωας καὶ Βερια οὗτοι υἱοὶ Σεμεϊ τέσσαρες

text_en: And Leheth was the first, Ziza the second: but Jaus and Baria had not many children, and therefore they were counted in one family , and in one house.
text_la: Erat autem Leheth prior, Ziza secundus : porro Jaus et Baria non habuerunt plurimos filios, et idcirco in una familia, unaque domo computati sunt.
text_pt: E Jaate era o chefe, e Ziza o segundo, mas Jeús e Berias não tiveram muitos filhos; por isso estes, sendo contados juntos se tornaram uma só família.
text_el: καὶ ἦν Ιεθ ὁ ἄρχων καὶ Ζιζα ὁ δεύτερος καὶ Ιωας καὶ Βερια οὐκ ἐπλήθυναν υἱοὺς καὶ ἐγένοντο εἰς οἶκον πατριᾶς εἰς ἐπίσκεψιν μίαν

text_en: The sons of Caath were Amram, and Isaar, Hebron , and Oziel, four.
text_la: Filii Caath : Amram, et Isaar, Hebron, et Oziel, quatuor.
text_pt: Os filhos de Coate: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom, e Uziel, quatro.
text_el: υἱοὶ Κααθ Αμβραμ Ισσααρ Χεβρων Οζιηλ τέσσαρες

text_en: The sons of Amram, Aaron , and Moses . And Aaron was separated to minister in the holy of holies, he and his sons for ever, and to burn incense before the Lord , according to his ceremonies , and to bless his name for ever.
text_la: Filii Amram : Aaron et Moyses. Separatusque est Aaron ut ministraret in Sancto sanctorum, ipse et filii ejus in sempiternum, et adoleret incensum Domino secundum ritum suum, ac benediceret nomini ejus in perpetuum.
text_pt: Os filhos de Anrão: Arão e Moisés; e Arão foi separado para santificar o santo dos santos, ele e seus filhos, eternamente; para incensar diante do Senhor, para o servirem, e para darem a bênção em seu nome eternamente.
text_el: υἱοὶ Αμβραμ Ααρων καὶ Μωυσῆς καὶ διεστάλη Ααρων τοῦ ἁγιασθῆναι ἅγια ἁγίων αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος τοῦ θυμιᾶν ἐναντίον τοῦ κυρίου λειτουργεῖν καὶ ἐπεύχεσθαι ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: The sons also of Moses , the man of God , were numbered in the tribe of Levi .
text_la: Moysi quoque hominis Dei filii annumerati sunt in tribu Levi.
text_pt: E, quanto a Moisés, homem de Deus, seus filhos foram contados entre os da tribo de Levi.
text_el: καὶ Μωυσῆς ἄνθρωπος τοῦ θεοῦ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐκλήθησαν εἰς φυλὴν τοῦ Λευι

text_en: The sons of Moses were Gersom and Eliezer:
text_la: Filii Moysi: Gersom et Eliezer.
text_pt: Foram, pois, os filhos de Moisés, Gérson e Eliézer.
text_el: υἱοὶ Μωυσῆ Γηρσαμ καὶ Ελιεζερ

text_en: The sons of Gersom: Subuel the first.
text_la: Filii Gersom : Subuel primus.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Gérson foi Sebuel o chefe.
text_el: υἱοὶ Γηρσαμ Σουβαηλ ὁ ἄρχων

text_en: And the sons of Eliezer were: Rohobia the first: and Eliezer had no more sons. But the sons of Rohobia were multiplied exceedingly.
text_la: Fuerunt autem filii Eliezer : Rohobia primus : et non erant Eliezer filii alii. Porro filii Rohobia multiplicati sunt nimis.
text_pt: E, quanto aos filhos de Eliézer, foi Reabias o chefe; e Eliézer não teve outros filhos; porém os filhos de Reabias foram muitos.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν υἱοὶ τῷ Ελιεζερ Ρααβια ὁ ἄρχων καὶ οὐκ ἦσαν τῷ Ελιεζερ υἱοὶ ἕτεροι καὶ υἱοὶ Ρααβια ηὐξήθησαν εἰς ὕψος

text_en: The sons of Isaar: Salomith the first.
text_la: Filii Isaar : Salomith primus.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Izar foi Selomite o chefe.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ισσααρ Σαλωμωθ ὁ ἄρχων

text_en: The sons of Hebron : Jeriau the first, Amarias the second, Jahaziel the third, Jecmaam the fourth.
text_la: Filii Hebron : Jeriau primus, Amarias secundus, Jahaziel tertius, Jecmaam quartus.
text_pt: Quanto aos filhos de Hebrom, foram Jerias o primeiro, Amarias o segundo, Jaaziel o terceiro, e Jecameão o quarto.
text_el: υἱοὶ Χεβρων Ιδουδ ὁ ἄρχων Αμαδια ὁ δεύτερος Οζιηλ ὁ τρίτος Ικεμιας ὁ τέταρτος

text_en: The sons of Oziel: Micha the first, Jesia the second.
text_la: Filii Oziel : Micha primus, Jesia secundus.
text_pt: Quanto aos filhos de Uziel, Mica o chefe, e Issias o segundo.
text_el: υἱοὶ Οζιηλ Μιχας ὁ ἄρχων καὶ Ισια ὁ δεύτερος

text_en: The sons of Merari: Moholi, and Musi. The sons of Moholi: Eleazar and Cis.
text_la: Filii Merari : Moholi, et Musi. Filii Moholi : Eleazar et Cis.
text_pt: Os filhos de Merari: Mali, e Musi; os filhos de Mali: Eleazar e Quis.
text_el: υἱοὶ Μεραρι Μοολι καὶ Μουσι υἱοὶ Μοολι Ελεαζαρ καὶ Κις

text_en: And Eleazar died, and had no sons but daughters: and the sons of Cis their brethren took them.
text_la: Mortuus est autem Eleazar, et non habuit filios, sed filias : acceperuntque eas filii Cis fratres earum.
text_pt: E morreu Eleazar, e não teve filhos, porém filhas; e os filhos de Quis, seus parentes, as tomaram por mulheres.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ελεαζαρ καὶ οὐκ ἦσαν αὐτῷ υἱοὶ ἀλλ' ἢ θυγατέρες καὶ ἔλαβον αὐτὰς υἱοὶ Κις ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: The sons of Musi: Moholi, and Eder, and Jerimoth, three.
text_la: Filii Musi : Moholi, et Eder, et Jerimoth, tres.
text_pt: Os filhos de Musi: Mali, e Eder, e Jeremote, três.
text_el: υἱοὶ Μουσι Μοολι καὶ Εδερ καὶ Ιαριμωθ τρεῖς

text_en: These are the sons of Levi in their kindreds and families , princes by their courses, and the number of every head that did the works of the ministry of the house of the Lord from twenty years old and upward.
text_la: Hi filii Levi in cognationibus et familiis suis, principes per vices, et numerum capitum singulorum qui faciebant opera ministerii domus Domini, a viginti annis et supra.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Levi, segundo a casa de seus pais, chefes dos pais, conforme foram contados pelos seus nomes, segundo as suas cabeças, que faziam a obra do ministério da casa do Senhor, desde a idade de vinte anos para cima.
text_el: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Λευι κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν αὐτῶν κατὰ τὴν ἐπίσκεψιν αὐτῶν κατὰ τὸν ἀριθμὸν ὀνομάτων αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν ποιοῦντες τὰ ἔργα λειτουργίας οἴκου κυρίου ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω

text_en: For David said: The Lord the God of Israel has given rest to his people, and a habitation in Jerusalem for ever.
text_la: Dixit enim David : Requiem dedit Dominus Deus Israël populo suo, et habitationem Jerusalem usque in æternum.
text_pt: Porque disse Davi: O Senhor Deus de Israel deu repouso ao seu povo, e habitará em Jerusalém para sempre.
text_el: ὅτι εἶπεν Δαυιδ κατέπαυσεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ κατεσκήνωσεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: And it shall not be the office of the Levites to carry any more the tabernacle , and all the vessels for the service thereof.
text_la: Nec erit officii Levitarum ut ultra portent tabernaculum et omnia vasa ejus ad ministrandum.
text_pt: E também, quanto aos levitas, que nunca mais levassem o tabernáculo, nem algum de seus aparelhos pertencentes ao seu ministério.
text_el: καὶ οἱ Λευῖται οὐκ ἦσαν αἴροντες τὴν σκηνὴν καὶ τὰ πάντα σκεύη αὐτῆς εἰς τὴν λειτουργίαν αὐτῆς

text_en: So according to the last precepts of David , the sons of Levi are to be numbered from twenty years old and upward.
text_la: Juxta præcepta quoque David novissima, supputabitur numerus filiorum Levi a viginti annis et supra.
text_pt: Porque, segundo as últimas palavras de Davi, foram contados os filhos de Levi da idade de vinte anos para cima:
text_el: ὅτι ἐν τοῖς λόγοις Δαυιδ τοῖς ἐσχάτοις ἐστὶν ὁ ἀριθμὸς υἱῶν Λευι ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ ἐπάνω

text_en: And they are to be under the hand of the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord , in the porches, and in the chambers, and in the place of purification, and in the sanctuary, and in all the works of the ministry of the temple of the Lord .
text_la: Et erunt sub manu filiorum Aaron in cultum domus Domini, in vestibulis, et in exedris, et in loco purificationis, et in sanctuario, et in universis operibus ministerii templi Domini.
text_pt: Porque o seu cargo era assistir aos filhos de Arão no ministério da casa do Senhor, nos átrios, e nas câmaras, e na purificação de todas as coisas sagradas, e na obra do ministério da casa de Deus.
text_el: ὅτι ἔστησεν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ χεῖρα Ααρων τοῦ λειτουργεῖν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου ἐπὶ τὰς αὐλὰς καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ παστοφόρια καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν καθαρισμὸν τῶν πάντων ἁγίων καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ἔργα λειτουργίας οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And the priests have the charge of the loaves of proposition , and of the sacrifice of fine flour, and of the unleavened cakes , and of the frying pan, and of the roasting, and of every weight and measure.
text_la: Sacerdotes autem, super panes propositionis, et ad similæ sacrificium, et ad lagana azyma, et sartaginem, et ad torrendum, et super omne pondus atque mensuram.
text_pt: A saber: para os pães da proposição, e para a flor de farinha, para a oferta de alimentos, e para os coscorões ázimos, e para as sertãs, e para o tostado, e para todo o peso e medida;
text_el: εἰς τοὺς ἄρτους τῆς προθέσεως εἰς τὴν σεμίδαλιν τῆς θυσίας καὶ εἰς τὰ λάγανα τὰ ἄζυμα καὶ εἰς τήγανον καὶ εἰς τὴν πεφυραμένην καὶ εἰς πᾶν μέτρον

text_en: And the Levites are to stand in the morning to give thanks, and to sing praises to the Lord : and in like manner in the evening,
text_la: Levitæ vero ut stent mane ad confitendum et canendum Domino: similiterque ad vesperam,
text_pt: E para estarem cada manhã em pé para louvarem e celebrarem ao Senhor; e semelhantemente à tarde;
text_el: καὶ τοῦ στῆναι πρωὶ τοῦ αἰνεῖν ἐξομολογεῖσθαι τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ οὕτως τὸ ἑσπέρας

text_en: as well in the oblation of the holocausts of the Lord , as in the sabbaths and in the new moons, and the rest of the solemnities, according to the number and ceremonies prescribed for everything, continually before the Lord .
text_la: tam in oblatione holocaustorum Domini, quam in sabbatis et calendis et solemnitatibus reliquis juxta numerum et cæremonias uniuscujusque rei, jugiter coram Domino.
text_pt: E para oferecerem os holocaustos do Senhor, aos sábados, nas luas novas, e nas solenidades, segundo o seu número e costume, continuamente perante o Senhor;
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ πάντων τῶν ἀναφερομένων ὁλοκαυτωμάτων τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν τοῖς σαββάτοις καὶ ἐν ταῖς νεομηνίαις καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἑορταῖς κατὰ ἀριθμὸν κατὰ τὴν κρίσιν ἐπ' αὐτοῖς διὰ παντὸς τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: And let them keep the observances of the tabernacle of the covenant , and the ceremonies of the sanctuary, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, that they may minister in the house of the Lord .
text_la: Et custodiant observationes tabernaculi fœderis, et ritum sanctuarii, et observationem filiorum Aaron fratrum suorum, ut ministrent in domo Domini.
text_pt: E para que tivessem cuidado da guarda da tenda da congregação, e da guarda do santuário, e da guarda dos filhos de Arão, seus irmãos, no ministério da casa do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ φυλάξουσιν τὰς φυλακὰς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου καὶ τὰς φυλακὰς υἱῶν Ααρων ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν τοῦ λειτουργεῖν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου

text_en: Now these were the divisions of the sons of Aaron : The sons of Aaron : Nadab, and Abiu, and Eleazar , and Ithamar.
text_la: Porro filiis Aaron hæ partitiones erant. Filii Aaron : Nadab, et Abiu, et Eleazar, et Ithamar.
text_pt: E quanto aos filhos de Arão, estas foram as suas divisões: os filhos de Arão: Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ααρων διαιρέσεις υἱοὶ Ααρων Ναδαβ καὶ Αβιουδ Ελεαζαρ καὶ Ιθαμαρ

text_en: But Nadab and Abiu died before their father, and had no children: so Eleazar , and Ithamar did the office of the priesthood .
text_la: Mortui sunt autem Nadab et Abiu ante patrem suum absque liberis : sacerdotioque functus est Eleazar, et Ithamar.
text_pt: E morreram Nadabe e Abiú antes de seu pai, e não tiveram filhos; e Eleazar e Itamar administravam o sacerdócio.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ναδαβ καὶ Αβιουδ ἐναντίον τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν καὶ υἱοὶ οὐκ ἦσαν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἱεράτευσεν Ελεαζαρ καὶ Ιθαμαρ υἱοὶ Ααρων

text_en: And David distributed them, that is, Sadoc of the sons of Eleazar , and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their courses and ministry.
text_la: Et divisit eos David, id est, Sadoc de filiis Eleazari, et Ahimelech de filiis Ithamar, secundum vices suas et ministerium.
text_pt: E Davi, com Zadoque, dos filhos de Eleazar, e Aimeleque, dos filhos de Itamar, dividiu-os segundo o seu ofício no seu ministério.
text_el: καὶ διεῖλεν αὐτοὺς Δαυιδ καὶ Σαδωκ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ελεαζαρ καὶ Αχιμελεχ ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Ιθαμαρ κατὰ τὴν ἐπίσκεψιν αὐτῶν κατὰ τὴν λειτουργίαν αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And there were found many more of the sons of Eleazar among the principal men , than of the sons of Ithamar. And he divided them so, that there were of the sons of Eleazar , sixteen chief men by their families : and of the sons of Ithamar eight by their families and houses.
text_la: Inventique sunt multo plures filii Eleazar in principibus viris, quam filii Ithamar. Divisit autem eis, hoc est, filiis Eleazar, principes per familias sedecim : et filiis Ithamar per familias et domos suas octo.
text_pt: E acharam-se muito mais chefes dos pais entre os filhos de Eleazar do que entre os filhos de Itamar, quando os repartiram; dos filhos de Eleazar dezesseis chefes das casas paternas, mas dos filhos de Itamar, segundo as casas paternas, oito.
text_el: καὶ εὑρέθησαν υἱοὶ Ελεαζαρ πλείους εἰς ἄρχοντας τῶν δυνατῶν παρὰ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ιθαμαρ καὶ διεῖλεν αὐτούς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ελεαζαρ ἄρχοντας εἰς οἴκους πατριῶν ἓξ καὶ δέκα καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ιθαμαρ ὀκτὼ κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν

text_en: And he divided both the families one with the other by lot: for there were princes of the sanctuary, and princes of God , both of the sons of Eleazar , and of the sons of Ithamar.
text_la: Porro divisit utrasque inter se familias sortibus : erant enim principes sanctuarii, et principes Dei, tam de filiis Eleazar quam de filiis Ithamar.
text_pt: E os repartiram por sortes, uns com os outros; porque houve governadores do santuário e governadores da casa de Deus, assim dentre os filhos de Eleazar, como dentre os filhos de Itamar.
text_el: καὶ διεῖλεν αὐτοὺς κατὰ κλήρους τούτους πρὸς τούτους ὅτι ἦσαν ἄρχοντες τῶν ἁγίων καὶ ἄρχοντες κυρίου ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ελεαζαρ καὶ ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ιθαμαρ

text_en: And Semeias the son of Nathanael the scribe a Levite , wrote them down before the king and the princes, and Sadoc the priest , and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar , and the princes also of the priestly and Levitical families : one house, which was over the rest, of Eleazar : and another house, which had the rest under it, of Ithamar.
text_la: Descripsitque eos Semeias filius Nathanaël scriba Levites, coram rege et principibus, et Sadoc sacerdote, et Ahimelech filio Abiathar, principibus quoque familiarum sacerdotalium, et Leviticarum : unam domum, quæ ceteris præerat, Eleazar : et alteram domum, quæ sub se habebat ceteros, Ithamar.
text_pt: E Semaías, filho de Natanael, o escrivão dentre os levitas, os registrou perante o rei, e os príncipes, e Zadoque, o sacerdote, e Aimeleque, filho de Abiatar, e os chefes dos pais entre os sacerdotes, e entre os levitas; dentre as casas dos pais tomou-se uma para Eleazar, e outra para Itamar.
text_el: καὶ ἔγραψεν αὐτοὺς Σαμαιας υἱὸς Ναθαναηλ ὁ γραμματεὺς ἐκ τοῦ Λευι κατέναντι τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῶν ἀρχόντων καὶ Σαδωκ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ Αχιμελεχ υἱὸς Αβιαθαρ καὶ ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν τῶν ἱερέων καὶ τῶν Λευιτῶν οἴκου πατριᾶς εἷς εἷς τῷ Ελεαζαρ καὶ εἷς εἷς τῷ Ιθαμαρ

text_en: Now the first lot came forth to Joiarib, the second to Jedei,
text_la: Exivit autem sors prima Jojarib, secunda Jedei,
text_pt: E saiu a primeira sorte a Jeoiaribe, a segunda a Jedaías,
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος ὁ πρῶτος τῷ Ιαριβ τῷ Ιδεϊα ὁ δεύτερος

text_en: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
text_la: tertia Harim, quarta Seorim,
text_pt: A terceira a Harim, a quarta a Seorim,
text_el: τῷ Χαρημ ὁ τρίτος τῷ Σεωριμ ὁ τέταρτος

text_en: the fifth to Melchia, the sixth to Maiman,
text_la: quinta Melchia, sexta Maiman,
text_pt: A quinta a Malquias, a sexta a Miamim,
text_el: τῷ Μελχια ὁ πέμπτος τῷ Μιαμιν ὁ ἕκτος

text_en: the seventh to Accos, the eighth to Abia,
text_la: septima Accos, octava Abia,
text_pt: A sétima a Hacoz, a oitava a Abias,
text_el: τῷ Κως ὁ ἕβδομος τῷ Αβια ὁ ὄγδοος

text_en: the ninth to Jesua, the tenth to Sechenia,
text_la: nona Jesua, decima Sechenia,
text_pt: A nona a Jesua, a décima a Secanias,
text_el: τῷ Ἰησοῦ ὁ ἔνατος τῷ Σεχενια ὁ δέκατος

text_en: the eleventh to Eliasib, the twelfth to Jacim,
text_la: undecima Eliasib, duodecima Jacim,
text_pt: A undécima a Eliasibe, a duodécima a Jaquim,
text_el: τῷ Ελιασιβ ὁ ἑνδέκατος τῷ Ιακιμ ὁ δωδέκατος

text_en: the thirteenth to Hoppha, the fourteenth to Isbaab,
text_la: tertiadecima Hoppha, decimaquarta Isbaab,
text_pt: A décima terceira a Hupa, a décima quarta a Jesebeabe,
text_el: τῷ Οχχοφφα ὁ τρισκαιδέκατος τῷ Ισβααλ ὁ τεσσαρεσκαιδέκατος

text_en: the fifteenth to Belga, the sixteenth to Emmer,
text_la: decimaquinta Belga, decimasexta Emmer,
text_pt: A décima quinta a Bilga, a décima sexta a Imer,
text_el: τῷ Βελγα ὁ πεντεκαιδέκατος τῷ Εμμηρ ὁ ἑκκαιδέκατος

text_en: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
text_la: decimaseptima Hezir, decimaoctava Aphses,
text_pt: A décima sétima a Hezir, a décima oitava a Hapizes,
text_el: τῷ Χηζιρ ὁ ἑπτακαιδέκατος τῷ Αφεσση ὁ ὀκτωκαιδέκατος

text_en: the nineteenth to Pheteia, the twentieth to Hezechiel,
text_la: decimanona Pheteia, vigesima Hezechiel,
text_pt: A décima nona a Petaías, a vigésima a Jeezquel,
text_el: τῷ Φεταια ὁ ἐννεακαιδέκατος τῷ Εζεκηλ ὁ εἰκοστός

text_en: the one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
text_la: vigesima prima Jachin, vigesima secunda Gamul,
text_pt: A vigésima primeira a Jaquim, a vigésima segunda a Gamul,
text_el: τῷ Ιαχιν ὁ εἷς καὶ εἰκοστός τῷ Γαμουλ ὁ δεύτερος καὶ εἰκοστός

text_en: the three and twentieth to Dalaiau, the four and twentieth to Maaziau.
text_la: vigesima tertia Dalaiau, vigesima quarta Maaziau.
text_pt: A vigésima terceira a Delaías, a vigésima quarta a Maazias.
text_el: τῷ Δαλαια ὁ τρίτος καὶ εἰκοστός τῷ Μαασαι ὁ τέταρτος καὶ εἰκοστός

text_en: These are their courses according to their ministries, to come into the house of the Lord , and according to their manner under the hand of Aaron their father: as the Lord the God of Israel had commanded.
text_la: Hæ vices eorum secundum ministeria sua, ut ingrediantur domum Domini, et juxta ritum suum sub manu Aaron patris eorum, sicut præceperat Dominus Deus Israël.
text_pt: O ofício destes no seu ministério era entrar na casa do Senhor, segundo lhes fora ordenado por Arão seu pai, como o Senhor Deus de Israel lhe tinha mandado.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ ἐπίσκεψις αὐτῶν κατὰ τὴν λειτουργίαν αὐτῶν τοῦ εἰσπορεύεσθαι εἰς οἶκον κυρίου κατὰ τὴν κρίσιν αὐτῶν διὰ χειρὸς Ααρων πατρὸς αὐτῶν ὡς ἐνετείλατο κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ

text_en: Now of the rest of the sons of Levi , there was of the sons of Amram, Subael: and of the sons of Subael, Jehedeia.
text_la: Porro filiorum Levi qui reliqui fuerant, de filiis Amram erat Subaël, et de filiis Subaël, Jehedeia.
text_pt: E do restante dos filhos de Levi: dos filhos de Anrão, Subael; dos filhos de Subael, Jedias.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Λευι τοῖς καταλοίποις τοῖς υἱοῖς Αμβραμ Σουβαηλ τοῖς υἱοῖς Σουβαηλ Ιαδια

text_en: Also of the sons of Rohobia the chief Jesias.
text_la: De filiis quoque Rohobiæ, princeps Jesias.
text_pt: Quanto a Reabias: dos filhos de Reabias, Issias era o primeiro;
text_el: τῷ Ρααβια ὁ ἄρχων Ιεσιας

text_en: And the son of Isaar Salemoth, and the son of Salemoth Jahath:
text_la: Isaari vero filius Salemoth, filiusque Salemoth Jahath:
text_pt: Dos izaritas, Selomote; dos filhos de Selomote, Jaate;
text_el: καὶ τῷ Ισσαρι Σαλωμωθ τοῖς υἱοῖς Σαλωμωθ Ιαθ

text_en: And his son Jeriau the first, Amarias the second, Jahaziel the third, Jecmaan the fourth.
text_la: filiusque ejus Jeriau primus, Amarias secundus, Jahaziel tertius, Jecmaan quartus.
text_pt: E dos filhos de Hebrom, Jerias o primeiro, Amarias o segundo, Jaaziel o terceiro, Jecameão o quarto;
text_el: υἱοὶ Ιεδιου Αμαδια ὁ δεύτερος Ιαζιηλ ὁ τρίτος Ιοκομ ὁ τέταρτος

text_en: The son of Oziel, Micha: the son of Micha, Samir.
text_la: Filius Oziel, Micha : filius Micha, Samir.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Uziel, Mica; dos filhos de Mica, Samir;
text_el: υἱοὶ Οζιηλ Μιχα υἱοὶ Μιχα Σαμηρ

text_en: The brother of Micha, Jesia: and the son of Jesia, Zacharias.
text_la: Frater Micha, Jesia : filiusque Jesiæ, Zacharias.
text_pt: O irmão de Mica, Issias; dos filhos de Issias, Zacarias;
text_el: ἀδελφὸς Μιχα Ισια υἱοὶ Ισια Ζαχαρια

text_en: The sons of Merari: Moholi and Musi: the son of Oziau: Benno.
text_la: Filii Merari : Moholi, et Musi. Filius Oziau : Benno.
text_pt: Os filhos de Merari, Mali e Musi; dos filhos de Jaazias, Beno;
text_el: υἱοὶ Μεραρι Μοολι καὶ Μουσι υἱοὶ Οζια υἱοὶ Βοννι

text_en: The son also of Merari Oziau, and Soam, and Zacchur, and Hebri.
text_la: Filius quoque Merari : Oziau, et Soam, et Zachur, et Hebri.
text_pt: Os filhos de Merari: de Jaazias, Beno, e Soão, e Zacur, e Ibri;
text_el: υἱοὶ Μεραρι τῷ Οζια υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ Ισοαμ καὶ Ζακχουρ καὶ Αβδι

text_en: And the son of Moholi: Eleazar , who had no sons.
text_la: Porro Moholi filius, Eleazar, qui non habebat liberos.
text_pt: De Mali, Eleazar; e este não teve filhos.
text_el: τῷ Μοολι Ελεαζαρ καὶ Ιθαμαρ καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ελεαζαρ καὶ οὐκ ἦσαν αὐτῷ υἱοί

text_en: And the son of Cis, Jeramael.
text_la: Filius vero Cis, Jerameel.
text_pt: Quanto a Quis: dos filhos de Quis, Jerameel;
text_el: τῷ Κις υἱοὶ τοῦ Κις Ιραμαηλ

text_en: The sons of Musi: Moholi, Eder, and Jerimoth. These are the sons of Levi according to the houses of their families .
text_la: Filii Musi : Moholi, Eder et Jerimoth : isti filii Levi secundum domos familiarum suarum.
text_pt: E os filhos de Musi: Mali, e Eder, e Jerimote; estes foram os filhos dos levitas, segundo as suas casas paternas.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ τοῦ Μουσι Μοολι καὶ Εδερ καὶ Ιαριμωθ οὗτοι υἱοὶ τῶν Λευιτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν

text_en: And they also cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron before David the king, and Sadoc, and Ahimelech, and the princes of the priestly and Levitical families , both the elder and the younger. The lot divided all equally.
text_la: Miseruntque et ipsi sortes contra fratres suos filios Aaron coram David rege, et Sadoc, et Ahimelech, et principibus familiarum sacerdotalium et Leviticarum, tam majores quam minores : omnes sors æqualiter dividebat.
text_pt: Estes também lançaram sortes como seus irmãos, os filhos de Arão, perante o rei Davi, e Zadoque, e Aimeleque, e os chefes das famílias entre os sacerdotes e entre os levitas; assim fizeram, tanto os pais principais como os irmãos menores.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον καὶ αὐτοὶ κλήρους καθὼς οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν υἱοὶ Ααρων ἐναντίον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ Σαδωκ καὶ Αχιμελεχ καὶ ἀρχόντων πατριῶν τῶν ἱερέων καὶ τῶν Λευιτῶν πατριάρχαι αρααβ καθὼς οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ νεώτεροι

text_en: Moreover David and the chief officers of the army separated for the ministry the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Idithun: to prophesy with harps, and with psalteries, and with cymbals according to their number serving in their appointed office.
text_la: Igitur David et magistratus exercitus segregaverunt in ministerium filios Asaph, et Heman, et Idithun, qui prophetarent in citharis, et psalteriis, et cymbalis secundum numerum suum, dedicato sibi officio servientes.
text_pt: E Davi, juntamente com os capitães do exército, separou para o ministério os filhos de Asafe, e de Hemã, e de Jedutum, para profetizarem com harpas, com címbalos, e com saltérios; e este foi o número dos homens aptos para a obra do seu ministério:
text_el: καὶ ἔστησεν Δαυιδ ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες τῆς δυνάμεως εἰς τὰ ἔργα τοὺς υἱοὺς Ασαφ καὶ Αιμαν καὶ Ιδιθων τοὺς ἀποφθεγγομένους ἐν κινύραις καὶ ἐν νάβλαις καὶ ἐν κυμβάλοις καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν κατὰ κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν ἐργαζομένων ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτῶν

text_en: Of the sons of Asaph: Zacchur, and Joseph, and Nathania, and Asarela, sons of Asaph: under the hand of Asaph prophesying near the king.
text_la: De filiis Asaph : Zachur, et Joseph, et Nathania, et Asarela, filii Asaph : sub manu Asaph prophetantis juxta regem.
text_pt: Dos filhos de Asafe: Zacur, José, Netanias, e Asarela, filhos de Asafe; a cargo de Asafe, que profetizava debaixo das ordens do rei Davi.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ασαφ Ζακχουρ καὶ Ιωσηφ καὶ Ναθανιας καὶ Εραηλ υἱοὶ Ασαφ ἐχόμενοι Ασαφ τοῦ προφήτου ἐχόμενοι τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And of Idithun: the sons of Idithun, Godolias, Sori, Jeseias, and Hasabias, and Mathathias , under the hand of their father Idithun, who prophesied with a harp to give thanks and to praise the Lord .
text_la: Porro Idithun : filii Idithun, Godolias, Sori, Jeseias, et Hasabias, et Mathathias, sex, sub manu patris sui Idithun, qui in cithara prophetabat super confitentes et laudantes Dominum.
text_pt: Quanto a Jedutum, os filhos: Gedalias, Zeri, Jesaías, Hasabias, e Matitias, seis, a cargo de seu pai, Jedutum, o qual profetizava com a harpa, louvando e dando graças ao Senhor.
text_el: τῷ Ιδιθων υἱοὶ Ιδιθων Γοδολια καὶ Σουρι καὶ Ισαια καὶ Σεμεϊ καὶ Ασαβια καὶ Ματταθιας ἕξ μετὰ τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν Ιδιθων ἐν κινύρᾳ ἀνακρουόμενοι ἐξομολόγησιν καὶ αἴνεσιν τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: Of Heman also: the sons of Heman, Bocciau, Mathaniau, Oziel, Subuel, and Jerimoth, Hananias, Hanani, Eliatha, Geddelthi, and Romemthiezer, and Jesbacassa, Mellothi, Othir, Mahazioth:
text_la: Heman quoque : filii Heman, Bocciau, Mathaniau, Oziel, Subuel, et Jerimoth, Hananias, Hanani, Eliatha, Geddelthi, et Romemthiezer, et Jesbacassa, Mellothi, Othir, Mahazioth:
text_pt: Quanto a Hemã, os filhos: Buquias, Matanias, Uziel, Sebuel, Jerimote, Hananias, Hanani, Eliata, Gidalti, Romanti-Ezer, Josbecasa, Maloti, Hotir, e Maaziote.
text_el: τῷ Αιμανι υἱοὶ Αιμαν Βουκιας καὶ Μανθανιας καὶ Αζαραηλ καὶ Σουβαηλ καὶ Ιεριμωθ καὶ Ανανιας καὶ Ανανι καὶ Ηλιαθα καὶ Γοδολλαθι καὶ Ρωμεμθι-ωδ καὶ Ιεσβακασα καὶ Μαλληθι καὶ Ωθηρι καὶ Μεαζωθ

text_en: All these were the sons of Heman the seer of the king in the words of God , to lift up the horn: and God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
text_la: omnes isti filii Heman videntis regis in sermonibus Dei, ut exaltaret cornu : deditque Deus Heman filios quatuordecim, et filias tres.
text_pt: Todos estes foram filhos de Hemã, o vidente do rei nas palavras de Deus, para exaltar o seu poder; porque Deus dera a Hemã catorze filhos e três filhas.
text_el: πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ τῷ Αιμαν τῷ ἀνακρουομένῳ τῷ βασιλεῖ ἐν λόγοις θεοῦ ὑψῶσαι κέρας καὶ ἔδωκεν ὁ θεὸς τῷ Αιμαν υἱοὺς δέκα τέσσαρας καὶ θυγατέρας τρεῖς

text_en: All these under their father's hand were distributed to sing in the temple of the Lord , with cymbals, and psalteries and harps, for the service of the house of the Lord near the king: to wit, Asaph, and Idithun, and Heman.
text_la: Universi sub manu patris sui ad cantandum in templo Domini distributi erant, in cymbalis, et psalteriis, et citharis, in ministeria domus Domini juxta regem : Asaph videlicet, et Idithun, et Heman.
text_pt: Todos estes estavam sob a direção de seu pai, para a música da casa do Senhor, com saltérios, címbalos e harpas, para o ministério da casa de Deus; e Asafe, Jedutum, e Hemã, estavam sob as ordens do rei.
text_el: πάντες οὗτοι μετὰ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν ὑμνῳδοῦντες ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου ἐν κυμβάλοις καὶ ἐν νάβλαις καὶ ἐν κινύραις ἐχόμενα τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ Ασαφ καὶ Ιδιθων καὶ Αιμανι

text_en: And the number of them with their brethren, that taught the song of the Lord , all the teachers, were two hundred and eighty-eight.
text_la: Fuit autem numerus eorum cum fratribus suis, qui erudiebant canticum Domini, cuncti doctores, ducenti octoginta octo.
text_pt: E era o número deles, juntamente com seus irmãos instruídos no canto ao Senhor, todos eles mestres, duzentos e oitenta e oito.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν μετὰ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῶν δεδιδαγμένοι ᾄδειν κυρίῳ πᾶς συνίων διακόσιοι ὀγδοήκοντα καὶ ὀκτώ

text_en: And they cast lots by their courses, the elder equally with the younger, the learned and the unlearned together.
text_la: Miseruntque sortes per vices suas, ex æquo tam major quam minor, doctus pariter et indoctus.
text_pt: E deitaram sortes acerca da guarda igualmente, assim o pequeno como o grande, o mestre juntamente com o discípulo.
text_el: καὶ ἔβαλον καὶ αὐτοὶ κλήρους ἐφημεριῶν κατὰ τὸν μικρὸν καὶ κατὰ τὸν μέγαν τελείων καὶ μανθανόντων

text_en: And the first lot came forth to Joseph, who was of Asaph. The second to Godolias, to him and his sons, and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Egressaque est sors prima Joseph, qui erat de Asaph. Secunda Godoliæ, ipsi et filiis ejus, et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: Saiu, pois, a primeira sorte a Asafe, a saber a José; a segunda a Gedalias; e ele, e seus irmãos, e seus filhos, ao todo eram doze.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος ὁ πρῶτος υἱῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ τῷ Ασαφ τῷ Ιωσηφ Γοδολια ὁ δεύτερος Ηνια ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The third to Zachur, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Tertia Zachur, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A terceira a Zacur, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ τρίτος Ζακχουρ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The fourth to Isari, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Quarta Isari, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A quarta a Izri, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ τέταρτος Ιεσδρι υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The fifth to Nathania, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Quinta Nathaniæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A quinta a Netanias, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ πέμπτος Ναθανιας υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The sixth to Bocciau, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Sexta Bocciau, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A sexta a Buquias, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ ἕκτος Βουκιας υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The seventh to Isreela, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Septima Isreela, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A sétima a Jesarela, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ ἕβδομος Ισεριηλ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The eighth to Jesaia, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Octava Jesaiæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A oitava a Jesaías, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ ὄγδοος Ιωσια υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The ninth to Mathanaias, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Nona Mathaniæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A nona a Matanias, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ ἔνατος Μανθανιας υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The tenth to Semeias, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Decima Semeiæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A décima a Simei, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ δέκατος Σεμεϊ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The eleventh to Azareel, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Undecima Azareel, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A undécima a Azareel, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ ἑνδέκατος Αζαρια υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The twelfth to Hasabia, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Duodecima Hasabiæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A duodécima a Hasabias, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ δωδέκατος Ασαβια υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The thirteenth to Subael, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Tertiadecima Subaël, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A décima terceira a Subael, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ τρισκαιδέκατος Σουβαηλ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The fourteenth to Mathathias , to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Quartadecima Mathathiæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A décima quarta a Matitias, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ τεσσαρεσκαιδέκατος Ματταθιας υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The fifteenth to Jerimoth, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Quintadecima Jerimoth, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A décima quinta a Jeremote, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ πεντεκαιδέκατος Ιεριμωθ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The sixteenth to Hananias, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Sextadecima Hananiæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A décima sexta a Hananias, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ ἑκκαιδέκατος Ανανιας υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The seventeenth to Jesbacassa, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Septimadecima Jesbacassæ, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A décima sétima a Josbecasa, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ ἑπτακαιδέκατος Ιεσβακασα υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The eighteenth to Hanani, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Octavadecima Hanani, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A décima oitava a Hanani, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ ὀκτωκαιδέκατος Ανανι υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The nineteenth to Mellothi, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Nonadecima Mellothi, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A décima nona a Maloti, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ ἐννεακαιδέκατος Μελληθι υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The twentieth to Eliatha, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Vigesima Eliatha, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A vigésima a Eliata, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ εἰκοστὸς Ελιαθα υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The one and twentieth to Othir, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Vigesima prima Othir, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A vigésima primeira a Hotir, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ εἰκοστὸς πρῶτος Ηθιρ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The two and twentieth to Geddelthi, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Vigesima secunda Geddelthi, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A vigésima segunda a Gidalti, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ εἰκοστὸς δεύτερος Γοδολλαθι υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Vigesima tertia Mahazioth, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A vigésima terceira a Maaziote, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ τρίτος καὶ εἰκοστὸς Μεαζωθ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: The four and twentieth to Romemthiezer, to his sons and his brethren twelve.
text_la: Vigesima quarta Romemthiezer, filiis et fratribus ejus duodecim.
text_pt: A vigésima quarta a Romanti-Ezer, seus filhos, e seus irmãos, doze.
text_el: ὁ τέταρτος καὶ εἰκοστὸς Ρωμεμθι-ωδ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δέκα δύο

text_en: And the divisions of the porters: of the Corites Meselemia, the son of Core, of the sons of Asaph.
text_la: Divisiones autem janitorum : de Coritis Meselemia, filius Core, de filiis Asaph.
text_pt: Quanto às divisões dos porteiros: dos coraítas: Meselemias, filho de Coré, dos filhos de Asafe.
text_el: εἰς διαιρέσεις τῶν πυλῶν υἱοῖς Κορεϊμ Μοσολλαμια υἱὸς Κωρη ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Αβιασαφ

text_en: The sons of Meselemia: Zacharias the firstborn , Jadihel the second, Zabadias the third, Jathanael the fourth,
text_la: Filii Meselemiæ : Zacharias primogenitus, Jadihel secundus, Zabadias tertius, Jathanaël quartus,
text_pt: E foram os filhos de Meselemias: Zacarias o primogênito, Jediael o segundo, Zebadias o terceiro, Jatniel o quarto,
text_el: καὶ τῷ Μοσολλαμια υἱοί Ζαχαριας ὁ πρωτότοκος Ιδιηλ ὁ δεύτερος Ζαβαδιας ὁ τρίτος Ιεθνουηλ ὁ τέταρτος

text_en: Elam the fifth, Johanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
text_la: Ælam quintus, Johanan sextus, Elioënai septimus.
text_pt: Elão o quinto, Joanã o sexto, Elioenai o sétimo.
text_el: Ωλαμ ὁ πέμπτος Ιωαναν ὁ ἕκτος Ελιωηναι ὁ ἕβδομος

text_en: And the sons of Obededom, Semeias the firstborn , Jozabad the second, Joaha the third, Sachar the fourth, Nathanael the fifth,
text_la: Filii autem Obededom : Semeias primogenitus, Jozabad secundus, Joaha tertius, Sachar quartus, Nathanaël quintus,
text_pt: E os filhos de Obede-Edom foram: Semaías o primogênito, Jozabade o segundo, Joá o terceiro, e Sacar o quarto, e Natanael o quinto,
text_el: καὶ τῷ Αβδεδομ υἱοί Σαμαιας ὁ πρωτότοκος Ιωζαβαδ ὁ δεύτερος Ιωαα ὁ τρίτος Σωχαρ ὁ τέταρτος Ναθαναηλ ὁ πέμπτος

text_en: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Phollathi the eighth: for the Lord had blessed him.
text_la: Ammiel sextus, Issachar septimus, Phollathi octavus : quia benedixit illi Dominus.
text_pt: Amiel o sexto, Issacar o sétimo, Peuletai o oitavo; porque Deus o tinha abençoado.
text_el: Αμιηλ ὁ ἕκτος Ισσαχαρ ὁ ἕβδομος Φολλαθι ὁ ὄγδοος ὅτι εὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν ὁ θεός

text_en: And to Semei his son were born sons, heads of their families : for they were men of great valour.
text_la: Semei autem filio ejus nati sunt filii, præfecti familiarum suarum : erant enim viri fortissimi.
text_pt: Também a seu filho Semaías nasceram filhos, que dominaram sobre a casa de seu pai; porque foram homens valentes.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Σαμαια υἱῷ αὐτοῦ ἐτέχθησαν υἱοὶ τοῦ πρωτοτόκου Ρωσαι εἰς τὸν οἶκον τὸν πατρικὸν αὐτοῦ ὅτι δυνατοὶ ἦσαν

text_en: The sons then of Semeias were Othni, and Raphael, and Obed, Elizabad, and his brethren most valiant men : and Eliu, and Samachias.
text_la: Filii ergo Semeiæ : Othni, et Raphaël, et Obed, Elzabad, fratres ejus viri fortissimi : Eliu quoque et Samachias.
text_pt: Os filhos de Semaías: Otni, Rafael, Obede, e Elzabade, com seus irmãos, homens valentes, Eliú e Semaquias.
text_el: υἱοὶ Σαμαια Γοθνι καὶ Ραφαηλ καὶ Ωβηδ καὶ Ελζαβαδ καὶ Αχιου υἱοὶ δυνατοί Ελιου καὶ Σαβχια καὶ Ισβακωμ

text_en: All these of the sons of Obededom: they, and their sons, and their brethren most able men for service, sixty-two of Obededom.
text_la: Omnes hi, de filiis Obededom : ipsi, et filii et fratres eorum, fortissimi ad ministrandum, sexaginta duo de Obededom.
text_pt: Todos estes foram dos filhos de Obede-Edom; eles e seus filhos, e seus irmãos, homens valentes e de força para o ministério; ao todo sessenta e dois, de Obede-Edom.
text_el: πάντες ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Αβδεδομ αὐτοὶ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν καὶ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν ποιοῦντες δυνατῶς ἐν τῇ ἐργασίᾳ οἱ πάντες ἑξήκοντα δύο τῷ Αβδεδομ

text_en: And the sons of Meselemia, and their brethren strong men , were eighteen.
text_la: Porro Meselemiæ filii, et fratres eorum robustissimi, decem et octo.
text_pt: E os filhos e os irmãos de Meselemias, homens valentes, foram dezoito.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Μοσολλαμια υἱοὶ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ δέκα καὶ ὀκτὼ δυνατοί

text_en: And of Hosa, that is, of the sons of Merari: Semri the chief, (for he had not a firstborn , and therefore his father made him chief.)
text_la: De Hosa autem, id est, de filiis Merari : Semri princeps (non enim habuerat primogenitum, et idcirco posuerat eum pater ejus in principem),
text_pt: E de Hosa, dentre os filhos de Merari, foram filhos: Sinri o chefe (ainda que não era o primogênito, contudo seu pai o constituiu chefe),
text_el: καὶ τῷ Ωσα τῶν υἱῶν Μεραρι υἱοὶ φυλάσσοντες τὴν ἀρχήν ὅτι οὐκ ἦν πρωτότοκος καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἄρχοντα

text_en: Helcias the second, Tabelias the third, Zacharias the fourth: all these the sons, and the brethren of Hosa, were thirteen.
text_la: Helcias secundus, Tabelias tertius, Zacharias quartus : omnes hi filii et fratres Hosa, tredecim.
text_pt: Hilquias o segundo, Tebalias o terceiro, Zacarias o quarto; todos os filhos e irmãos de Hosa foram treze.
text_el: τῆς διαιρέσεως τῆς δευτέρας Ταβλαι ὁ τρίτος Ζαχαριας ὁ τέταρτος πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ καὶ ἀδελφοὶ τῷ Ωσα τρισκαίδεκα

text_en: Among these were the divisions of the porters, so that the chiefs of the wards, as well as their brethren, always ministered in the house of the Lord .
text_la: Hi divisi sunt in janitores, ut semper principes custodiarum, sicut et fratres eorum ministrarent in domo Domini.
text_pt: Destes se fizeram as turmas dos porteiros, alternando os principais dos homens da guarda, juntamente com os seus irmãos, para ministrarem na casa do Senhor.
text_el: τούτοις αἱ διαιρέσεις τῶν πυλῶν τοῖς ἄρχουσι τῶν δυνατῶν ἐφημερίαι καθὼς οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν λειτουργεῖν ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου

text_en: And they cast lots equally, both little and great, by their families for every one of the gates.
text_la: Missæ sunt ergo sortes ex æquo, et parvis et magnis, per familias suas in unamquamque portarum.
text_pt: E lançaram sortes, assim os pequenos como os grandes, segundo as casas de seus pais, para cada porta.
text_el: καὶ ἔβαλον κλήρους κατὰ τὸν μικρὸν καὶ κατὰ τὸν μέγαν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν εἰς πυλῶνα καὶ πυλῶνα

text_en: And the lot of the east fell to Selemias. But to his son Zacharias, a very wise and learned man , the north gate fell by lot.
text_la: Cecidit ergo sors orientalis, Selemiæ. Porro Zachariæ filio ejus, viro prudentissimo et erudito, sortito obtigit plaga septentrionalis.
text_pt: E caiu a sorte do oriente a Selemias; e lançou-se a sorte por seu filho Zacarias, conselheiro entendido, e saiu-lhe a do norte.
text_el: καὶ ἔπεσεν ὁ κλῆρος τῶν πρὸς ἀνατολὰς τῷ Σαλαμια καὶ Ζαχαρια υἱοὶ Ιωας τῷ Μελχια ἔβαλον κλήρους καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος βορρᾶ

text_en: And to Obededom and his sons that towards the south: in which part of the house was the council of the ancients.
text_la: Obededom vero et filiis ejus ad austrum : in qua parte domus erat seniorum concilium.
text_pt: E para Obede-Edom a do sul; e para seus filhos a casa dos depósitos.
text_el: τῷ Αβδεδομ νότον κατέναντι οἴκου εσεφιν

text_en: To Sephim, and Hosa towards the west, by the gate which leads to the way of the ascent: ward against ward.
text_la: Sephim et Hosa ad occidentem, juxta portam, quæ ducit ad viam ascensionis : custodia contra custodiam.
text_pt: Para Supim e Hosa a do ocidente, junto a porta Salequete, perto do caminho da subida; uma guarda defronte de outra guarda.
text_el: εἰς δεύτερον τῷ Ωσα πρὸς δυσμαῖς μετὰ τὴν πύλην παστοφορίου τῆς ἀναβάσεως φυλακὴ κατέναντι φυλακῆς

text_en: Now towards the east were six Levites : and towards the north four a day: and towards the south likewise four a day: and where the council was, two and two.
text_la: Ad orientem vero Levitæ sex : et ad aquilonem, quatuor per diem : atque ad meridiem similiter in die quatuor : et ubi erat concilium bini et bini.
text_pt: Ao oriente seis levitas; ao norte quatro por dia, ao sul quatro por dia, porém para as casas dos depósitos de dois em dois.
text_el: πρὸς ἀνατολὰς ἓξ τὴν ἡμέραν βορρᾶ τῆς ἡμέρας τέσσαρες νότον τῆς ἡμέρας τέσσαρες καὶ εἰς τὸ εσεφιν δύο

text_en: In the cells also of the porters toward the west four in the way: and two at every cell.
text_la: In cellulis quoque janitorum ad occidentem quatuor in via, binique per cellulas.
text_pt: Em Parbar, ao ocidente, quatro junto ao caminho, e dois junto a Parbar.
text_el: εἰς διαδεχομένους καὶ πρὸς δυσμαῖς τέσσαρες καὶ εἰς τὸν τρίβον δύο διαδεχομένους

text_en: These are the divisions of the porters of the sons of Core, and of Merari.
text_la: Hæ sunt divisiones janitorum filiorum Core et Merari.
text_pt: Estas são as turmas dos porteiros dentre os filhos dos coraítas, e dentre os filhos de Merari.
text_el: αὗται αἱ διαιρέσεις τῶν πυλωρῶν τοῖς υἱοῖς Κορε καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Μεραρι

text_en: Now Achias was over the treasures of the house of God , and the holy vessels.
text_la: Porro Achias erat super thesauros domus Dei, et vasa sanctorum.
text_pt: E dos levitas: Aías tinha cargo dos tesouros da casa de Deus e dos tesouros das coisas sagradas.
text_el: καὶ οἱ Λευῖται ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τῶν θησαυρῶν οἴκου κυρίου καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν θησαυρῶν τῶν καθηγιασμένων

text_en: The sons of Ledan, the sons of Gersonni: of Ledan were heads of the families , of Ledan, and Gersonni, Jehieli.
text_la: Filii Ledan, filii Gersonni : de Ledan principes familiarum Ledan, et Gersonni, Jehieli.
text_pt: Quanto aos filhos de Ladã, os filhos dos gersonitas que pertencem a Ladã, chefes das casas paternas de Ladã: Jeieli.
text_el: υἱοὶ Λαδαν υἱοὶ τῷ Γηρσωνι τῷ Λαδαν ἄρχοντες πατριῶν τῷ Λαδαν τῷ Γηρσωνι Ιιηλ

text_en: The sons of Jehieli: Zathan and Joel, his brethren over the treasures of the house of the Lord ,
text_la: Filii Jehieli : Zathan, et Joël fratres ejus super thesauros domus Domini.
text_pt: Os filhos de Jeieli: Zetã e Joel, seu irmão; estes tinham cargo dos tesouros da casa do Senhor,
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιιηλ Ζεθομ καὶ Ιωηλ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἐπὶ τῶν θησαυρῶν οἴκου κυρίου

text_en: with the Amramites, and Isaarites, and Hebronites , and Ozielites.
text_la: Amramitis, et Isaaritis, et Hebronitis, et Ozihelitis.
text_pt: Dos anramitas, dos izaritas, dos hebronitas, dos uzielitas.
text_el: τῷ Αμβραμ καὶ Ισσααρ Χεβρων καὶ Οζιηλ

text_en: And Subael the son of Gersom, the son of Moses , was chief over the treasures.
text_la: Subaël autem filius Gersom filii Moysi, præpositus thesauris.
text_pt: E Sebuel, filho de Gérson, o filho de Moisés, era o chefe dos tesouros.
text_el: καὶ Σουβαηλ ὁ τοῦ Γηρσαμ τοῦ Μωυσῆ ἡγούμενος ἐπὶ τῶν θησαυρῶν

text_en: His brethren also, Eliezer, whose son Rohobia, and his son Isaias, and his son Joram, and his son Zechri, and his son Selemith.
text_la: Fratres quoque ejus Eliezer, cujus filius Rahabia, et hujus filius Isaias, et hujus filius Joram, hujus quoque filius Zechri, et hujus filius Selemith.
text_pt: E seus irmãos foram, do lado de Eliézer, Reabias seu filho, e Jesaías seu filho, e Jorão seu filho, e Zicri seu filho, e Selomite, seu filho.
text_el: καὶ τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ τῷ Ελιεζερ Ρααβιας υἱὸς καὶ Ιωσαιας καὶ Ιωραμ καὶ Ζεχρι καὶ Σαλωμωθ

text_en: Which Selemith and his brethren were over the treasures of the holy things, which King David , and the heads of families , and the captains over thousands and over hundreds , and the captains of the host had dedicated ,
text_la: Ipse Selemith, et fratres ejus, super thesauros sanctorum quæ sanctificavit David rex, et principes familiarum, et tribuni, et centuriones, et duces exercitus,
text_pt: Este Selomite e seus irmãos tinham a seu cargo todos os tesouros das coisas dedicadas que o rei Davi e os chefes das casas paternas, capitães de milhares, e de centenas, e capitães do exército tinham consagrado.
text_el: αὐτὸς Σαλωμωθ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πάντων τῶν θησαυρῶν τῶν ἁγίων οὓς ἡγίασεν Δαυιδ ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν χιλίαρχοι καὶ ἑκατόνταρχοι καὶ ἀρχηγοὶ τῆς δυνάμεως

text_en: out of the wars, and the spoils won in battles, which they had consecrated to the building and furniture of the temple of the Lord .
text_la: de bellis et manubiis præliorum, quæ consecraverant ad instaurationem et supellectilem templi Domini.
text_pt: Dos despojos das guerras dedicaram ofertas para repararem a casa do Senhor.
text_el: ἃ ἔλαβεν ἐκ τῶν πολέμων καὶ ἐκ τῶν λαφύρων καὶ ἡγίασεν ἀπ' αὐτῶν τοῦ μὴ καθυστερῆσαι τὴν οἰκοδομὴν τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And all these things that Samuel the seer and Saul the son of Cis, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Sarvia had sanctified : and whosoever had sanctified those things, they were under the hand of Selemith and his brethren.
text_la: Hæc autem universa sanctificavit Samuel videns, et Saul filius Cis, et Abner filius Ner, et Joab filius Sarviæ : omnes qui sanctificaverant ea per manum Selemith et fratrum ejus.
text_pt: Como também tudo quanto tinha consagrado Samuel, o vidente, e Saul filho de Quis, e Abner filho de Ner, e Joabe filho de Zeruia; tudo que qualquer havia dedicado estava debaixo da mão de Selomite e seus irmãos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων Σαμουηλ τοῦ προφήτου καὶ Σαουλ τοῦ Κις καὶ Αβεννηρ τοῦ Νηρ καὶ Ιωαβ τοῦ Σαρουια πᾶν ὃ ἡγίασαν διὰ χειρὸς Σαλωμωθ καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: But Chonenias and his sons were over the Isaarites, for the business abroad over Israel to teach them and judge them.
text_la: Isaaritis vero præerat Chonenias, et filii ejus ad opera forinsecus super Israël ad docendum et judicandum eos.
text_pt: Dos izaritas, Quenanias e seus filhos foram postos sobre Israel como oficiais e como juízes, dos negócios externos.
text_el: τῷ Ισσαρι Χωνενια καὶ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ τῆς ἐργασίας τῆς ἔξω ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ τοῦ γραμματεύειν καὶ διακρίνειν

text_en: And of the Hebronites Hasabias, and his brethren most able men , a thousand seven hundred had the charge over Israel beyond the Jordan westward, in all the works of the Lord , and for the service of the king.
text_la: Porro de Hebronitis Hasabias, et fratres ejus viri fortissimi, mille septingenti præerant Israëli trans Jordanem contra occidentem, in cunctis operibus Domini, et in ministerium regis.
text_pt: Dos hebronitas foram Hasabias e seus irmãos, homens valentes, mil e setecentos, que tinham a superintendência sobre Israel, além do Jordão para o ocidente, em toda a obra do Senhor, e para o serviço do rei.
text_el: τῷ Χεβρωνι Ασαβιας καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ υἱοὶ δυνατοί χίλιοι καὶ ἑπτακόσιοι ἐπὶ τῆς ἐπισκέψεως τοῦ Ισραηλ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου πρὸς δυσμαῖς εἰς πᾶσαν λειτουργίαν κυρίου καὶ ἐργασίαν τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And the chief of the Hebronites was Jeria according to their families and kindreds. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were numbered, and there were found most valiant men in Jazer Galaad,
text_la: Hebronitarum autem princeps fuit Jeria secundum familias et cognationes eorum. Quadragesimo anno regni David recensiti sunt, et inventi sunt viri fortissimi in Jazer Galaad,
text_pt: Dos hebronitas Jerias era o chefe, segundo as suas gerações conforme as suas famílias. No ano quarenta do reino de Davi se buscaram e acharam entre eles homens valentes em Jazer de Gileade.
text_el: τοῦ Χεβρωνι Ιουδιας ὁ ἄρχων τῶν Χεβρωνι κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν κατὰ πατριάς ἐν τῷ τεσσαρακοστῷ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ ἐπεσκέπησαν καὶ εὑρέθη ἀνὴρ δυνατὸς ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐν Ιαζηρ τῆς Γαλααδίτιδος

text_en: and his brethren of stronger age, two thousand seven hundred chiefs of families . And King David made them rulers over the Rubenites and the Gadites , and the half tribe of Manasses , for all the service of God , and the king.
text_la: fratresque ejus robustioris ætatis, duo millia septingenti principes familiarum. Præposuit autem eos David rex Rubenitis, et Gadditis, et dimidiæ tribui Manasse, in omne ministerium Dei et regis.
text_pt: E seus irmãos, homens valentes, dois mil e setecentos, chefes dos pais; e o rei Davi os constituiu sobre os rubenitas e os gaditas, e a meia tribo dos manassitas, para todos os negócios de Deus, e para todos os negócios do rei.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ υἱοὶ δυνατοί δισχίλιοι ἑπτακόσιοι ἄρχοντες πατριῶν καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτοὺς Δαυιδ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐπὶ τοῦ Ρουβηνι καὶ Γαδδι καὶ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασση εἰς πᾶν πρόσταγμα κυρίου καὶ λόγον βασιλέως

text_en: Now the children of Israel according to their number, the heads of families , captains of thousands and of hundreds , and officers, that served the king according to their companies, who came in and went out every month in the year, under every chief were four and twenty thousand.
text_la: Filii autem Israël secundum numerum suum, principes familiarum, tribuni, et centuriones, et præfecti, qui ministrabant regi juxta turmas suas, ingredientes et egredientes per singulos menses in anno, viginti quatuor millibus singuli præerant.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Israel segundo o seu número, os chefes dos pais, e os capitães dos milhares e das centenas, com os seus oficiais, que serviam ao rei em todos os negócios das turmas que entravam e saíam de mês em mês, em todos os meses do ano; cada turma de vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ κατ' ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν χιλίαρχοι καὶ ἑκατόνταρχοι καὶ γραμματεῖς οἱ λειτουργοῦντες τῷ λαῷ καὶ εἰς πᾶν λόγον τοῦ βασιλέως κατὰ διαιρέσεις εἰς πᾶν λόγον τοῦ εἰσπορευομένου καὶ ἐκπορευομένου μῆνα ἐκ μηνὸς εἰς πάντας τοὺς μῆνας τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ διαίρεσις μία εἴκοσι καὶ τέσσαρες χιλιάδες

text_en: Over the first company the first month Jesboam, the son of Zabdiel was chief, and under him were four and twenty thousand.
text_la: Primæ turmæ in primo mense Jesboam præerat filius Zabdiel, et sub eo viginti quatuor millia;
text_pt: Sobre a primeira turma do primeiro mês estava Jasobeão, filho de Zabdiel; e em sua turma havia vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως τῆς πρώτης τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου Ιεσβοαμ ὁ τοῦ Ζαβδιηλ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως αὐτοῦ εἴκοσι καὶ τέσσαρες χιλιάδες

text_en: Of the sons of Phares, the chief of all the captains in the host in the first month.
text_la: de filiis Phares, princeps cunctorum principum in exercitu mense primo.
text_pt: Era este dos filhos de Perez, chefe de todos os capitães dos exércitos, para o primeiro mês,
text_el: ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Φαρες ἄρχων πάντων τῶν ἀρχόντων τῆς δυνάμεως τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου

text_en: The company of the second month was under Dudia, an Ahohite, and after him was another named Macelloth, who commanded a part of the army of four and twenty thousand.
text_la: Secundi mensis habebat turmam Dudia Ahohites, et post se alter nomine Macelloth, qui regebat partem exercitus viginti quatuor millium.
text_pt: E sobre a turma do segundo mês estava Dodai, o aoíta, com a sua turma, cujo líder era Miclote; também em sua turma havia vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ δευτέρου Δωδια ὁ Εχωχι καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως αὐτοῦ εἴκοσι καὶ τέσσαρες χιλιάδες ἄρχοντες δυνάμεως

text_en: And the captain of the third company for the third month, was Banaias the son of Joiada the priest : and in his division were four and twenty thousand.
text_la: Dux quoque turmæ tertiæ in mense tertio erat Banaias filius Jojadæ sacerdos: et in divisione sua viginti quatuor millia.
text_pt: O terceiro capitão do exército, para o terceiro mês, era Benaia, filho de Joiada, chefe dos sacerdotes; também em sua turma havia vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: ὁ τρίτος τὸν μῆνα τὸν τρίτον Βαναιας ὁ τοῦ Ιωδαε ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ ἄρχων καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως αὐτοῦ τέσσαρες καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες

text_en: This is that Banaias the most valiant among the thirty, and above the thirty. And Amizabad his son commanded his company.
text_la: Ipse est Banaias fortissimus inter triginta, et super triginta : præerat autem turmæ ipsius Amizabad filius ejus.
text_pt: Era este Benaia valente entre os trinta, e sobre os trinta; e na sua turma estava Amizabade, seu filho.
text_el: αὐτὸς Βαναιας δυνατώτερος τῶν τριάκοντα καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν τριάκοντα καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως αὐτοῦ Αμιζαβαθ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zabadias his son after him: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
text_la: Quartus, mense quarto, Asahel frater Joab, et Zabadias filius ejus post eum : et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
text_pt: O quarto, do quarto mês, era Asael, irmão de Joabe, e depois dele Zebadias, seu filho; também em sua turma havia vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: ὁ τέταρτος εἰς τὸν μῆνα τὸν τέταρτον Ασαηλ ὁ ἀδελφὸς Ιωαβ καὶ Ζαβδιας ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως αὐτοῦ τέσσαρες καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες

text_en: The fifth captain for the fifth month, was Samaoth a Jezerite: and his company were four and twenty thousand.
text_la: Quintus, mense quinto, princeps Samaoth Jezerites : et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
text_pt: O quinto, do quinto mês, Samute, o israíta; também em sua turma havia vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: ὁ πέμπτος τῷ μηνὶ τῷ πέμπτῳ ὁ ἡγούμενος Σαμαωθ ὁ Ιεσραε καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως αὐτοῦ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες χιλιάδες

text_en: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Hira the son of Acces a Thecuite: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
text_la: Sextus, mense sexto, Hira filius Acces Thecuites : et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
text_pt: O sexto, do sexto mês, Ira, filho de Iques, o tecoíta; também em sua turma havia vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: ὁ ἕκτος τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἕκτῳ Οδουιας ὁ τοῦ Εκκης ὁ Θεκωίτης καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως αὐτοῦ τέσσαρες καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες

text_en: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helles a Phallonite of the sons of Ephraim: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
text_la: Septimus, mense septimo, Helles Phallonites de filiis Ephraim : et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
text_pt: O sétimo, do sétimo mês, Helez, o pelonita, dos filhos de Efraim; também em sua turma havia vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: ὁ ἕβδομος τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἑβδόμῳ Χελλης ὁ ἐκ Φαλλους ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Εφραιμ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως αὐτοῦ τέσσαρες καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες

text_en: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sobochai a Husathite of the race of Zarahi: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
text_la: Octavus, mense octavo, Sobochai Husathites de stirpe Zarahi : et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
text_pt: O oitavo, do oitavo mês, Sibecai, o husatita, dos zeraítas; também em sua turma havia vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: ὁ ὄγδοος τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ὀγδόῳ Σοβοχαι ὁ Ισαθι τῷ Ζαραϊ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως αὐτοῦ τέσσαρες καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες

text_en: The ninth, for the ninth month, was Abiezer an Anathothite of the sons of Jemini, and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
text_la: Nonus, mense nono, Abiezer Anathothites de filiis Jemini : et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
text_pt: O nono, do nono mês, Abiezer, o anatotita, dos benjamitas; também em sua turma havia vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: ὁ ἔνατος τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἐνάτῳ Αβιεζερ ὁ ἐξ Αναθωθ ἐκ γῆς Βενιαμιν καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως αὐτοῦ τέσσαρες καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες

text_en: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Marai, who was a Netophathite of the race of Zarai: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
text_la: Decimus, mense decimo, Marai, et ipse Netophathites de stirpe Zarai : et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
text_pt: O décimo, do décimo mês, Maarai, o netofatita, dos zeraítas; também em sua turma havia vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: ὁ δέκατος τῷ μηνὶ τῷ δεκάτῳ Μεηρα ὁ ἐκ Νετουφατ τῷ Ζαραϊ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως αὐτοῦ τέσσαρες καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες

text_en: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Banaias , a Pharathonite of the sons of Ephraim: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
text_la: Undecimus, mense undecimo, Banaias Pharathonites de filiis Ephraim : et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
text_pt: O undécimo, do undécimo mês, Benaia, o piratonita, dos filhos de Efraim; também em sua turma havia vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: ὁ ἑνδέκατος τῷ μηνὶ τῷ ἑνδεκάτῳ Βαναιας ὁ ἐκ Φαραθων τῶν υἱῶν Εφραιμ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως αὐτοῦ τέσσαρες καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες

text_en: The twelfth, for the twelfth month, was Holdai a Netophathite, of the race of Gothoniel: and in his company were four and twenty thousand.
text_la: Duodecimus, mense duodecimo, Holdai Netophathites, de stirpe Gothoniel : et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
text_pt: O duodécimo, do duodécimo mês, Heldai, o netofatita, de Otniel; também em sua turma havia vinte e quatro mil.
text_el: ὁ δωδέκατος εἰς τὸν μῆνα τὸν δωδέκατον Χολδαι ὁ Νετωφατι τῷ Γοθονιηλ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαιρέσεως αὐτοῦ τέσσαρες καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες

text_en: Now the chiefs over the tribes of Israel were these: over the Rubenites , Eliezer the son of Zechri was ruler: over the Simeonites , Saphatias the son of Maacha:
text_la: Porro tribubus præerant Israël, Rubenitis, dux Eliezer filius Zechri : Simeonitis, dux Saphatias filius Maacha:
text_pt: Sobre as tribos de Israel estavam: sobre os rubenitas era líder Eliezer, filho de Zicri; sobre os simeonitas, Sefatias, filho de Maaca.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν φυλῶν Ισραηλ τῷ Ρουβην ἡγούμενος Ελιεζερ ὁ τοῦ Ζεχρι τῷ Συμεων Σαφατιας ὁ τοῦ Μααχα

text_en: Over the Levites , Hasabias the son of Camuel: over the Aaronites, Sadoc:
text_la: Levitis, Hasabias filius Camuel : Aaronitis, Sadoc:
text_pt: Sobre os levitas, Hasabias, filho de Quemuel; sobre os aronitas, Zadoque;
text_el: τῷ Λευι Ασαβιας ὁ τοῦ Καμουηλ τῷ Ααρων Σαδωκ

text_en: Over Juda , Eliu the brother of David over Issachar , Amri the son of Michael:
text_la: Juda, Eliu frater David : Issachar, Amri filius Michaël.
text_pt: Sobre Judá, Eliú, dos irmãos de Davi; sobre Issacar, Onri, filho de Micael;
text_el: τῷ Ιουδα Ελιαβ τῶν ἀδελφῶν Δαυιδ τῷ Ισσαχαρ Αμβρι ὁ τοῦ Μιχαηλ

text_en: Over the Zabulonites , Jesmaias the son of Adias: over the Nephtalites , Jerimoth the son of Ozriel:
text_la: Zabulonitis, Jesmaias filius Abdiæ : Nephthalitibus, Jerimoth filius Ozriel:
text_pt: Sobre Zebulom, Ismaías, filho de Obadias; sobre Naftali, Jerimote, filho de Azriel;
text_el: τῷ Ζαβουλων Σαμαιας ὁ τοῦ Αβδιου τῷ Νεφθαλι Ιεριμωθ ὁ τοῦ Εσριηλ

text_en: Over the sons of Ephraim, Osee the son of Ozaziu: over the half tribe of Manasses , Joel the son of Phadaia:
text_la: filiis Ephraim, Osee filius Ozaziu : dimidiæ tribui Manasse, Joël filius Phadaiæ:
text_pt: Sobre os filhos de Efraim, Oséias, filho de Azazias; sobre a meia tribo de Manassés, Joel, filho de Pedaías;
text_el: τῷ Εφραιμ Ωση ὁ τοῦ Οζιου τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασση Ιωηλ ὁ τοῦ Φαδαια

text_en: And over the half tribe of Manasses in Galaad, Jaddo the son of Zacharias: and over Benjamin , Jasiel the son of Abner .
text_la: et dimidiæ tribui Manasse in Galaad, Jaddo filius Zachariæ : Benjamin autem, Jasiel filius Abner:
text_pt: Sobre a outra meia tribo de Manassés em Gileade, Ido, filho de Zacarias; sobre Benjamim, Jaasiel, filho de Abner;
text_el: τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασση τῷ ἐν τῇ Γαλααδ Ιαδδαι ὁ τοῦ Ζαβδιου τοῖς υἱοῖς Βενιαμιν Ασιηλ ὁ τοῦ Αβεννηρ

text_en: And over Dan , Ezrihel the son of Jeroham: these were the princes of the children of Israel .
text_la: Dan vero, Ezrihel filius Jeroham : hi principes filiorum Israël.
text_pt: Sobre Dã, Azarel, filho de Jeroão. Estes eram os príncipes das tribos de Israel.
text_el: τῷ Δαν Αζαραηλ ὁ τοῦ Ιωραμ οὗτοι πατριάρχαι τῶν φυλῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: But David would not number them from twenty years old and under: because the lord had said that he would multiply Israel like the stars of heaven .
text_la: Noluit autem David numerare eos a viginti annis inferius : quia dixerat Dominus ut multiplicaret Israël quasi stellas cæli.
text_pt: Não tomou, porém, Davi o número dos de vinte anos para baixo, porquanto o Senhor tinha falado que havia de multiplicar a Israel como as estrelas do céu.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔλαβεν Δαυιδ τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν ἀπὸ εἰκοσαετοῦς καὶ κάτω ὅτι κύριος εἶπεν πληθῦναι τὸν Ισραηλ ὡς τοὺς ἀστέρας τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: Joab the son of Sarvia began to number, but he finished not: because upon this there fell wrath upon Israel : and therefore the number of them that were numbered, was not registered in the chronicles of King David .
text_la: Joab filius Sarviæ cœperat numerare, nec complevit : quia super hoc ira irruerat in Israël, et idcirco numerus eorum qui fuerant recensiti, non est relatus in fastos regis David.
text_pt: Joabe, filho de Zeruia, tinha começado a numerá-los, porém não acabou; porquanto viera por isso grande ira sobre Israel; assim o número não se pôs no registro das crônicas do rei Davi.
text_el: καὶ Ιωαβ ὁ τοῦ Σαρουια ἤρξατο ἀριθμεῖν ἐν τῷ λαῷ καὶ οὐ συνετέλεσεν καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τούτοις ὀργὴ ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ καὶ οὐ κατεχωρίσθη ὁ ἀριθμὸς ἐν βιβλίῳ λόγων τῶν ἡμερῶν τοῦ βασιλέως Δαυιδ

text_en: And over the king's treasures was Azmoth the son of Adiel: and over those stores which were in the cities, and in the villages , and, in the castles, was Jonathan the son of Ozias .
text_la: Super thesauros autem regis fuit Azmoth filius Adiel : his autem thesauris, qui erant in urbibus, et in vicis, et in turribus, præsidebat Jonathan filius Oziæ.
text_pt: E sobre os tesouros do rei estava Azmavete, filho de Adiel; e sobre os tesouros dos campos, das cidades, e das aldeias, e das torres, Jônatas, filho de Uzias.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν θησαυρῶν τοῦ βασιλέως Ασμωθ ὁ τοῦ Ωδιηλ καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν θησαυρῶν τῶν ἐν ἀγρῷ καὶ ἐν ταῖς κώμαις καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐποικίοις καὶ ἐν τοῖς πύργοις Ιωναθαν ὁ τοῦ Οζιου

text_en: And over the tillage, and the husbandmen, who tilled the ground, was Ezri the son of Chelub:
text_la: Operi autem rustico, et agricolis qui exercebant terram, præerat Ezri filius Chelub:
text_pt: E sobre os que faziam a obra do campo, na lavoura da terra, Ezri, filho de Quelube.
text_el: ἐπὶ δὲ τῶν γεωργούντων τὴν γῆν τῶν ἐργαζομένων Εσδρι ὁ τοῦ Χολουβ

text_en: And over the dressers of the vine yards, was Semeias a Romathite: and over the wine cellars, Zabdias an Aphonite.
text_la: vinearumque cultoribus, Semeias Romathites : cellis autem vinariis, Zabdias Aphonites.
text_pt: E sobre as vinhas, Simei, o ramatita; porém sobre o que das vides entrava nas adegas do vinho, Zabdi, o sifmita.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν χωρίων Σεμεϊ ὁ ἐκ Ραμα καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν θησαυρῶν τῶν ἐν τοῖς χωρίοις τοῦ οἴνου Ζαχρι ὁ τοῦ Σεφνι

text_en: And over the oliveyards and the fig groves, which were in the plains, was Balanam a Gederite: and over the oil cellars, Joas.
text_la: Nam super oliveta et ficeta quæ erant in campestribus, Balanam Gederites : super apothecas autem olei, Joas.
text_pt: E sobre os olivais e sicômoros que havia nas campinas, Baal-Hanã, o gederita; porém Joás sobre os armazéns do azeite.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ἐλαιώνων καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν συκαμίνων τῶν ἐν τῇ πεδινῇ Βαλανας ὁ Γεδωρίτης ἐπὶ δὲ τῶν θησαυρῶν τοῦ ἐλαίου Ιωας

text_en: And over the herds that fed in Saron, was Setrai a Saronite: and over the oxen in the valleys, Saphat the son of Adli:
text_la: Porro armentis quæ pascebantur in Saron, præpositus fuit Setrai Saronites : et super boves in vallibus, Saphat filius Adli:
text_pt: E sobre os gados que pastavam em Sarom, Sitrai, o saronita; porém, sobre os gados dos vales, Safate, filho de Adlai.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν βοῶν τῶν νομάδων τῶν ἐν τῷ Ασιδων Σατραις ὁ Σαρωνίτης καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν βοῶν τῶν ἐν τοῖς αὐλῶσιν Σωφατ ὁ τοῦ Αδλι

text_en: And over the camels, Ubil an Ishmahelite and over the asses, Jadias a Meronathite:
text_la: super camelos vero, Ubil Ismahelites : et super asinos, Jadias Meronathites:
text_pt: E sobre os camelos, Obil, o ismaelita; e sobre as jumentas, Jedias, o meronotita.
text_el: ἐπὶ δὲ τῶν καμήλων Ωβιλ ὁ Ισμαηλίτης ἐπὶ δὲ τῶν ὄνων Ιαδιας ὁ ἐκ Μεραθων

text_en: And over the sheep Jaziz an Agarene. All these were the rulers of the substance of King David .
text_la: super oves quoque, Jaziz Agareus : omnes hi, principes substantiæ regis David.
text_pt: E sobre o gado miúdo, Jaziz, o hagrita; todos esses eram administradores da fazenda que tinha o rei Davi.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν προβάτων Ιαζιζ ὁ Αγαρίτης πάντες οὗτοι προστάται ὑπαρχόντων Δαυιδ τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And Jonathan David's uncle, a counsellor, a wise and learned man : he and Jahiel the son of Hachamoni were with the king's sons.
text_la: Jonathan autem patruus David, consiliarius, vir prudens et litteratus : ipse et Jahiel filius Hachamoni erant cum filiis regis.
text_pt: E Jônatas, tio de Davi, era do conselho, homem entendido, e também escriba; e Jeiel, filho de Hacmoni, estava com os filhos do rei.
text_el: καὶ Ιωναθαν ὁ πατράδελφος Δαυιδ σύμβουλος ἄνθρωπος συνετὸς καὶ γραμματεὺς αὐτός καὶ Ιιηλ ὁ τοῦ Αχαμανι μετὰ τῶν υἱῶν τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And Achitophel was the king's counsellor, and
text_la: Achitophel etiam consiliarius regis, et Chusai Arachites amicus regis.
text_pt: E Aitofel era do conselho do rei; e Husai, o arquita, amigo do rei.
text_el: καὶ Αχιτοφελ σύμβουλος τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ Χουσι πρῶτος φίλος τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And after Achitophel was Joiada the son of Banaias , and Abiathar . And the general of the king's army was Joab.
text_la: Post Achitophel fuit Jojada filius Banaiæ, et Abiathar. Princeps autem exercitus regis erat Joab.
text_pt: E depois de Aitofel, Joiada, filho de Benaia, e Abiatar; porém Joabe era o general do exército do rei.
